jobs.title: VP of Policy and Communications
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health operates in 42 states, serving some of the highest-acuity behavioral health patients in the country, many of them on Medicaid. The policy outcomes that matter to us are decided in Washington, in statehouses and Medicaid agencies, and in the media. We are building a public affairs operation that runs like a campaign, and this role leads it.

The VP, Policy and Communications owns Charlie Health’s federal and state/local public affairs and corporate communications. You will set the strategy, build and lead the team, and be accountable for outcomes across proactive and reactive regulatory campaigns, coalition building, earned and paid media, and company reputation. We are looking for someone who works the seam between policy and communications: who can read a proposed rule in the morning, brief a coalition partner at lunch, and shape the story a reporter files that evening. You will report to the President and work closely with legal, compliance, clinical, and growth leaders. This role suits someone who sees a problem early, takes it on without being asked, and moves quickly while exercising sound judgment on high-stakes decisions.

We’re a team of passionate, forward-thinking professionals eager to take on the challenge of the mental health crisis and play a formative role in providing life-saving solutions. If you’re inspired by our mission and energized by the opportunity to increase access to mental healthcare and impact millions of lives in a profound way, apply today.

Responsibilities

• Own the integrated strategy: set and run a single public affairs and communications strategy across federal, state/local, and corporate audiences, with clear priorities, tradeoffs, and measures of success

• Lead federal advocacy: define and advance our positions on federal policy affecting virtual behavioral health care, such as telehealth, Medicaid, and parity, and build relationships with Congress, agencies, and trade associations directly and alongside the CEO, President and Chief Clinical Officer.

• Run state and local campaigns end to end: set the objective, map who decides and who influences them, sequence tactics, and be accountable for results in a portfolio of priority states

• Direct lobbyists and consultants: manage federal, state, and local lobbyists and public affairs firms, point them at the right targets, and hold them accountable for real work

• Build relationships early: get in front of elected officials, regulators, and payers before we need them, so we are never introducing ourselves in the middle of a fight

• Lead corporate and crisis communications: own company messaging, media strategy, and rapid response, including preparedness for patient safety and reputational issues, in close partnership with legal and clinical leaders

• Drive earned and paid media and grassroots activation: design and run programs that build pressure and shape the story, including national and local story placement

• Build coalitions and a validator network: recruit and prepare allies, patient and family voices, and national and community organizations, and put them in the right rooms at the right moments

• Build and lead the team: hire, develop, and set the operating rhythm for a high-performing public affairs and communications team

• Advise the CEO, President and executive team: translate policy and reputation risk into clear business tradeoffs and recommendations

Requirements

• 12+ years in public affairs, government relations, political campaigns, and policy communications, including 5+ years leading teams and experience being accountable for outcomes at the executive or senior leadership level

• Experience running both federal and state-level advocacy, with fluency in how policy gets made at each level

• Background in a highly regulated or politically contested industry, such as healthcare, health insurance, energy, data centers, labor, or similar

• Track record managing lobbyists and external consultants and getting real work out of them

• Demonstrated crisis and reputation management experience, including making decisions quickly under pressure with incomplete information

• Sound strategic judgment: the ability to set priorities, make tradeoffs, and explain the reasoning to a CEO, a board, or a skeptical legislator

• A strong sense of ownership: you take responsibility for outcomes, own your mistakes, and act without waiting to be asked

• Exceptional communication skills: a strong writer and speaker who can move from a comment letter to a coalition one-pager to a reporter pitch in the same day and adapt the message to each audience

• No hard line between government relations and communications in how you work; the best practitioners do both

• Comfortable building without a clear precedent and operating with a high degree of independence

• Willingness to travel frequently for key events and milestones

Benefits

Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

The total target base compensation for this role will be between $200,000 and $250,000 per year at the commencement of employment. jobs.title: Senior AI Development Lead
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

We're the AI & ML Enablement team in Supply Tech. Teams across Airbnb come to us when they want AI to take over a process, or to ship an AI feature they can trust. We're helping business and field teams use AI to take on high volume-low value tasks, and helping product teams understand whether an AI feature works before it reaches our users. Day to day, we move manual review processes to AI and put people where their judgment matters most. We design new workflows so AI does the work from the start. We also build the labeled datasets that show whether the AI is right, and we keep everything running as models and policies change. Our methods and projects change as the models do, and we expect the scope of this role to grow with them.

The Difference You Will Make

You'd work with whichever team has a problem AI could take on, whether that's a business team with a process that's slow, expensive or inconsistent, or a product team getting an AI feature ready to launch. The job looks much the same either way. You start with how the work really gets done, build an AI version of it, and test it until you trust the results. Then you graduate it and use what worked on the next problem. The mix of projects will keep changing as AI takes on more of the work, so we care more about how you work than about a fixed list of projects. This is a hands-on role. You design and build the workflow, prove it works with data, and ship it with engineering and product.

A Typical Day

• Drive the AI workflows and features we support from design to launch, defining the quality bar and measurement plan with engineering, product and business partners.

• Prioritize projects by business impact, making trade-offs in partnership with your manager and the business and product leads you support.

• Sit with the team that owns a problem, map how the work gets done today, and work out how AI can do it and where people step in for the hard cases.

• Design and build AI workflows: write the prompts when needed, set up the pipeline and tooling, and monitor quality and drift once it's live.

• Design the evaluation framework: build test sets, define accuracy and agreement metrics, and calibrate LLM judges against human reviewers.

• Work with engineers on architecture and tooling decisions, and pressure-test estimates and scope.

• Turn unclear guidelines into criteria a reviewer can apply consistently, working with product, Legal and Policy.

• Work with subject matter experts to write labeling guidelines and produce human-verified labels on real data.

• Run labeling at scale with vendor labeling teams, and check their work against agreement metrics and your own spot checks.

• Work with product teams early to agree on what "good enough to launch" means for an AI feature, and bring the evidence and a recommendation for the go/no-go decision.

• Build reusable evaluation and workflow components, document what you learn, and get other teams using them so the next team gets to production faster.

• Keep our methods current as models, tools and policies change, and recommend what to retire when it stops working.

Your Expertise

• 8+ years in product or program management, analytics, consulting or applied AI, with a proven record of taking technical programs from idea to production and owning results such as backlog, cycle time or launch speed among others.

• You're strong in SQL and in the statistics of quality: accuracy, precision and recall, sampling and reviewer agreement. You pull and analyze the data yourself instead of waiting for a report.

• You’ve shipped something built on AI that other people rely on, such as a workflow, an agent or an automation, and you can show the before-and-after numbers. You can tell us where it failed and what you changed.

• You're technically fluent enough to pressure-test an engineering estimate, understand how prompts, pipelines and evaluations fit together, and know when a workaround is the right call.

• You're curious about how work actually gets done, including the awkward exceptions, and you've taken a messy process and made it measurable. You state the desired result first and measure success in business outcomes, not features shipped.

• You have good judgment on quality. You can take messy qualitative feedback, such as reviewer comments or disagreements, and boil it down to what matters and what is worth changing.

• You write clearly and can work with sales, operations, PMs and engineers in the same week, getting results through people you don't manage.

• You're fine being the first person on a problem, and you try things yourself instead of waiting for someone to build them.

Nice to have

• Hands-on Python and API experience, such as scripting data pulls, calling model APIs or building small automations.

• Experience with LLM evaluation: building test sets, calibrating LLM judges or fine-tuning models.

• Experience with experimentation and measurement, such as A/B tests, metric design and dashboards.

• Trust and safety, content moderation, customer support automation, annotation operations or other human-in-the-loop work at scale.

• Background in a two-sided marketplace, travel, or another operations-heavy business.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list  If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$157,000—$171,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Test Engineer I
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR SYSTEM TEST ENGINEER I

Based out of Rocket Lab's office in Littleton, CO, the Senior System Test Engineer I is responsible for the development and maintenance of technical budgets, requirements definition, test planning and execution, and overall management of the systems engineering process. You will support the Chief Space Systems Engineer and Space Systems organization, with deliverables required for internal leadership, board of directors, and investors.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Design, document, review and execute tests on spacecraft systems

• Author, review and provide feedback for test plans, hardware drawings, test results summaries and reports

• Write and review test scripts in a collaborative, peer reviewed test framework

• Troubleshoot flight software to aid with issue resolution

• Execute tests that verify hardware, software and validate requirements

• Design, procure and integrate test hardware according to documentation

• Collaborate with other hardware teams, Flight Software (FSW) developers and Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) experts to verify performance and troubleshoot anomalies

• Communicate plans, status and results with leadership, team and customers

• Travel to customer and vendor facilities to aid hardware delivery and commissioning

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or other technical discipline

• 5+ years of experience developing or testing electrical systems (avionics, automotive, spacecraft)

• Experience tracking tasks in a project management system like Jira

• Programming experience with scripting/automation using Python or similar languages

• Ability to obtain and maintain a Security clearance

• U.S citizenship is required, due to program requirements

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Master’s degree in aerospace, computer science or related field

• Experience testing spacecraft avionics according to requirements

• Familiarity with avionics test equipment (examples include Digital Multimeters, Oscilloscopes, logic analyzers etc.)

• Experience testing or working with Radio Frequency (RF) communication systems

• Familiarity with digital communication protocols (Ethernet, UART, LVDS, CAN, etc.)

• Active Secret or Top Secret Security clearance

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

The expected salary range for the position is displayed in accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. Final agreed upon compensation is based upon individual qualifications and experience.

Base salary is only one part of Rocket Lab’s compensation package for this role. You may be eligible for company stock, or cash incentives, and can purchase discounted stock through Rocket Lab’s Employee Stock Purchase Program. Employee benefits also include medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401(k) retirement plan options; paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave; paid parental leave; and other discounts and perks.

Base Pay Range (CO Only)

$100,000—$137,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality.  For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

jobs.title: Telephony Field Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/ who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Every Sierra voice agent sits inside a customer’s phone network, from Uber and Rivian to Santander, SoFi, and Singapore Airlines. Before a deal closes, the customer's telephony, network, and security teams must know how calls will reach the agent, how calls will return to their contact center, and what they must change on their side. You will be the person who answers those questions. You will sit on the Channels team, with the engineers who build Sierra's telephony stack, and you will work with Sales and Agent Engineering on our largest deals and customer deployments.

 - Lead telephony conversations in sales and implementation cycles. Run discovery on the customer's carriers, session border controllers, IVR, voice networks, and contact centers. Draw their topology, and recommend how to connect it to Sierra.

 - Design the integration. Choose between SIP trunking, PSTN, and websocket audio connections for each customer. Explain the trade-offs to their architects. Cover inbound calls, outbound calls, transfers to human agents, and the context that goes with each transfer.

 - Get security and network reviews approved. Give the customer's firewall and telephony teams the specifications they need: IP ranges, ports, TLS and SRTP requirements, codecs, authentication options, and SIP header behavior. Answer their follow-up questions accurately and quickly.

 - Solve the hard cases. Bring-your-own-carrier, private network interconnects, on-premises contact centers, data residency rules, and international calling each change the design. You will work out what is possible and tell the customer plainly.

 - Stay on the hard deployments. Most customers go to the account's Agent Engineer once the first test call connects. The hard ones stay with you: bring-your-own-carrier setups, private interconnects, on-premises contact centers. You help bring up the trunk. When calls drop, audio goes one way, or transfers lose their context, you read the packet captures, find the cause, and fix it, whether it's on their side or ours.

 - Build new capabilities with design partners. When a customer needs something we don't support yet, like a new transfer method, a custom SIP header mapping, or a new carrier, you work with them and Channels engineering. You spec it, test it against their real network, and get it into the product.

 - Make the answers reusable. Write the reference architectures, diagrams, setup guides, and customer-ready decks that let Sales Engineers and Agent Engineers handle routine integrations without you.

 - Bring what you learn back to the product. You will see every gap in our telephony and contact-center integrations first. Turn those gaps into clear requirements for Channels engineering and product.

 - Work with contact-center and carrier partners. Build direct relationships with their technical teams so that mutual customers get one consistent answer.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 8+ years in field engineering for voice, telephony, CPaaS, or contact-center products.

 - Deep knowledge of SIP and VoIP telephony: trunking, session border controllers, TLS and SRTP, authentication, codecs, call transfers, and SIP headers. You can read a packet capture and find the problem.

 - Experience leading technical conversations with enterprise networking, telephony, and security teams, including with executive audiences.

 - The ability to explain a call flow to a telephony architect and to a non-technical buyer in the same meeting.

 - Clear technical writing. Your diagrams and guides can be used by a customer's team without you in the room.

 - Ability to leverage AI tools efficiently as a regular part of your work. Importantly, you own the accuracy of anything you put in front of a customer, whether or not AI helped you build it.

 - Bachelor's Degree or above in Computer Science or related STEM field, or equivalent professional experience.


EVEN BETTER...

 - Experience building a modern voice edge network with SBCs, gateway services, etc.

 - Experience with SIP-based voice products from CPaaS providers like Twilio, Sinch, InfoBip, etc.

 - Experience connecting voice AI agents to telephony or contact-center systems.

 - Published technical guides, reference architectures, or sample applications.

 - Experience with private network interconnects (Equinix), data residency requirements, or regulated industries such as financial services and healthcare.

 - Knowledge of WebRTC and websocket-based audio streaming.

 - Experience with SMS, WhatsApp, or other messaging channels.

None of these are required. If the problems above excite you, we'd love to hear from you.


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

 - Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

 - Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

 - Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at accommodations@sierra.ai. Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable fair chance laws.

jobs.title: US- Central North- EHS Manager
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

CoreWeave’s Global Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) organization supports every CoreWeave function, not just operations. As the US Central Regional EHS Manager, you will be directly accountable for EHS at every data center in your region, supporting operational compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies. As part of the Global EHS function, you will also support other business operations across the company as assigned.

This is a hands-on role in a matrixed organization, where alignment and collaboration are key. You will build strong relationships at every level, including peers, Regional Leaders, and the Extended Leadership Team across EHS, Operations, Development, and Office Management. You will partner closely with data center managers, EHS-IT, EHS cross-functional teams, and operational knowledge management.

This role requires up to 50% travel to data centers across the region.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own EHS operational performance for all data centers in the region and serve as the single point of contact for EHS issues and emergencies at your sites.

• Visit every site in the region regularly, on an established cadence of site visits and virtual check-ins, to provide training, walk-throughs, inspections, risk assessments, coaching, performance follow-ups, and other support each site needs.

• Recognize actual and potential workplace hazards, propose corrective actions, support their implementation, and track them to completion.

• Manage the quality of all applicable EHS programs, including event reporting, investigations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), regulatory reporting, and all federal, state, and local EHS program expectations.

• Implement and ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and CoreWeave expectations, including recording and reporting regulatory and company compliance requirements.

• Set and manage EHS objectives and expectations for your sites, and work with EHS and operational leadership to develop EHS management systems and set operational objectives.

• Build a regional EHS support network that fosters a culture where everyone, at every level, is accountable for EHS, and help integrate EHS into operational procedures and area management responsibilities.

• Act as the sites’ technical EHS expert, bringing in additional internal or external technical support as needed, and build a culture of learning and EHS expertise across the region.

• Manage working relationships with colocation partners, providers, and facilities management.

• Provide additional EHS support as requested.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in an Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) field.

• 7+ years of related experience in a technical, industrial, or mission-critical environment.

• Knowledge of federal OSHA and environmental regulations, plus experience navigating state and local regulations.

• Proven technical EHS experience with regulatory reporting, dashboards, and management systems.

• Proven experience as a technical EHS generalist in safety, health, and environmental program management, including carrying out tactical EHS program elements.

• Technical expertise in safety, health, environment, and sustainability.

• Proven ability to bring diverse groups together in a matrixed organization, incorporating feedback to align teams with organizational strategy and vision.

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple competing projects and deadlines.

• Clear, professional verbal and written communication, with a demonstrated ability to address client needs and collaborate with internal teams.

• Demonstrated commitment to accuracy and thoroughness in all work.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

• Be Curious at Your Core

• Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization’s growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $122,000 to $179,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• Voluntary supplemental life insurance

• Short and long-term disability insurance

• Flexible Spending Account

• Health Savings Account

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

• Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health

jobs.title: EHS-by-Design Specialist
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

CoreWeave’s Global Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) organization supports every CoreWeave function, not just operations. As the EHS by Design Manager, you will provide EHS support, including project management, across the Global EHS organization and its matrixed partners.

You will build engagement channels with the facility design, construction, commissioning, and operations organizations and foster a culture of EHS engagement on technical EHS topics. You will make sure every operational build design gets an EHS review. Where appropriate, you will also build EHS expectations directly into engineering design standards, using modern engineering and construction software platforms (e.g., AutoCAD, Procore).

This role requires an estimated 25% to 50% travel.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design Review: Make sure every new build, expansion, and major retrofit gets an EHS review at defined design stages, and lead those reviews.

• Design Standards: Write EHS requirements into CoreWeave’s engineering design standards and specifications, and keep them current as technology and codes change.

• Hazard Studies: Plan, facilitate, and document HAZOP, PHA, LOPA, and JHA studies, tracking every action to closure.

• Construction Verification: Set up processes to confirm facilities are built to the approved design and CoreWeave EHS standards, including field change reviews.

• Commissioning: Establish EHS oversight of commissioning, including pre-startup safety reviews (PSSRs) before energization or operational handover.

• Management of Change: Build and run a management of change (MOC) process for post-approval design changes and for changes to operating facilities.

• FM Global & Insurance: Oversee FM Global recommendations through resolution, working with regional EHS and facilities partners.

• New Technology: Assess the EHS risks of new technologies, building materials, and systems before adoption (e.g., liquid cooling, high-density power, lithium-ion BESS).

• Data Center Hazards: Serve as the technical expert on electrical/arc flash (NFPA 70E), battery storage (NFPA 855), fire protection (NFPA 75/76), coolants, generator fuel, and confined spaces.

• Metrics: Compile and report EHS metrics and KPIs, and prepare dashboards on EHS by Design activities for EHS leadership.

• Mentoring: Train and mentor EHS professionals and partner teams in EHS by Design principles, consistent with ANSI/ASSP Z590.3.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering (chemical, mechanical, electrical, or fire protection preferred), EHS, or a related field.

• Background in EHS or process safety engineering in high-hazard operations (chemical processing, oil & gas, or utilities).

• Proven experience planning and facilitating PHA, HAZOP, and LOPA studies.

• Working knowledge of US and international building and fire codes (IBC, IFC, NFPA), and experience assessing new materials for EHS risk.

• Strong facilitation and engineering systems thinking, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

• Familiarity with engineering and construction tools such as AutoCAD and Procore, enough to work directly with engineering and design teams.

Preferred Skills:

• Professional Engineer (PE) license; CSP, CFPS, or similar certification.

• Data center or mission-critical facility experience.

• Sound risk judgment that balances risk reduction against cost, schedule, and operability.

• Strong technical report writing and executive communication across matrixed organizations.

• A track record of building effective, high-trust working relationships across engineering, construction, operations, and vendor teams.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

jobs.title: Payroll Administrator
jobs.description:
ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an experienced Payroll Administrator to prepare, process, and audit payroll for our US and Canadian employee population of 600+, and to partner with international payroll providers on processing for global locations, including our largest populations in India and Luxembourg.

The ideal candidate brings 5+ years of hands-on payroll experience, deep proficiency with ADP Workforce Now, and strong working knowledge of multi-jurisdictional payroll tax and compliance requirements. This role is critical to ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time, and that the company stays compliant with all applicable federal, state/provincial, and local regulations.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Prepare and audit end-to-end payroll cycles for US and Canadian employees using ADP Workforce Now.

 - Prepare and review payroll inputs (new hires, terminations, pay changes, garnishments, retro pay, bonuses, commissions) for accuracy prior to processing.

 - Work in partnership with our international payroll provider/ EOR on all global payroll locations.

 - Establish and oversee audit controls to identify and resolve discrepancies before submission each cycle.

 - Ensure compliance with US federal, state, and local payroll tax regulations, as well as Canadian federal and provincial requirements (CRA remittances, EI, CPP, provincial tax variances).

 - Maintain and reconcile payroll tax filings, year-end reporting, and related documentation, including W-2s, T4s, and ROEs.

 - Respond to all employee inquiries such as pay, deductions, and tax withholdings in a timely and professional manner.

 - Partner with the People team on onboarding, offboarding, one-time payments, and leaves of absence, ensuring information flows smoothly between teams.

 - Stay current on changes in payroll tax law and compliance requirements across US and Canadian jurisdictions.

 - Support internal and external payroll audits, and maintain accurate, well-organized payroll records.

 - Assist in developing an SOP for payroll procedures.

 - Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes, controls, and efficiency.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of experience in payroll administration, including multi-state and Canadian payroll.

 - Strong hands-on proficiency with ADP WorkForce Now

 - Solid understanding of US and Canadian payroll tax regulations and compliance requirements.

 - Strong passion to integrate AI into everyday processes.

 - Experience auditing payroll for accuracy and resolving discrepancies.

 - Familiarity with wage and hour laws, garnishments, and statutory deductions in both countries.

 - High degree of accuracy, attention to detail, and discretion with confidential information.

 - Strong Excel skills and comfort working with payroll and HRIS data.

 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with HR and Finance.
   




COMPENSATION

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $60,000 - $75,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.



Benefits include:

 - Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

 - Life insurance

 - Mental wellness coverage

 - Fertility and growing family support

 - Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

 - Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

 - Retirement saving plans

 - Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

 - Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist I - Cell Culture Process Development
jobs.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic and creative hands-on senior scientist to join the Cell Culture Process Development group within PDS&T Biologics at AbbVie Bioresearch Center in Worcester, MA. As part of the Cell Culture Development organization, you will support process development and technology transfer activities for cell culture processes, contributing to the clinical manufacturing and commercialization of therapeutic proteins in the AbbVie pipeline. Additionally, you will be a part of a team that provides subject matter expertise and experimental support for the production of commercial biologics. The ideal candidate will work effectively both independently and collaboratively within a dynamic team environment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and characterize highly-productive CHO cell culture processes suitable for cGMP biotherapeutic manufacturing within project timelines, performing technical transfer, and manufacturing support activities.
• Lead and execute scientific research and development initiatives to reduce cost of goods (COGs) by significantly improving platform processes and workflows, deepening scientific understanding, and applying new methods and technologies. These include cell metabolic modeling, perfusion technology, and a suite of Process Analytical Technology (PAT) tools.
• Design, execute, and analyze cell culture experiments using Design of Experiments (DOE) principles and report data summary packages for multi-variate analysis.
• Work collaboratively and cross-functionally with colleagues in other functional areas (Analytical Development, Cell Line Development, Discovery, Manufacturing, and Quality). Effectively communicate scientific data and concepts to internal and external audiences through reports, presentations and manuscripts. Author and review technical reports, protocols, and other key documents.
• Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding code of conduct, safety, documentation and GMP compliance.

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent education with minimum 10 years of experience, or Master’s Degree or equivalent education with minimum 8 years of experience. Or PhD with no minimum years of experience, in chemical engineering, biochemical engineering, or a related discipline.
• Proven ability to independently design experiments, troubleshoot technical issues, and deliver high-quality scientific output.
• Strong understanding of cell biology with extensive hands-on experience with mammalian suspension cell culture
• Theoretical and practical knowledge to carry out the job functions.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Understanding of cell culture processes (e.g., cell culture process development, process scale up and scale down, recombinant protein production, protein characterization).
• Demonstrated experience in cell metabolic modeling and process modeling using mechanistic model and/or machine learning algorithms.
• Familiarity with bioreactor perfusion processes.
• Demonstrated experience in applying Process Analytical Technology (PAT) to improve cell culture processes.
• Hands-on experience with upstream mammalian suspension cell culture using bench scale bioreactors, AMBR, and shake flasks.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Strong scientific curiosity with a passion for problem-solving and optimization. Self-motivated with excellent attention to detail and ability to multi-task. Strong organizational, planning and trouble-shooting skills.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Salary: $140,000 - $175,000 + share options

Location: Austin, TX - Hybrid;  (3 days per week)

 


ABOUT LAWHIVE

Lawhive is a global, AI-native law firm. Operating in the US and UK, we’ve built our own agentic operating system for legal services.

We partner with leading Main Street law firms to give lawyers and back-office teams the AI platform, marketing, and operational support to grow faster than they could alone. Our specialized AI agent for legal work, Lawrence, works alongside lawyers, putting human legal judgment right where it belongs: at the center of every matter.

We're backed by a $60M Series B at a $685M valuation, from investors including Google Ventures, TQ Ventures, Mitch Rales, Balderton Capital and Premier League footballers Harry Maguire and Reece James. In the last few years we've hit milestone after milestone, raising over $110M in funding. Today, we're on track to exceed $100 million in annual revenue, and we have offices in London, New York, Austin, and Phoenix.

So if you want your work to have real, tangible impact as we redefine an entire industry, Lawhive is where you can make it happen.

 



THE ROLE

We're looking for a Marketing Lead to help grow the law firms in our portfolio. You'll work across multiple firms, practice areas and US markets, identifying the biggest growth opportunities and then doing the work required to capture them.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. We need someone who can set direction, but who is equally comfortable getting into an ad account, diagnosing a conversion problem, running a split test, or planning out an attribution model. This role is about more than coordinating agencies or managing other marketers. You'll be personally responsible for delivering meaningful improvements.

Our targets are ambitious, the problems vary by firm, and the work will move quickly. It's an opportunity for a commercially minded digital marketing generalist who enjoys ownership, experimentation and delivering measurable outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive growth across a portfolio of firms. Partner with firm leaders to turn revenue ambitions into practical, measurable marketing plans tailored to each firm's markets and practice areas.

 - Execute performance marketing. Plan, launch, manage and optimise campaigns across channels such as Google Ads and Meta. Work directly on campaign structure, targeting, budgets, creative tests, bidding and lead quality to improve acquisition efficiency and volume.

 - Improve conversion rates. Identify and remove friction in the journey from search or ad click through landing page, enquiry, consultation and retained client. Design and run CRO tests, improve pages and forms, and work with intake teams to address conversion bottlenecks.

 - Build organic acquisition. Identify and execute SEO opportunities across local, on-page, technical and content-led search. Improve service-area coverage, local visibility, Google Business Profiles and high-intent search performance, partnering with specialists where useful.

 - Test new growth levers. Evaluate and experiment with channels beyond the core digital mix, including emerging AI search discovery and, where appropriate, local offline channels such as out-of-home advertising.

 - Measure the full funnel. Use analytics, call tracking, ad-platform reporting and CRM data to connect marketing activity to qualified leads, consultations, new clients and revenue. Build clear reporting and use it to prioritise action.

 - Create repeatable playbooks. Turn successful experiments and channel tactics into practical approaches that can be adapted and deployed across the portfolio, without losing sight of what makes each firm and local market different.

 - Work closely with the business. Collaborate with lawyers, firm operators, intake teams, product and other growth specialists to make sure acquisition translates into real commercial results.

 


ABOUT YOU

 - A genuine digital marketing generalist. Strong working knowledge across performance marketing, conversion rate optimisation and SEO, with the confidence to move between disciplines and identify the highest-impact opportunities.

 - Deep hands-on execution experience. A track record of personally building, launching, optimising and troubleshooting campaigns or growth initiatives—not only briefing others and reviewing results.

 - Analytical and experimental. Able to diagnose a problem using messy data, form a clear hypothesis, run a test and learn from the result. Comfortable with tools such as Google Ads, GA4, Google Search Console, spreadsheets and CRM reporting.

 - High ownership and bias to action. You can prioritise across several workstreams, manage your own execution and deliver against ambitious targets without needing a large team around you.

 - Excellent stakeholder skills. You can work credibly with firm leadership, explain performance clearly, and bring people along while still challenging assumptions and pushing for results.

 - Adaptability. You enjoy switching between different practices, geographies, channels and stages of growth. You know when to reuse a proven approach and when a local market requires something different.
   
   


DESIRABLE

 - AEO / GEO / AI search visibility: Familiarity with how brands and services are discovered through AI-powered search and answer engines, and experience testing ways to improve visibility.

 - Business Development & Referrals: Experience working closely with BD and sales teams to develop referral partnerships, grow referral channels and drive new client acquisition.

 - Offline and out-of-home marketing: Experience assessing, buying or measuring local media such as billboards and other OOH placements, including how to judge their impact alongside digital channels.

 - Local services or legal marketing: Experience marketing high-intent consumer services, especially law firms or other location-based businesses with consultation-led sales funnels.

 - Lifecycle and retention marketing: Working knowledge of email, SMS, remarketing and lead-nurture strategies.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - The firms you support are making measurable progress against ambitious growth and revenue targets.

 - Lead generation is increasing in the right places, with attention to lead quality, conversion and acquisition economics—not vanity metrics.

 - Campaigns, landing pages and search visibility are improving because of work you have personally delivered.

 - You can clearly explain what's working, what isn't and what to do next using full-funnel data.

 - The growth team is building a library of repeatable experiments and playbooks that compound in value across the portfolio.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Introductory call with our Talent team

 - 1:1 with your hiring manager 

 - Technical interview / practical skills assessment 

 - Values interview with one of our Founders

 - We offer!

 


BENEFITS

 - 🩺 Healthcare benefits: 'Premium' plan with 100% employee cover and 50% dependent cover

 - ✈️ Vacation: 20 days + 11 Federal holidays + 1 day of Birthday leave

 - 💰 401k: Matching contribution up to 2% of salary

 - 💰 Meaningful early-stage share options

 - 🌍 Work from anywhere for a month

 - 💻 Top-spec Macbook

 - ⛳️ Regular team building activities and socials!

 


DIVERSITY AT LAWHIVE

At Lawhive we know that diversity of thought is critical to delivering outlier outcomes. As such, we’re always working hard to ensure we build a diverse, inclusive team. We’re not yet where we want to be but as we scale we’ll only ever increase the focus we apply to this.

jobs.title: Director of Strategic Sourcing
jobs.description:
ABOUT OBSERVABLE SPACE

At Observable Space, we're redefining how humanity observes and connects with the universe. We're a vertically integrated, high-growth, space technology company building industry-leading precision optics platforms for Earth and in space. Our systems are trusted by thousands of customers, including NASA, JPL, SpaceX, Boeing, RTX, the US Space Force and the U.S. Department of War, leading research institutions and international partners.

We combine precision opto-mechanical hardware, embedded compute, cloud orchestration, and developer-friendly APIs into world class products at scale with in-house manufacturing. From advanced ground stations, on-orbit sensor suites, free space optical lasercom, to distributed compute platforms, we deliver the foundational systems enabling continuous, real-time navigation, observation, and communication in space.

Observable Space is backed by top-tier institutional investors including Lux Capital, Upfront Ventures, RTX Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners and Embedded Ventures. To learn more, visit observable.space http://observable.space.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Observable Space is looking for a Director of Strategic Sourcing to develop and execute our long-term sourcing strategy and lead our sourcing and procurement team. You’ll own sourcing and purchasing across direct materials and components, capital equipment and facilities projects, and goods and services that support day-to-day operations in Los Angeles, CA and in Adrian and Detroit, MI. You’ll grow the team and partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, Quality, and Program Management.

This is a high-impact leadership role with real organizational scope for a true builder. You will build a world-class sourcing and procurement organization capable of supporting Observable Space’s growth over the next decade – developing people, creating scalable processes, and forging resilient supplier relationships. You will own strategy and execution while driving category strategy, supplier development, and cost optimization across the organization. Your decisions will directly influence product cost, production capacity, customer delivery, working capital, and our ability to scale and deliver on programs that matter – from ground-based observation systems to space optics and laser communications platforms.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


STRATEGIC SOURCING

 - Develop and execute the company’s long-term sourcing strategy across all purchasing categories

 - Set category strategies for critical hardware, including optics, motors, actuators, and machined components

 - Partner with Engineering early in product development to inform design decisions with supplier capabilities, cost, and lead times

 - Lead make-or-buy decisions and determine which capabilities to build in-house and which to source externally

 - Lead competitive sourcing and own supplier selection

 - Lead sourcing for capital investments, including manufacturing equipment, metrology systems, and facilities projects

 - Manage company-wide spend on goods and services that support day-to-day operations

 - Track spend and savings to set sourcing priorities and report results to leadership

 - Monitor supply markets, surface risks and opportunities to leadership, and protect supply continuity through dual sourcing and contingency planning

 - ~30% domestic and international travel to suppliers and clients 


PROCUREMENT

 - Own procurement operations and purchasing controls, with the team handling routine purchase orders and supplier follow-up

 - Improve purchasing workflows as the company scales and use procurement metrics to track operational efficiency


SUPPLIER MANAGEMENT & NEGOTIATION

 - Build and manage relationships with key suppliers and develop their capabilities as production needs evolve

 - Lead critical supplier negotiations on pricing, lead times, payment terms, and contractual conditions

 - Develop commercial terms for long term supplier agreements and master supply agreements

 - Drive continuous improvement in supplier cost, quality and on time delivery and lead corrective actions when needed


PEOPLE & LEADERSHIP

 - Build and develop the sourcing and procurement team, set priorities across sites, and hire as the organization grows

 - Develop future leaders while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and accountability

 - Serve as a trusted strategic partner to executive leadership on supply chain strategy and risk


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic sourcing, procurement or supply chain, including leadership of sourcing or procurement teams

 - Demonstrated experience building and developing teams and managers

 - Track record of scaling supply chain or manufacturing organizations through periods of significant growth

 - Strong understanding of ERP systems, purchasing workflows, supplier management, inventory management, and operational metrics

 - Proven ability to build and use data to drive sourcing decisions and report to leadership

 - Strong business judgment and ability to prioritize competing demands, make decisions with incomplete information, and recognize when to act independently or escalate

 - Experience in aerospace, defense, or advanced manufacturing

 - Familiarity with optical systems, precision hardware, or electromechanical components strongly preferred

 - Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced technical degree a plus


WHO YOU ARE

 - You think and operate at multiple altitudes — equally comfortable setting strategy and diving into operational details to solve a critical issue

 - You build teams and develop people as deliberately as you build supplier relationships

 - You balance urgency with sound business judgment, making decisions with incomplete information and knowing when to escalate

 - You thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, bringing focus and clear priorities as business needs change

 - You communicate clearly and build trust quickly — with suppliers, engineers, and executives alike

 - You value ownership, curiosity, and collaboration over hierarchy and bureaucracy


WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE

 - Be part of a mission-driven company helping shape the future of space infrastructure

 - Work on technically complex, high-visibility programs where your sourcing decisions have real impact

 - Join a lean, high-performance team where you’ll have the autonomy to build and the authority to execute

 - Competitive salary, equity opportunities, and comprehensive benefits


WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Compensation – A salary package aligned with industry standards and your experience.

Equity Opportunities – Take part in our success with stock options.

Flexible Work Environment – Enjoy working from our office or in a hybrid work setup with the flexibility to work remotely part of the week. We require a minimum of 3 days per week in our office to support collaboration and team culture. (LA Office only)

Unlimited PTO (Salaried positions only) – Take the time you need with our flexible, trust-based vacation policy, including paid holidays. We encourage everyone to rest, recharge, and take care of themselves.

Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% of the premium paid by the employer for employees.

Cutting-Edge Tools – Get access to the latest hardware and software you need to do your best work.

Mission-Driven Culture – Be part of a team working on meaningful challenges with real-world impact.

Inclusive Team – We foster a supportive and diverse workplace where all voices are valued.



Observable Space is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Director of Trade Compliance
jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

ABOUT ZONE 5 TECHNOLOGIES

Zone 5 Technologies is redefining what is possible in unmanned aircraft systems. Our engineers develop cutting-edge autonomous solutions to complex challenges, and we are looking for exceptional talent driven by hard problems and rapid innovation.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Director of Trade Compliance leads Zone 5’s export and import compliance program, ensuring the company, its programs, and its international partnerships operate within U.S. trade control laws, including ITAR, EAR, and OFAC. Reporting to the General Counsel, the Director sets compliance strategy, policies, and controls, and leads the team that executes them.

The role owns the full compliance lifecycle (classification, U.S. Government authorizations, screening, recordkeeping, training, and reporting) and partners closely with Business Development, Engineering, Security, Supply Chain, Program Management, IT, and Legal. The Director also manages the trade compliance relationship with Zone 5’s parent company, Kongsberg, within the requirements of the company’s Proxy Agreement, and gives leadership clear visibility into licenses, agreements, and regulatory constraints so the business can plan with confidence.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Program Leadership and Strategy

• Own the enterprise trade compliance program, including strategy, governance, risk assessment, and controls, applying DDTC and BIS requirements and applicable corporate policies across the organization.

• Serve as the Empowered Official and principal advisor to leadership on export compliance, anticipating regulatory change and its impact on programs, partners, and pursuits.

Parent Company Relationship

• Serve as Zone 5’s primary trade compliance point of contact with its parent company, Kongsberg, building a collaborative working relationship while preserving the safeguards of the company’s Proxy Agreement.

• Ensure exchanges of technical data, defense articles, and personnel with the parent and its affiliates are properly authorized and consistent with the Proxy Agreement, Technology Control Plan, Electronic Communications Plan, and visitation procedures.

• Align with parent company compliance expectations where permissible, and coordinate with Security and the General Counsel on related FOCI reporting and approvals.

Licensing and U.S. Government Authorizations and Relationships

• Direct the preparation and submission of export and import authorizations in partnership with Business Development and Program Managers.

• Maintain a real-time license and agreement tracker (status, dates, scope, parties, and provisos) and report status routinely to business leaders.

• Manage relationships with DDTC, the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), service component international affairs offices, and other regulators, and track follow-up to closure.

Classification and Technical Data Controls

• Oversee ECCN and USML classifications for hardware, software, and technology, including commodity jurisdiction requests. Develop classification procedure and train employees accordingly.

• Direct technology control plans, program export documentation, and controls for sharing technical data and defense articles with foreign persons and partners.

• Partner with Security and IT on the handling of CUI and export-controlled data.

Screening, Shipping, and Controls

• Oversee denied party, embargo, and sanctions (OFAC) screening of customers, suppliers, partners, and visitors.

• Govern export and import shipping documentation with Supply Chain and logistics partners, and ensure ATF obligations are identified and met where applicable.

• Ensure compliance for foreign national visits and engagements, including visitor review, technical data access, and required approvals.

Policies, Procedures, and Training

• Draft and maintain company-wide trade compliance policies, procedures, and work instructions, released through the company’s configuration management and approval process.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:

 - Identify new opportunities to delight our customers, like novel new ways to improve availability or performance or even developing new products.

You

 - 8+ years in relevant domains like cloud computing, systems engineering, and large-scale network infrastructure

 - Experience with the network characteristics of large distributed training workloads

 - Experience with software defined networking

 - Familiarity with network monitoring and telemetry

 - General awareness and ability to go deep in datacenter, backbone, internet protocols and technology

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.




About Lambda

 - Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.
