jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
Greenhouse is the first Orchestrated Hiring Ecosystem: a single place that brings the right person and the right role together at the right time. Our mission is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for an Enterprise Account Manager to join our team!

Our Account Management team drives customer retention, growth and expansion opportunities, as well as continued product optimization and adoption. As an Enterprise Account Manager, you will own the renewals and upselling of new products into our rapidly growing ecosystem of customers. You will ensure a premium experience for our customers by understanding their core business objectives and motivating change in their organization. In addition, you’ll partner with our Customer Success, Marketing, Product and Finance teams to streamline workflows and communication processes within Greenhouse.

Who will love this job:

• A strategic hunter - you thrive in a dynamic environment, and clearly see the full picture of an account, always recommending the best solutions that drive value for both customers and Greenhouse revenue

• A thoughtful mediator - you're consultative and receptive under pressure, and you can build and defend a pricing structure on the spot rather than just smoothing the conversation over

• A collaborative teammate - you love working with others and rely on strong partnerships to achieve the best outcomes for our customers

• A builder and problem solver - you’re not afraid to test, iterate, and chip in ideas when it comes to solutions. You leverage AI tools to create custom workflows and streamline tasks. You can roll with the punches and adapt, and are excited to be a part of the solution

What you’ll do:

• Effectively manage a book of business consisting of our most strategic accounts

• Build, present, and defend data-backed pricing structures directly with procurement and finance stakeholders, driving alignment across broader buyer groups to close deals

• Develop strategic account plans that map out expansion and other upsell opportunities

• Maintain an active pipeline of forecasted renewals and expansions to meet quota objectives

• Partner with Customer Success Managers and leverage product expertise to solution for customer pain points

• Position yourself as a strategic partner to key stakeholders and champions within named accounts

• Diagnose and clearly mitigate churn risks, owning resolution strategies and advising sales leadership on ideal resolutions wherever appropriate

• Be an active participant in building and improving internal operational processes

• Travel: Travel to customer and prospect sites, industry events, and Greenhouse offices is an essential function of this role. Travel is expected to be approximately 10-15% of working time and may include overnight stays and domestic travel. Travel frequency and destinations may vary with territory, account needs, and business priorities.

• Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require

You should have:

• Several years of demonstrated experience in account expansion and renewals working with executive collaborators within Enterprise accounts (1,000+ employees)

• A consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quotas

• Excellent project management skills

• The ability to construct, present, and defend complex pricing structures directly with procurement and finance, not just manage the relationships around them

• Proven ability to solve complex problems through a consultative approach, effectively managing customer expectations while navigating challenges often outside of your direct control

• Mastery in lifecycle revenue management, delivering high-accuracy forecasting for both renewals and expansion within a complex enterprise portfolio

• Experience acting as a strategic advisor to senior leadership by synthesizing portfolio data into actionable insights regarding market themes, risk mitigation strategies, and growth opportunities

• Experience with HR industry and SaaS, a plus

• Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here.

The national pay range for this role is $116,900.00 - $137,500.00 base pay. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and qualifications. Certain roles may be eligible for additional compensation, including stock option awards, bonuses, and merit increases. Additionally, certain roles have the opportunity to receive sales commissions that are based on the terms of the sales commission plan applicable to the role.

Greenhouse provides a variety of benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, basic life insurance, mental health resources, financial wellness benefits, and a fully paid parental leave program. For US-based employees, we offer short-term and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan and company match. U.S. based employees also receive, per calendar year, up to 14 scheduled paid holidays and up to 80 hours of paid sick leave. Non-exempt employees accrue up to 20-25 days of paid vacation time annually, depending on tenure, and exempt employees have flexible paid time off (PTO).

The anticipated closing date for this role is Friday, November 27, 2026.

Who we are

At Greenhouse, we live by our mission through using our own product to help us hire the right person for the job, every time. We’re committed to designing and responsibly using AI tools to transform how we work while keeping people at the center. We are a remote-first company and have shared office spaces in New York City and Ireland, and optional co-working spaces that give us flexibility to do our best work anywhere. We take an active role in our growth through a performance review program that’s committed to providing actionable feedback, and a bonus structure that rewards great performance. We believe that bringing together a variety of perspectives makes us a stronger company – and we nurture leaders who create an inclusive culture and invest into employee resource groups that celebrate our differences and life experiences. We’re proud to have built an award-winning culture that’s been recognized as Fortune’s Best Places to Work and Inc.’s Best Workplaces multiple years in a row.

–

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to accommodations@greenhouse.io.

jobs.title: RN Nurse Manager, Home Health
jobs.description:
BAYADA Home Health Care

RN Clinical Manager — Home Health (Hilo, HI)

Relocation assistance available

Lead clinical care on Hilo — and live where others vacation

BAYADA Home Health Care is hiring an RN Clinical Manager for our Big Island Visits (BIV) office. This is a rare chance to grow your nursing leadership career while living on one of the most beautiful islands in the world. We offer relocation assistance to help make the move easy.

If you’re a clinically strong nurse who loves mentoring field staff and making sure every client receives exceptional care, this role was made for you. You won’t just manage a team — you’ll shape a culture of clinical excellence and directly improve the lives of clients and families across the Big Island.

Why you’ll love this role

• Real impact. Your leadership shapes the care experience for every client your office serves.

• Mentor and grow nurses. Develop field staff, build competencies, and help your team do their best work.

• Island life. Build a meaningful career in a place you’ll be proud to call home — relocation support included.

• Mission-driven team. Join an organization celebrating 50 years of compassion, excellence, and reliability.

What you’ll do

• Lead and support field staff in delivering high-quality, compassionate client care.

• Serve as internal case manager and client advocate — coordinating care, assignments, and care plans for the best possible outcomes.

• Oversee service quality, including clinical documentation review and key performance measures.

• Match the right clinicians to each client and ensure individualized care plans are developed, implemented, and kept current.

• Provide clinical oversight: hiring, validating competency, reviewing performance, supporting education, and supervising care.

• Partner with office leadership and the Clinical Practice Office to launch programs and strengthen training.

• Represent BAYADA in the community, including outreach to physicians and facilities.

What we’re looking for

• Active HI RN license in good standing (BSN or Master’s preferred; required where state regulations apply).

• At least 2 years of home health or community health nursing experience.

• Prior supervisory experience.

• Strong interpersonal skills and a track record of achieving goals and taking on growing responsibility.

• Alignment with our values of compassion, excellence, and reliability — The BAYADA Way.

What we offer

• Competitive salary: up to $95k annually plus incentives

• Relocation assistance. To help make your move to Hilo easy.

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage — Choose from Kaiser (HMO) or HMSA (PPO) plans, with prescription drug coverage included.

• Company-paid life & AD&D insurance, With optional voluntary life coverage.

• Company-paid short- and long-term disability. Income protection if you’re unable to work.

• 401(k) retirement plan With employer match.

• Paid time off — Vacation that grows with tenure, plus paid holidays, floating holidays, and paid sick time.

• Flexible Spending Accounts For health care and dependent care.

• Tuition reimbursement To support your continued education and growth.

• Employee Assistance Program At no cost to you.

Ready to apply?

Take the next step in your nursing leadership career — on Hilo. Apply today and a member of our team will be in touch.

As an accredited, regulated, certified, and licensed home health care provider, BAYADA complies with all state/local mandates.

BAYADA is celebrating 50 years of compassion, excellence, and reliability. Learn more about our 50th anniversary celebration and how you can join in here.

BAYADA Home Health Care, Inc., and its associated entities and joint venture partners, are Equal Opportunity Employers. All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, military status, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws.  Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other marginalized communities.

jobs.title: Cardiologist Physician, Interventional
jobs.description:
Akido builds AI-powered doctors. Akido is the first AI-native care provider, combining cutting-edge technology with a nationwide medical network to address America’s physician shortage and make exceptional healthcare universal. Its AI empowers doctors to deliver faster, more accurate, and more compassionate care.

Serving 500K+ patients across California, Rhode Island, and New York, Akido offers primary and specialty care in 26 specialties—from serving unhoused communities in Los Angeles to ride-share drivers in New York.

Founded in 2015 (YC W15), Akido is expanding its risk-bearing care models and scaling ScopeAI, its breakthrough clinical AI platform. Read more about Akido’s $60M Series B. More info at Akidolabs.com.

The Opportunity
Chaparral Medical Group is recruiting for an Interventional Cardiologist to join our team to deliver comprehensive cardiovascular care. You'll play a critical role in diagnosing, treating, and preventing cardiovascular disease while performing and interpreting advanced diagnostic and interventional procedures. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team to deliver exceptional care, supported by a well-established referral network, and help improve heart health outcomes in our community.

We welcome applicants at all career stages, from recent fellowship graduates to experienced cardiologists.

What You’ll Do

• Evaluate, diagnose and manage patient with wide array of cardiovascular diseases and conditions

• Perform and interpret diagnostic tests including ECGs, echocardiograms, stress tests, and other cardiac imaging

• Develop individualized treatment plans for patients with chronic and acute cardiovascular issues.

• Perform interventional procedures such as cardiac catheterization and angioplasty

• Monitor patient outcomes and adjust treatment plans based on progress and evolving needs

• Provide patient education on heart health, lifestyle modifications, and preventive care

• Collaborate closely with internal medicine providers, specialists, and allied health professionals to ensure coordinated care

• Maintain thorough and timely patient documentation in the EMR system

• Participate in call rotations and provide emergency cardiology care as needed

• Stay current with advancements in cardiology through continuing education, research, and peer collaboration

• Contribute and advise on possible improvements to the EMR system, actively collaborating with the tech team on future product enhancements.

Who You Are

• Medical degree (MD or DO) from an accredited institution (required)

• Successful completion of ACGME accredited Internal Medicine residency, fellowship in Cardiovascular Disease, and sub-specialty fellowship training in Interventional Cardiology (required)

• Board certified in Cardiovascular Disease as well as Board certified or board eligible in Interventional Cardiology

• Must have a California medical license or be eligible for full, unrestricted licensure by the time of hire (required)

• Demonstrate strong diagnostic and interventional clinical skills (required)

• Experience with cardiac imaging and interventional procedures such as cardiac catheterization, percutaneous intervention (required)

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal abilities

• Committed to continuous professional development and delivering patient-centered care

Chaparral Medical Group and Akido MSO are an equal opportunity employers, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

Salary range

$495,000—$600,000 USD

Akido Labs, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

jobs.title: Onboarding Experience Specialist, Threat Services
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an Onboarding Experience Specialist, you will be tasked with owning one of the most important transitions in the customer lifecycle: the handoff from a signed sale to a successful partner-led services start. Our expanded global relationship with our strategic partners brings together SentinelOne’s AI-powered security platform and our partners’ expertise in managed detection and response, managed SIEM, and incident response, and as partner-delivered services grow, SentinelOne remains committed to clear customer ownership, technical quality, and measurable results. This is an execution-focused customer experience role that prevents small omissions from turning into costly implementation delays.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Ensure that the partner, SentinelOne, and the customer enter the engagement with the same scope, expectations, contacts, prerequisites, and next steps.

• Own the standardized sale-to-delivery handoff checklist for partner-related onboarding engagements.

• Collect and validate customer contacts, commercial scope, service entitlements, POV outcomes, technical prerequisites, and delivery timing.

• Coordinate the onboarding intake and first kickoff between customer stakeholders, SentinelOne account teams, and the partner.

• Confirm that ownership, support channels, escalation contacts, customer commitments, and next milestones are clearly communicated.

• Track first-30-day engagement health, customer questions, stalled decisions, and unresolved handoff defects.

• Work with Sales, Deal Desk, Provisioning, Customer Success, and partner intake teams to resolve missing information.

• Maintain accurate CRM, onboarding, and delivery records while protecting customer data.

• Identify recurring handoff failures and implement clearer templates, communications, and lightweight automation.

• Provide a warm and organized customer transition to the named deployment or technical success owner.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• 3 or more years of experience in SaaS onboarding, customer operations, implementation coordination, account services, or a related customer-facing function.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to recognize incomplete scope, records, prerequisites, and ownership.

• Excellent customer communication, follow-up, meeting facilitation, and stakeholder coordination.

• Experience working with CRM, onboarding workflow, ticketing, or project management tools.

• Ability to understand basic cybersecurity or enterprise technology terminology and ask clarifying questions confidently.

• Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent handoffs under time pressure.

• Comfort spotting process defects and proposing practical workflow improvements.

• Experience with partner-led technology services or professional-services handoffs.

• Exposure to Salesforce, CPQ, or services provisioning workflows.

• Ability to deliver on the success measures for this role: a lower handoff defect rate and fewer missed prerequisites; shorter time to first value and stronger first-30-day onboarding CSAT; timely kickoff and clear ownership for new services engagements; complete and accurate onboarding records; and fewer preventable escalations caused by sale-to-delivery gaps.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

• Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

• Competitive leave benefits

• Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

• Private medical, dental, and vision insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

• Global home office allowance

• Internet or mobile phone allowance

• Hybrid work model with flexible hours

Wellness & Lifestyle

• Wellness programs

Growth & Community

• In-office lunch program

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Rehab Manager, Clinical, Home Health
jobs.description:
Rehabilitation Manager - Hilo, HI

Position Overview

BAYADA is seeking a Rehabilitation Manager to support our Big Island Visits (BIV) office in Hilo, Hawaii. This role is designed for a licensed therapist who is passionate about leading clinicians, supporting outstanding client outcomes, and helping office and field teams deliver care the BAYADA Way.

In this role, the Rehabilitation Manager leads field staff with a focus on client service, clinical excellence, quality, and adherence to policies and procedures. The position is accountable for internal case management, field staff evaluation and development, and regulatory compliance as it relates to rehabilitation therapies.

This is an exempt office-based leadership position that partners closely with the Director and Clinical Manager to ensure cohesive, high-quality support of rehabilitation services across the office.

Salary: up to $95k annually plus incentives

What You'll Do

• Lead and support rehabilitation field staff in alignment with The BAYADA Way and BAYADA standards for quality, service, and compliance.

• Partner closely with the Clinical Manager and Director to ensure consistent management of field staff and coordinated client care.

• Oversee rehabilitation service delivery, including review of therapy documentation, support for accurate ICD coding, facilitation of client care coordination, and monitoring of key performance indicators and process measures.

• Help ensure the right clinicians are matched to each client and that documentation moves efficiently from start of care through discharge.

• Support timely case management, authorization management, interdisciplinary communication, and response to ADRs and denials.

• Serve as an internal case manager and client advocate, collaborating with team members around client status, care plans, and expected outcomes.

• Provide clinical oversight to field therapists by participating in hiring, validating competency, reviewing performance, supporting education, and supervising care through home observations and documentation review.

• Partner with Visit Clinical Leadership to pilot new programs, implement process changes, and strengthen orientation, training, and ongoing competencies for therapy staff.

• Represent BAYADA in community and marketing activities, including visits to physician offices and facilities, while supporting broader office and company initiatives.

• Help support day-to-day office needs and, when necessary, step in to support field staff when staffing is unavailable.

What We're Looking For

• Current license in good standing as a Physical Therapist, Occupational Therapist, or Speech Language Pathologist in the state of Hawaii.

• Graduation from an accredited and approved therapist program.

• Prior supervisory experience commensurate with program requirements.

• At least two years of direct therapy experience.

• Strong interpersonal skills, a record of goal achievement, and a demonstrated ability to take on increasing responsibility with positive results.

• Successful completion of required clinical quizzes, competency testing, skills checklist, background and exclusions checks, and continuing education requirements.

• A clear alignment with the values of compassion, excellence, and reliability that define The BAYADA Way.

Why This Role Matters

This is a meaningful leadership opportunity for a therapist who wants to make a direct impact on both clinicians and clients. In BAYADA's Big Island office, the Rehabilitation Manager helps build a culture of clinical excellence, strengthens team performance, and ensures clients receive the high-quality rehabilitation care they deserve.

As an accredited, regulated, certified, and licensed home health care provider, BAYADA complies with all state/local mandates.

BAYADA is celebrating 50 years of compassion, excellence, and reliability. Learn more about our 50th anniversary celebration and how you can join in here.

jobs.title: Lead Generation Manager
jobs.description:
About Us:

Founded in 2021, Axion is at the forefront of transforming product quality and customer satisfaction in manufacturing. Our cutting-edge AI-powered platform empowers manufacturers to swiftly identify, thoroughly investigate, and effectively resolve quality issues while simultaneously elevating customer experiences and outcomes.

As trailblazers in end-to-end quality intelligence, we're setting new industry standards. Our innovative approach enables industrial, aerospace, consumer, and medtech manufacturers to harness the power of quality and post-market data, driving down costs and boosting business performance.

Our vision extends beyond mere problem-solving; we're committed to reshaping the future of manufacturing. By seamlessly integrating advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Axion is paving the way for smarter, safer, and more efficient production processes across diverse sectors.

Backed by leading investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Amplo, Boeing, and RTX Ventures, Axion is poised to lead the quality revolution in manufacturing.



About the Role:

Axion is looking for a Lead Generation Manager to build and execute demand generation programs that convert market awareness into qualified pipeline and drive measurable revenue growth.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can own lead generation from strategy through execution, including paid media, webinars, email campaigns, marketing automation, lead scoring, and field marketing. You'll also lead the development and execution of our 2027 conference and exhibition strategy.

Working closely with Product Marketing, Content, and Sales, you'll develop campaigns that engage enterprise buyers, improve lead quality, and accelerate pipeline generation. We're looking for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes ownership of outcomes, and is equally comfortable building HubSpot workflows and executing field events.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Own and execute multi-channel demand generation campaigns across paid media, email, webinars, and content to generate qualified leads and pipeline.

 - Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, and other channels, managing budgets, targeting, creative testing, and conversion performance.

 - Develop and execute webinars end to end, including content planning, speaker coordination, promotion, registration, follow-up, and performance reporting.

 - Partner with Product Marketing and Content to create nurture campaigns, landing pages, gated content, and compelling email messaging that drive engagement and conversion.

 - Own lead scoring, segmentation, and lifecycle workflows in HubSpot, continuously improving lead quality and conversion in partnership with Sales.

 - Develop and execute account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns targeting strategic enterprise accounts in collaboration with Sales.

 - Build and manage Axion's 2027 conference and exhibition strategy, including event selection, budgeting, sponsorships, logistics, and onsite execution.

 - Drive pre-event outreach and post-event follow-up to maximize engagement, lead conversion, and pipeline contribution.

 - Track and report on campaign performance, funnel conversion, channel ROI, and marketing-sourced pipeline, using insights to continuously optimize programs.

Requirements:

 - 6+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in lead generation or demand generation within a B2B SaaS environment.

 - Advanced hands-on experience with HubSpot, including workflows, lead scoring, segmentation, email marketing, forms, and reporting.

 - Working knowledge of Salesforce, including campaign management, lead and contact records, and CRM integrations.

 - Experience managing paid media campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, or other digital channels, with demonstrated success improving conversion rates and pipeline quality.

 - Experience developing and executing account-based marketing strategies, including target account segmentation, multi-channel campaigns, and Sales alignment.

 - Demonstrated success producing webinars and virtual events from planning through execution and follow-up.

 - Strong copywriting skills with experience developing high-converting email campaigns, landing pages, and marketing content.

 - Experience planning and executing conferences, trade shows, and sponsored events, including budgeting, vendor management, logistics, and ROI measurement.

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to track marketing performance, interpret funnel metrics, and optimize campaigns based on data.

 - Ability to manage multiple projects independently, prioritize effectively, and execute with minimal oversight.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, particularly when partnering with Sales, Product Marketing, and Content.

 - Familiarity with modern B2B marketing channels, technologies, and demand generation best practices.

 - Willingness to travel approximately 10% for conferences and exhibitions.

Nice to Have:

 - Experience marketing to manufacturing, industrial, or technical enterprise buyers.

 - HubSpot certifications or Salesforce Administrator experience.

 - Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, and event vendors.



Who You Are:

You’re a builder and operator who thrives in fast-moving, high-accountability environments. You take pride in getting things done — thoughtfully, efficiently. You’re energized by ambiguity, skilled at bringing clarity, and comfortable flexing between strategy and execution. You value feedback — giving it, receiving it, and acting on it — and you see collaboration as a competitive advantage, not a burden. You’re low-ego but high-agency: you care about winning as a team more than being right individually. You move quickly, communicate directly, and make decisions grounded in impact and data.

You don’t need constant direction — you create momentum. You take ownership for outcomes, and you expect the same from those around you.

You genuinely enjoy building relationships, particularly with senior industry leaders whose experience and perspective can shape meaningful business outcomes. You understand that trust takes time, and you prioritize long-term partnerships over transactional interactions.

You're equally comfortable engaging with C-suite executives, developing thought leadership initiatives, and managing the details of strategic partnerships. You bring executive presence, strong commercial instincts, and the ability to create mutually valuable relationships that strengthen Axion's industry position.



How We Operate:

We move fast, work smart, and hold ourselves to a high bar. Axion isn’t a 9–5 — it’s a place for people who take pride in their craft and are motivated by meaningful work. We respect time off and boundaries, but we’re also realistic: hard problems sometimes require weekend pushes or late-night thinking sessions. We support that balance — intensity with respect for recharge.



We:

 - Collaborate deeply. Feedback is part of how we build — everyone has a voice, and ideas win on merit.

 - Leave ego at the door. Titles don’t define value; contribution does.

 - Bias toward action. We iterate fast and favor progress over perfection.

 - Communicate with clarity. Direct, transparent, and always in service of the mission.

 - Act like owners. Everyone is accountable for outcomes, not just tasks.

 - Sustain excellence. We push hard but don’t glorify burnout — we’re in this for the long game.

If you want to help shape a company redefining how manufacturing operates — and you thrive in a culture that rewards ownership, speed, and candor — you’ll feel at home here.



What We Offer:

 - Work with cutting-edge AI technology making a tangible impact in manufacturing

 - Collaborative, mission-driven team and supportive leadership

 - Generous time off

 - Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits

 - Lunch stipend…. And much more

Ready to drive the future of manufacturing with AI? Apply today to join our team and help us build the category-defining platform for quality intelligence.

Axion is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. jobs.title: MEP & Site Utilities Manager
jobs.description:
NBCUniversal is seeking a Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) and Site Utilites Manager to join the Facilities Operations and Engineering team in Universal City, CA.

The MEP & Site Utilities Manager provides technical and operational leadership for the mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and utility infrastructure supporting a large-scale, mission-critical facility or campus.

You will be responsible for ensuring the safety, reliability, efficiency, and resiliency of critical building and utility systems, including electrical distribution, HVAC and central plant equipment, plumbing, water, natural gas, stormwater, wastewater, and emergency power systems.

You will lead preventive and predictive maintenance strategies, infrastructure reliability initiatives, capital improvement projects, utility planning, emergency response, and regulatory compliance. You will also oversee multidisciplinary technical teams, contractors, vendors, and engineering partners while collaborating closely with Facilities, Engineering, Construction, Operations, EHS, Finance, Sustainability, and other business stakeholders.

What You’ll Do:

Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing & Critical Infrastructure Operations

• Serve as the primary technical and operational resource for MEP systems and site utility infrastructure, directing the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and modernization of critical systems across multiple facilities.
• Oversee medium- and low-voltage electrical distribution, including transformers, switchgear, substations, motor control centers, generators, automatic transfer switches, and UPS systems.
• Manage central utility plants, chillers, cooling towers, chilled water systems, pumps, air handling units, HVAC, and building automation systems, as well as domestic water, sanitary sewer, stormwater, natural gas, industrial piping, drainage, and pumping stations.
• Ensure equipment and infrastructure are maintained in accordance with engineering standards, manufacturer requirements, operating procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Partner with engineering, construction, environmental health and safety, sustainability, security, and business units to evaluate equipment capacity, system redundancy, and expansion requirements, and to align infrastructure operations with production schedules, facility occupancy, and organizational priorities.

Infrastructure Reliability & Business Continuity

• Develop and manage preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance programs for mission-critical infrastructure.
• Lead risk assessments, equipment condition evaluations, and root-cause investigations; implement sustainable corrective actions to reduce equipment failures and unplanned outages.
• Maintain emergency response plans, utility shutdown procedures, contingency strategies, and recovery plans; coordinate planned shutdowns with affected business units to minimize disruption(s).
• Evaluate system redundancy, backup generation, UPS capacity, and emergency cooling, and support business continuity efforts during utility failures, natural disasters, and other critical events.

Site-Wide Utilities & Energy Management

• Oversee electrical, natural gas, domestic water, wastewater, stormwater, and other utility services supporting facility and campus operations.
• Build productive relationships and coordinate with public utilities, municipalities, regulatory agencies, engineering consultants, equipment manufacturers, and service providers on capacity, upgrades, planned shutdowns, and emergency restoration.
• Monitor demand, peak loads, consumption, and system capacity to support planning for new construction, facility expansion, and changing operational requirements.
• Drive utility reliability, energy efficiency, demand management, electrification, renewable energy, and distributed generation or microgrid initiatives.

Capital Projects & Infrastructure Modernization

• Develop, prioritize, and execute capital improvement projects focused on infrastructure reliability, lifecycle replacement, energy efficiency, and long-term facility needs.
• Manage MEP and utility projects from feasibility and design through procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout.
• Prepare scopes of work, technical requirements, cost estimates, schedules, and capital justifications; review engineering drawings, specifications, submittals, and construction plans.
• Coordinate architects, engineers, contractors, specialty trades, vendors, and internal stakeholders, evaluating lifecycle cost and total cost of ownership to ensure projects meet safety, budget, schedule, and operational requirements.

Team Leadership & Operational Management

• Lead and provide technical direction to multidisciplinary facilities personnel, technicians, supervisors, engineering partners, and contractors.
• Establish work priorities, performance expectations, and accountability; oversee daily maintenance, preventive maintenance schedules, work orders, inspections, and emergency repairs.
• Support technical training, performance evaluations, employee development, workforce planning, and succession planning.
• Manage vendor performance, service agreements, and service-level expectations while fostering a culture of safety, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Financial Management & Operational Budgeting

• Develop and manage operating budgets, maintenance expenses, service contracts, and capital funding for MEP and utility infrastructure.
• Evaluate replacement costs, project estimates, and infrastructure investments; prepare forecasts, budget justifications, and capital recommendations for senior management.
• Manage vendor proposals, competitive bids, contract negotiations, purchase approvals, and project cost controls.
• Identify cost savings through energy optimization, maintenance efficiencies, lifecycle planning, and strategic procurement while balancing reliability, safety, business continuity, and long-term asset preservation.

Regulatory Compliance, Safety & Risk Management

• Ensure operations, maintenance, construction, and infrastructure modifications comply with applicable codes, standards, safety requirements, and environmental regulations.
• Promote compliance with OSHA/Cal-OSHA requirements, NFPA standards, electrical safety practices, lockout/tagout, confined-space, and contractor safety requirements.
• Coordinate inspections, permits, testing, certifications, and corrective actions; maintain operating procedures, safety records, inspection reports, and maintenance histories.
• Identify operational hazards and infrastructure risks and implement mitigation strategies to protect personnel, facilities, equipment, and business operations.

Facilities Technology & Performance Reporting

• Utilize CMMS, IWMS, BMS, asset management, and infrastructure monitoring technologies, including Archibus, ArcGIS/ESRI, Siemens, Tridium, and comparable systems.
• Maintain accurate asset inventories, equipment records, electrical single-line diagrams, utility maps, and infrastructure drawings.
• Establish KPIs, outage tracking, and dashboards for infrastructure availability, utility reliability, maintenance performance, asset condition, energy consumption, safety, and capital project delivery.
• Use performance data, trends, and condition assessments to inform risk-based maintenance and capital decisions, and communicate infrastructure risks, service interruptions, project milestones, capital requirements, and technical recommendations to senior leadership.

Let’s Talk About You…

• Analytical - You create tools and processes quickly and accurately to provide job estimates for clients levering deep industry experience, historical trends, teams and vendor relationships.
• Executer - You get things done and take accountability! Using strong business acumen, organizational and superior process/project management skills, you prioritize and execute numerous complex projects in parallel.
• Customer Service Skills - You communicate effectively and solve problems to drive customer service and make client delivery a priority.
• Principles- Displays integrity, responsibility, accountability, teamwork, and ethics.
• Team Player Fosters a culture of teamwork, mutual respect, and collaboration across diverse teams. Builds and maintains strong, productive relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Leadership - You are a proven leader known to challenge the status quo, introduce new and better ways of delivering results, and make difficult decisions and lead through change.

What You Must Have:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Facilities Management, Construction Management, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
• 8+ years of progressive experience in facilities engineering, MEP systems, utility infrastructure, industrial maintenance, critical facilities, or a related environment.
• 3+ years of leadership experience managing technical employees, contractors, maintenance operations, engineering functions, or multidisciplinary facilities teams.
• Strong technical understanding of electrical distribution, HVAC and mechanical infrastructure, plumbing systems, utility distribution, emergency power, and critical facility systems.
• Experience developing or managing preventive maintenance and infrastructure reliability programs.
• Experience supporting equipment replacement, infrastructure upgrades, troubleshooting, and capital improvement projects.
• Demonstrated experience working with contractors, engineering consultants, vendors, and construction partners.
• Working knowledge of relevant building, electrical, life-safety, environmental, and workplace safety requirements and operating procedures.
• Strong project management, budgeting, procurement, analytical, and technical reporting skills.

What Would Make You a Stand-out:

• Experience supporting large commercial campuses, entertainment or production facilities, industrial operations, data centers, healthcare environments, or other mission-critical facilities.
• Experience with medium-voltage electrical distribution, central utility plants, emergency power, redundant infrastructure, and large-scale utility systems.
• Experience with infrastructure modernization, lifecycle replacement programs, and complex capital projects.
• Knowledge of utility planning, energy management, renewable energy, distributed generation, electrification, or microgrid technologies.
• Experience with facilities and asset management technologies such as Archibus, ArcGIS/ESRI, Siemens, Tridium, CMMS, IWMS, or BMS platforms.
• PE, CEM, PMP, CFM, or similar technical or facilities-related credentials are a plus.
• Studio Lot experience.
• Experience managing in a union environment.

Additional Requirements:

• Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $90,000-$115,000 (bonus eligible)

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

NBCUniversal will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Alumni Engagement
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Alumni Engagement will build and manage an active and supportive community that strengthens the alumni network through relationship building, volunteer development, alumni services, educational programming and events with the goal of continuous, meaningful alumni engagement.

Reporting to the Vice President, Alumni Engagement, the Senior Manager, Alumni Engagement is responsible for the design, implementation and evaluation of progressive alumni engagement strategies that build enduring and mutually beneficial relationships, inspire loyalty and support, strengthen the institution's reputation and engage our alumni in meaningful activities that advance the institution. The ideal candidate will bring exceptional organizational skills, including expertise in project leadership and relationship management. They will have a demonstrated track record of building and maintaining a robust alumni program and must have the poise and ability to build relationships with multiple constituents, influence action and achieve results.

Responsibilities

• Implement a comprehensive and inclusive alumni strategy that engages alumni and creates rewarding experiences designed to foster lifelong connections between alumni and the institution.
• Develop and deploy activities valued by alumni, including event management, digital platform oversight and volunteer programs with outcomes focused on building relationships and brand loyalty.
• Work across functional areas to identify, recruit and engage alumni in meaningful activities with students, staff and each other to enhance admissions and student success and to advance the institution’s mission.
• Manage alumni engagement in the student experience for student mentorship and prospective student outreach and sourcing alumni speakers for student initiatives.
• Identify, cultivate and steward alumni volunteers. Implement the alumni awards and recognition program.
• Plan, organize and help execute in-person and virtual alumni events such as alumni receptions, reunions, student events, campus visits and conferences.
• Strategize, recommend and implement new tactics and initiatives to increase brand awareness and alumni engagement.
• Partner with Corporate Affairs to share the story of our alumni community.
• Support efforts to accelerate the brand strategy by sourcing and leveraging alumni stories to showcase our global community of lifelong learners.
• Contribute to communications for alumni, including university announcements, eNewsletters, alumni stories and profiles, social media posts and online community group posts and announcements.
• Manage an alumni leadership council/advisory board; design the group’s objectives, host regular meetings (virtual and in-person), record minutes and report on activity and progress to university stakeholders.
• Track alumni engagement and ROI, compile metrics and analytics and prepare progress reports.
• Support efforts to maintain an up-to-date alumni database; provide reporting to university stakeholders when requested.
• Manage budget related to the institution's alumni engagement activities.
• Raise internal awareness of the alumni engagement efforts through project leadership, collaboration and clear articulation of the alumni program's value, benefits and goals.
• Establish and build relationships with institutional alumni and maintain regular communication with them.
• May supervise a Senior Coordinator or Specialist, Alumni Engagement.
• Contribute to Alumni Engagement goals by supporting other duties and projects as needed.

• Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communications or a related field required
• Master's degree preferred
• 7+ years experience in a community relations, marketing or relationship management role
• Previous alumni relations or related community management/higher education experience preferred
• Experience using CRM platforms and/or integrated student information systems preferred (e.g., Banner, HubSpot)
• Proven leadership skills, particularly in starting new initiatives, launching successful direct marketing/outreach programs, fundraising or membership organizing activities.
• Excellent oral and written communication and presentation skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), database applications and web-based tools.
• Ability to organize, prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines
• Ability to travel 5-6 times per year (valid passport is required for Ross Vet)
• Ability to work occasional weekends and evenings to support alumni events

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected salary range for this position is between $80336.75 and $140851.54. Actual pay will be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we look forward to learning more about your salary requirements. The position qualifies for the below benefits.

Covista offers a robust suite of benefits including:

• 401k Retirement Program + 6% employer match
• Participation in Covista’s Flexible Time Off (FTO) Policy
• 12 Paid Holidays For more information related to our benefits please visit: https://careers.covista.com/benefits You are also eligible to participate in an annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   


THE ROLE:

Savvy's Forward Deployed Engineers sit between our core platform and the external firms who run their business on top of it. Rather than pulling advisors into Savvy, you'll embed with the client: understanding their existing tech stack, operations, and workflows, then building and customizing the integrations that bring Savvy's software directly into their environment. The best FDEs here move quickly between discovery, scrappy prototyping, and production-quality code, and bring what they learn back to the core product so the next deployment goes faster than the last.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Embed with external firms and clients to understand their existing systems and workflows, and build the integrations and custom solutions that bring Savvy's platform into their stack.

 - Partner with a lead or senior engineer, and with a deployed PM, to scope ambiguous client requests into a clear plan, then own execution end to end: discovery, build, deployment, and iteration.

 - Practice decomposition on client feedback: separate the real, fixable technical and business problems from surface-level complaints, and propose solutions grounded in that analysis.

 - Produce high-quality, maintainable, production-ready code that balances client urgency with long-term scalability.

 - Prototype quickly, validate with the client or internal stakeholder, and iterate before locking in a final solution.

 - Feed patterns and learnings from each deployment back to Product and core Engineering so one-off client solutions become reusable platform capability, not one-off work that lives only at the client.

 - Debug, diagnose, and resolve live issues in collaboration with clients and internal teams, including working through logs and unfamiliar parts of the client's stack to root cause problems.

 - Join client-facing calls and demos as part of a small embedded team (engineers and a deployed PM), presenting work and gathering requirements directly from the client.

 - Contribute to tooling, automation, and process improvements that make future deployments faster and more sustainable.

 - Participate in code review and architecture discussions with the broader engineering team.

 - Travel within the United States as needed (approximately 2 to 4 times per quarter) for client deployments and collaboration sessions, typically 2 days each.

 - We expect folks to work in office Tuesday through Thursday, with the option to work from home on Mondays and Fridays.


MUST HAVE:

 - 1 to 4 years of experience building and shipping production web applications.

 - Solid full-stack proficiency, including a web framework (Rails preferred), a front-end framework or library (React preferred), and SQL databases.

 - Comfort debugging production issues across an unfamiliar stack, including a client's existing systems, working through logs and data to root cause problems.

 - Strong experience with Excel, Google Sheets, and other tools to collect and mutate data into client-friendly formats.

 - Clear, confident communication, able to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, including clients.

 - Genuine motivation to work directly with clients and understand their problems firsthand, not just build against a spec.

 - Comfort working in ambiguous, client-driven environments, and the judgment to know when to move fast versus when to loop in a more senior engineer.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience in fintech or wealth management, especially around systems integration, APIs, or working with external firms' existing tech stacks.

 - Experience leveraging AI directly and various AI tools to integrate disparate systems, including those without APIs.

 - Experience with systems integrations or ETL across SaaS, custodial, or legacy systems.

 - Prior customer-facing engineering experience (forward-deployed, professional services, implementation engineering, or similar), even from an internship or short-term project.

 - Proven ability to collaborate in fast-moving, cross-functional startup environments.


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - We offer a generous relocation package to help top talent make the move to our NYC office

 - Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

 - Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

 - Company 401(k) (including Mega backdoor Roth options), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans 

 - NYC office in Union Square

 - Lunch and snacks provided in the office, & dinner if you stay late

 - Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care

 - Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

 - Benefits are available to full-time employees

This role is responsible for overseeing the execution of the firm’s service model, ensuring that client experiences align with the firm’s standards and values. The Relationship Manager I plays a critical role in practice management, client retention, and business growth, serving as a key contributor to the success of the advisory team.

This role offers a clear career path to Relationship Manager II and III, with increasing levels of strategic influence, leadership, and client engagement.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Program Management
jobs.description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Mirai Bio is a privately-held, Flagship-founded biotechnology company that is delivering genetic medicines from promise to performance. Mirai was built to solve one of the field’s central challenges: achieving precise, scalable delivery of diverse nucleic acid payloads to specific cells and tissues, particularly beyond the liver. By combining a large and growing proprietary in vivo biodistribution dataset, machine learning-guided lipid nanoparticle optimization, modular targeted particle design, and integrated translation and manufacturing capabilities, Mirai helps partners accelerate development, reduce technical risk, and pursue high-value programs making delivery a strategic advantage. We are seeking collaborative, relentless problem solvers that share our passion for defining the future of genetic medicines together.

THE ROLE

Mirai Bio is seeking an experienced Associate Director, Program Management to provide strategic and operational leadership for the execution of research programs focused on nucleic acid therapeutics, including mRNA, and lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery.

The primary focus of this role is leading the execution of complex research projects within external collaborations. The Associate Director will establish and drive integrated project plans, timelines, milestones, resources, risks, and deliverables across internal and external teams. Working closely with Alliance Management and internal functional leaders, this individual will ensure projects remain strategically aligned, appropriately resourced, and focused on delivering high-quality results for Mirai and its partners.

The Associate Director will also play a key role in cross-functional operations and resource planning, partnering with functional leaders to align resources and capacity with project objectives and portfolio priorities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Project and Program Execution

• Provide leadership and oversight for the execution of complex research projects and external collaborations, coordinating activities across internal and partner teams.

• Develop, maintain, and drive integrated project plans encompassing timelines, milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, decisions, and deliverables.

• Track progress against project plans and partner commitments; identify, escalate, and resolve risks, issues, dependencies, and delays.

• Partner with Mirai Platform, LNP Formulation, Analytical, and other functional teams to establish project priorities and align support and deliverables across multiple projects.

• Establish effective meeting structures, decision-making processes, and communication plans with internal stakeholders and external partners. Drive clear accountability for actions, decisions, and deliverables across organizational boundaries.

• Provide regular project status updates and recommendations to senior leadership.

• Support development and management of Statements of Work (SOWs), including scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, budgets, and change management.

External Collaboration and Alliance Management

• Work closely with Alliance Management to support effective collaboration, communication, governance, and issue resolution with external research partners.

• Facilitate cross-company decision-making and drive resolution of issues that may impact project objectives or timelines.

• Lead coordination across complex, multidisciplinary teams and ensure alignment on objectives, milestones, dependencies, and resource requirements.

• Represent Program Management in cross-functional and leadership discussions, driving alignment and accountability across stakeholders

Resource Planning

• Proactively identify critical path risks, resource constraints, technical dependencies, and potential impacts to key milestones.

• Facilitate prioritization and resource allocation discussions with functional leaders to ensure critical project needs are appropriately supported.

• Lead cross-functional resource and capacity planning across the project portfolio, identifying resource constraints, competing priorities, and potential gaps.

• Develop resource forecasts and capacity models to support pipeline growth, portfolio prioritization, and long-term organizational planning.

• Partner with Finance and functional leaders on program budgets, forecasting, cost tracking, and resource allocation.

Leadership Reporting & Program Communications

• Develop executive-level program reporting, dashboards, and portfolio updates that provide clear visibility into program health and strategic priorities.

• Establish standardized reporting and documentation practices across programs, including milestone tracking, decision logs, risk registers, action items, and program dashboards.

• Translate complex scientific and operational information into concise, actionable communications for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Organizational & PM Capability Building

• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the organization’s project and program management framework.

• Establish scalable tools, templates, dashboards, governance processes, and operating rhythms to improve program visibility and execution.

• Mentor and provide guidance to project managers and cross-functional team members on program management best practices.

• Identify opportunities to improve organizational processes, communication, resource utilization, and decision-making across the research portfolio.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

• Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, MS, or equivalent) in a relevant scientific discipline or comparable experience.

• 8+ years of project or program management experience in biotech or pharma, preferably in RNA therapeutics, nucleic acid delivery, or LNP development.

• Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional projects and external research collaborations in a biotech or pharmaceutical environment.

• Experience managing projects involving CROs, collaborators, vendors, or other third parties.

• Strong understanding of preclinical research and drug development processes.

• Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, drive accountability across organizational boundaries, and effectively engage senior stakeholders.

• Experience with resource planning, capacity management, portfolio prioritization, or cross-functional operational planning.

• Strong organizational, communication, facilitation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

• Ability to operate strategically while maintaining strong attention to execution and operational detail.

• PMP certification or formal project management training is a plus.

Preferred Experience

jobs.title: Manager, Revenue Enablement & Strategy [M3]
jobs.description:
Who we are

Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn't kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase.

With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today - giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once.

Companies like Stripe, Reddit, and Leidos rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We're backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love.

If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us.

Working hours

🌎 While we are an all-remote company and hire almost anywhere in the world, we do require successful candidates to be located in the United States.

Preferred location:

• USA

Why this job is exciting

Sourcegraph gives the largest, most sophisticated engineering organizations in the world full codebase context so their teams and their agents can understand, oversee, and change their codebase with confidence. As agent adoption grows, our sellers and customer teams need to explain a fast-evolving product to a fast-moving market. Enablement is how we keep up.

This is the chance to lead Revenue Enablement and own its strategy, roadmap, and cross-functional alignment with Product, Marketing, and Revenue leadership.

This is a player-coach role; like every role in the company we are do-ers as well as leaders. You'll set the direction and also build and deliver key programs yourself. You'll take topics from idea to finished program, pull in the right partners without being asked, and measure whether reps actually understood and applied what they learned, not just whether they completed it.

📅 Within one month, you will…

• Learn our products, our value prop, and our customer engagement process

• Shadow every active enablement workstream, including our value framework roll-out, competitive trainings, product roadmap roll-out, onboarding programs for new hires, and more

• Build relationships with key stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and across our Revenue teams (the key individuals you serve)

• Work with your direct report to establish shared goals and responsibilities for how you’ll work together

📅 Within one quarter, you will…

• Take ownership of the Revenue Enablement roadmap, intake, and prioritization process, with inputs from key stakeholders

• Run key launches yourself, while also supporting your team’s workstreams as well

• Report enablement progress to Revenue leadership on a regular cadence

• Help us build out and execute on our FY28 Revenue Kick-Off

📅 Within six months, you will…

• Define how enablement measures comprehension and application, and report results to Revenue leadership

• Coach your direct report to take programs from ideation to finished program on her own

About you

You're an enablement practitioner first and a leader second. You can set a strategy on a Monday and run a live training on a Wednesday. You command a room, read it, and adjust in the moment, because you care whether teammates understood, not whether they finished.

You know how sales and enterprise GTM works. You understand processes and methodologies well enough to coach sellers and earn the trust of sales leaders. You've managed or led people and you enjoy developing someone early in their career.

Your skill-set:

• 7+ years in revenue enablement, including experience at a developer tools company

• Experience designing and delivering programs end-to-end: onboarding, methodology, persona, competitive, and launch training

• Strong sales and business acumen, with a working knowledge of sales processes and methodologies

• Excellent presentation and live facilitation skills

• Proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Notion, and comparable tools

Level

📊 This job is an M3.  You can read more about our job leveling philosophy in our Handbook.

Compensation

💸 We pay you an above-average salary because we want to hire the best people who are fully focused on helping Sourcegraph succeed, not worried about paying bills. As an open and transparent company that values competitive compensation, our compensation ranges are visible to every single Sourcegraph teammate.

Your salary is determined by your pay band for the M3  job level. For determining pay bands, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources, along with your location zone, and target the high-end of the range to ensure we’re always paying above market regardless of where you live in the world. Both U.S. and international locations are divided into one of four zones, determined by the cost of labor index for each area. The salary for a successful candidate will be based on level, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location zone. Please note that the salaries below may be adjusted in the future.

💰 The target compensation for this role is $160,650 USD base + $28,350 USD variable ($189,000 USD on-target-earnings).

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer equity (because when we succeed as a company, we want you to succeed, too) and generous perks & benefits.

Interview process

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role (you can read more about the types of interviews in our Handbook). It may look like a lot of steps, but rest assured that we move quickly and the steps are designed to help you get the information needed to determine if we’re the right fit for you… Interviewing is a two-way street, after all!

We expect the interview process to take 3.75 hours in total.

🧑‍💻 Team Interview Stage - we then delve into your experience in more depth and introduce you to members of the team, including cross-functional partners…

🎉 Final Interview Stage - we move you to our final round, where you gain a better understanding of our business and values holistically…

Please note - you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet, but didn’t get to meet during the interview process.

Learn more about us

You can learn more about what it is like to work at Sourcegraph by reading our handbook.

We are an ambitious team who are collectively working hard to build the most influential company in the world. You can read more about our culture, competitive compensation and benefits here.
