jobs.title: Senior Events and Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Viam

Founded by Eliot Horowitz, co-founder and former CTO of MongoDB, Viam is a novel robotics engineering platform that lets you configure, control, and manage robots intuitively and quickly. We’re inspiring a generation of engineers to solve complicated automation problems with our uniquely powerful suite of software tools.

We’re a ~100-person company headquartered in New York City.

About the role

In office at our New York City headquarters, with travel to events in other cities.

At a Viam hackathon, teams of robotics application developers spend the event building projects on robot arms and other machines. Before the first team sits down, someone has booked the room, made sure the venue has power at every table and a network the robots can use, filled it with 50 to 100 developers, and made sure Viam’s mentors and staff know their roles, where to be, and when. That someone is you, and once the event starts, you keep it on time and help troubleshoot any problems that arise.

You'll run Viam's events program, and hackathons are one part of it. We've held them in person at our New York City headquarters and in San Francisco. The rest of the program is workshops and conferences, where we run a booth and demos. We run one to two hackathons a month and attend four to six conferences a year. Field marketing is part of the job as well: filling our events with developers and getting us in front of developers at other organizations' events.

This is not a technical role, and you don't need a technical background. Our technical staff handle the robots, the demos, the software, and the network. They tell you what each event needs from a venue or a conference organizer, and you make sure it's there. Your work is logistics, people, promotion, and the event itself.

What you'll do

• You propose the event calendar, and Marketing and Education leadership approves it. The calendar sets which events we run, which conferences we attend, and when and where each one happens. You own the events budget and are accountable for what the program produces.

• Hackathons are a core part of the job, including joint hackathons with partner companies and internal hackathons for Viam employees. You produce each one from the first budget and timeline to the final report. You produce workshops and training sessions the same way.

• At conferences, you run our booth. You book the space, plan the layout, order the materials, and arrange shipping and staging. Then you schedule the people who work the booth and keep it staffed and stocked until the conference ends.

• You build local partnerships with universities, maker spaces, robotics clubs, meetups, and partner companies, so that each event reaches the developers it's for.

• For the events we hold, you find the space, negotiate terms and cost, and get the agreement signed. Then you work out the floor plan and the catering.

• You write the description for every event, set up its registration, and write the promotion plan and content that fill it. The plan names the audience, the channels, the dates, and a registration target. The content is the announcements, emails, partner blurbs, and reminders that go out before the day.

• Each event needs mentors, judges, speakers, volunteers, and time from our technical staff. You recruit and schedule them, brief them, and keep everyone on track with a run-of-show and deadlines.

• When something goes wrong on the day and it isn't technical, you sort it out, whether it's a vendor running late or a session running long. When the problem is technical, you get the right technical person to it fast.

• Every attendee hears from you after the event, and you publish a recap of what participants built. The follow-up points people to our Discord and our free online courses.

• You measure what each event produced and report it. Registrations and attendance show whether the promotion worked. What participants built, and what attendees did afterward, show whether the event did.

• You write a playbook for each kind of event, with its checklists and a chart of who's responsible for what, so our events are repeatable. After every event, you update it with what the event taught you.

What you bring

• Seven or more years producing events or running field marketing, including programs you owned end to end.

• Experience producing hackathons or events of similar complexity, public or internal, from first plan through the day itself.

• A background in operations and events is welcome, including large internal company events, executive support, and community programs. We don't expect a developer relations or engineering background.

• A track record in field marketing, with evidence: events you filled, the registrations and attendance against your target, and what attendees did afterward. A conference or trade show booth you ran counts as evidence too: how you set it up, the leads it captured, and where they went.

• Clear, specific writing, shown in event descriptions and promotion content you’ve written.

• Experience negotiating venue agreements, and getting venues and vendors to deliver on technical requirements that others hand you.

• Ability to organize people who do not report to you and keep them on schedule.

• Steady judgment when something fails during a live event.

• Willingness and ability to travel to events and conferences outside New York, and to work evenings and weekends when events take place.

What success looks like in your first 90 days

In your first 30 days

• You've met the people you'll work with on events, and you've collected the plans and results that exist from Viam's past hackathons, other events, and conferences.

• You have the venue requirements checklist for a robot arm hackathon from our technical staff.

In your first 60 days

• Marketing and Education leadership has approved the event calendar you proposed for the next two quarters.

• You've delivered a field marketing plan for that calendar that names the cities, conferences, and other third-party events.

In your first 90 days

• If a hackathon falls in your first 90 days, you’ve produced it from plan to report.

• At one conference, you've run our booth, or you have the booth booked and the demo requirements confirmed for the next one.

• Local partners in the calendar's cities have agreed to promote Viam's events to their members.

• You've published a first playbook for a robot arm hackathon.

• You've run one internal event, or have one scheduled.

The salary for this role is between $160,000 - $200,000 /year.

Full-time Benefits

Viam’s base salary range for this role is posted above. In addition to cash compensation, Viam offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants, health benefits, and more.

• 100% covered medical/dental/vision insurance plans, commuter benefits

• 25 days paid vacation and generous holiday observances

• Free lunch every day that you’re in the office

• One Medical Membership

• Citi Bike memberships

• Monthly wellness stipend to be used for a variety of fitness-related items like gym memberships, fitness classes, fitness equipment, and more

• Paid parental leave

• Reproductive Health Benefits, including Fertility Benefits and Abortion Access Travel Benefits

• Yearly Learning and Development Budget for your own personal learning goals

Values:

• Vision Driven

• Collaborate Openly

• Act Decisively

• Succeed Through Diversity

• Hold Ourselves Accountable

• Lead with Curiosity

To all recruitment agencies:

Viam does not accept unsolicited agency resumes or calls from recruitment agencies or search firms. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or Viam employees. Viam is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:
Senior Contract Manager

If you are interested in the role please apply asap, do not wait until the last day :)

As a Senior Contract Manager at HubSpot, you will own the commercial success of your accounts by identifying expansion opportunities and growing customer investment through value-led conversations.

You will partner closely with customers to understand their goals, uncover growth opportunities and drive retention through effective renewal strategies. Your role will also involve proactively identifying customer risk and using data-driven insights to create strong renewal outcomes.

This role is available for all work preferences @home @flex @office in the United States location.

What You'll Do

• Negotiate value-driven renewals and contract changes while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

• Proactively identify account expansion opportunities by understanding customer goals and aligning HubSpot's AI-powered solutions to business outcomes.

• Lead customer conversations that combine discovery, value articulation, renewal planning, and commercial execution.

• Partner closely with Customer Success Managers to execute the contract renewal process and support long-term customer success.

• Forecast renewal outcomes accurately and update deal pipeline effectively.

• Lead initiatives beyond your individual accounts, driving process and operational improvements that increase team effectiveness.

• Influence cross-functional stakeholders to resolve complex customer and business challenges.

• Mentor teammates by sharing best practices and contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in Sales, Customer Success, Account Management or another customer-facing SaaS role.

• Experience leading customer conversations involving renewals, negotiations or complex contract discussions.

• Ability to manage multiple customer engagements in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in renewal and contract-related conversations.

• Experience building trusted relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.

• Strong prioritisation, organisation, and attention-to-detail skills.

• Demonstrated ability to identify customer needs and translate them into commercial outcomes.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently, exercise sound judgment and navigate ambiguity to solve complex business problems.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

• Familiarity with customer success, retention or usage-based risk models.

• Experience working with CRM-driven workflows, automation, or AI-enabled tools.

• Experience supporting account growth through cross-sell or upsell motions.

• Experience working within a SaaS subscription or recurring revenue business.

jobs.title: Training Program Manager, Security Operations
jobs.description:
Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach? In a world of shifting threats, Concentric is your trusted ally. Powered by elite professionals from military, government, and intelligence backgrounds. If you are passionate about intelligence, risk analysis, threat management, executive protection, security operations, or business resiliency, Concentric may be the organization you’ve been searching for!

Concentric is a risk consultancy specializing in delivering strategic security and intelligence services. We provide holistic, intelligent security solutions for private clients and corporations globally. Concentric offers strategic advisory services, risk assessments, physical protection, threat intelligence, open-source monitoring, program audits, secure embedded staffing, and training for security teams and intelligence analysts.

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:

Integrity – Collaboration - Relationships – Excellence – Creativity - Results

Join Us,

Concentric - "Your World Secured"

We are currently seeking a Training Program Manager, Security Operations to join Concentric’s Corporate Team.

This is a full-time, remote position. Days and hours of work are generally Monday through Friday. Evening and weekend work may be required to support training schedules for agents working varied shifts.

IS THIS ROLE RIGHT FOR YOU?

We’re looking for an experienced executive protection professional who can both deliver training and run the program behind it.

You’ll lead hands-on training for our embedded security teams, and over time for corporate employees. We have established courses in place, so you won’t be starting from scratch, but you’ll have the ownership to improve them and build new training where we have gaps. When we bring in outside vendors, you’ll work alongside them and stay closely involved in delivery.

Just as important is the administrative side. You’ll track licenses, certifications, and requalifications in tandem with our compliance team, schedule training around shift coverage and ongoing onboarding, and maintain audit-ready records for every agent. This role requires someone who is highly organized and detail-oriented. Strong instruction alone won’t be enough to succeed here.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Training Program Manager will deliver, manage, and continuously improve Concentric’s training and certification program for Security Operations and physical security embedded positions, including armed and unarmed security personnel, executive protection agents, and residential security teams.

This is Concentric’s first dedicated training role, created to support significant growth across our embedded client programs. The Training Program Manager will lead hands-on training for embedded security teams, with the opportunity to extend programs to Concentric’s corporate employees. We have established courses, vendors, and a strong network in place, so this role is not a build from scratch. You’ll have the ownership to improve existing training and create new courses where gaps exist.

Equally important, this role owns the administration that keeps the program running. You’ll work in tandem with our compliance team to track licenses, certifications, and qualifications, schedule training around shift coverage and ongoing onboarding, and maintain complete, audit-ready records for every employee. You’ll also serve as the company’s subject matter resource on security training compliance, including California Bureau of Security and Investigative Services (BSIS) requirements and other evolving state and international regulations.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Training Delivery & Development

• Deliver hands-on training to embedded security personnel, with the opportunity to extend programs to Concentric’s corporate employees

• Design, schedule, and manage initial and recurring training, including de-escalation, use of force, defensive tactics, First Aid/CPR/AED, Tactical Emergency Casualty Care (TECC), emergency evacuation, fire and water safety, surveillance and surveillance detection, advance work and site assessment, defensive driving, and communications and radio protocol

• Evaluate and improve existing courses, and develop new training where gaps are identified

• Develop and facilitate tabletop exercises and scenario-based training that prepare teams for critical incidents and emergency response

• Source, evaluate, and manage external training vendors, instructors, and ranges, and actively participate in vendor-led training to ensure quality and alignment with Concentric standards

• Coordinate physical fitness standards and testing, swim and water safety qualifications, and other client-required proficiency assessments

• Coordinate continuing education and advanced certification opportunities, such as advanced medical and trauma care, including client-sponsored programs

Compliance, Tracking & Administration

• Work in tandem with Concentric’s compliance team to track guard registrations, firearms qualifications, firearms permit renewals, and other required licenses and certifications, ensuring renewals and requalifications are completed before expiration

• Verify that new hires have completed required pre-start training and certifications (such as CPR, driving, and licensing requirements), and enroll them in needed courses without delay

• Identify, document, and maintain a training requirements matrix by state, country, license type, position, and client contract, covering initial, annual, and recurring requirements

• Build and lead Concentric’s plan to meet current and upcoming California BSIS training requirements for armed and unarmed security personnel, including initial training, annual refresher hours, in-person de-escalation instruction, and employee rights training

• Build and manage training calendars that balance ongoing onboarding, annual training requirements, and shift coverage across multiple client teams

• Translate client contract and work order training mandates into training plans for each client-specific team, and track and report completion against those requirements

• Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready training, certification, and qualification records for each employee throughout employment, and provide documentation to clients upon request

• Partner with People Operations to ensure mandatory training time is properly scheduled, recorded, and compensated, and that training records are maintained in the company’s systems of record

• Manage training schedules, logistics, and budget

• Provide regular reporting to leadership and clients on training compliance status, upcoming expirations, and program gaps

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship

• Bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, security management, business, education, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• 5+ years of executive protection experience, including 3+ years designing, managing, or delivering training programs; military or law enforcement background preferred

• Experience delivering hands-on security training to adult learners

• Established professional network of training vendors, instructors, ranges, and subject matter experts within the security, law enforcement, or military community

• Working knowledge of security guard licensing and training requirements, including California BSIS requirements

• Demonstrated experience building and maintaining training records, tracking systems, or a learning management system (LMS)

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong program management skills and the ability to manage multiple requirements, deadlines, and stakeholders across locations

• Excellent organizational, written, and verbal communication skills, including presenting to leadership and clients

• Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote environment

• Proficiency in Google Workspace, Monday.com, and spreadsheet-based tracking

• This position requires up to 35% travel, primarily to California and other client locations in the USA and internationally (Ireland, UK), often on short notice. Candidates must live within a reasonable distance of a major airport.

• Periodic work at client sites, training facilities, and firearms ranges is required to deliver, coordinate, or oversee training. This role is largely sedentary when working remotely. When attending or delivering training, the employee may be required to stand for extended periods, move about training areas and firearms ranges, and lift and carry training equipment weighing up to 25 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• BSIS-approved instructor or Firearms Training Instructor certification, or equivalent

• First Aid, CPR, AED Instructor Certification

• TECC/TCCC Instructor Certification

• De-escalation, defensive tactics, or use of force instructor certification

• Executive protection training or certification

• Certified Protection Professional (CPP) or Physical Security Professional (PSP)

• Experience building or formalizing a training program within a growing security organization

• Experience supporting client-embedded security programs with contract-mandated training requirements

• Experience with multi-state security licensing and compliance

• Familiarity with UKG or a similar HRIS platform

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

• Medical plan options: Concentric offers two medical plans: a high deductible health plan (HDHP) and a copay plan

• Health Savings Account (HSA): Employees enrolled in the HDHP receive an employer contribution to their HSA, which can be used for eligible medical expenses and carries over year to year

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA): Employees can set aside pre-tax dollars in a medical FSA to cover eligible healthcare expenses

• Paid holidays

• Annual Health & Wellness Benefit

• Paid leave (vacation, sick, parental)

• Employer-paid insurance: life, STD, LTD, and AD&D

• 401(k) including employer match

• Pet Insurance

• National discount employee program

• Employee Assistance Program for personal needs

jobs.description:

jobs.title: CAD Technician
jobs.description:
Hybrid-based position in our Syracuse, Rochester, or Albany, NY office.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position

Develop your excellence in our collaborative, inclusive, diverse, and empowering culture at Ramboll! When you start with Ramboll, you’ll be joining a company that strives to make a difference – for our employees, clients, and society. As you begin working on projects, you will be given increasing responsibility, while also being able to rely on experienced managers and colleagues who offer support and a helping hand as you learn and develop in your role. Our vision is to be a leading consultancy globally, delivering integrated and sustainable solutions that shape today and tomorrow.

Are you excited about understanding, interpreting, and navigating complex projects with real-life implications? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you a curious and open-minded person?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment & Health Division as our new CAD Technician and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

We are seeking a Civil CAD Technician or Civil Engineer with strong Civil 3D skills to support conceptual master planning efforts for large-scale data center campus developments. This role requires a blend of technical drafting/design and an ability to work closely with civil engineers and planners to visualize site layouts during early due diligence and planning phases.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Support conceptual site layouts, parcel planning, and preliminary utility, roadway, and grading concepts using AutoCAD Civil 3D, while translating engineering and planning mark-ups into accurate CAD drawings and site plans.
• Produce test fit layouts for large campuses, incorporating zoning setbacks, wetlands, access roads, utility corridors, and other site constraints.
• Perform quality control reviews of drawings to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable standards.
• Coordinate regularly with project managers, civil engineers, and planners, and occasionally participate in meetings with clients or other project stakeholders.
• Assist with gathering and interpreting site data, zoning information, and environmental constraints to support planning and design efforts.

About you

• Proficient in AutoCAD Civil 3D; experience with data center, industrial, or campus-scale planning preferred.
• Diploma or degree in CAD design/drafting, civil engineering technology, or related field plus 2+ years of experience in site/civil drafting or design.
• Familiarity with land development, site planning, grading, and utility routing.
• Ability to read and interpret zoning ordinances and planning criteria is a plus.
• Detail-oriented with excellent communication skills and the ability to meet deadlines.

What we can offer you

• Investment in your development
• Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
• Being valued for the unique person you are
• Never being short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $69,222 to $86,528 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

jobs.title: Service Manager, Threat Services
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Service Manager, Threat Services, you will be tasked with helping make our strategic partnership successful for customers by representing SentinelOne's interests in partner-delivered managed detection and response (MDR), ensuring the service is performing as promised, quality issues are identified early, and operational changes produce better customer outcomes. The partner operates the service; you own SentinelOne-side assurance, cross-team resolution, and evidence-driven continuous improvement. Our expanded global relationship with our strategic partners brings together SentinelOne's AI-powered security platform and our partners' expertise in managed detection and response, managed SIEM, and incident response, and as partner-delivered services grow, SentinelOne remains committed to clear customer ownership, technical quality, and measurable results.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Run structured MDR operational reviews with the partner covering alert handling, investigation quality, escalation decisions, and customer impact.

• Monitor detection and response performance, including mean time to detect, mean time to respond, false positives, and escalation accuracy.

• Investigate missed handoffs, inaccurate prioritization, repeated tuning defects, and service failures; coordinate corrective-action plans.

• Partner with SentinelOne detection engineering and Product to adjudicate content issues while preserving SentinelOne ownership of platform detection decisions.

• Validate that MDR runbooks, escalation thresholds, customer contacts, and evidence requirements are current and followed.

• Coordinate high-severity service issues with Critical Situation Management, Support, Threat Services, and customer-facing technical success teams.

• Review partner quality samples and reconcile partner-reported results with SentinelOne telemetry and independent reporting.

• Maintain a prioritized improvement backlog with owners, actions, deadlines, and objective closure evidence.

• Identify onboarding and service-readiness risks that could affect ongoing operations or customer retention.

• Drive measurable outcomes, including improved MDR detection and response performance with evidence-based reporting; better escalation accuracy and lower avoidable false-positive burden; closure of recurring MDR quality findings and improvement actions; higher MDR customer satisfaction and stronger renewal health; and earlier identification and containment of systemic service issues.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• 5 or more years of experience in MDR, SOC management, security operations, managed security service delivery, or technical service assurance.

• Strong understanding of SIEM, EDR/XDR, alert triage, incident handling, detection tuning, and operational security workflows.

• Experience evaluating detection quality, response timelines, false-positive trends, and customer escalation patterns.

• Ability to work productively with external delivery partners without confusing governance with hands-on service operations.

• Strong root-cause analysis, quality-review, documentation, and data interpretation capabilities.

• Confident stakeholder management during urgent security events and sensitive customer issues.

• Ability to drive remediation across technical, customer success, engineering, and partner teams.

• Experience with SentinelOne Singularity and Purple AI or similar detection and response platforms is highly desirable.

• Familiarity with threat hunting, incident readiness and response, and security analytics is highly desirable.

• Experience building scorecards or operational quality programs for an MSSP is highly desirable.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

• Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

• Flexible time off

• Paid company holidays and paid sick time

• Gender-neutral parental leave

• Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Life and disability insurance

• Health and dependent care FSA

• Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• ARAG pre-paid legal

• Nationwide pet insurance

• Cancer Care program

• Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

• Home office allowance

• Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

• Wellness coach

• Wellness/gym reimbursement

• Fertility coverage

• Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

This U.S. role has a base pay range that will vary based on the location of the candidate. For some locations, a different pay range may apply.  If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

Base Salary Range

$132,000—$182,000 USD

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Medical Laboratory Technician-Part-time Days
jobs.description:
This is a part-time, 20 hours per week, 1st shift position at Delnor Hospital in Geneva. Will be required to work every third weekend.

The Medical Laboratory Technician reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A Medical Laboratory Technician performs test procedures in a clinical laboratory and conveys the results to the physician or designee in an accurate and timely manner for the purpose of patient diagnosis and treatment.

Responsibilities:

Technical responsibilities:

• Performs all aspects of pre-analytic workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure orders are entered correctly, specimens collected are appropriate for the test ordered and are correctly processed/transported.
• Verifies order where necessary
• Verifies non-patient information (e.g., collection time) according to established protocol.
• Handles unresolved orders, troubleshoots where needed. Informs senior staff of resolutions. Escalates promptly when unable to resolve.
• Verifies with physicians and/or nurses prior to laboratory information system (LIS) order entry to resolve unclear, duplicate or otherwise ambiguous orders.
• Verifies specimens for add-on tests are available and acceptable and generates add-on test orders.
• Recognizes when fraud and abuse compliance issues require adjustments to the test order
• Collecting, receiving and processing of specimens:
• Verifies specimens are correctly and completely labeled upon receipt. Evaluates specimens for appropriateness and takes necessary corrective action. Appropriately documents unacceptable specimens and proper notifications as needed.
• Prioritizes specimen processing based on established priorities.
• Aliquots specimens according to established protocols.
• Performs all aspects of analytical testing appropriate for the specific laboratory section, following established written protocols and standard operating procedures (SOP)
• Maintains test system integrity:
• Performs preventive maintenance on instruments/equipment in a timely fashion according to defined schedule.
• Verifies reagents and supplies meet defined acceptability criteria upon receipt and prior to use; takes action to ensure unacceptable items are removed from use.
• Ensures that sufficient reagents and supplies necessary for test performance are available. Notifies senior staff when minimum inventory level is encountered.
• Performs and records all necessary quality control (QC) required for test system performance.
• Evaluates QC results and takes necessary corrective actions according to established protocol.
• Performs specimen preparation:
• Performs any necessary pretest specimen preparation according to protocols (e.g., microbiology plating, cell cultures, filtering, extraction, separation, elution, absorption, etc.)
• Transfers or ships specimens to approved testing locations according to SOPs
• Performs waived, moderate, and high complexity testing
• Prioritizes testing based on assignment or established priorities, completes testing within defined turn-around-times (TAT).
• Recognizes the need for and follows any age-specific protocols
• Responds effectively to changes in the workflow by coordinating a simultaneous series of tests when needed or adjusting work to incorporate STAT tests or fluctuations in work volume.
• Monitors daily workflow and priorities to assure meeting service levels.
• Performs technical review and interpretation, according to defined SOPs:
• Reviews results for completeness, correctness, and consistency within defined test system
• Evaluates test results/reactions and provides accurate interpretations as appropriate to include correlation with, and integration of, other patient data as necessary.
• Performs visual interpretation/identifications as appropriate.
• Recognizes unusual test results/interpretations and completes indicated reflex testing or other follow-up actions.
• Follows established notification protocols for critical values, phone/fax/e-mail results requests, abnormalities.
• Troubleshoots and solves problems:
• Recognizes test system performance problems and takes necessary corrective actions
• Recognizes when unresolved problems need to be escalated and takes necessary follow-up action.
• Prints pending logs and follows-up to ensure pending tests are completed or cancelled when appropriate.
• Post-test specimen storage:
• Stores specimens and related materials (blood, slides, tissues, etc.) according to protocols for location and duration.
• Retrieves specimen and related materials when needed

Universal responsibilities:

Ensures quality of operations:

• Follows written SOPs
• Operates instruments/equipment according to protocol.
• Uses computers according to established protocol; follows downtime procedures as required.
• Performs required quality system responsibilities
• Meets proficiency and competency standards of the department.
• Participates in the training of new employees and students, under the direction of Medical Laboratory Scientist trainers Performs operational review of new SOPs.
• Participates in new test development, validations and implementation.
• Attends at least one personal development session per year
• Performs other duties as assigned, or as needed, to ensure continued quality operations Ensures safety of operations: Follows all required safety procedures, uses personal protective equipment (PPE) appropriate for tasks performed.
• Maintains cleans and organized work area
• Provides service excellence:
• Answers telephone when needed, using NM telephone etiquette
• Maintains patient confidentiality including protected health information (PHI)
• Assists patients, visitors and other contacts whenever need occurs

Post-analytical responsibilities:

Performs all aspects of the post-analytical workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure accurate results are reported within established time frames, specimens are retained appropriately, test results and/or current status are available upon inquiry, and billed charges are correct for testing performed.  Verifies and reports results:

• Verifies results according to procedure.
• Performs computer functions necessary for releasing results.
• Generates written reports according to established protocol.
• Reviews electronic or printed reports when applicable, recognizes problems and escalates according to protocol.

Amends reports:

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Operational Technology- Remote (Anywhere in the U.S.)
jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

GuidePoint Security’s Operational Technology service offerings are perpetually evolving in response to emerging threats and diverse client needs. We are growing and are looking to hire an OT Security Engineer with an in-depth understanding of Securing Operational Technology. Knowledge of OT, IoT, network architecture, and cybersecurity is a must.

About the OT/IoT Security Services Practice

The OT/IoT Security Services practice protects the industrial systems our clients depend on in energy, water, manufacturing, healthcare, transportation, and other critical infrastructure sectors. We deliver in every GuidePoint Security region and provide the services behind GuidePoint Security's OT technology partnerships.

Most of the team came to security from the plant floor or the military: veterans and former engineers from utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, and nuclear power. They know what an operator is thinking when a consultant walks into the control room with a laptop, and safety and uptime come first on every job.

A typical client relationship starts with finding out what's actually on the OT network and where it's exposed. From there we design segmentation and controls that don't interrupt operations, and many clients stay with us for ongoing OT vulnerability management. The work in between includes OT risk assessments against ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, NERC CIP, and the TSA security directives; OT penetration tests scoped for live environments; and deployment and tuning of OT visibility and secure remote access platforms.

OT has problems you won't find in IT security, like hunting for an attacker on a network that can't handle an active scan, or explaining a firewall change to someone who has to keep a turbine running. Every site is different, and that's a big part of why we stay.

What sets the practice apart

• A multi-vendor OT lab with PLC hardware and several visibility and remote access platforms, so clients can compare them side by side before buying

• Vendor-objective advice. We work with many platforms and can tell a client which one fits their environment

• A fast-growing OT practice on track to become one of GuidePoint Security's top practices, with leadership support and the autonomy to shape the service catalog, lab, and team

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Deliver OT professional services, including but not limited to OT Architecture Reviews, Validated Architecture and Design Reviews (VADR), OT Advisory and Engineering services, deployment of OT tools such as Claroty, Dragos, Nozomi, and Tenable OT

• Perform OT security assessments and OT penetration tests on live environments, using passive-first, OT-safe methods and coordinating testing with plant operations around change and outage windows

• Install and configure network taps and monitoring sensors at client sites, including rollouts across many field locations, working from approved design documents

• Author comprehensive services deliverables that are proficiently tailored to both technical and managerial audiences and fully detail the technical execution, core deficiencies, business impact, and realistic remediation strategies

• Perpetually strengthen relevant skills, knowledge, and abilities to stay at the forefront of the OT security industry

• Foster strong client relationships and represent GuidePoint Security well by providing interactive and collaborative support, information, and guidance to ensure delivery of maximum value

• Maintain a strong desire to learn, adapt, and improve along with a rapidly-growing company

• Perform other duties as assigned

Required Experience and Education:

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience performing security services related to OT, or two (2) years of experience performing security services related to OT and a BS/BA Degree, or MS/MA Degree.

• Minimum of two (2) years of experience in an enterprise-level consulting services role.

• Over five (5+) combined years of IT, networking, and information security experience is strongly preferred

• Knowledge of ISA/IEC 62443, NIST-CSF, NIST 800-82, etc.

• Knowledge of the Purdue Model Framework

• Operational Technology Penetration Testing experience is preferred

• Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional (GICSP) or GIAC Response and Industrial Defense (GRID) certification is preferred

• Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes

Preferred Experience and Education:

While it may not be feasible to satisfy every desired attribute listed below perfectly, the OT Security Engineer is expected to possess the vast majority of these attributes:

• Able to be lead consultant with technical oversight

• Contribute to marketing initiatives via activities such as publishing research, speaking at industry conferences, authoring blog articles and whitepapers, and hosting webinars

• May need occasional assistance from a senior team member during report review meetings when describing more complex scenarios

• Writes reports that typically require a fair amount of re-writing/edits before delivery to clients

• Performs tasks in a timely manner (e.g., timesheets, reports, weekly status reports) and can communicate issues efficiently if any arise

• Ability to handle tricky client/project situations with assistance from senior team member

• Strong knowledge of OT related attacks, tactics, and techniques

• Experience deploying OT security tools, such as Claroty, Dragos, Nozomi, and Tenable OT

Travel Requirements:

• Up to 25% travel

Physical Requirements:

• Sedentary work

• Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day

• Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

• Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)

• Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)

• Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our FP&A team. Reporting to the Finance Manager, FP&A, you’ll primarily own financial tracking and analysis for our hardware programs and R&D functions, working closely with Program Managers and R&D leadership. You’ll build and maintain program-level P&Ls and investment frameworks that inform strategic priorities, track budget vs. actuals, and surface cost variances in real time. You’ll also manage headcount forecasts and spend, support month-end close in partnership with Accounting, and contribute to key deliverables, such as Monthly Financial Results presentations and Board materials.

What You Will Do:

• Help evolve tracking of program-level financials, partnering with Program Managers to track budget vs. actuals on active programs and surfacing cost variances in real time

• Build and maintain program-level P&Ls and investment frameworks to evaluate whether hardware/R&D programs clear investment hurdles and inform go/no-go decisions

• Own monthly financial file updates for each assigned R&D function, identifying and explaining cost variances

• Review and approve purchase orders for assigned functions, ensuring spend is coded correctly and aligns with approved budgets

• Partner with business leaders to manage the headcount forecast for owned R&D functions, tracking departmental headcount changes and ensuring managers are hiring according to the approved plan

• Support the month-end close process, partnering closely with Accounting on accuracy of program and functional financials, and provide variance commentary vs. plan/forecast

• Support the preparation of key monthly and quarterly deliverables, including Monthly Financial Results presentations, Board meeting materials, and function and program-specific reviews

• Identify opportunities to streamline and automate program and R&D financial reporting processes (e.g., templates, dashboards), enhancing efficiency and accuracy across monthly and quarterly deliverables

• Drive best practices in reporting and data utilization across the Program Management and R&D finance workflows.

• Prepare other ad hoc analysis and modeling as needed

This is a remote role open to candidates across the US, with a slight preference for those based in the Pacific time zone.

What you'll bring

• 4-6 years of relevant finance experience, experience partnering with Product facing teams is a plus

• Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, working with planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, Pigment) preferred

• Established experience in FP&A or a similar analytical finance role, strong Accounting foundation, and a familiarity with annual planning, forecasting, and reporting

• Exceptional attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and precision of financial data and resolving discrepancies effectively

• A self-starter attitude, with a demonstrated ability to operate well with ambiguity and build things from scratch

• Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new systems and tools

• High integrity, intellectual curiosity, self awareness, and a self starter attitude

Nice to have:

• Experience in an opex-focused FP&A role

jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The mission of the Machine Shop is to deliver high-precision, high-quality machined components while pioneering advanced manufacturing methods to support the rapid development and production of Terran-R’s reusable launch system. Through cross-functional collaboration, rigorous quality control, and a commitment to continuous improvement, we play a vital role in accelerating aerospace innovation. We are responsible for machining critical flight hardware, optimizing manufacturing processes, and ensuring efficiency, reliability, and scalability in high-rate production. Over the past year, the Machine Shop team has successfully developed and refined machining processes for complex propulsion components. Now, we are entering a critical phase: scaling our machining operations to support full-rate vehicle production and enable Terran-R’s first launch to orbit.

About the Role:

• Technically guide a small group of manufacturing engineers through process development for combustion devices products.

• Create Process Plans, Standard Operating Procedures, Inspection Plans, Work Holding Designs, and other supporting documents to define the process to manufacture parts.

• Improve manufacturing processes through developing and deploying new technologies and methodologies.

• Advise on Design for Manufacturability methodologies to upstream partners.

• Articulate manufacturing, fixturing, and inspection method for a design concepts, GD&T requirements, and datum structures to inform design choices.

• Recommend novel designs or design updates to improve manufacturability

• Analyze and improve processes that create non-conforming hardware. Investigate root causes and determine corrective actions.

About You:

• B.S. in Engineering or comparable STEM field

• Knowledge of machining and GD&T

• 3+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in machining environment

Nice to haves but not required:

• Previous leadership experience formally or informally

• Understanding of manufacturing processes, lean principles, and continuous improvement methodologies

• Understanding of business systems, ERP, MES, PLM, CAD, CAM, etc. and how they support a production system.

jobs.title: Technical Success Manager, Threat Services
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Technical Success Manager, Threat Services, you will be tasked with being the named SentinelOne owner for customers receiving Threat Services delivered through our expanded global relationship with strategic partners, which brings together SentinelOne's AI-powered security platform and our partners' expertise in managed detection and response, managed SIEM, and incident response. You will turn security-service activity into customer confidence, actionable improvements, and renewal health, helping make this partnership successful for customers as SentinelOne remains committed to clear customer ownership, technical quality, and measurable results. Your focus is the customer relationship, detection posture, tuning outcomes, and escalation quality; the partner remains responsible for day-to-day MDR operations.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Own recurring service reviews, action plans, and customer communications for an assigned Threat Services portfolio.

• Collaborate with partner MDR analysts and delivery managers to review detection posture, escalation quality, response workflows, and tuning requests.

• Translate service trends and investigation outcomes into specific technical and operational improvements for each customer.

• Maintain customer health assessments, documented risks, priorities, stakeholder maps, and renewal-readiness indicators.

• Coordinate SentinelOne detection engineering, Support, Product, and crisis response when partner issues require platform intervention.

• Validate that critical customer runbooks, escalation contacts, expectations, and service commitments are reflected in delivery.

• Proactively identify false-positive fatigue, repeated service defects, or adoption gaps and drive corrective actions to closure.

• Lead customer-facing explanations during service-quality issues and ensure credible ownership and follow-through.

• Collaborate with account management and Renewals to protect retention and identify appropriate service expansion opportunities.

• Deliver the outcomes this role is measured on: stronger MDR customer satisfaction and net promoter feedback; fewer unnecessary escalations and faster completion of tuning actions; clear, current health scores and timely renewal risk identification; improved gross retention and customer trust in Threat Services; and consistent service reviews and closed-loop customer action plans.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• 5 or more years of experience in technical customer success, technical account management, MDR customer management, SOC services, or a comparable role.

• Practical knowledge of endpoint protection, EDR/XDR, MDR, SIEM, incident investigation, and security operations, with enough technical fluency to challenge a service review.

• Experience leading service reviews and converting technical outcomes into executive-ready customer narratives.

• Strong relationship management with security managers, SOC leaders, and CISOs.

• Ability to assess service health using escalation, tuning, customer-satisfaction, and retention signals, and the commercial judgment to spot risks before renewal.

• Strong coordination skills across outsourced operations, engineering, support, and sales teams.

• Clear written and verbal communication, disciplined follow-through, and resilience under pressure.

• Experience with SentinelOne Singularity, Purple AI, or managed SIEM is highly desirable.

• Security credentials such as Security+ or CISSP, or equivalent practical expertise, are highly desirable.

• Experience supporting large enterprise security operations or high-priority escalations is highly desirable.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

• Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

• Flexible time off

• Paid company holidays and paid sick time

• Gender-neutral parental leave

• Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Life and disability insurance

• Health and dependent care FSA

• Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)

jobs.title: Histotechnician-Full-time Evenings
jobs.description:
This is a full-time, 40 hours per week, 2nd shift position located at Central DuPage Hospital in Winfield.

The Histotechnician reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Histotechnician performs routine histology procedures, in accordance with all department specific SOPs and guidelines, resulting in the stained slides for microscopic review and diagnosis by the Pathologist. This position is responsible for communication with pathologists, residents, and coordinators/supervisors regarding specimen problems.  The position is also required to participate in the laboratory occurrence management program.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Performs cassette-log reconciliation. Initiates appropriate programs on conventional and microwave tissue processors. Recognizes, resolves, and documents standard processor alarms.
• Embeds biopsy, routine surgical, and autopsy tissues, if applicable, per SOP. Recognizes adequacy of processing.
• Identifies and orients tissues correctly. Documents tracking and quality issues on embedding log.
• Performs and documents routine paraffin block reconciliation. Prioritizes blocks based on established guidelines.
• Operates microtome per SOP, and determines appropriate block orientation and alignment, knife angles, and settings to obtain representative sections.
• Recognizes acceptable vs. unacceptable sections; evaluates instances in which specific tissue might require a deviation from standard procedures to ensure diagnostic sections are produced.
• Appropriate documentation including specimen identification throughout all technical and clerical processes including in the laboratory information system, as well as cassettes, slides and logs, as required by regulatory compliance.
• Operates automated instrumentation to stain and coverslip microscopic slides.
• Performs manual methods during instrument downtimes.
• Recognizes, resolves, and documents unacceptable staining, coverslipping results and/or instrument failure.
• Performs special staining techniques using automated instrumentation and manual methods.
• Identifies appropriate positive and/or negative controls. Evaluates stains microscopically for acceptable results.
• Executes sectioning and staining of frozen tissued. Identifies and corrects staining deficiencies.¿ Documents stains and quality issues.
• Performs and/or assists with gross examination, dissection, and selection of representative tissue for microscopic examination for designated specimen, if applicable by site. Resolves discrepancies prior to gross examination and escalates to supervisor or Pathologist when necessary.
• Utilizes dictation equipment to document description per procedure, if applicable.
• Investigates, escalates, and documents any discrepancies or unresolved issues appropriately.
• Prioritizes technical workload based on assignment or established priorities, responds effectively to changes in workflow adjusting work to incorporate STAT requests or fluctuations in work volume.
• Exercises independent judgment in the performance of technical responsibilities.
• Practices the proficient and safe use of all equipment necessary for the completion of all duties and responsibilities within defined turn-around times.
• May perform required Quality System responsibilities including initiating “Quality Investigation Reports”, if needed
• Reports equipment or instrument malfunctions appropriately.
• Maintains a clean and safe work environment to ensure efficient workflow and compliance with all regulatory requirements. Cleans and disinfects laboratory areas per SOP. Performs minor spill cleanup per SOP when necessary.
• Notifies coordinator promptly of any supply issues.
• May participate in Safety and Infection Control activities. Follows all required safety procedures, assumes a proactive role in laboratory safety.
• Takes initiative for personal development by attending teleconferences, educational sessions, and required meetings, etc.
• May participate in the training or teaching of students and staff in the department.

Additional functions:

• Performs other duties as assigned.

• May be asked to assist in specific process improvement projects.

• May be asked to assist with problem resolution regarding patient specimens including root cause analysis

Required:

• Associates degree (if hired after 1/19/2025) with a combination of 12 semester hours (18 quarter hours) in biology and chemistry OR must have successfully completed 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) of academic credit from an accredited (regionally or nationally) college/university, with a combination of 12 semester hours (18 quarter hours) in biology or chemistry, qualifying the applicant to take the national ASCP certifying exam. Must provide proof of education as stated in CLIA guidelines.

• Certification Requirement: Must obtain Histotechnician (HT) ASCP certification within 1 year of hire.

• Must meet requirements for performing high complexity testing as defined by federal licensing guidelines (CLIA) and accreditation agencies (TJC,CAP)

Preferred:

• Associated degree as Histotechnician.
