jobs.title: Social Content Associate
jobs.description:
JOB TITLE: SOCIAL CONTENT ASSOCIATE
TYPE: FULL-TIME


WORKING HOURS: MONDAYS - FRIDAYS 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM PST
LOCATION: REMOTE



About the Company
The client is a boutique PR and branding agency for select creative companies, including production companies, post houses, and advertising agencies. We opened in 2017 with a simple idea: see the work and the people behind it, then help tell their story to the press and the audiences that matter to them.



The Role
We are looking for a Social Content Associate to join our creative team. The ideal candidate is highly organized, collaborative, and an outstanding communicator, with a passion for crafting compelling written and visual content that resonates with audiences across relevant platforms.

Our clients are makers, so we want their social feeds to look and sound like them. That’s where you come in. You'll design, write, edit and publish content across Instagram, LinkedIn, websites, and newsletters, for our own brand and a wide range of creative clients.

You're a creative thinker with a sharp eye for detail, and you care about keeping every client's feed fresh, distinct and never boring. You also have agency experience and can juggle multiple clients and projects at once, feeling confident in a fast-paced environment.



Responsibilities

Social content and copy:

 - Still imagery: Select high-resolution, eye-catching images for social grid posts that keep each feed cohesive and polished.

 - Reels: Edit Instagram Reels using on-screen text, graphics and motion elements to create engaging short-form video.

 - Layouts: Create on-brand templates for assets like custom Instagram story slide layouts, award show badges, etc.

 - Captions: Write concise, on-brand captions that fit each client's voice and are ready for client approval.

 - Keeping feeds fresh: Bring new ideas, formats, memes and cultural references to keep our company and client pages feeling current and not repetitive.

Design:

 - Distinct visual directions: Create a wide range of editorial-feeling visual options so each client's work looks like its own brand, not a template shared across accounts.

 - Social graphics: Design visually engaging content tailored to each platform's formats and best practices.

 - Newsletters: Design and build email newsletters in Mailchimp or similar platforms.

 - Pitch decks: Develop professional, compelling pitch decks that clearly communicate ideas and strategies.

 - Brand and promotional materials: Use Adobe Suite and Canva to produce branding, advertising and promotional content.

Publishing and quality control:

 - Pre-publish testing: Test posts on Instagram and LinkedIn before they go live, checking crops, text, links, tags and how they display on mobile and desktop.

 - Posting: Publish content directly to Instagram and LinkedIn for our company and client accounts.

Client collaboration:

 - Work closely with multiple clients to understand their brand vision and deliver content that reflects it.

 - Asset organization: Keep client files, brand assets, approved copy and templates organized in Drive so anyone on the team can find the latest version.

Tools:

 - Design and video: Canva, Adobe Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects)

 - Publishing: Instagram, LinkedIn

 - Email: Mailchimp or similar

 - Collaboration: Google Workspace (Drive), Slack, Monday.com http://Monday.com

Requirements:

 - Experience: At least 2 years of graphic design or social content experience in an agency setting.

 - Design skills: Proficiency in Canva & Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).

 - Social media: Proven experience creating and publishing content for Instagram and LinkedIn.

 - Video: Hands-on experience editing Reels or other short-form video with text and motion elements (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or similar).

 - Writing: Strong, concise copywriting skills and the ability to adapt tone across different brands.

 - Visual range: Ability to work across many visual styles so each client's look stays distinct.

 - Email: Experience designing newsletters in Mailchimp or a similar platform.

 - Pitch decks: Demonstrated ability to create compelling, visually appealing pitch decks.

 - Detail: A strong eye for quality control, from image resolution to typos to how a post displays once live.

 - Location: Based in Brazil or Argentina, working remotely.



Familiarity with the following software and platforms is preferred:

 - Monday.com http://monday.com

 - Apple/Mac

 - Google Drive and Google Suite

 - iCal

 - Zoom

 - Microsoft Office

 - Pages


Portfolio Requirements



Please include a portfolio with examples of your previous work. We'd especially like to see:

• Instagram grid posts and captions you created.

• At least one Reel or short-form video you edited.

• Work for two or more clients with clearly different visual styles.

• A newsletter or pitch deck you designed (if available).

jobs.title: Senior Web Designer
jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Senior Web Designer’s primary responsibility is the corporate website, which makes up about 80% of the role; the remaining 20% goes to cross-disciplinary support and workflow improvements. As a member of the design team (Marketing → Corporate Marketing → Design), reporting to the Design Manager, you’ll collaborate in the nexus between the digital, product, marketing, and design teams. This role will weave intricate product and infrastructure security concepts together with remarkable design to deliver an intuitive and engaging experience that exemplifies both brand and product expression.

This role will pair visual excellence with technical depth, and as an arbiter of visual information, you understand successful web design is underpinned by well-defined data: clear information architecture and structured content. You will build and maintain an agile web design system—including the Git repo—that scales and adapts to different creative workflows and evolves along our brand ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with the digital team to ensure design choices align with digital strategies (e.g., SEO/GEO); you’ll make informed creative decisions that balance design with corporate and product marketing objectives.

Our internal design team’s capabilities span web, print, 2D and 3D design and animation, and experiential: We do it all. On occasion, we may ask for design support across disciplines and platforms where skills align with needs, or where cross-functional opportunities exist. We are an AI-forward organization and we're looking for a candidate who sees creative opportunity rather than creative obsolescence: generative AI does not supplant creativity and judgment on our team.






WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the website (your primary focus)

 - Conceive a visual hierarchy across our full site, goteleport.com http://goteleport.com, that is as structured and cohesive as it is creatively flexible. How will you differentiate product pages from corporate pages?

 - Help to shape the site’s information architecture and navigation in partnership with the content and digital teams, so the structure serves both our target audience and messaging

 - Design individual pages and components from concept to delivery, including the steady flow of campaign, launch, and event pages that support our marketing programs (e.g., Identity Summit https://goteleport.com/identity-summit/)

 - Partner with our web engineers on shared components in our front-end stack and Strapi-based headless CMS; contribute updates directly where it makes sense, carrying your work through implementation

 - Create prototypes to explore interactions, communicate ideas, and surface technical constraints early-on

 - Incorporate responsive behavior, accessibility (to WCAG 2.2 AA), and performance from the very first pixel, not a later pass; knowledge of how design decisions affect GEO/SEO and discoverability

 - QA your work across browsers and devices before launch, and confirm it holds up after release

 - Improve the site continuously through frequent releases, feedback, and refinement, collaborating with the digital team to consider analytics and testing that measure what is/isn’t working to decide what to change next

 - Coordinate and prioritize incoming web requests across design and digital teams

Build the design system behind the site

 - Collaborate with digital team to migrate the current website design system to a version-controlled GitHub repo that is accessible to teams and AI across the organization

 - Translate brand standards into design tokens, components, common rasters/vectors, motion and/or interactive patterns, and documentation as single sources of truth that people and AI tools can use consistently and predictably (i.e., mitigate inference)

 - Maintain an agile web design system so teammates can use it without depending on you

Set the standard for web design

 - Present and defend design direction to marketing and product leadership, including our CMO

 - Help teammates and external partners work within the design system and our web standards, so quality holds no matter who’s building

Flex design skills across Teleport

 - The website is our most comprehensive expression of brand; as such, you anticipate deliverables for the website may inform creative across our other channels in support of a well-orchestrated, cohesive brand experience

Shape how we create

 - Spot repetitive tasks and build practical tools that cut production time—tools such as new software, vibe-coded scripts, plugins, or templates

 - Find creative ways to combine design disciplines—web, motion, 3D, experiential—into work none of them would produce alone




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5 to 8 years of professional design experience with websites as the centerpiece of a portfolio that shows thoughtful visual decisions and polished execution; B2B SaaS experience preferred

 - A track record of leading web projects end to end, from brief through launch, and presenting work to senior stakeholders

 - Demonstrated typographic excellence through compelling typeface choices and strong type hierarchies, along with an equally strong sense of color and color hierarchy

 - A hands-on AI practice. You use AI through exploration and production, evaluate its output critically, and know when to step in by hand; you can explain where it helped, where it failed, and how you verified the result

 - Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG), web performance fundamentals, and SEO/GEO, and how design decisions affect and support performance goals

 - Comfort using analytics and test results to inform design decisions

 - Clear communication with fellow designers and teammates, including colleagues across other functional teams and time zones

 - Natural curiosity with a desire to surprise and delight; you pick up new tools quickly and enjoy stretching beyond your core discipline when appropriate

 - You’re mindful of the time-value of design in order to balance and maximize design impact efficiently




SOFTWARE & PLATFORM STACK

Required

 - Expert Figma skills, including components, variables and collections, auto layout, and library management

 - Working fluency with GitHub: branches and pull requests, and how changes move through review, previews, and CI/CD into production

 - Understanding of how design tokens and components flow from Figma into code, and best practices that keep design and production from drifting apart

 - HTML and CSS knowledge—enough to contribute production updates and maintain components in a shared repo

 - Adobe Creative Cloud with a focus on Photoshop & Illustrator

Nice-to-have

 - React and Next.js in production, ideally alongside a headless CMS such as Strapi

 - Code-driven graphics, including Three.js, WebGL, procedural or programmatic animation, and automated diagram layout with elkjs

 - Design and build tooling: working with APIs such as Figma’s REST API or Strapi’s content API and scripting to automate design tasks, Figma plugins, design token pipelines such as Style Dictionary, and Playwright or similar tools for browser automation, visual capture, and verification

 - Motion and 3D in After Effects, Rive, Cavalry, and Cinema 4D

We acknowledge this nice-to-have list is deep and don’t expect depth of knowledge in every medium or familiarity with every tool. We are, however, looking for evidence that you can balance learning new tools and adapt to new workflows in real-time, all while continuing to deliver on the primary job functions.




HOW WE HIRE

Our hiring process is designed to be straightforward and respectful of your time. We skip performative rounds and focus on what matters: understanding how you think about and solve creative problems.

Please anticipate up to four rounds of interviews plus a focused, two-hour-long creative exercise completed on your own time. This exercise is specific to the hiring process and any creative results therein are yours alone.

You’ll start with a 30-minute recruiter screen, followed by a 30-minute interview with the hiring manager. If you’re selected to proceed after interviewing with the hiring manager, you’ll be asked to complete the design exercise in preparation for the third interview round where you’ll pitch this creative to colleagues across the marketing, digital, and product design teams.

The final interview round will be a 30-minute conversation with our CMO.


Portfolio Review & Creative Discussion Expectations
Please be prepared to speak about 2-3 web-based projects you completed within the past three years. The projects should capture what you’re most capable of creatively and technically. We care less about their relative brand popularity and will focus more on the brief and how you navigated the creative constraints to arrive at the final deliverable. Read: we are more interested in the journey than the destination. And while portfolio reviews are indicative of what you’re capable of today, we are just as interested in where you’d like to go creatively tomorrow—even if it’s new territory! We’d like to learn about how you tinker in your free time, along with 2-3 examples of other designers/studios/technologists’ work that inform your creativity.

Finally, we’d like to hear your perspectives on generative AI and how it has affected your creative process. This is a purposely broad thought exercise since generative AI covers a lot of ground, so please be concise, specific, and candid with your answer.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first 90 days, you'll:

 - Ship improvements to goteleport.com http://goteleport.com

 - Begin migrating our existing web design system into a Git repository, with core tokens and components in place, along with a plan to complete the rest

 - Build strong working relationships with Design, Marketing, Digital, Product, and our European web engineers

 - Learn about Teleport’s platform and fundamentals about unified infrastructure identity



Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.



The Benefits

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

- Extensive health coverage

- Annual expense budget

- Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge

- Investment in your future with retirement savings plans

- Professional development opportunities



Teleport is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classifications protected by federal, state, or local law.



Candidate Privacy Notice: For information about our collection and processing of job applicant personal data for this position, please see our Job Applicant Privacy Policy and Notice of Collection at goteleport.com/legal/apply/job-applicant/ http://goteleport.com/legal/apply/job-applicant/

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

jobs.title: Staff Platform & Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About Project Healthy Minds
 
Project Healthy Minds is a mental health nonprofit that runs like a tech startup. We are pioneering a first-of-its-kind model: applying technology to address one of the biggest social issues of our time: the growing mental health crisis. We believe in a simple but profound idea: that it should be as easy to find mental health services as it is to book a flight or a restaurant reservation. That's why we're building the world’s first digital marketplace for finding mental health services that are right for you. 
 
To do that, we work with some of the most inspiring and influential leaders in America - business titans, tech entrepreneurs, clinicians and scientists, musicians, artists, athletes, media stars, policymakers, and more - because we believe that the world's most complex challenges require interdisciplinary teams and solutions.
 
We are backed by a powerhouse of industry-leading Board of Directors and Advisory Council Members who are passionate, hands-on, and dive into the important work with us.
 
Learn more atprojecthealthyminds.com and @projecthealthyminds on social.
 
About The Role
 
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 
Project Healthy Minds (PHM) is a small nonprofit team building the front door on the internet for finding mental health care. People share sensitive information about their mental health when they use our screeners and search, and protecting it is part of the product. As our first full-time platform and security engineer, you’ll keep our Google Cloud platform reliable and secure. You’ll also serve as PHM’s designated Security Officer, owning the program that governs how we protect that data. You’ll split your time between hands-on platform work and running the security program, and the balance will shift with what PHM needs. 
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
 
Platform
• Own the reliability, performance, and cost of production on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, BigQuery) and Cloudflare
• Manage infrastructure in Terraform and keep our GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines secure and fast
• Build the monitoring, alerting, and logging that catch problems before users do, and lead the response when something breaks
• Design and maintain least-privilege access for a distributed team, and run the quarterly access review
• Plan for growth: traffic spikes from media coverage, partner integrations, and new features that handle health data
• Review application changes that touch sensitive data, authentication, or access control
• Co-design the architecture of new systems and features with product and engineering
Security program
• Serve as PHM’s Security Officer: own our written information security program, built on the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0, along with its policies and annual review
• Maintain the risk register and report on security posture to our Risk Committee
• Review risk assessments before adding them to our stack
• Run our annual third-party penetration test and track findings to closure
• Lead security incident response with legal counsel, and run the annual disaster-recovery drill
• Set the guardrails for how the team uses AI tools, and deliver security and privacy training to staff and contractors
 
WHAT YOU'LL BRING
 
• 8+ years in platform, infrastructure, site reliability, or security engineering, with hands-on production work in the last two years
• Experience at a health tech company that handled sensitive health data (required)
• Ownership of a security or compliance program under SOC 2, HIPAA, HITRUST, or NIST CSF. You built the controls, kept the evidence, and answered the auditors’ or partners’ questions.
• Deep production experience in at least one major cloud, and working familiarity with Google Cloud
• Infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred) and CI/CD
• Incident response experience, including at least one incident where you led the response
• Sound risk judgment: you can tell a launch-blocking issue from one that belongs in the risk register, and you can explain the difference to non-engineers
• A preference for hands-on work over managing people
• Able to work from our New York City office 5 days a week
• Belief in our mission: connecting Americans to mental health services that actually work for them
 
NICE TO HAVE
 
• Deep Google Cloud security experience
• Experience securing applications that use large language models
• You were the first security hire at a startup
 
WHY THIS IS A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY
 
• Strong backing. Our Board, Clinical Advisory Committee, and partners come from business, academia, medicine, and media, and they’re closely involved in the work.
• A big goal with the funding to pursue it. We have a multi-year record of year-over-year growth, paid for by philanthropy and earned revenue.
• Real authority. As Security Officer you can approve security policy, require fixes, and pause a launch that puts people’s data at risk. On security, you report to our Risk Committee directly.
• A modern platform. Our main application launched in 2026 on managed Google Cloud services, with infrastructure in Terraform and security scanning in CI. You’ll shape how it grows.
• A startup team with a social mission. People here come from venture-backed startups, large companies, and everything in between. They chose a nonprofit because the work can change how people find mental health care.
 
What We Offer
 
• Competitive compensation
• Competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits
• Paid holidays and generous PTO 
• Life insurance
• Short-term and long-term disability
• Spring Health mental healthcare
• Commuter benefits
• Perks at Work
• Experience joining a dynamic start-up environment that is re-writing the playbook for social change in the mental health tech space
• Benefits of joining a close-knit, highly-motivated team with mentorship opportunities from a world-class network of founding leaders, Advisors, and Board members
• Learning & Development opportunities, including free MasterClass subscriptions
• Opportunity to attend inspiring experiences and events with thought leaders, business executives, and iconic speakers across a range of industries
• And more (just ask!)
 
The annual salary for this role is $220,000 to $260,000depending on experience. This full-time role is in our New York City office five days a week.

jobs.title: Junior Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
Katalyst Description:

Katalyst is an American technology company focused on dynamic space operations.  We are building a fleet of dual-use multipurpose robotic space vehicles to create the future where maneuvering, upgrading, refueling, resupply and exploration are as routine as they are on Earth. Getting to space and overcoming the gravity well is only half the story. What you do there is the future. We are not building the trains. We are building the machines that lay down the tracks. By developing the foundational capabilities that make sustained, responsive operations possible, we enable a new era of space exploration that strengthens national security and ensures freedom of action in an increasingly contested domain.

Katalyst Culture:

Working at Katalyst is intense, hands-on, and deeply rewarding. You’ll take real ownership and see your work move from concept to operations in an environment where the problems are hard and the impact is real. We value humility, craftsmanship, and doing things the right way, even when it’s harder. You’ll work closely with thoughtful, driven teammates who push each other to do their best.  Oh, and we're dog friendly!

Benefits:

• Stock options & equity

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k)

• Unlimited PTO

• Catered lunches

What You’ll Do

• Build targeted candidate pipelines for technical roles across spacecraft engineering, GNC, software, avionics, electrical, mechanical, systems, product, and other priority hiring areas.

• Review Katalyst's ATS (Greenhouse) daily to coordinate next steps, schedule interviews, and provide follow-ups with candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers. Resolve blockers to keep candidates moving quickly.

• Research and identify candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, public technical communities, conferences, research papers, university networks, company websites, referrals, and other creative sources.

• Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to calibrate on profiles, learn the technical context behind each role, incorporate feedback quickly, and adjust search strategy when the market does not match the initial assumptions.

• Maintain accurate and organized candidate records in Greenhouse and related recruiting tools, including source, stage, notes, follow-up timing, disposition, and relevant market intelligence.

• Support consistent follow-up with prospects, referrals, and passive candidates, and flag delays or other issues that could cause strong candidates to disengage.

• Help develop and maintain sourcing playbooks, target-company maps, talent pools, university pipelines, referral campaigns, and recruiting reports to support consistent, scalable recruiting processes.

What We’re Looking For

Required

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Degrees in business, communications, psychology, engineering, computer science, aerospace, data, or related fields are all relevant; strong curiosity and demonstrated ability to learn quickly matter more than a specific major.

• 0-2+ years of experience in recruiting, sourcing, research, sales development, staffing, talent intelligence, customer outreach, university recruiting, or another role requiring disciplined research and proactive communication. Strong internships or project experience may count.

• Demonstrated ability to research people, companies, or markets systematically and turn incomplete information into a clear list of prioritized prospects or actions.

• Strong written communication and the ability to write concise, personalized outreach that feels credible and specific rather than templated or transactional.

• Technical curiosity and willingness to learn unfamiliar engineering and software concepts well enough to understand what a hiring manager is actually looking for and why one candidate may be stronger than another.

• Good judgment, coachability, and comfort receiving direct feedback on candidate quality, search strategy, messaging, and execution; able to incorporate feedback quickly without becoming overly dependent on step-by-step direction.

• Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with measurable activity and outcome expectations while maintaining quality, professionalism, and candidate experience.

Your Ideal Background

Preferred

• Prior experience as a Recruiting Coordinator is preferred.

• Prior experience in technical recruiting, sourcing, staffing, talent research, sales development, or research-heavy work supporting engineering, aerospace, defense, software, robotics, or deep-tech organizations.

• Hands-on familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Greenhouse or another ATS/CRM, Boolean search, spreadsheets, research databases, AI-assisted research tools, or similar sourcing systems.

• Evidence of creative sourcing beyond basic LinkedIn searches, such as GitHub, technical publications, patents, conference agendas, professional associations, university programs, alumni networks, referrals, or targeted web research.

• Experience writing outbound messages, running outreach campaigns, measuring response/conversion, or iterating on messaging based on data and candidate feedback.

• Interest in aerospace, space systems, robotics, defense technology, software, or other complex technical domains and a desire to build long-term expertise in technical recruiting.

Additional Requirements: This role is expected to work primarily onsite in Broomfield, Colorado and may occasionally support recruiting events, conferences, university activities, or extended hours when hiring priorities require it.

Compensation and Benefits: Your base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. The anticipated salary range for this role is $60,000 - $90,000 annually.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at Katalyst. You will also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of the Employee Stock Option and Equity Plan, as well as a relocation bonus and other discretionary bonuses. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, and unlimited Paid Time Off.

At Katalyst our work on projects involving the U.S. Department of Defense requires adherence to International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), 22 C.F.R. Parts 120-130, which requires compliance with U.S. export laws before allowing employees to perform certain positions. Currently, our available roles necessitate access to ITAR-controlled information, and as a result, Katalyst would have to ensure any non-US person is authorized access to ITAR information before the commencement of employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunities and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

jobs.description:
Business Insider is hiring a fellow to join our Tech team.

Our mission is to inform and inspire the digital generation and become the most influential and loved journalism brand in the world. At Business Insider, we aim to cover the people, companies, and ideas changing our world. At Insider, we strive to uphold three main core values: We are all one team, we are effective and we strive to get better every day.

The Business Insider Fellowship Program is for early career journalists who want to spend six months learning from a newsroom full of passionate, dedicated journalists. Fellows are assigned to teams and become experts in digital storytelling. They produce real work that is distributed to our audience of millions, and by the end of six months, they are prepared for the next phase of their journalism careers. This role requires you to work for 40 hours a week.

Fellows are required to come into our New York or San Francisco offices three times a week.

Applications will close on Dec. 4.

The Role & Team:

We are looking for a reporting fellow interested in the fast-moving world of artificial intelligence, tech companies, startups, and venture capital. Our team covers the companies, founders, and investors shaping the future and holds them accountable.

The ideal candidate is curious about how AI is transforming industries, how startups are built and scaled, and how venture capital is flowing through this ecosystem. You’re excited to write about emerging technologies, the people behind them, and the business driving the next generation of AI companies.

You’re eager to build sources, develop a sharp understanding of the tech ecosystem, and spot trends before they go mainstream. You’re just as interested in a funding scoop as you are in a deeper story about how AI is changing work, power, and money.

You’re versatile enough to move quickly on breaking news while also pursuing profiles, lists,  and trend stories. You’re a collaborative teammate who wants to grow as a reporter in a fast-paced, supportive newsroom.

This job title is for an early-career journalist who is grasping the Business Insider way and refining their original reporting skills.

• Report and write stories on AI, startups, and venture capital

• Contribute to lists, profiles, and data-driven stories

jobs.title: Global Event Security Lead
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Global Security Operations Team safeguards our people, mission-critical technology, and operational footprint through an integrated, intelligence-led security framework. Our remit spans physical security infrastructure, Global Security Operations Centers (GSOC), guard force management, crisis response, counterintelligence, and comprehensive risk management. We operate at the intersection of commercial speed and defense-grade security, enabling rapid innovation and operational freedom across domestic and global environments.

ABOUT THE JOB

As our footprint expands across commercial and defense markets, field deployments, and strategic demonstrations, we are seeking an autonomous, mission-driven Global Event Security Lead. In this role, you will own the physical security lifecycle and threat management for domestic and international events, major defense trade exhibitions, field trials, and off-site customer demonstrations. Your core objective is to design, implement, and lead robust security architectures that safeguard personnel, proprietary hardware, and sensitive information in diverse and dynamic environments.
This is a senior individual contributor role requiring high autonomy, strong analytical acumen in threat and vulnerability assessments, cross-functional operational leadership, and deep expertise in event security management across domestic and global venues.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the dedicated security business partner to Events, Marketing, Communications, BD, and Workplace, embedding early into planning cycles to integrate physical access, badging, and venue security into project timelines.

• End-to-End Event Security Execution: Independently design, project-manage, and execute physical security operational plans for major domestic and international defense trade shows (e.g., AUSA, Paris Air Show, DSEI), customer demonstrations, and executive off-sites.

• Site & Facility Security Assessments (PSVAs): Conduct formal Physical Security Vulnerability Assessments, threat analyses, and site surveys for event venues, static displays, hotels, transit corridors, and Anduril satellite offices, test ranges, and regional facilities globally.

• Hardware & ITAR Asset Protection: Partner with Logistics, Trade Compliance, and Engineering to design secure display footprints, anti-tamper protocols, overnight monitoring, and physical chain-of-custody measures for proprietary technology, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and ITAR/EAR-controlled platforms.

• On-Site Operational Leadership: Serve as the lead security operator on the ground during major activations—managing access control points, resolving venue-level issues, and supervising contract guard forces seamlessly in the background.

• Vendor & Resource Management: Directly scope, vet, contract, and oversee third-party security guard forces, technical access providers, and specialized event security vendors worldwide.

• External Stakeholder Liaison: Establish operational coordination with venue managers, show organizers, local law enforcement, emergency services, and host-nation authorities (including U.S. Embassy Regional Security Officers abroad).

• Traveler Safety & Intelligence Integration: Partner with internal Threat Intelligence to assess location-specific risks and deliver actionable, practical security briefs for attending Anduril staff and executives.

• Scale Security Workflows: Conduct post-event reviews with internal partners, track vendor performance, and iterate on Anduril’s event security playbooks, checklists, and access standards to support company growth.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience: 5+ years of progressive physical security, event security, or site security experience within corporate defense/aerospace/tech, high-end event operations, or relevant law enforcement/government security environments.

• Independent Execution (IC3): Demonstrated track record of independently managing end-to-end physical security projects and events from initial site survey through post-event wrap-up with minimal oversight.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Proven ability to build collaborative, productive relationships with non-security business partners (Event Managers, Brand/Marketing, Executive Assistants, Real Estate teams).

• Physical Security Assessments: Demonstrated experience conducting structured Physical Security Vulnerability Assessments (PSVAs) for facilities, dynamic venues, and corporate offices.

• Vendor & Contractor Oversight: Practical experience scoping, onboarding, and managing contract security guard forces and physical security vendors.

• Asset & Access Control Fundamentals: Solid working knowledge of physical access control systems (PACS), perimeter hardening, and the handling/display requirements for proprietary technologies and ITAR/EAR defense articles.

• Travel Flexibility: Willingness and ability to travel 30%–50% (domestically and internationally) aligned with events and site assessment schedules.

• Clearance Eligibility: Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident) due to ITAR requirements, with the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Security Clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Active U.S. Secret or Top Secret / SCI security clearance.

• Industry certifications such as Physical Security Professional (PSP), Certified Protection Professional (CPP), or Project Management Professional (PMP).

• Direct experience securing major defense/aerospace exhibitions (e.g., AUSA, Sea-Air-Space, Paris Air Show, DSEI, Farnborough).

• Formal training in threat modeling, protective intelligence, or physical security assessment methodologies.

• Established networks with domestic public safety agencies and international bodies (e.g., Overseas Security Advisory Council - OSAC / DSAC).

US Salary Range

$108,000—$143,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
This is a part-time, 24 hours per week, 3rd shift position located at Delnor Hospital in Geneva.

The Medical Laboratory Scientist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A Medical Laboratory Scientist performs test procedures in a clinical laboratory and conveys the results to the physician or designee in an accurate and timely manner for the purpose of patient diagnosis and treatment

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Technical responsibilities:
• Performs all aspects of pre-analytic workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure orders are entered correctly, specimens collected are appropriate for the test ordered and are correctly processed/transported.
• Verifies order where necessary
• Verifies non-patient information (e.g., collection time) according to established protocol.
• Handles unresolved orders, troubleshoots where needed.
• Verifies with physicians and/or nurses prior to laboratory information system (LIS) order entry to resolve unclear, duplicate or otherwise ambiguous orders.
• Verifies specimens for add-on tests are available and acceptable and generates add-on test orders.
• Recognizes when fraud and abuse compliance issues require adjustments to the test order
• Collecting, receiving and processing of specimens:
• Verifies specimens are correctly and completely labeled upon receipt. Evaluates specimens for appropriateness and takes necessary corrective action. Appropriately documents unacceptable specimens and proper notifications as needed.
• Prioritizes specimen processing based on established priorities.
• Aliquots specimens according to established protocols.
• Performs all aspects of analytical testing appropriate for the specific laboratory section,following established written protocols and standard operating procedures (SOP)

• Maintains test system integrity:
• Performs preventive maintenance on instruments/equipment in a timely fashion according to defined schedule.
• Verifies reagents and supplies meet defined acceptability criteria upon receipt and prior to use; takes action to ensure unacceptable items are removed from use.
• Ensures that sufficient reagents and supplies necessary for test performance are available. Notifies senior staff when minimum inventory level is encountered.
• Performs and records all necessary quality control (QC) required for test system performance.
• Evaluates QC results and takes necessary corrective actions according to established protocol.
• Performs specimen preparation:
• Performs any necessary pretest specimen preparation according to protocols (e.g., microbiology plating, cell cultures, filtering, extraction, separation, elution, absorption, etc.)
• Transfers or ships specimens to approved testing locations according to SOPs

• Performs tests:
• Prioritizes testing based on assignment or established priorities, completes testing within defined turn-around-times (TAT).
• Recognizes the need for and follows any age-specific protocols
• Responds effectively to changes in the workflow by coordinating a simultaneous series of tests when needed or adjusting work to incorporate STAT tests or fluctuations in work volume.
• Monitors daily workflow and priorities to assure meeting service levels.
• Performs technical review and interpretation:
• Reviews results for completeness, correctness, and consistency within defined test system
• Evaluates test results/reactions and provides accurate interpretations as appropriate to include correlation with, and integration of, other patient data as necessary.
• Performs visual interpretation/identifications as appropriate.
• Recognizes unusual test results/interpretations and completes indicated reflex testing or other follow-up actions.
• Follows established notification protocols for critical values, phone/fax/e-mail results requests, abnormalities.
• Troubleshoots and solves problems:
• Recognizes test system performance problems and takes necessary corrective actions
• Recognizes when unresolved problems need to be escalated and takes necessary follow-up action.
• Prints pending logs and follows-up to ensure pending tests are completed or cancelled when appropriate.
• Post-test specimen storage:
• Stores specimens and related materials (blood, slides, tissues, etc.) according to protocols for location and duration.
• Retrieves specimen and related materials when needed
• Post-analytical responsibilities:
• Performs all aspects of the post-analytical workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure accurate results are reported within established time frames, specimens are retained appropriately, test results and/or current status are available upon inquiry, and billed charges are correct for testing performed.
• Verifies and reports results:
• Verifies results according to procedure.
• Performs computer functions necessary for releasing results.
• Generates written reports according to established protocol.
• Reviews electronic or printed reports when applicable, recognizes problems and escalates according to protocol.
• Amends reports:
• Corrects erroneous reports and amends reports according to procedure
• Responds to inquiries:
• Responds to requests for information according to established protocol for confidentiality and release of information
• Recognizes when unresolved inquiries need to be escalated and takes action
• Stores documents and records:
• Stores documents and records according to established protocol.
• Charge capture/billing:
• Performs billing and/or enter credits for tests and services when applicable.
• Recognizes billing problems and escalates accordingly
• Universal responsibilities:
• Ensures quality of operations:
• Follows written standard operating procedures (SOP).
• Operates instruments/equipment according to protocol.
• Uses computers according to established protocol; follows downtime procedures as required.
• Performs required quality system responsibilities
• Meets proficiency and competency standards of the department.
• Participates in the training of new employees and students
• Performs operational review of new SOPs.
• Participates in new test development, validations and implementation.
• Attends at least one personal development session per year
• Performs other duties as assigned, or as needed, to ensure continued quality operations
• Ensures safety of operations:
• Follows all required safety procedures, uses personal protective equipment (PPE) appropriate for tasks performed.
• Maintains cleans and organized work area
• Provides service excellence:
• Answers telephone when needed, using NM telephone etiquette
• Maintains patient confidentiality including protected health information (PHI)
• Assists patients, visitors and other contacts whenever need occurs

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Medical Technology, Medical Laboratory Science, Clinical Laboratory Science, Chemistry, Biology, or Allied Health qualifying the applicant to take the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or equivalent certification examination.

Certification:

• General MLS or MT (ASCP) Certification or eligible or
• Categorical BB, C, H or M (ASCP) Certification or eligible

Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

Job summary:

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Hardware Test to build and lead the team that validates Apptronik’s robots, from actuators and robotic hands through integrated systems, and to own test strategy from design verification through handoff to the production test team. You will hire and develop a fast-growing team of test engineers while staying hands-on as a player-coach, build the reliability program from scratch, and set the direction for fixtures and data infrastructure. You will lead cross-stack root-cause analysis across mechanical, electrical, and firmware, and plan test equipment and lab capacity.

Responsibilities:

• Build and lead the team: Hire, develop and manage a growing hardware test team, setting priorities, hiring bar and career paths, and staying hands-on technically as a player-coach.

• Own test strategy from DVT to production: Define how robot hands and actuators are validated and tested, including pass/fail criteria, and hand off production test methods to test ops with the documentation and training to run them at scale.

• Own reliability: Run life, durability and failure-mode testing, build the reliability program from scratch.

• Lead cross-stack root-cause analysis: Diagnose issues across mechanical, electrical and firmware, and turn test data into clear, actionable feedback for design teams.

• Own test equipment and lab capacity: Plan and budget for fixtures, dynamometers and test assets, make build vs buy calls, and keep equipment calibrated, maintained and sized for upcoming builds.

• Own program execution and reporting: Plan test around hardware build timelines, and communicate results, risks and recommendations to engineering and program leadership early.

Required qualifications:

• 10+ years in hardware test, validation or reliability engineering, including 3+ years managing engineers, ideally as a player-coach.

• Track record of hiring, developing and retaining a technical team, including growing a team through a period of fast headcount growth.

• Hands-on experience testing and characterizing electromechanical systems (actuators, motors, gearboxes, or robotic hands/grippers), including dynamometer or custom test stand operation.

• Demonstrated ownership of test strategy from design validation through production, including defining pass/fail criteria and handing off test methods to a manufacturing or test ops team.

• Experience building or leading a reliability program, including life testing, failure analysis and failure-mode tracking.

• Strong cross-disciplinary debugging ability across mechanical, electrical and firmware domains, with the judgment to run root-cause analysis through your team.

• Experience planning test equipment, fixtures and lab capacity, including budgets and build vs buy decisions.

• Ability to read electrical schematics, mechanical drawings and component datasheets.

• BS in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science or a related field (MS or PhD preferred).

• Ability to sit at a desk and work on a computer for prolonged periods, lift 15 pounds at times, and read printed materials and screens, with hearing and speech to communicate.

jobs.title: Field Refrigeration Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
Vixxo is seeking a full-time Field Refrigeration Quality Assurance Specialist.

Position Summary

The Field Install Quality Specialist– Refrigeration is responsible for overseeing installation quality and ensuring commercial refrigeration systems installed by regional contractors meet Vixxo, Walgreens, and OEM specifications. This role serves as Vixxo's on-site technical representative throughout the installation process, performing field inspections, identifying and resolving deficiencies, validating installation documentation, and ensuring all closeout requirements are met before submission.

This position requires extensive knowledge of commercial refrigeration systems, HVAC/R installation practices, construction quality standards, and contractor oversight. Significant travel throughout an assigned multi-state territory is required.

Why This Role Exists

Vixxo installs walk-in cooler and freezer refrigeration systems for Walgreens across the country using a network of regional contractors. Walgreens holds every install to a written spec and reviews every closeout package photo by photo. This role is Vixxo's person on the roof and in the box: making sure the install matches the spec while the crew is still on site, and making sure the closeout is complete and correct before it leaves the store.

Job Responsibilities

• Travel to assigned installation sites before, during and after installation. Expect 2 to 4 sites per week across a multi-state territory.

• Walk the site with the contractor at kickoff: confirm survey accuracy, equipment on hand, line-set routing, roof penetrations, electrical and the Walgreens spec items the crew is responsible for.

• Spot-check the work in progress: piping (traps, slope, insulation, UV jacketing), evaporator mounting and bonding, A2L components, wiring, labeling, pressure test and evacuation, charge and pressure-control settings against the OEM charge chart and Walgreens targets.

• Verify the completed install against the Walgreens closeout standard and ensure identified deficiencies are corrected before the contractor leaves the site. Write the go-back list on site when they cannot be.

• Own closeout quality on site: make sure every required photo is taken, legible and in the right slot, gauges are shown at cut in and cut out, labels and signatures are captured, and the FastField form is complete and accurate the first time.

• Run Vixxo's closeout audit tool on each package before submission and clear every item it raises.

• Coach contractors on the Walgreens spec and the OEM requirements (Hussmann/Copeland X-Line, Bally/Keeprite, HTPG). Identify and escalate recurring contractor performance issues and failure to meet installation standards.

• Report weekly to the VP, Projects: sites visited, defects found and fixed, repeat issues by contractor, and anything that threatens an install date.

• Provide feedback and recommendations in Vixxo’s survey, pre-construction, and closeout standards to prevent recurring installation issues.

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of hands-on commercial refrigeration experience, including walk-in cooler and freezer installations, troubleshooting, and system startups.

• Must have a valid driver’s license and clean driving record.

• Strong technical understanding of refrigeration system operation, including reading gauges, setting low-pressure controls, checking superheat, and weighing refrigerant charges.

• EPA 608 Universal. A2L (R-454A) experience or training strongly preferred.

• Ability to recognize installation deficiencies, communicate expectations clearly, and hold contractor crews accountable for meeting required quality standards.

• Proficiency using mobile applications for field documentation, photo capture, inspections, and reporting.

• Nice to have: experience with Walgreens or another national retail refrigeration program; QA/QC or field supervision background.

Physical Demands

• Ability to travel extensively throughout an assigned multi-state territory, including overnight travel most weeks.

• Expected travel to approximately 2–4 installation sites per week.

• Ability to access rooftops, climb ladders, and work in walk-in coolers and freezers.

• Ability to work in varying weather conditions and environments, including outdoor rooftops and refrigerated spaces.

• Ability to safely perform the physical activities associated with inspecting commercial refrigeration installations.

How Success Is Measured

• Closeouts accepted by Walgreens on first submission.

• Days from install complete to closeout submitted.

• Defects found on site versus defects found by Walgreens after submission.

• Repeat issues per contractor trending down.

jobs.description:
Why Choose Orthopedics at Northwestern Memorial Hospital?

Northwestern Memorial Hospital is the No. 1 hospital in Illinois and our orthopedics program is consistently ranked among the top Orthopaedic programs in the country by U.S. News & World Report.

Northwestern Medicine’s Orthopedic surgeons provide leading musculoskeletal treatment, using state-of-the-art imaging and operating room facilities. U.S. News & World Report ranked Northwestern Memorial Hospital's orthopedics program No. 19 (2021–2022). The collaborative, comprehensive continuum of care provided helps ensure more accurate diagnoses, a streamlined process for patients, and better outcomes.

For additional information about our Orthopaedic care, please visit Orthopaedic and Spine Care at Northwestern Memorial Hospital

Patient Population: General Surgery, Trauma, and Orthopedics

General Care Information

The Orthopedic unit is a 30-bed unit that provides care to patients with a variety of orthopedic conditions including joint replacement, orthopedic oncology, and trauma. The Orthopedic unit is a surgical unit with a specialty in orthopedics! This unit is divided between planned and unplanned visits such as planned knee and hip replacements vs unplanned trauma patients.

You will learn the specialty of Orthopedics along with the skills and concepts of general med/surg. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to treat a variety of surgical patients from any surgical unit! Expect to work in a fast-paced environment collaborating with an inter-professional team and contributing to excellent patient outcomes!  The cornerstone to this unit is teamwork and professional growth!  Come learn why it’s HIP to be an Ortho Nurse!

The Clinical Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Based on the NMH framework for practice, the registered professional clinical nurse (RN) is accountable and responsible for the provision and coordination of clinically competent, evidence-based care for an assigned group of patients that includes diagnosis, outcome identification, planning, implementation and evaluation. The nurse adheres to the ANA Scope and Standards of Professional Nursing, the Code of Ethics, and the Nursing Social Policy Statement.   As a member of the clinical care and unit team, the RN participates in decision-making, teaching, mentoring, and collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advance the patient plan of care, achieve exceptional outcomes and enhance unit operations.  The RN exemplifies the components of what it means to be an NMH nurse, reflects the Mission, Vision, and Values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

The role of the professional clinical nurse is unique and essential to the care of the patient.  The nurse demonstrates that unique and essential function through the framework for nursing practice.

Advocate:

• Practices in accordance with the patient centered care model
• Develops an individualized age-specific culturally sensitive nursing plan of care for the patient that is based on the nursing process
• Incorporates the role of patient advocate into the plan of care
• Uses a team approach to develop and achieve daily patient-centered individualized care goals
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of the patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care
• Identifies potential conflict situations and facilitates resolution using established communication channels
• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient
• Protects patients by maintaining a safe environment

Clinical Expert:

• Advances clinical expertise, as demonstrated through pursuit of informal and formal continuing education opportunities and obtaining specialty certification when eligible
• Continuously enhances skills and abilities to ensure the highest quality patient care
• Shares knowledge and expertise through educating team members, patients and students
• Demonstrates critical thinking by integrating theoretical knowledge and expertise to pose relevant clinical questions when evidence and practice differ
• Identifies priorities, sets realistic and measureable goals, prescribes and implements nursing interventions in a safe and timely manner
• Develops and implements individualized education plans for patients and families using suitable instructional materials and methods
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings
• Identifies situations that require further intervention and escalates appropriately; Consults appropriate experts and resources when needed
• Participates in the formation, implementation and evaluation of team goals
• Appropriately delegates and supervises interventions to implement the plan of care
• Conveys complete, timely and accurate information at hand off at the bedside or any hand off
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice

Community Volunteer:

• Participates in one or more volunteer initiatives annually, Northwestern Memorial organized or on his/her own

Compassionate:

• Consistently demonstrates interpersonal connections with patients and families from introduction through discharge
• Proactively responds to patient concerns such as speaking to patients about possible/expected delays in plan of care
• Treats patients, families, visitors and staff in a caring manner with respect and dignity
• Facilities recovery and where appropriate helps ensure a peaceful death for patients

Professionally Engaged:

• Is a member of a professional organization or participates on an Northwestern Memorial committee or taskforce at the hospital-wide, departmental, or unit level
• Demonstrates accountability and collaborative practice with co-workers, other disciplines, and departments
• Assumes responsibility for continued professional growth and education reflecting knowledge and understanding of current nursing practice
• Serves as a community mentor for team members
• Serves as a preceptor for new team members
• Participates in the peer feedback process by conducting a constructive assessment and evaluation of peer performance
• Works collaboratively with all hospital services to accomplish daily work and maintain an environment of excellence
• Participates in the development of policies, procedures and systems to support safe and effective care and advance nursing practice at NMH through the Shared Leadership Process
• Assumes personal responsibility for meeting internal (i.e. Best People profile, ELMs, CPR, and health requirements) and external regulatory and accreditation requirements
• Identifies opportunities for innovation and quality improvement; participates in innovation projects and the quality improvement process, including unit based quality committees
• Demonstrates accountability to Northwestern Memorial strategic, operational and fiscal goals
• Exemplifies a professional image in appearance and communications

• Maintains and advances the professional image of nursing and the practice of professional nursing through an ongoing analysis of resources
• Professional Organizations, literature, electronic resources, etc.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Verified Audience
jobs.description:
About Prove

As the world moves to a mobile-first economy, businesses need to modernize how they acquire, engage with and enable consumers. Prove’s phone-centric identity tokenization and passive cryptographic authentication solutions reduce friction, enhance security and privacy across all digital channels, and accelerate revenues while reducing operating expenses and fraud losses. Over 1,000 enterprise customers use Prove’s platform to process 20 billion customer requests annually across industries, including banking, lending, healthcare, gaming, crypto, e-commerce, marketplaces, and payments. For the latest updates from Prove, follow us on LinkedIn.

Prove is driving the future of digital identity. We are looking for Provers who know how to make an impact. We’re talking self-starting professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment, process information quickly, and make intelligent decisions. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together.

Prove has big plans, and we’re excited about the future. If this sounds like the place for you – come join our team!

Senior Product Manager, Verified Audience

Department: Product

Reports To: General Manager, Grow Products

Location: New York, NY (hybrid; open to remote in the US)

About the Role

As the Senior Product Manager for Verified Audience, you will own one of Prove's newest product lines, from early revenue to scale. Verified Audience lets lenders and merchants recognize a real, verified consumer the moment they arrive on a website, without asking them to log in or fill out a form, and make them a personalized offer in real time. The first use case is firm offers of credit: a consumer browsing a credit card page sees that they are pre-approved, instead of a generic "Apply now" button.

The product sits where identity, credit and marketing meet. It is delivered with a major credit bureau partner and is bought from customers' marketing and acquisition budgets rather than their fraud or identity budgets. You will define the roadmap, run the product side of our partnerships, and prove to customers that the product drives measurable conversion lift.

You will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Business Development, Sales and Marketing, and with Prove's executive team, since Verified Audience is a company-level priority.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the Verified Audience strategy, roadmap and requirements end to end, from matching an anonymous visitor to a verified identity through to the real-time offer the consumer sees.

• Run the product side of our credit bureau partnership and other data and channel partners, including joint requirements, integration plans, launch readiness and performance reviews.

• Move early customers from beta to production, and define the metrics that show the product's value, such as pre-approval rate, conversion lift and revenue per verified visitor.

• Set pricing and packaging with Finance and Sales for a product sold into marketing and acquisition budgets.

• Expand the product beyond credit cards into personal lending, buy now pay later and merchant financing, and evaluate adjacent channels such as programmatic audiences and identity graph partners.

• Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy and Information Security so the product meets FCRA, GLBA, mobile carrier and consumer privacy requirements.

• Create the product documentation that doesn't exist yet: architecture, data flows, partner and carrier approval requirements, and customer-facing integration guides.

• Work with Engineering and Data Science to manage the backlog, write clear requirements, and deliver on time.

• Communicate strategy and progress to executives, and set realistic expectations with internal stakeholders and partners.

Qualifications and Experience

• 6+ years of product management, including at least 2 years owning a B2B or B2B2C product from launch to revenue.

• Experience with consumer credit, card acquisition, lending, or marketing and growth products sold into marketing budgets.

• Track record leading complex partner integrations (credit bureaus, data providers, mobile carriers or payment networks) with engineering, legal and business development teams.

• Strong data skills, including SQL and funnel and conversion analysis, and comfort presenting results to customers.

• Experience taking a new product from 0 to 1 in a fast-moving, high-growth company.

• Solid technical understanding of APIs, data matching and real-time decisioning systems.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to build consensus across functions and with senior leaders.

• Promotes Prove's values of humility, passion, inclusion and leadership.

Nice to Have

• Experience at or with a credit bureau (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion), or with prescreen and firm-offer-of-credit programs.

• Working knowledge of FCRA, GLBA and consumer data privacy rules.

• Background in payments, identity, authentication, or mobile and telco data.

• Experience in ad-tech or mar-tech, such as programmatic audiences, demand-side platforms or identity resolution.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

• Early customers are live in production, with conversion lift measured and reported.

• The Verified Audience architecture, data flows and approval requirements are documented.

• A 2027 roadmap and go-to-market plan is agreed with leadership, starting with card acquisition and laying out the path to lending and buy now pay later.

Why Join

• Own a largely greenfield product line with a live credit bureau partnership and early revenue already in place.

• Work on a company-level priority with direct access to Prove's executive team.

• A clear path to Lead or Principal PM as the product expands into new use cases.

The anticipated salary range for this role for the metro 2 area is  $190,000- $210,000 plus company bonus. Offered salary will be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, geo-location and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

The anticipated salary range for this role for the metro 3 area is  $178,000- $195,000 plus company bonus. Offered salary will be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, geo-location and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Prove follows a market driven compensation philosophy based on geographic location and respective market rates. Job offers will be aligned to location. Please speak with your recruiter if you have questions. Prove defines:

Benefits & Perks for FTE Provers:

jobs.title: Account Manager – Grocery West
jobs.description:
What We Do

C.A. Fortune is a national consumer-centric integrated commerce agency built to help brands win at retail. We deliver sales strategy, in-store execution, full-service marketing, and digital commerce through a single, fully integrated partner. Our capabilities span the full shelf: from getting brands on it, to getting them off it.

We’re passionate, energetic, and deeply motivated by one thing: helping brands win over customers and consumers. We bring together sales experts, marketers, e-commerce specialists, data analysts, and creatives. Different backgrounds, one mission.

Who We Are

C.A. Fortune is built on the belief that great people build great brands. We're a national consumer-centric integrated commerce agency. We show up every day to help brands of all sizes grow, compete, and lead. From emerging challengers to established market leaders, we bring the sales horsepower, marketing firepower, and integrated thinking to move the needle at retail.

The best brands are built by the best people. Come build with us.

Overview of the Role

• We are seeking an experienced Account Managerto lead our business with The Save Mart Companies (Save Mart, Lucky and FoodMaxx). You'll be the main link between our client brands and Save Mart's category, merchandising and leadership teams, driving distribution, promotions and in-store execution for a diverse portfolio of food and beverage brands.

• The ideal candidate understands the Northern California grocery landscape, and brings a strong working knowledge of distribution, category reviews, promotional planning, and new item presentations.

• Location: Remote, must be local to Modesto, CA or Stockton, CA

• Salary: $60,000 - $65,000, based on experience, qualifications, and skills

• This is a highly relationship-driven role that requires someone who can independently manage retailer relationships while also identifying opportunities to expand distribution and build a stronger portfolio of business across the region.

Key Responsibilities

• Customer leadership: Own the day-to-day relationship with Save Mart category managers, directors and leadership. Lead new item presentations, category review submissions and annual business planning (JBP) meetings.

• Promotions and pricing: Build and submit promotional plans, EDLP and TPR contracts, and pre-orders such as Wall of Value through Save Mart's processes, including DemandTec. Monitor shelf and promotional prices, and find and fix pricing or execution gaps quickly.

• Client partnership: Serve as the Save Mart expert for client brands, sharing proactive recaps, insights and proof of performance (store photos, data and retailer feedback). Respond to client requests within 48 hours.

• Category reviews and compliance: Track Save Mart's category review calendar, announce reviews to client teams early, and keep Salesforce up to date.

• In-store execution: Conduct store visits, verify new item setup, promotions and displays, and share findings with clients and internal teams.

• Retailer events: Help plan and run retailer engagement events, such as the Save Mart Parking Lot Event and grand opening events, from brand recruitment through day-of execution.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Client Partnership Managers, Sales Enablement, Insights, Order Management and distributor teams (KeHE, UNFI, C&S) to keep clients, the retailer and internal teams aligned.

• Data and reporting: Use retailer and syndicated data (Symphony AI, Circana, in-store photos) to analyze performance, explain trends and build data-driven recommendations.

Qualifications

• 3+ years of CPG sales experience with a broker, manufacturer or retailer, ideally including direct work with Save Mart or comparable West Coast grocery retailers.

• Solid understanding of trade promotion, retail pricing and margin math, and category management.

• Experience managing multiple brands and deadlines with a high level of organization and attention to detail.

• Clear, proactive and timely communication with clients and retailers.

• Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint and Salesforce, and comfortable using AI tools (Copilot) to work efficiently.

Location & Travel

• This position requires a strong local presence in Northern California and willing to travel regularly within Northern California, plus occasional trade shows and events.

You Will Stand Out If You Have

• Experience planning retailer events or tabletop shows.

Perks

• PTO and Sick Days

• 11 paid company holidays per year

• 1 Floating Holiday

• 2 paid volunteer days per year

• 3 months fully paid parental leave (regardless of gender)

• Medical, dental, and vision

• Paid company life insurance

• 401k with company match

• Summer hours (half day Fridays from Memorial Day thru Labor Day)

• Work from home flexibility

Come As You Are

C.A. is committed to making our company more inclusive. Diversity fuels our innovation and better connects us to our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. Based on research, we know that women and other marginalized groups tend to apply to roles only when their experience perfectly matches the job description. That said, we encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of qualifications, especially if this role aligns with your career trajectory.
