jobs.title: Senior Associate Sales Executive, Diversified
jobs.description:
About Definitive Healthcare:

At Definitive Healthcare, our mission is simple: to connect with the real people who make healthcare happen. With real data on real people, our customers get the Definitive picture of the Healthcare market to move their businesses and organizations forward.

We’re committed to delivering the industry’s most reliable, actionable, and differentiated insights and empowering the innovators and organizations transforming healthcare. Because when our customers succeed, healthcare improves—for everyone.

Since our founding in 2011, we’ve grown into a global company headquartered just outside Boston, Massachusetts, supporting more than 2,100 customers around the world. Along the way, we’ve built a culture centered on purposeful work, collaboration, curiosity, and meaningful impact.

We’re passionate about the work we do and the people we do it with. Through programs like Definitive Cares and our employee-led affinity groups, we create opportunities for our teams to connect and give back to the communities where we live and work.

About the Role

We're looking for a motivated Sales Executive to join our Sales team, focused on our Diversified vertical. You'll run full-cycle new-business sales within a defined territory, generating your own pipeline and closing new logos to grow Definitive Healthcare's footprint in the market supported by Marketing and Sales Development.

What You’ll Do

You'll run the entire new business sales cycle within the Strategic market — selling into Diversified organizations. Your outbound effort will be complemented by inbound leads and Sales Development support as you research prospective customers, develop outreach strategies, identify prospects, demo decision makers, and close business. This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated and driven sales professional looking to take their sales career to the next level within a high-growth healthcare commercial intelligence company!

• Research, identify, and connect with individuals and organizations who would be strong prospects for Definitive Healthcare solutions

• Develop a working understanding of how Diversified organizations use healthcare commercial intelligence and data

• Partner with Marketing and Sales Development to follow up on leads within your assigned territory

• Build relationships with prospects and key stakeholders to identify and secure new business

• The ability to navigate deals independently day-to-day, looping in your manager when pricing, contract terms, or strategic exceptions need a second set of eyes.

• Understand each prospect's business problem and use case, then show how Definitive Healthcare's solutions solve it

• Close new business consistently at or above quota

• Accurately forecast opportunities and maintain pipeline hygiene in Salesforce

• Use AI tools to enhance prospecting, research, and personal productivity

What You'll Bring

• BA or BS degree.

• 5+ years of experience selling into Enterprise or Strategic accounts, with experience in data or consultative selling; healthcare data experience a plus.

• Experience selling data, analytics, or a product with a significant data component preferred.

• Comfort with a cold-outreach, full-cycle sales motion.

• Strong communication, negotiation, and closing skills.

• A powerful work ethic with energy and drive.

• Willingness to travel approximately 25% of the time, including occasional industry events and onsite prospect meetings.

Compensation and Benefits

The base salary range for this position is $64,000 - $96,000 per year, which represents the base pay the company reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this role. Target on-target earnings (OTE), including commission, is $128,000–$192,000 per year. Actual pay within this range will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

Depending on the position, employees may also be eligible to participate in a company bonus or commission plan. All employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible paid time off, and participation in the company’s 401(k) plan with employer contribution.

Why we love Definitive Healthcare, and why you will too!

At Definitive Healthcare, our values shape how we work, how we treat one another, and how we deliver for our customers.

• We’re obsessed with data. Great companies are built on data customers can rely on. As responsible stewards, we validate rigorously, question assumptions, and use data to make better decisions.

• We’re accountable. We take ownership of results, not just tasks. When something needs doing, we step up. When things break, we fix them. We follow things through until the job is done.

• We care deeply. About our teammates, our customers, and the impact of what we build. We assume good intent, communicate openly, and support each other through challenges. We always bring maximum energy to everything we do.

We're also committed to creating an environment where our people feel supported in their work, their wellbeing, and their financial future.

• We invest in our people. We offer a competitive benefits package, including comprehensive healthcare benefits and a 401(k) match.

• We make room for connection and impact. Definitive Cares is our 100% employee-driven program that creates opportunities to connect with colleagues through affinity groups and make a positive impact on our communities.

• We’re a great place to work. In 2024 and 2025, we earned multiple workplace honors, including Built In’s 100 Best Places to Work in Boston (both years), a Stevie Bronze Award for Great Employers, and recognition as a Great Place to Work in India.

What our Employees are saying about us on Glassdoor:

“Great Work atmosphere, great work life balance, excellent company to work for, amazing top notch product, incredible customer service, lots of tools to help you succeed.”

-Business Development Manager

“Great team. Amazing growth. Employees are treated very well.”

-Research Analyst

“I have waited 36 years to work at a dream job for a dream company, and I am so happy to have finally got there.”

-Profile Analyst

If you don’t fit all of these qualifications, but believe you’re still a great fit, feel free to apply and tell us why in your cover letter.

If you are a California, Colorado, New York City or Washington resident and this role is a remote role, you can receive additional information about the compensation and benefits for this role, which we will provide upon request.

Definitive Hiring Philosophy

Definitive Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other status. If you’re interested in working in a fast growing, exciting working environment – we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Array is a financial innovation platform that helps digital brands, financial institutions, and fintechs get compelling consumer products to market faster. We deliver a suite of credit and identity monitoring tools, privacy protection, and a financial ads marketplace via embeddable widgets or a clean, modern API.  Our private label offerings help drive revenue and increase engagement for our customers while empowering millions of consumers to achieve their financial goals.

As a remote-first company, we’re focused on providing opportunities for high performing individuals to have deep impact in the fast growing fintech space. A clear mission, a commitment to continuous improvement and a willingness to experiment empower us individually and together deliver the best products for our clients and users.

As a Senior Field Marketing Manager at Array, you will develop and execute field marketing strategies that drive pipeline, accelerate existing opportunities, and strengthen relationships with prospects, customers, and partners. You will work closely with Sales and Partnerships leadership to identify where and how Marketing can have the greatest impact. This is a hands-on role for someone who can build strategy, execute programs, and scale processes in a fast-growing organization. This role reports to the VP of Field & Events Marketing.

You will:

• Own the field marketing strategy and calendar in alignment with Sales priorities, target accounts, key verticals, and revenue goals.

• Partner with Sales and BDR leadership to identify pipeline gaps, prioritize accounts, and develop targeted programs that generate qualified meetings, new opportunities, and pipeline acceleration.

• Develop and execute high-impact programs including industry conferences, regional events, executive dinners, roundtables, VIP hospitality, and account-based marketing initiatives.

• Own the end-to-end marketing strategy for assigned programs, from business case, audience selection and promotion through sales enablement, onsite execution, follow-up, and reporting.

• Build and scale partner and customer marketing programs, including joint webinars, co-marketing campaigns, and experiences that support acquisition, retention, and expansion.

• Collaborate with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, RevOps, and Events to deliver integrated campaigns and ensure clear ownership across the pre- and post-event lifecycle.

• Establish program goals and measure performance against qualified meetings, opportunity creation, sourced and influenced pipeline, and ROI. Use data to determine where to invest, scale, or pivot.

• Manage program budgets, negotiate with vendors and agencies, and ensure investments align with business priorities.

• Build repeatable playbooks and processes that enable the team to scale, proactively plan, and execute consistently.

• Mentor junior field marketers and have the opportunity to take on direct people management as the team grows.

• Maintain a habit of using AI tools to think, build, and ship faster—it’s your default, not an afterthought.

You have:

• 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a strong background in field marketing, demand generation, and revenue-driving programs, ideally in a high-growth SaaS or fintech environment.

• A proven track record of developing and executing field marketing programs that generate measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

• Experience partnering directly with Sales leadership, account executives, and BDR teams to build account-focused marketing plans.

• Experience managing a diverse portfolio of programs, from large industry conferences to intimate executive experiences, partner campaigns, and webinars.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate performance data into actionable recommendations and investment decisions.

• Experience with Salesforce, marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, and campaign reporting and attribution.

• Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and budgets independently.

• A strategic mindset paired with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and execute in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

• Experience mentoring or managing junior marketers is a plus, as is familiarity with banks, credit unions, fintechs, or the broader financial services ecosystem.

• A willingness to travel regularly for field programs and team meetings.

• A belief that AI is reshaping work, you instinctively use it to accelerate everything you do.

Pay transparency: $175,000 + for base salary, depending on experience. Full time employee compensation includes an Incentive Stock Option (ISO) grant, subject to Board approval.

Expected interview process: Recruiter Conversation - Hiring Manager Interview - Loop round:

Expected onboarding process: Onboarding at Array is active, not passive: new hires spend their first two weeks building fluency in our products, customers, and value proposition, and are expected to pass scored assessments before beginning role-specific work. Success means meeting defined performance standards through a six-month evaluation period — with continuous feedback and ongoing accountability as core parts of working at Array.

Array Offers All Full Time Employees the following Benefits and Perks:

• Full medical, dental, and vision, premiums covered at 100% for full-time employees and 70% for dependents

• Unlimited PTO and sick leave + 14 company holidays to encourage a healthy work-life blend

• 100% 401k match up to 4% with immediate vesting

• Generous and competitive parental leave for all parents

• $1,000 desk setup subsidy to set-up your unique remote office

• $100/month to subsidize wifi/cell phone expenses

• Summer Fridays (half-day Fridays) typically from late May to the end of August

• Commuter benefits for those who choose to go into our New York City or San Francisco office spaces

Not sure if you meet the Qualifications? We know that folks tend to only apply if they check every box. If you think you have the appropriate qualifications, but don’t meet every single one, we encourage you to still apply. We’d love to hear from you.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace; we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.title: Associate E-Commerce Partnership Manager
jobs.description:
What We Do

C.A. Fortune is a national consumer-centric integrated commerce agency built to help brands win at retail. We deliver sales strategy, in-store execution, full-service marketing, and digital commerce through a single, fully integrated partner. Our capabilities span the full shelf: from getting brands on it, to getting them off it.

We’re passionate, energetic, and deeply motivated by one thing: helping brands win over customers and consumers. We bring together sales experts, marketers, e-commerce specialists, data analysts, and creatives. Different backgrounds, one mission.

Who We Are

C.A. Fortune is built on the belief that great people build great brands. We're a national consumer-centric integrated commerce agency. We show up every day to help brands of all sizes grow, compete, and lead. From emerging challengers to established market leaders, we bring the sales horsepower, marketing firepower, and integrated thinking to move the needle at retail.

The best brands are built by the best people. Come build with us.

Overview of the Role

• The Associate E-commerce Partnership Manager will work together with the E-commerce Partnership Manager on all day- to-day client activities to grow C.A. Fortune Clients’ business on e-commerce platforms with a focus on Amazon. This is a dynamic, fast-paced and rewarding position in the ever changing and growing digital sales and marketing industry. The Associate E-commerce Partnership Manager will support E-commerce Partnership Managers in the day-to-day management of their portfolio participating in strategy sessions, business reviews, and operations meetings. They will also have direct partnership management responsibilities owning the development and execution of digital shelf and merchandising strategies. The ideal candidate for this role is digitally curious, problem solver, continuous learner, and data oriented. They enjoy being a part of a team that gets things done, supports each other, and likes to have fun while doing it.

• Fully Remote but if local to Chicago, IL will observe a hybrid schedule in office 3 days

• Salary range: $60,000 - $65,000 based on experience, qualifications and skills.

• Travel required is less than 10% - i.e. industry trade shows, client national sales meetings, ECommerce Team meetings, and /or any other events

What You’ll do at C.A. Fortune

• Support Partnership Manager and direct management of clients’ brands and portfolio with responsibility for: E-commerce strategy development across the channel to ensure product availability, content, customer acquisition, and retention Amazon digital shelf creation & optimization, assortment recommendations, pricing, merchandising, Amazon Advertising strategy & execution, 1P & 3P selling Work with clients to identify, track, and report on KPIs. Help clients navigate relationships and meetings with Amazon Vendor Managers

• Support Partnership Manager by managing clients’ vendor and seller accounts, including catalog and content updates, merchandising, data accuracy, and submissions to Amazon support

• Engage internal insights team to deliver client reporting and data needed to make key business decisions

• Analyze client reporting and develop insights that lead to action to drive growth

• Ongoing project management to drive client success: Tracking progress and coordinate client updates with Partnership Manager Ensure critical timelines are met by coordinating deliverables between client and operations team

• Identification of issues and troubleshooting solutions with Amazon support

• Participation in key client strategy meetings as needed.

• Work with distributors and other 3P logistics providers to provide solutions for clients to sell any product via Amazon platforms

• Troubleshoot operational issues that may cause delays in shipments to Amazon, etc.

What You Should Bring to the Table

• Extremely organized and detail-oriented

• Demonstrated ability to achieve high performance goals and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

• Strong knowledge of the consumer products industry (specifically food products)

• Experience with a major retailer (Brick & Mortar or Online)

• Experience working for or partnering with Amazon

• Strong communication skills, ability to clearly articulate complex concepts/processes in a concise manner, including strong attention to detail and proofreading skills

• Must be comfortable with change and ambiguity

• Internal motivation to take initiative, learn, and become an Amazon expert

• Team player

• Strong analytics skills

• A demonstrated competency in multi-tasking and problem-solving with focus on meeting deadlines

• Strong analytical and strategic thinker; can turn self-developed strategies/efficient processes into execution

• 4-year bachelor’s degree, and/or similar industry experience

• Proficient with all necessary computer-based programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint)

You Will Stand Out if You Have

• Prior Amazon experience

• Prior client management and/or agency experience

• Prior CPG experience

• Familiarity with both Seller Central and Vendor Central platforms

• Digital curiosity and are a continuous learner

Perks

• PTO and sick days

• 11 paid company holidays per year

• 1 Floating holiday

• 2 paid volunteer days per year

• Bonus eligible

• 3 months fully paid parental leave (regardless of gender)

• Medical, dental, and vision

• Paid company life insurance

• 401k with company match

• Summer hours (half day Fridays from Memorial Day thru Labor Day)

Come As You Are

C.A. Fortune is committed to making our company more inclusive. Diversity fuels our innovation and better connects us to our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. Based on research, we know that women and other marginalized groups tend to apply to roles only when their experience perfectly matches the job description. That said, we encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of qualifications, especially if this role aligns with your career trajectory.

jobs.title: Stationary Engineer
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

The Stationary Engineer’s primary responsibility is to provide operations and maintenance support to the facility. This would include repair and maintenance and preventive maintenance on building systems and equipment included in the scope of work associated with the contract between Veolia and the client. The Stationary Engineer will report directly to the Chief Engineer.

This is a position attached to the Collective Bargaining Agreement between Veolia and the International Union of Operating Engineers – Local 39.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Operation, maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of all boilers, heating pumps, valves, appurtenances and lines used in the distribution of steam and heated or processed water.
• Operation, maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of refrigerant compressors, condensers, evaporators, traps, transfer pumps, expansion valves, stop valves and float valves, together with all refrigerant lines and devices used to control temperature, and air conditioning systems in their entirety.
• Operation, maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of pumps handling brines or other secondary refrigerating liquids together with all valves, appurtenances and lines used in the system.
• Operation, maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of air compressors, together with distribution lines and all valves and devices for air control.
• Operation, maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of all natural and manufactured gas distribution lines, including all valves and devices for air control.
• Operation, maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of water filters, softeners, piping and pumps used in conjunction with water distribution, including all sinks and toilet bowls, including all supply lines, drains, water lines, control devices and sprinkler systems.
• Operation, maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of all types of electrical motors and engines used to power pumps, compressors and fans.
• Operate and maintain all data center specific HVAC, and Electrical Systems to include: PDUs, CRAC Units, UPS Modules, Static Transfer Switches, Emergency Generators, Cooling Towers, Fans, Motors, Underfloor LDS, specialized Fire Systems including Fire suppression, and FA monitoring including VESDA.
• Appropriate levels of electrical work including troubleshooting and repair.
• Tools considered as necessary to the fulfillment of the duties of the engineer shall include all those which may be required in the performance of his duties, including such types of special equipment necessary to operate, install, maintain and repair the equipment listed.
• Operation, maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of all repair of all fuel oil systems including pumps, valves, lines and controls.
• Operation, maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of building automation systems for HVAC, including consoles, data gathering panels, remote sensors and indicating devices.
• Operation, maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of all mail conveyor systems excluding tenant owned systems.
• Operation, maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of sanitary sewer systems, sump pumps including basins, water closets, urinals and piping.
• Maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of trash compactors, including electrical and hydraulic systems.
• Maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of all kitchen equipment excluding tenant owned equipment.
• Operation, maintenance, installation, replacement and repair of all life Safety related equipment.

Education/Experience/Background:

• High school diploma or GED equivalent.
• Local 39 Apprenticeship program preferred.
• Minimum of five (5) years experience in the implementation of the above.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Excellent time management skills and the ability to problem solve.
• Must be highly organized, with excellent attention to detail.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• EPA – Refrigerant
• Fire Pump license preferred.
• High Rise Fire Safety
• Licensed for equipment – responsible per job location.

Physical Requirements:

• Lift heavy equipment and carry materials up and down stairs with the capacity of lifting about 50 pounds.
• Hear and understand audible alarms, detect changes in noise levels of rotating equipment and portable radio communication.
• Occasional stooping, bending, or kneeling and entering confined spaces.
• Constantly uses hands to finger, handle or feel and frequently reaches with hands and arms. Works in various positions; works on ladders, catwalks, and supports at heights of 50 feet above the ground; and works with hands extended above and below head and body.
• Typically spends 25 – 35% of time exposed to outdoor and sometimes inclement weather.

Pay Rate: $76.50, Per Hour.

Benefits: Our employees are covered by comprehensive benefits packages including paid time off policies; health, dental, vision, and life insurance; retirement plans, savings accounts; tuition reimbursement; paid volunteering and more.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINDAR

Quindar builds modern software for satellite operations, helping teams operate spacecraft with greater speed, clarity, and reliability. We work at the intersection of aerospace, software, and operations, supporting customers who need dependable tools for complex, real-world missions.

About the Role

Quindar is hiring a Full Stack Engineer to develop ground satellite operations software using Python, AWS, and modern web technologies. In this role, you will support mission-unique software development for U.S. government programs, working across backend and frontend systems while also contributing to Quindar’s core product.

You do not need to be a satellite expert to succeed here. We are looking for a strong software engineer who is excited to build reliable, scalable systems in a mission-driven environment.

This is a hybrid role based in Arvada, CO.

 
What You’ll Do

 - Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and cloud-native applications for satellite operations workflows.

 - Develop mission-specific software for U.S. government customers while contributing to Quindar’s core product platform.

 - Design, integrate, and troubleshoot services using AWS technologies such as EC2, S3, RDS, Fargate, EKS, CloudWatch, S3, EFS/EBS, EC2, and RDS.

 - Work across backend and frontend systems, including integration with React, TypeScript, GraphQL, and modern application frameworks.

 - Improve the scalability, security, cost efficiency, reliability, and performance of software used in satellite operations.

 - Build and support containerized and serverless architectures using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines.

 - Collaborate with satellite operators, customers, product managers, frontend engineers, backend engineers, and other cross-functional partners to understand requirements and deliver new capabilities.

 - Troubleshoot production issues, analyze system behavior, and improve maintainability, resilience, and observability over time.

 - Automate development, deployment, and operational workflows to help teams move quickly and reliably.

What We’re Looking For

 - 4+ years of professional experience in backend development, full-stack engineering, DevOps, or a related software engineering role.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Strong proficiency with Python and experience building production backend services.

 - Experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting APIs, distributed systems, relational and NoSQL databases, caching systems, event-driven systems, and multi-tier architectures.

 - Experience with AWS services and cloud-native development patterns.

 - Hands-on experience with Docker, containerized applications, and Kubernetes systems.

 - Experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or similar.

 - Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript, with experience either developing full-stack or frontend software or closely integrating with frontend engineers.

 - Experience with version control systems such as Git, GitHub, GitLab, or similar tools.

 - Strong technical analysis, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.

 - Ability to work independently, manage projects with minimal guidance, and deliver high-quality work on time.

 - High standards for software maintainability, quality, resilience, security, and performance.

 - Strong communication skills across engineering, product, customer, and operations stakeholders.

Nice to Have

 - Experience building React components in TypeScript.

 - Experience with frameworks such as Next.js, Refine, or Vite.

 - Experience with Kubernetes and AWS services such as EKS, ECS, CloudWatch, S3, EFS/EBS, EC2, and RDS.

 - Experience building CI/CD pipelines, especially with GitHub Actions.

 - Experience working on satellite operations, aerospace, defense, or government software systems.

 - Demonstrated self-starting technical ownership, including building or deeply improving a product outside of a traditional professional role.

Role Requirements
Ability to obtain a U.S. government issued security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

 - To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/ddtc_public/ddtc_public?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.

Why You’ll Love Working at Quindar

 - We work in a cutting edge industry and you will get the opportunity to be part of a small team with a large direct impact on the success of our customers’ space missions!

 - We take work life balance very seriously. We require employees to take 15 days off but provide unlimited PTO and follow most US federal government holidays.

 - Mental health is just as important as physical so we provide quarterly health & wellness benefits.

 - Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family with 100% coverage for employees.

 - We encourage employees to save for retirement and provide 4% 401(k) matching.

 - Each year we have a 4-day company offsite. Previous locations include San Francisco, Nashville, Denver, Santa Fe, New Orleans, San Diego, Bozeman, and New York City.

 - Our culture and company is evolving. You will be key in creating the next major or minor version!

jobs.title: Scientist, Arrayed Screening, Alzheimer's Disease Initiative
jobs.description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

• Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets, accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.

• Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Scientist with a strong background in stem cell biology and high-throughput screening to join the Molecular Engineering team within the Genome Engineering Technology Center at the Arc Institute. In this role, you will lead the optimization, scale-up, and execution of arrayed perturbation screens in 2D human pluripotent stem cell (hPSC)-derived microglia. This includes refining and adapting microglia differentiation protocols for high-throughput screening, validating their reproducibility and compatibility with diverse perturbations and readouts, and establishing robust workflows that can transition to automated platforms. In this highly collaborative, cross-functional role, you will partner with researchers across Arc’s Tech Centers and Core Labs to drive the process development, validation, and execution of these screening pipelines, directly enabling Arc’s Alzheimer’s Disease Initiative (ADI), an ambitious effort to identify and drug rational therapeutic targets for neurodegenerative disorders

About you

• You are passionate about science and excited about answering questions related to functional genomics, genome engineering technology development, and complex human diseases.

• You are creative and excited to try new ways of tackling problems beyond the techniques and approaches you’re already familiar with.

• You have a systematic, process-oriented mindset and take pride in building workflows that are reproducible, scalable, and ready for automation.

• You understand the importance of collaboration and thrive when working with a diverse team of scientists.

• You have a deep commitment to data quality while working in a fast-paced environment.

• Your organizational skills enable you to manage multiple concurrent projects, and your curiosity and creativity drive you to continuous learning and innovation.

• You have high standards for experimental design and data analysis while moving fast and efficiently to keep projects on track.

In this position you will

• Design, lead and execute the adaptation and validation of 2D hPSC-derived microglia differentiation for high-throughput arrayed perturbation screens, optimizing protocols as needed to establish scalable, reproducible, and automation-ready workflows.

• Define quality control metrics and acceptance criteria across differentiation and screen execution to ensure robust, interpretable transcriptomic and functional readouts at scale.

• Collaborate with experimental and computational teams across Arc to establish compatibility with diverse perturbations and downstream readouts, and work closely with automation engineers to implement and rigorously validate automated workflows.

• Contribute to additional pooled and arrayed genetic perturbation screening efforts across the Molecular Engineering team, supporting workflows that advance Arc’s Alzheimer’s Disease Initiative.

• Present findings at internal meetings and external conferences, and contribute to scientific publications.

• Stay current on developments in genome engineering, functional genomics, and high-throughput screening, actively seeking opportunities for innovation and technology adoption.

Requirements

• Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Bioengineering, Genetics, Biochemistry, or a related field.

• 0–5 years of post-PhD research experience (industry or academia).

• Experience with hPSC culture and differentiation; immune cell differentiation experience highly desirable.

• Experience with CRISPR-Cas9 or other genome editing/perturbation techniques (e.g., CRISPRi/a).

• Experience designing, executing, and troubleshooting arrayed screening workflows; experience carrying out high-throughput workflows strongly preferred.

• Proficiency with computational tools for analyzing genomics data (Python, R, or similar).

• Strong project management skills with the ability to plan, execute, and deliver results on time.

• Demonstrated ability to work both independently and in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Benchling or similar LIMS systems.

• Hands-on experience with developing protocols intended for lab automation and linking/tracking associated processes and materials within a LIMS system.

• Experience with process development or scaling of cell-based workflows.

The base salary range for this position is $128,500 to $159,000. These amounts reflect the range of base salary that the Institute reasonably would expect to pay a new hire or internal candidate for this position. The actual base compensation paid to any individual for this position may vary depending on factors such as experience, market conditions, education/training, skill level, and whether the compensation is internally equitable, and does not include bonuses, commissions, differential pay, other forms of compensation, or benefits. This position is also eligible to receive an annual discretionary bonus, with the amount dependent on individual and institute performance factors.

In addition to the Base Salary and Annual Bonus above, you will be eligible to participate in the Institute’s Compound Cash Grant Program (the “CCGP”). The CCGP is a program designed to offer multi-year cash grants providing for a fixed dollar amount paid out in semi-annual installments to reward employees for staying and contributing to the Institute. As soon as reasonably practical after your start date, you will receive a grant letter describing the terms of your award under the CCGP.

About Quindar

Quindar builds modern software for satellite operations, helping teams operate spacecraft with greater speed, clarity, and reliability. We work at the intersection of aerospace, software, and operations, supporting customers who need dependable tools for complex, real-world missions.

About the Role

Quindar is hiring a Full Stack Engineer to develop ground satellite operations software using Python, AWS, and modern web technologies. In this role, you will support mission-unique software development for U.S. government programs, working across backend and frontend systems while also contributing to Quindar’s core product.

You do not need to be a satellite expert to succeed here. We are looking for a strong software engineer who is excited to build reliable, scalable systems in a mission-driven environment.

This is a hybrid role based in Arvada, CO.

 
What You’ll Do

 - Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and cloud-native applications for satellite operations workflows.

 - Develop mission-specific software for U.S. government customers while contributing to Quindar’s core product platform.

 - Design, integrate, and troubleshoot services using AWS technologies such as EC2, S3, RDS, Fargate, EKS, CloudWatch, S3, EFS/EBS, EC2, and RDS.

 - Work across backend and frontend systems, including integration with React, TypeScript, GraphQL, and modern application frameworks.

 - Improve the scalability, security, cost efficiency, reliability, and performance of software used in satellite operations.

 - Build and support containerized and serverless architectures using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines.

 - Collaborate with satellite operators, customers, product managers, frontend engineers, backend engineers, and other cross-functional partners to understand requirements and deliver new capabilities.

 - Troubleshoot production issues, analyze system behavior, and improve maintainability, resilience, and observability over time.

 - Automate development, deployment, and operational workflows to help teams move quickly and reliably.

What We’re Looking For

 - Active Secret clearance. TS/SCI preferred

 - 4+ years of professional experience in backend development, full-stack engineering, DevOps, or a related software engineering role.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Strong proficiency with Python and experience building production backend services.

 - Experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting APIs, distributed systems, relational and NoSQL databases, caching systems, event-driven systems, and multi-tier architectures.

 - Experience with AWS services and cloud-native development patterns.

 - Hands-on experience with Docker, containerized applications, and Kubernetes systems.

 - Experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or similar.

 - Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript, with experience either developing full-stack or frontend software or closely integrating with frontend engineers.

 - Experience with version control systems such as Git, GitHub, GitLab, or similar tools.

 - Strong technical analysis, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.

 - Ability to work independently, manage projects with minimal guidance, and deliver high-quality work on time.

 - High standards for software maintainability, quality, resilience, security, and performance.

 - Strong communication skills across engineering, product, customer, and operations stakeholders.

Nice to Have

 - Experience building React components in TypeScript.

 - Experience with frameworks such as Next.js, Refine, or Vite.

 - Experience with Kubernetes and AWS services such as EKS, ECS, CloudWatch, S3, EFS/EBS, EC2, and RDS.

 - Experience building CI/CD pipelines, especially with GitHub Actions.

 - Experience working on satellite operations, aerospace, defense, or government software systems.

 - Demonstrated self-starting technical ownership, including building or deeply improving a product outside of a traditional professional role.

Why You’ll Love Working at Quindar

 - We take work life balance very seriously. We require employees to take 15 days off but provide unlimited PTO and follow most US federal government holidays.

 - Mental health is just as important as physical so we provide quarterly health & wellness benefits.

 - Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family with 100% coverage for employees.

 - We encourage employees to save for retirement and provide 4% 401(k) matching.

 - Each year we have a 4-day company offsite. Previous locations include San Francisco, Nashville, Denver, Santa Fe, New Orleans, San Diego, Bozeman, and New York City.

jobs.title: Cleared Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Our customers run satellite missions on our software. Failure isn't an option. As a Forward Deployed Product Engineer, you make sure our software holds up at the edge, where it matters most. 

You'll also spot what's missing, what could be simpler, and what should exist but doesn't yet, then turn those observations into product direction.

This is a product role as much as an engineering one. You'll work in the field, in ops centers, and alongside customers. You're a generalist who moves across the full stack, from infrastructure to frontend, and you use AI as leverage to ship faster. At Quindar, we believe the future belongs to engineers who use AI to move faster, build better, and shape the next generation of our products

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Configure and deploy our software in customer environments, ensuring reliability and performance across complex workflows.

 - Troubleshoot issues across backend APIs, cloud infrastructure, databases, and the frontend.

 - Travel to customer sites and embed with operations teams, building trusted technical relationships.

 - Prototype products and iterate quickly with live customer data and direct feedback.

 - Act as the voice of the customer in product discussions, translating field insights into roadmap priorities, solutions, and integrations.

 - Partner with Product & Engineering to turn successful prototypes into production code.

 - Develop playbooks for repeatable integrations and maintain clear documentation and training resources.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Education:
   
   - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Aerospace, Engineering, or a related field.

 - Experience:
   
   - 3+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on customer-facing roles.
   
   - Proven track record of building, deploying, or supporting production software in mission-critical environments.

 - Technical Skills:
   
   - Proficiency in Python; experience with TypeScript, Java, or similar is a plus.
   
   - Experience building software with AI tools such as Cursor, Amp, ChatGPT
   
   - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), databases, and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

 - Soft Skills:
   
   - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
   
   - Strong product sense: ability to question requirements, spot patterns, solve problems for the users.
   
   - Bias toward action: comfortable shipping prototypes quickly and iterating.
   
   - Adaptability and curiosity, thriving in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

 - Certifications:
   
   - Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Certified Kubernetes Administrator) are a plus.

 - Clearance:
   
   - Active US Security Clearance (TS/SCI) required


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

 - To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/ddtc_public/ddtc_public?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.


WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT QUINDAR

 - We work in a cutting edge industry and you will get the opportunity to be part of a small team with a large direct impact on the success of our customers’ space missions!

 - We take work life balance very seriously. We require employees to take 15 days off but provide unlimited PTO and follow most US federal government holidays.

 - Mental health is just as important as physical so we provide quarterly health & wellness benefits.

 - Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family with 100% coverage for employees.

 - We encourage employees to save for retirement and provide 4% 401(k) matching.

 - Each year we have an annual company offsite. Previous locations include San Francisco, Palm Springs, Nashville, Denver, Santa Fe, New Orleans, San Diego, Bozeman, and New York City.

 - Our culture and company is evolving. You will be key in creating the next major or minor version!

jobs.title: Deployment Customer Success Manager (Implementation Success Specialist)
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Deployment Customer Success Manager (Implementation Success Specialist), you will be tasked with making partner-delivered implementations successful from the customer's side as our expanded global relationship with strategic partners brings together SentinelOne's AI-powered security platform and our partners' expertise in managed detection and response, managed SIEM, and incident response. As partner-delivered services grow, SentinelOne remains committed to clear customer ownership, technical quality, and measurable results, and you will be the named SentinelOne contact who ensures the customer is prepared, decisions are unblocked, validated scope remains intact, and the project reaches an accepted, usable outcome. The partner executes the deployment; you own customer readiness, coordination, adoption milestones, and a clean transition into steady-state success.

What Will You Do?

• Confirm first-time acceptance, training/readiness milestones, and transition to Technical Success or ongoing Customer Success.

• Capture onboarding and deployment feedback to improve repeatable playbooks and customer communications.

• Surface delays or customer friction that could jeopardize satisfaction, adoption, or renewal readiness.

• Deliver measurable outcomes, including faster customer time to first value and on-time deployment outcomes; higher first-time acceptance and deployment CSAT; fewer defects in prerequisites, handoffs, and customer readiness; timely closure of blockers and reliable deployment success plans; and clean transitions into ongoing customer ownership.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• 3 or more years of experience in customer onboarding, implementation success, customer success, technical coordination, or SaaS deployment operations.

• Proven ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and follow complex implementation checklists.

• Familiarity with enterprise software deployments and the importance of scope, prerequisites, and acceptance.

• Strong customer communication and issue-resolution skills with consistent documentation.

• Comfort using CRM, project tracking, service delivery, or customer success platforms.

• Ability to understand technical conversations and translate them into clear next steps for a customer.

• Detail-oriented, proactive approach and the ability to manage concurrent deployments with a strong customer-first mindset.

• Exposure to cybersecurity, EDR/XDR, AI SIEM, or enterprise IT projects is highly desirable.

• Experience coordinating deployments delivered by implementation partners is highly desirable.

• Professional proficiency in English and Spanish is a plus for regional customer coverage.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

BASIC FUNCTION:

Lead Right First-Time engineering activities by troubleshooting non-conforming seal designs. Lead projects to develop improvements to existing products. This is an independent role with great latitude to affect the outcome of critical, time-sensitive projects.

PRIMARY DUTIES (RFT):

• Provide technical input and guidance to projects with respect to the design, performance, procurement, manufacturing, and testing of Dry Gas Sealing products for the turbomachinery equipment.

• Advanced use of CSTEDY & ANSYS for design analysis. Ability to understand and interpret results correctly to explain testing anomalies.
• Use 2D and 3D CAD software (Solid Edge).
• Analyse and interpret large amounts of test data to troubleshoot failed seal tests.
• Maintain build logs tracking all relevant variables for the specific seal problem (requires expert knowledge of manufacturing, assembly, and testing of gas seals).
• Advise and support work instructions for Operations (requires expert knowledge of manufacturing, assembly, and testing of gas seals).
• Evaluate the cosmetic appearance of seals, often in front of customers.
• Manage customers in difficult testing and inspection situations.
• Lead technical root cause analyses, including analysis of problems / recommendation & implementation of appropriate solutions, meeting with and presenting to customers to resolve satisfactorily and maintain a good customer relationship / confidence in John Crane products with necessary commercial awareness.
• Prepare customer-facing correspondence and technical engineering reports in connection with the projects.
• Maintain good working relationship and respect with Operations counterparts.
• Raise / process / approve Engineering Change Notice (ECN) requests, approve/reject parts not to drawing specification (handle non-conformances).
• Use engineering judgment and experience to resolve difficult technical problems.
• Develop and implement clear plans for enhancements to existing products via PAL projects.
• Manage and monitor the testing of mechanical seal designs, whether as part of a PAL project or for customer-specific tests.
• Create & distribute technical bulletins, articles, or papers dealing with product design.
• Train more junior engineers in RCAs, manufacturing, assembly, testing, design, CStedy, and FEA.
• Above engineering grade outline also implies full knowledge of / capability to perform relevant tasks in lower grade (i.e. ME1, ME2, ME3).

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical Engineering preferred).
• At least 5 years’ relevant experience with rotating equipment, preferably turbomachinery equipment.
• Broad knowledge of engineering sciences, materials, and modern manufacturing processes.
• Ability to review 2D & 3D CAD drawings.
• Project management skills.
• Effective written and oral communication skills.

At The Place for Children with Autism, we’re more than a therapy center. We’re a team on a mission to help children with autism thrive. That’s why we provide you with fully paid comprehensive training to help you earn your Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification – That means no prior experience is required! In fact, most of our new hires are ready to sit for their certification within just 35 days of their start date.

What We Offer

jobs.title: RF Regulatory Engineer
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role:

Northwood is hiring a  RF Regulatory Engineer to help license our global ground station network. Working directly with our RF Regulatory Licensing Manager, you will prepare and file earth station applications in the U.S. and internationally, support ITU filings, and keep a fast-growing licensing pipeline organized from customer request through grant and renewal. You will turn satellite and antenna technical data into regulator-ready filings, work with customers, outside counsel, and internal teams, and own the ticketing system that tracks every application. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who wants to work at the intersection of RF engineering, spectrum regulation, legal, and operations.



Responsibilities:

 - Prepare, file, and track earth station applications, modifications, amendments, special temporary authorities, and renewals before the FCC (Part 25 and Part 5 experimental) and international regulators such as ACMA (Australia) and BNetzA (Germany), working with outside counsel and filing agents.

 - Build the technical content of filings: link budgets, EIRP and EIRP density, G/T and system noise temperature, antenna gain patterns and off-axis compliance, emission designators, and RF hazard (EMF) analyses.

 - Support ITU filings for earth stations and customer satellite networks: assemble and check Appendix 4 data (SpaceCap/SpaceVal), track filing status, and keep national applications consistent with the underlying ITU filings.

 - Own the licensing Jira space day to day: triage new requests from Business Development, keep status, owners, due dates, and blockers current, and prepare the dashboard and metrics (drafted, filed, granted) for the weekly licensing meeting.

 - Serve as a technical point of contact for customers’ regulatory teams at intake: collect satellite, ITU filing, and authorization details, and flag gaps early (e.g., missing ITU filings, market access, or national authorizations).

 - Track post-grant obligations, including license conditions, frequency coordination with other operators, expirations, and renewals, and maintain the license register.

 - Support equipment certification and type approval of our S-, X-, and Ka-band antennas for import and licensing in multiple countries.



Basic Qualifications:

 - 3–6 years of experience in satellite communications, spectrum regulatory work, or RF systems engineering, including at least 2 years preparing regulatory filings.

 - Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, physics, or a related field.

 - Hands-on experience preparing U.S. earth station or space station applications (FCC Part 25 and/or Part 5) and applications in at least one non-U.S. jurisdiction.

 - Working knowledge of the ITU Radio Regulations as they apply to satellite networks and earth stations (including Articles 21 and 22 and Appendix 4), and experience preparing or reviewing ITU filing data.

 - Solid satellite link fundamentals: link budgets, EIRP, PSD, G/T, antenna patterns, and interference metrics such as C/I and I/N.

 - Experience managing many concurrent work items in Jira or a similar ticketing tool, with the discipline to keep status, owners, and dates current.

 - Clear technical writing for regulators, customers, and non-engineers.



Preferred Qualifications:

 - Hands-on use of ITU BR software (SpaceCap, SpaceVal, TerRaSys) and experience with coordination requests or BR IFIC review.

 - Experience with FCC, NTIA, or other U.S. federal spectrum processes, or with government customers.

 - RF test and measurement experience (e.g., spectrum analyzer emissions measurements, antenna pattern testing), or equipment certification and type approval.

 - Background at a ground station, GSaaS, or NGSO operator; familiarity with S-, X-, and Ka-band TT&C and mission data links.

 - Jira configuration experience (workflows, filters, dashboards) and Confluence.



Additional Information:



To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian (Per Diem) - Woodbury, MN
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a per diem Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

jobs.title: Trading Analyst
jobs.description:
IMC is looking for a talented and analytically driven Trading Analyst in New York to join our systematic equities business.

Our Trading team is responsible for overseeing the real-time trading, performance, and risk of our systematic strategies. Working closely with quantitative researchers, senior leaders, execution engineers, and external partners, the team makes time-sensitive decisions to ensure strategies operate effectively, respond to changing market conditions, and identify opportunities to improve trading performance.

Your Core Responsibilities:

• Real-Time Trading Oversight: Monitor live systematic trading strategies, identify anomalies, and take timely action to ensure operational stability and continuity.

• Risk Management: Monitor portfolio exposures, trading activity, and risk limits, escalating and responding to potential risks.

• Performance Analysis: Analyze trading performance, P&L, execution quality, and market behavior to identify opportunities for improvement.

• Research Collaboration: Work closely with quantitative researchers to investigate trading outcomes, evaluate strategy behavior, and support ongoing optimization.

• Technology & Automation: Partner with engineers to improve trading systems, monitoring tools, and automated operational workflows.

• Business Expansion: Support the deployment of new strategies and expansion into new markets, venues, and asset classes.

Your Skills and Experience:

• 2+ years of experience in a trading analyst, trade support, or trading operations role at a bank or trading firm.

• Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with a degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, or a related field.

• Genuine interest in financial markets, systematic trading, and quantitative research.

• Sound judgment and the ability to make effective decisions under pressure.

• Intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across trading, research, and technology teams.

• Experience with Python, SQL, or other programming languages is advantageous.

• We value analytical ability, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

Please note that immigration sponsorship is not offered for this specific opening.

The Base Salary range for the role is included below. Base salary is only one component of total compensation; all full-time, permanent positions are eligible for a discretionary bonus and benefits, including paid leave and insurance. Please visit Benefits - US | IMC Trading for more comprehensive information.

Salary Range

$200,000—$250,000 USD

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer, Battlespace Awareness
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Anduril’s Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. The Battlespace Awareness (BA) Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge radar products. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.

As a Manufacturing Engineer within BA, you will be responsible for driving process improvements, ensuring the highest quality of production, and supporting the development and implementation of new products. You will play a crucial role in optimizing manufacturing processes, reducing costs, and increasing efficiencies on existing technologies while also developing new products and scaling to full scale production.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain that includes Assembly, Integration & Test (AI&T) for electro-mechanical assemblies

• Contribute to operational excellence with a strong continuous improvement mindset and leading impactful Kaizen events

• Be a strong partner with Product Quality Engineering to drive and support RCCA burndowns that tackle key issues both internally and externally to BA Production

• Collaborate with Design Engineering teams in early to late phases of the development process to provide DFx for smooth NPI transitions

• Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes

• Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.

• Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production

• Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware

• Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Degree in a technical field preferred such as engineering, math, or a hard science

• 2+ years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware

• Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment

• Demonstrated ability to contribute to the delivery of electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment

• Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.) Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus.

• Prior experience working with JIRA, Siemens NX, Teamcenter (PLM), or Oracle (ERP) or equivalents

• Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing concepts and tools

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Exposure to or interest in scaling product testing and production.

• Hands-on experience with software & firmware flashing or end-of-line testing & troubleshooting

• Experience with RF Products that require system AI&T (assembly, integration, and test)

• Software scripting experience in any language

• A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning

• Current active U.S. Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$87,000—$116,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. jobs.title: Senior Principal Scientist, Psychiatry
jobs.description:
At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Senior Principal Scientist, Psychiatry accountable for planning and overseeing the scientific strategy and delivery of psychiatry-focused clinical trial services across a portfolio of studies. This role is responsible for ensuring the scientific integrity, quality, and consistency of endpoint data collection, including rater training, scale administration, and central monitoring methodologies. The role provides scientific leadership across a portfolio of studies, supporting study design implementation and the development of services for psychiatric indications (e.g., MDD, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder). Responsibilities include oversight of rater training programs, central monitoring frameworks, and data quality strategies to support reliable and valid clinical trial outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee the scientific delivery of psychiatry clinical trial services across a portfolio of studies, including rater training and central monitoring.

• Contribute to definition and implementation of study-specific delivery plans for endpoint quality, including integration of central monitoring and review workflows.

• Provide direction to internal study teams on feasibility, scale selection, administration standards, and timing of deliverables.

• Serve as the primary scientific point of contact for assigned studies, ensuring clarity and consistency in internal and sponsor communications.

• Contribute to design and implementation of rater training programs (e.g., MADRS, HAM-D, HAM-A, YMRS), including certification, calibration, and remediation pathways.

• Monitor central monitoring outputs, including identification of data quality signals, rater drift, and protocol deviations, and guide appropriate follow-up actions.

• Support the resolution of scientific and data quality escalations arising from central monitoring and study review activities.

• Develop central monitoring resources to systematize feedback.

• Collaborate with Project Management to ensure efficient and profitable delivery of services, including resource allocation and workflow optimization.

• Contribute to the development and standardization of SOPs, training materials, and operational guidelines for psychiatry trials.

• Support staff development within scientific and rater training teams, including mentoring and performance feedback.

• Contribute to the development and refinement of psychiatry-focused products and services, including rater training programs, central monitoring methodologies, and scale-specific guidance.

• Support innovation in endpoint quality assurance and approaches for detecting data quality issues.

• Contribute to the design and interpretation of metrics related to rater performance, endpoint reliability, and data quality.

• Analyze patterns in clinical trial data to identify risks such as placebo response inflation, rater drift, and scoring inconsistencies.

• Provide scientific consultation on study design, scale selection, administration strategy, and risk mitigation.

• Support business development through scientific input in proposals

• Drive scientific dissemination through publications, conference presentations, and internal knowledge-sharing initiatives.
