jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role:

The Forward Deployed Engineer will help customers adopt and succeed on Northwood's ground station network. You'll work with satellite operators to understand their missions, shape requirements, and guide them from first conversation through deployment and beyond. You'll partner closely with Business Development, Engineering, and Program Management throughout.



This role suits a technically credible operator who can build trust with satellite customers, spot opportunities, and turn mission needs into clear priorities for our internal teams.



Responsibilities:

 - Make customer missions succeed on Northwood's network.

 - Serve as the primary technical contact for customers during capture, evaluation, onboarding, and post-deployment.

 - Get hands-on with implementation and integration — working directly alongside customers and Engineering to bring up, troubleshoot, and validate their operations on the network.

 - Ship code, debug integrations, and validate operations alongside customers and Engineering

 - Support Business Development on qualification, proposals, and expansion.

 - Lead technical discovery, exchanges, demos, and readiness reviews alongside Program Management.

 - Learn each customer's mission, workflows, constraints, decision criteria, and success metrics in depth.

 - Translate customer needs into clear priorities for Engineering, Product, and BD.

 - Surface friction points, adoption blockers, and recurring needs that should shape the product and network.

 - Coordinate onboarding and deployment readiness — clarifying requirements, flagging risks, and aligning internal teams around customer objectives.

 - Build reusable discovery frameworks and customer-facing materials that help Northwood scale capture and customer success.



Basic Qualifications:

 - 7+ years in customer-facing technical roles: solutions or systems engineering, mission operations, technical business development, capture engineering, solutions architecture, or TAM.

 - Bachelor's in EE, CE, CS, Aerospace, or related field — or equivalent experience with mission systems, ground systems, networking, cloud, or satellite operations.

 - Track record taking complex customer engagements from discovery through deployment or expansion.

 - Proven ability to build trust with technical customers and turn ambiguous mission needs into concrete priorities.

 - Comfortable working in ambiguous environments spanning hardware, software, networking, and business objectives.

 - Strong communicator — able to lead technical conversations, write clear customer materials, and brief internal stakeholders.

 - Effective across BD, Engineering, Product, Program Management, and customer teams.

 - Willing to travel up to 30%.



Preferred Qualifications:

 - Background in satellite communications, RF, space operations, ground stations, or telecom infrastructure.

 - Experience with proposals, technical evaluations, demos, pilots, or proof-of-concept work.

 - Experience managing technical relationships in mission-critical environments.

 - Familiarity with APIs, networking protocols, telemetry, scheduling systems, cloud infrastructure, or mission assurance.

 - Ability to obtain or hold TS/SCI clearance.



Additional Requirements:

 - This position requires successfully obtaining and maintaining a Top Secret Security Clearance as a condition of employment. While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiate the application process promptly upon accepting this offer. Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, Northwood Space reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with optional needs.

 - Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

 - This role requires being on-site 5 days per week



Additional Information:



To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.



Northwood Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Northwood Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Finance Data
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Finance Data Systems pillar within the Finance Transformation Office serves as the backbone of financial integrity and operational intelligence at the company. We build the foundational data ecosystems and analytical frameworks that drive critical business outcomes. Our mandate is to transform raw, disparate operational and financial data into a reliable, high-integrity information architecture. By bridging traditional finance rigor with modern analytics, we empower division leadership, hardware engineering, corporate functions, and operational teams to make rapid, data-informed decisions as we scale production and expand strategic initiatives.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking an experienced Finance Data Strategist with deep domain expertise in cost accounting, manufacturing, or operations finance to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will act as the strategic bridge connecting division finance teams, operational business stakeholders, and analytics engineers. You will lead high-impact data initiatives centered on complex operational finance—such as unit economics, Bill of Materials (BOM) cost rollups, inventory valuation, and production variances. Rather than writing data pipelines yourself, you will own the functional architecture: defining requirements, untangling complex business logic, establishing financial definitions, and partnering with our analytics engineering team to translate business questions into scalable data products.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead Complex Finance Data Projects: Drive the end-to-end strategy, roadmap, and delivery of data initiatives focused on product unit economics, BOM costing, inventory tracking, manufacturing variances, and operational performance.

• Bridge Finance & Engineering: Serve as the primary translator between division finance stakeholders, manufacturing/supply chain leaders, and analytics engineers. Convert ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable functional specifications and data requirements.

• Define Financial & Operational Logic: Establish standardized methodologies for complex finance calculations—such as standard costing, overhead absorption, landed costs, scrap rates, work-in-progress (WIP) tracking, and multi-tier BOM cost rollups.

• Partner with Analytics Engineering: Collaborate directly with analytics engineers who design and execute data models (e.g., in Databricks, Palantir Foundry, Snowflake) to ensure data assets reflect functional reality and business context.

• Ensure Financial Integrity & Validation: Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) and establish reconciliation frameworks to validate that engineered data products reconcile back to the general ledger, ERP systems, and standard accounting controls.

• Drive Stakeholder Alignment & Adoption: Build alignment across hardware engineering, manufacturing, program management, and FP&A. Enable stakeholders to leverage new analytical tools and self-serve reporting to drive product margin improvements.

• Master Data Governance: Partner with business systems and master data teams to govern key finance dimensions (item masters, cost centers, routing structures, and chart of accounts mapping) to prevent downstream reporting drift.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of progressive experience in Cost Accounting, Operations/Manufacturing Finance, Strategic FP&A, or as a Finance Business Analyst/Product Owner in a hardware, aerospace, automotive, or high-complexity manufacturing environment.

• Strong functional understanding of inventory accounting, multi-level BOM structures, cost variance analysis (PPV, usage, efficiency), standard costing methodologies, and gross margin analytics.

• Proven track record of driving cross-functional data or systems projects from ideation to operational adoption, acting as the product owner or functional lead.

• Demonstrated experience partnering with technical teams (analytics engineers, BI developers, or data engineers) and translating finance terminology into logical data models.

• Familiarity with enterprise ERP systems (e.g., Oracle Fusion Cloud, SAP, NetSuite) and how manufacturing/procurement transactions flow into the general ledger.

• Solid data literacy—ability to navigate complex datasets, interpret relational database concepts, review business logic, and perform intermediate data analysis (e.g., advanced Excel; functional knowledge of SQL or modern BI tools like Tableau/PowerBI is a strong plus).

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; capable of challenging assumptions, aligning conflicting requirements, and presenting complex financial concepts simply.

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced, hyper-growth environment with high ambiguity and evolving operational workflows.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior experience in defense tech, aerospace, or advanced hardware manufacturing.

• Experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Palantir Foundry, Databricks) from a functional/business architect standpoint.

• CPA, CMA, or background in standard cost accounting implementation in an ERP environment.

• Experience with Product Lifecyle systems (Teamcenter) and Warehouse Management tools.

US Salary Range

$183,000—$243,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Staff Process Engineer, NPI Projects
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

Form Energy is hiring an NPI Project Engineer to own the introduction and implementation of mechanical product and process changes into our manufacturing facility. This role sits within Operations Engineering and works in close partnership with our Technical Program Manager to ensure that every change — from next-generation pack-level design updates to equipment and process iterations — lands in production in a controlled, quality-safe, and schedule-conscious way. You will help build the systems, workflows, and standards that define how Form Energy scales new products into manufacturing. This is an exceptional opportunity to shape a critical function at a company developing breakthrough technology for long-duration energy storage. Relocation assistance is available.  




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own the end-to-end introduction of mechanical product and process changes into the manufacturing line, with initial focus on battery pack systems

 - Map all incoming engineering changes against production line state, identifying risks to quality, throughput, and schedule before cutover

 - Lead production trials for new or modified designs — defining trial plans, success criteria, timing, and documenting outcomes

 - Drive structured cutover planning, coordinating timing across engineering, supply chain, warehouse, and production to ensure clean transitions with no unplanned disruption

 - Translate engineering changes into manufacturing execution language — work orders, Oracle transactions, line flow impacts, and BOM/routing updates

 - Partner closely with the TPM to maintain change visibility, milestone tracking, and cross-functional alignment across all active NPI efforts

 - Serve as the operations voice in design reviews and change control processes, pushing back on changes that lack manufacturing readiness

 - Help develop NPI systems and standards — change intake, readiness criteria, trial governance, and cutover checklists — as this function matures




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 10+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, NPI, or engineering change management in a high-complexity production environment (automotive, aerospace, energy, or similar)

 - Demonstrated experience managing product or process changes into a live manufacturing line, including trial execution, change control, and cutover coordination

 - Hands-on familiarity with ERP systems (Oracle preferred) including work order flow, BOM management, and routing

 - Strong mechanical systems intuition — ability to read engineering drawings, understand pack/module assembly processes, and assess change impact on production

 - Proven ability to work independently in ambiguous environments and build structure where little exists

 - Excellent cross-functional communication — comfortable engaging engineering, supply chain, warehouse, and production teams simultaneously
   


WHERE YOU'LL WORK:


This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. Relocation assistance is available.



#LI-Onsite

 #LI-LN1



Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 



When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT HANOVER PARK DOES

Hanover Park https://hanoverpark.com/ builds AI systems that run financial operations for investment firms. We combine software and fund administration to help fund CFOs adopt AI in the workflows they’re responsible for every day.

We’ve raised $31 million from Emergence Capital, Lux Capital, Susa Ventures, and fund CFOs from Bain Capital, Clearlake, CD&R, and Hellman & Friedman.

Fund administration is our starting point. Our ambition is to build the financial infrastructure that supports how the world’s capital is operated, governed, and allocated. Over time, we believe these systems will help investment firms make decisions about their largest acquisitions and how they deploy capital.

Stripe for payments. Ramp for expenses. Hanover Park for investments.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Financial software has historically been complex, ugly, and painful to use. We think the next generation should be radically different. We’re focused on software that makes sophisticated financial workflows feel simple, and AI agents that increasingly perform the work themselves.

Building that experience requires engineers who can own the product, not just the implementation. Engineers with exceptional taste, strong technical instincts, and the ability to turn ambiguous customer problems into beautiful, production-ready software.

You'll work directly with our founders and customers to define what great financial software looks like. There are no PMs writing specs or designers handing you mockups. You'll identify problems, make product decisions, design solutions, and ship them yourself.

The best product engineers see the gap between what exists and what should exist, and have the judgment and technical ability to close it.




WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH

 - Own Product End to End: Take features from customer conversations through design, engineering, and production. Make product decisions independently and iterate directly with users.

 - Build Beautiful, High-Performance Software: Turn complex financial workflows into intuitive, fast, and polished experiences. Sweat the details, from interaction design to latency and edge cases.

 - Define the Future of Agent UX: Build new interaction patterns for humans working alongside autonomous AI agents. Solve hard problems around oversight, feedback, trust, and control in high-stakes workflows.

 - Ship Across the Stack: Work on everything from investor portals and portfolio management to core financial infrastructure and AI-powered workflows. Own the technical challenges required to deliver great experiences.

 - Set the Product Quality Bar: Shape our design system, component library, and engineering standards. Build the patterns that other engineers will follow.

 - Move Fast and Talk to Customers: Prototype in code, test with real users, and ship continuously. You'll work directly with some of the world's most sophisticated investors and financial operators.




EXCEPTIONAL CANDIDATES HAVE DEMONSTRATED

 - Full-Stack Engineering Depth: Strong TypeScript, React, and backend engineering skills, with the ability to own complex features from database to UI.

 - Exceptional Product Taste: A portfolio of shipped products that stand out for their usability, interaction design, and attention to detail. You know what great software feels like.

 - Independent Product Judgment: The ability to turn ambiguous customer needs into thoughtful product decisions without waiting for a spec, mockup, or approval.

 - UX and Design Obsession: You care deeply about the small details that distinguish functional software from exceptional software. You can design and implement those details yourself.

 - Experience Building with AI: You've shipped production LLM-powered features and understand the challenges of integrating agents into real user workflows.

 - Technical Ambition: You're comfortable tackling difficult engineering problems rather than compromising the product experience or handing the problem to someone else.

 - High Ownership and Velocity: A track record of independently shipping meaningful products quickly, learning from users, and continuously improving your work.

 - Relevant Experience: Experience building complex B2B software, AI products, developer tools, or financial infrastructure is a plus.

Our stack includes TypeScript, Next.js, React, Supabase/Postgres, AWS, and Trigger.dev http://Trigger.dev.




WHY HANOVER PARK

Private markets represent over $100 trillion in assets, yet the software powering them remains decades behind.

We're replacing that infrastructure with an AI-native system that can eventually run much of the work autonomously. The opportunity isn't just to build better accounting software. It's to fundamentally change how investment firms operate.

You'll join a small, engineering-first team where you can own entire products, work directly with customers, and ship software used by some of the most sophisticated financial institutions in the world.

We have no PM layer, no dedicated design team, and no shortage of hard problems.

If you want to build ambitious products with exceptional people, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Platform
jobs.description:
ABOUT E2B

E2B is a fast-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 9-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish.




ABOUT THE ROLE

E2B has started billions of Firecracker sandboxes across regions on Google Cloud, AWS and Azure, for customers whose products stop when our sandboxes do. Reliability here is an engineering problem: the fixes for our hardest incidents land in code, not in configuration.

Your job will be to build the reliability of the platform: defining what healthy means, building the observability and automation that keep it there, and making new capabilities work reliably in production. You'll work closely with our infrastructure and systems engineers, who build the platform, and with our sandbox team in Prague.

Responsibilities include:

 - Defining SLOs and error budgets for the platform's core paths, such as sandbox start, resume and connect, and making them part of how we alert, release and prioritize

 - Building the observability and alerting that tells us the platform is healthy before customers do

 - Taking new platform capabilities from first release to working reliably in production

 - Building the automation that removes operational work, from release checks to routine fleet operations

 - Building the security and trust layers the platform's reliability depends on, such as service-to-service mutual TLS

 - Making our private cloud and enterprise deployments as reliable as our own regions

 - Running incident response, and improving how we handle incidents so a class of failure does not come back

 - Being on call, and helping shape the rotation for the rest of the platform team

This role requires a high amount of ownership. You'll write the code and the design docs for the hardest changes in your area, and ship every day.

If words like SLOs, error budgets, eBPF, Kubernetes, multi-region, or noisy neighbor problem sound exciting rather than scary, we want to hear from you!


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience operating large-scale distributed systems in production across regions, and making their reliability measurable

 - Strong Go (Rust or C/C++ also welcome): you take ownership of the services you build and proactively fix issues across the codebase, including in services you didn't originally write

 - Reliability engineering: you've defined SLOs and error budgets for a production service and held the platform to them

 - Incident response: you've been on call, fixed what paged you, and written post-incident reviews that led to lasting fixes

 - Experience operating Kubernetes in production

 - Infrastructure as code and GitOps, for example Terraform and Argo CD, with deep experience on at least one of GCP, AWS or Azure; we run on all three, and you don't need to know them all

 - Solid Linux and networking fundamentals: enough to debug a host under load and reason about DNS, TCP and L4/L7 load balancing

 - Operating relational databases and caches in production, including performance diagnosis

 - Excited to work in person from San Francisco

 - Comfortable with our code and infrastructure being public

We expect this experience will often come from around five or more years of relevant work, but the depth of what you've built matters more than a specific number.


BONUS POINTS FOR:

 - Running observability pipelines at scale, for example Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry

 - Kernel tracing and eBPF tooling

 - Capacity planning and cost efficiency across clouds

 - Chaos engineering or deterministic simulation testing

 - Familiarity with Firecracker, KVM or how VM workloads behave on shared hosts
   
   - Contributions to CNCF or similar open source projects




WHAT IT’S LIKE TO WORK AT E2B

We’re a fast-growing startup with in-person (4 days on-site, 1 day WFH) offices in San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic. We already generate 9-figure revenue and work directly with top-tier AI companies like Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, Artificial Analysis and other exciting teams pushing the frontier of AI.

We offer healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, 401k, and a variety of perks for in-office employees.

jobs.description:

Zoro.com is a leading eCommerce platform offering nearly 15 million tools, parts and supplies for our business customers. Launched in 2011, we brought a B2C-like experience to the B2B industry, and continue to be at the forefront of digital innovation at the intersection of technology and distribution. Job Summary:

The Associate Private Brand Manager, Commercial Success takes new Private Brand items from NPI through launch and drives their commercial performance over the full lifecycle. Reporting to the PB Manager, Commercial Success, the role coordinates cross-functional work across Legal & Compliance, Customer Fulfillment, Merchandising, Marketing and Category Management to get products to market on time and ready to sell. The ideal candidate is highly organized and detail-oriented, and can manage many launches at once from compliance reviews and packaging approvals through content, pricing and first orders. This role is key to scaling Private Brand through a steady flow of successful launches and sustained revenue growth.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Commercialize new Private Brand items from NPI to launch, coordinating legal and compliance reviews, and packaging and label approvals

• Coordinate product enrichment, product relationship data, photography submission and initial pricing setup so items launch with complete, optimized content

• Facilitate purchase orders and test orders with Customer Fulfillment so inventory is in place for launch

• Coordinate marketing and merchandising for new product launches, including planning the full-year Private Brand marketing calendar

• Track commercial performance of Private Brand items after launch, finding opportunities and driving marketing and content optimization to grow revenue

• Manage launch timelines and status across cross-functional partners, flagging risks and bottlenecks early to keep launches on schedule

• Support the end-to-end label process and help document and improve repeatable launch processes as Private Brand scales

• Maternity support programs, nursing benefits, and up to 14 weeks paid leave for birth parents and up to 4 weeks paid leave for non-birth parents. We also support growing your family through access to adoption assistance program

• 6 free sessions each year with a licensed therapist and Wellhub portal membership to support your mental and emotional wellbeing

• At least 18 paid time off days annually for full-time employees and 6 company holidays per year

• 6% company contribution to a 401K Retirement Savings Plan each pay period, no employee contribution required

• Tuition reimbursement, student loan refinancing and access to financial counseling, education, and tools

• Employee discounts and admission to various civic and cultural institutions around Chicago

For additional information and details regarding our benefits and our parent company, W. W. Grainger, please click on the link here.

The pay range provided is not a guarantee of compensation. The range listed reflects the expected base pay for this position at the time of posting, based on the role's job grade. Actual compensation may vary depending on factors such as location, relevant experience and individual qualifications.

Our Culture

Zoro was founded in 2011 with a simple idea: make it easy for businesses to get the tools, parts, and supplies they need to keep things running. We've grown by staying curious, moving quickly, and solving everyday challenges in smart, practical ways. Backed by W.W. Grainger and inspired by our endless assortment business model, we’re on a clear path toward our next big milestone: $2 billion in revenue—and beyond.

At Zoro, we don’t just follow a playbook—we help build it. You’ll get to work on real problems with a supportive team that shares ideas freely, learns from each other, and celebrates wins together. Our culture is grounded in values that guide how we show up every day: Winning & Learning Together, Being Customer Obsessed, Being Transparent, and Taking Ownership. We don’t have all the answers, but we’re always asking good questions.

Zoro’s culture has been recognized by Fortune, Best Places to Work, and Built In Chicago—but the recognition we care about most comes from our team members, who make this place what it is.

We also know that flexibility matters. Our hybrid work model gives you space to focus and the flexibility to live your life — asking team members to be onsite at least two days a week. Our Chicago HQ (right above Ogilvie Transportation Center in the Accenture Tower) is always open and ready for connection, collaboration, or just a good cup of coffee.

At Zoro, we’re growing fast toward big aspirations — and we’re continuously excited about the new challenges we get to solve together.

Centria Autism is hiring Behavior Technicians to work one-on-one with children with autism using Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA therapy). No experience is required. We pay you during your 40-hour training and cover the full cost of your Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification.

If you've worked in childcare, babysitting, teaching, tutoring, caregiving, or customer service, or you're a student in psychology or education, your skills transfer directly. We'll teach you the rest.

Apply today and start a career where you'll see the difference you make every week.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US.  At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

Performance Manager

The Performance Manager plays a pivotal role in enhancing employee performance and driving organizational success through comprehensive training, coaching, and performance management initiatives. This position is responsible for developing and executing effective learning programs, coaching individuals and teams, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Communication

• Actively participate in organizational change initiatives, collaborating with various departments to ensure training initiatives support broader strategic objectives.

• Collaborate with other trainers or subject matter experts to enhance training content.

• Communicate effectively with stakeholders, providing updates on training outcomes and addressing any concerns.

Customer/End User Service

• Ensure learning solutions are engaging, effective, and tailored to meet the needs of various employee groups.

• Establish a continuous feedback loop with program participants to gather insights for refining and customizing learning programs.

Business Acumen

• Effectively use training technologies, such as Learning Management Systems (LMS) and multimedia tools.

Team Effectiveness (Training)

• Execute a comprehensive regional coaching plan each month driven by KPI results and global organizational objectives.

• Assist with delivering diverse learning programs, including leadership development, technical skills training, and onboarding.

• Support the implementation and utilization of learning management systems (LMS) and other relevant platforms.

• Deliver coaching sessions with clarity, ensuring participants understand the content.

• Enhance training content by incorporating real-world examples and case studies.

• Apply a blended learning approach, seamlessly combining in-person and online training modalities for optimal learning outcomes.

People Development (Global)

• Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth across the organization.

• Lead workshops to enhance individual and team performance through effective performance coaching processes.

• Identify, groom, and accelerate the development of high-potential individuals within the organization.

Problem-Solving

• Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure the impact and effectiveness of learning and performance initiatives.

• Cultivate strong relationships with external vendors, consultants, and subject matter experts.

Role Execution (KPIs)

• Contribute to lower employee turnover.

• Improve tenure in each individual role.

• Increase internal promotions.

• Improve overall employee engagement.

• Maintain a high number of properties achieving Property KPIs.

Education & Experience

• Proven experience in employee training, coaching, and performance management, preferably in a field-based environment.

• Strong understanding of learning and development principles and best practices.

• Excellent presentation, facilitation, and communication skills.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Familiar with Asset Living’s primary property management software systems (Entrata, RealPage, and Yardi).

• Certification in training and development (e.g., CPLP, CPTM) is a plus.

Travel Requirements

• This position entails travel, estimated at 60% of work time annually. Travel may be required for property visits, conferences, training sessions, or other business-related activities.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

Blackbird Health is looking to hire a Technical Program Manager (TPM), Clinical Data & Operations to join our growing Data & Technology team. This role will own the end-to-end delivery of our clinical data initiatives—serving as the strategic engine for clinical operations. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Data and Technology, you will translate complex operational bottlenecks (provider capacity, patient throughput, scheduling workflows) into scalable data products. Leveraging our modern cloud data stack (Snowflake, AWS, GCP, and dbt), you will define KPIs, eliminate manual reporting, and operationalize data so our clinics run as efficiently as possible. This is not a traditional TPM role. You won’t just coordinate roadmaps or track deliverables; you will build analytics solutions from prototype to production partnering with respective experts in the organization.

What makes you, you:

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate, Molecular and Cellular Biology (CONTRACT)

jobs.description:
Septerna is a biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, CA on a mission to develop life-changing medicines for patients with the vision to become the industry-leading G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR)-focused drug discovery company. The company’s Native Complex Platform™ recapitulates GPCRs with their native structure, function, and dynamics outside of the cellular context. This approach enables novel access to modern structural and screening technologies used in industrial-scale drug discovery for the entire class of GPCRs. Septerna has an emerging pipeline of GPCR-targeted small molecule programs, many in the Endocrinology space, with potential for growth to target many GPCRs that have been undruggable and unexploited to date.

We are excited to expand our multidisciplinary team of individuals focused on creating revolutionary medicines to address the unmet needs of patients. At Septerna we strive to embrace diversity of thought, expertise, and background through collaboration. To join our ambitious team, be prepared to bring your real self to work every day; grow and learn from a talented team of drug hunters, scientists, and business professionals; and contribute your passion, creativity, and energy to accomplish our mission. We share a fearless pursuit of ground-breaking innovations and cultivate an environment where our employees succeed by learning from each other and working as a team.

We are committed to the development of meaningful therapeutics for patients with indications of high unmet need. This is a tremendous opportunity to work with talented individuals on the frontlines of therapeutic discovery and development. You will directly help move therapies through preclinical research, positioning them for success in the clinic. The successful candidate will add their passion, unique talents, and expertise to a dynamic team motivated to discover new disease-modifying therapeutics for patients in a fast-paced environment.

For more information see: www.septerna.com.

THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Senior Research Associate or Associate Scientist Contractor who will support Septerna’s small molecule drug discovery pipeline. They will design, execute, and analyze in vitro and ex vivo studies to assess pharmacology, mechanism of action, and efficacy of Septerna’s drug candidates. They will work both independently and collaboratively to develop and run assays, generate preclinical data, and contribute biological insights to advance programs toward the clinic. They may also engage in assay development and implementation of advanced in vitro/ex vivo modeling approaches to support Septerna’s translational efforts.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to demonstrate their scientific expertise and grow within our R&D organization, contributing biological and physiological insights to projects as well as ideas for new therapeutic programs.

The position is based in South San Francisco, CA. Title and compensation commensurate with experience.

Key Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

• Design and execute in vitro/ex vivo studies to evaluate therapeutic mechanisms of action in relevant models

• Generate, analyze, document, and interpret data to establish potency and efficacy relationships

• Support assay development and optimization

• Help build and expand in vitro/ex vivo modeling capabilities

• Conduct literature reviews and interpret scientific publications to inform experimental design and troubleshooting

• Participate in project teams and present results at lab, team, and departmental meetings

• Follow all company policies and practices; maintain accurate and complete laboratory records and electronic notebooks

Required Education, Skills & Experience:

• BSc or MSc in Biology, Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, or a related field

• Minimum of 4 years (or 2 years with an MSc) of experience in academia, biotechnology, or the pharmaceutical industry focused on metabolic, inflammatory, and/or endocrine disorders

• Significant hands-on experience with tissue culture, including handling cell lines and human primary cells for MOA or receptor signaling studies

• Experience using various scientific methods and techniques, including molecular biology (e.g., RNA/DNA/protein purification, qRT-PCR), immunohistochemistry, flow cytometry, ELISA, and/or cell-based assays

• Results-oriented with a strong track record of research productivity, as evidenced by impactful contributions to drug discovery projects and/or high-quality publications

• Strong attention to detail and exceptional organizational skills, with experience using an ELN (e.g., Benchling), writing protocols, and troubleshooting biological experiments

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate with colleagues and effectively interpret and present data

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Experience with models of bone, kidney, and/or endocrine organs

• Experience with stem cell culture/differentiation and advanced cell culture techniques (e.g., organoids, sandwich cultures)

• Hands-on experience with primary cell isolation from animal and/or human tissues

• Familiarity with multi-omics data analysis and interpretation of complex datasets

• Experience in small-molecule drug discovery

• Experience in GPCR biology

The anticipated salary range for candidates who will work in South San Francisco, CA is $45.00/hr - 55.00/hr. Individual pay may vary based on additional factors, including, and without limitation, job-related skills, experience, work location and relevant education or training.

jobs.title: Second Shift High Voltage Test Technician
jobs.description:
About Helion

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.

Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.

This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.

What You Will Be Doing:

You will perform high-voltage testing of production assemblies, subsystems, and components critical to Helion's fusion generators. You will implement and troubleshoot test setups, ensuring safety, quality, and throughput targets are met. You will work closely with Design Engineers, Test Engineers, and Production Technicians to validate system performance, identify issues, and continuously improve test execution. This is an onsite role that reports directly to the Production Manager at our Everett, WA office.

You Will:

 - Set up, configure, and execute high-voltage tests on production assemblies and prototypes

 - Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical issues during testing and document findings

 - Operate test equipment, control panels, and data acquisition systems according to defined procedures

 - Follow high-voltage safety protocols and maintain compliance with defined high-voltage handling and grounding standards

 - Collaborate with Design and Test Engineers to review test results and escalate issues or anomalies

 - Support the repair, development, maintenance, and calibration of test fixtures and related equipment

 - Record and report test data accurately, participating in post-test reviews and process improvements

 - Occasionally assist with prototype or experimental testing

Required Skills:

 - 3–5 years of experience in electronics or manufacturing test environments

 - Familiarity with electrical systems and high-voltage safety practices

 - Proven ability to execute detailed test procedures safely and efficiently

 - Hands-on experience in test setup, troubleshooting, and use of electrical measurement tools

 - Ability to support a 2nd shift schedule: 2pm to 10:30pm, Monday through Friday

#LI-Onsite 

Benefits

Our total compensation package includes benefits, including but not limited to:

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision plans for employees and their families 

 - 31 Days of PTO (21 vacation days and 10 sick days) 

 - 10 Paid holidays, plus company-wide winter break 

 - Up to 5% employer 401(k) match 

 - Short term disability, long term disability, and life insurance 

 - Paid parental leave and support (up to 16 weeks) 

 - Annual wellness stipend

Helion is an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the interview process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Center-Based Registered Behavior Technician
jobs.description:
Centria Autism is hiring Behavior Technicians to work one-on-one with children with autism using Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA therapy). No experience is required. We pay you during your 40-hour training and cover the full cost of your Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification.

If you've worked in childcare, babysitting, teaching, tutoring, caregiving, or customer service, or you're a student in psychology or education, your skills transfer directly. We'll teach you the rest.

Pay: $19.00 - $24.00 per hour

Why you'll love working here

• Paid training: Earn while you complete your 40-hour RBT online course.

• Get paid fast: Early wage access to employees through Rain - Work today, get paid tomorrow!

• Career growth: Structured career path in the field of Behavioral Analysis.

• Perks: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) mental health support and retail discounts through our Benefit Hub.

What you'll do

Working under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), you will:

• Provide one-on-one ABA therapy to children with autism at home or in our centers.

• Teach communication, social, and daily living skills with positive reinforcement.

• Help children work through challenging behaviors calmly and safely.

• Record session data on a company-provided tablet.

• Keep sessions fun, engaging, and focused on each child's goals.

What you need

• 18+ years old with a high school diploma or GED.

• Valid ID and reliable transportation for in-home sessions.

• Ability to pass a background check and complete a TB test and CPR/First Aid course (we cover the cost).

• Ability to stay active with kids and move in various positions: bending, squatting, kneeling, sitting on the floor, and lifting up to 50 lbs.

• Patience, empathy, and a positive attitude.

We move fast. You'll complete online modules, a CPR class, a TB test, and a background check, and your onboarding specialist will guide you through each step.

Apply today and start a career where you'll see the difference you make every week.

jobs.title: PROJECT ACCOUNTANT
jobs.description:
At Nox Group, we are dedicated to humanizing construction as one of the fastest-growing industrial enterprises in the US. Nox Group owns and operates Corbins, RMCI, Nox Innovations, and Construction Labels, and our teams set the standard as industry leaders. As we continue to expand our reach nationwide, we seek people who are passionate about personal growth and eager to make a positive impact throughout the industries and communities we serve. We prioritize our people, our partners, and our relationships. Start your journey today and join our skilled team.

We are seeking a Project Accountant to support complex, large-scale construction projects. The Project Accountant serves as the financial partner to Project Managers, Project Executives, Operations, and Corporate Accounting, ensuring project financial data is timely, accurate, and actionable. As the front line for project accounting, this position plays a key role in maintaining accurate project records, protecting project profitability, supporting cash flow, and promptly identifying and escalating financial issues or discrepancies to Project Accounting Managers. Project Accountants are expected to be proactive and take ownership of project financial processes.

Responsibilities

PROJECT FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT:

• Set up and maintain projects in the ERP system, including contract values, billing structures, tax treatment, and phase codes, ensuring adherence to all contractual requirements and internal procedures.

• Review and process project costs and documentation for accuracy and compliance with company standards.

• Partner with Project Managers to complete the weekly financial reviews, identifying financial risks, billing constraints, and open items requiring escalation.

• Partner with Project Managers to prepare monthly Work-In-Process (WIP) forecasts, analyzing project profitability, percent complete, cost trends, and billing/payment status, and maintaining variance explanations.

• Review committed costs and purchase orders against actual costs and budget to identify duplicate, inactive, or unsupported exposure.

• Process job cost corrections and cost transfers, and maintain phase code structure to support accurate financial reporting.

• Identify and escalate sales and use tax discrepancies.

• Support and work closely with Operations regarding contracts, changes, costs, compliance documents, and other project financial matters.

• Complete month-end close responsibilities according to required deadlines and accounting procedures.

CHANGE ORDER MANAGEMENT:

• Issue and manage subcontractor documentation in accordance with contract specifications. Ensure all required documentation is collected and filed.

• Monitor, process, and issue change orders, ensuring they are correctly documented and approved. Maintain clear records of all change orders and associated financial impacts.

• Process project accounts payable, ensuring timely and accurate payments. Verify that all invoices align with contractual terms and project requirements.

• Manage subcontractor compliance, including insurance, lien waivers, retention, and W-9 forms. Ensure all subcontractor documentation is up-to-date and compliant.

• Research and resolve any issues related to subcontractor billing, working to ensure all discrepancies are addressed and resolved promptly.

ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE:

• Compile, prepare, and submit monthly project billings in accordance with contract requirements. Ensure that all billings are accurate and submitted in a timely manner.

• Track and bill stored materials where contractually allowed, maintaining required backup documentation.

• Track payment status, resolve any discrepancies or issues, and coordinate with customers to facilitate collections, ensuring that all project billings are collected efficiently and in accordance with contract terms.

• Manage and update owner and subcontractor schedules of values, ensuring accuracy and alignment with project progress and contract terms.

• Support submission and tracking of contractual compliance documentation, including certified payroll, OCIP/CCIP, and insurance requirements.

• Research and resolve billing and payment discrepancies, addressing any issues promptly to ensure smooth financial operations.

• Support project closeout, including final billings, retention, subcontract reconciliation, and final lien waivers.

Qualifications

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in project accounting

• Familiarity with construction accounting and knowledge of the project structure in a General Contractor/Subcontractor business environment a plus.

• Construction ERP experience (Spectrum preferred); proficient with Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) required.

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively and respond to changes in priorities.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills for interacting with operational teams, customers, vendors, and other stakeholders.

• Ability to maintain a high level of precision and accuracy in financial reporting and documentation.

• Team player with the desire to provide a high level of customer service and solutions.

Safety Level

This is a safety sensitive position, and all applicable policies including drug test and background check will apply.

• The inherent responsibilities of your role may include physical working conditions. In order to safely and successfully perform job duties you must be able to:

• Potentially lift up to 50 pounds

• Potentially need to do repeated pushing, pulling, carrying, reaching (or working above shoulder), walking, standing, sitting, stooping, kneeling, bending, and climbing

• Potentially operate a motor vehicle, crane, tractor, etc.

• We reserve the right to continually monitor your ability to safely and successfully complete these inherent physical responsibilities and take action as deemed appropriate in accordance with the Americans with Disability Act (ADA)

jobs.title: High Voltage Test Technician
jobs.description:
About Helion

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.

Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.

This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.

What You Will Be Doing:

You will perform high-voltage testing of production assemblies, subsystems, and components critical to Helion's fusion generators. You will implement and troubleshoot test setups, ensuring safety, quality, and throughput targets are met. You will work closely with Design Engineers, Test Engineers, and Production Technicians to validate system performance, identify issues, and continuously improve test execution. This is an onsite role that reports directly to the Production Manager at our Everett, WA office.

You Will:

 - Set up, configure, and execute high-voltage tests on production assemblies and prototypes

 - Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical issues during testing and document findings

 - Operate test equipment, control panels, and data acquisition systems according to defined procedures

 - Follow high-voltage safety protocols and maintain compliance with defined high-voltage handling and grounding standards

 - Collaborate with Design and Test Engineers to review test results and escalate issues or anomalies

 - Support the repair, development, maintenance, and calibration of test fixtures and related equipment

 - Record and report test data accurately, participating in post-test reviews and process improvements

 - Occasionally assist with prototype or experimental testing

Required Skills:

 - 3–5 years of experience in electronics or manufacturing test environments

 - Familiarity with electrical systems and high-voltage safety practices

 - Proven ability to execute detailed test procedures safely and efficiently

 - Hands-on experience in test setup, troubleshooting, and use of electrical measurement tools

 - Support a 1st shift schedule: 6am to 2:30pm Monday through Friday

#LI-Onsite 

Benefits

Our total compensation package includes benefits, including but not limited to:

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision plans for employees and their families 

 - 31 Days of PTO (21 vacation days and 10 sick days) 

 - 10 Paid holidays, plus company-wide winter break 

 - Up to 5% employer 401(k) match 

 - Short term disability, long term disability, and life insurance 

 - Paid parental leave and support (up to 16 weeks) 

 - Annual wellness stipend

Helion is an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the interview process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
At Tactile Medical, we specialize in developing at-home therapy devices to treat lymphedema, chronic venous insufficiency and respiratory illnesses.

The Business Systems Analyst supports the Team Forge application development team and its FileMaker-based business applications, serving as a key connection between business stakeholders and the development team. This role translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements and user stories, and works closely with business partners, developers, QA, and application leadership to define requirements, clarify priorities, and support solution delivery. The ideal candidate has 3+ years of business or systems analysis experience, a proven ability to write user stories and measurable acceptance criteria, and strong facilitation skills that turn complex or ambiguous requests into clearly defined work that addresses the underlying business need.

Accountabilities & Responsibilities:

• Partner with business stakeholders to understand business needs, current processes, challenges, and desired outcomes.

• Translate business requests into clearly defined functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.

• Facilitate requirements discussions between business subject-matter experts and technical team members, and coordinate with business contacts to obtain timely decisions and answers.

• Refine incoming requests so developers and QA have enough information to estimate, prioritize, build, and validate solutions.

• Identify workflow variations, edge cases, dependencies, data needs, and cross-system impacts.

• Work with developers and QA throughout delivery to clarify requirements, ensure acceptance criteria are clear and testable, and confirm solutions address the intended business outcome.

• Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and prioritization activities for Team Forge.

• Analyze existing FileMaker workflows and business processes to identify opportunities for simplification or improvement.

• Assist with application-issue investigation by gathering business context, documenting expected behavior, and distinguishing defects from enhancement requests.

• Maintain requirements, user stories, decisions, process flows, and supporting documentation through delivery, and support business readiness, validation, and communication for application changes.

• Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in business analysis, business systems analysis, application support, process analysis, or a similar role.

• Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements, including writing user stories and measurable acceptance criteria.

• Experience collaborating with application developers and QA resources.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and facilitation skills, with the ability to turn complex or ambiguous requests into clearly defined, actionable work.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow requirements from intake through delivery.

• Ability to work at a computer for extended periods in an office or hybrid environment.

Preferred:

• Experience with custom business applications or enterprise application development teams.

• FileMaker experience or experience supporting FileMaker-based applications.

• Knowledge of relational databases, data-driven applications, or system integrations.

• Experience analyzing workflows and documenting business processes.

• Experience with Azure DevOps, JIRA, or similar backlog-management tools and Agile software development methodologies.

• Experience in healthcare, medical device, or another regulated industry.

Core Competencies:

• Business Analysis

• Requirements Definition

• Problem Solving

• Communication

• Facilitation

• Customer Focus

• Planning and Prioritization

• Ownership

Our total compensation package includes medical, dental and vision benefits, retirement benefits, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off, parental leave, family medical leave, volunteer time off and additional leave programs, life insurance, disability coverage, and other life and work wellness benefits and discounts. Acquisition Sales Specialist

McLean, Virginia, USA | Work Model: Hybrid Field Role

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Federal Sales team drives Appian's growth within the government sector, transforming how agencies manage complex acquisition lifecycles. This team owns strategic relationships with decision-makers across defense and civilian agencies, delivering solutions that modernize procurement, contracting, and vendor management processes.

This role puts you at the forefront of a massive digital transformation wave, where you will pioneer AI-driven solutions that eliminate procurement bottlenecks and administrative burdens. You will own a greenfield territory with significant growth potential, building relationships from the ground up and establishing Appian as the platform of choice for next-generation acquisition management.

jobs.title: Housekeeping Runner
jobs.description:
As a Housekeeping Runner, you will help ensure guests have a comfortable and enjoyable stay by delivering requested items, transporting clean and soiled linens, and responding to guest needs promptly. You will support daily Housekeeping operations by keeping supplies, carts, and storage areas organized while providing friendly and attentive service throughout the resort. In this role, you demonstrate Westgate's core values of Passion, Integrity, and Work Ethic in every interaction.

What You'll Do as a Housekeeping Runner:

• Deliver requested items, supplies, and amenities to guest rooms and staff areas promptly and efficiently.
• Deliver clean linens to designated buildings and collect soiled linens for transport to the laundry facility.
• Respond to guest requests for additional services or room supplies using designated communication devices.
• Greet guests warmly and provide friendly, professional service throughout the resort.
• Respond to guest and owner requests or concerns promptly and professionally.
• Maintain clean, organized storage closets, carts, and equipment.
• Transport trash and linens to the appropriate collection and disposal areas.
• Inspect items and equipment for damage and report concerns to the immediate supervisor.
• Navigate the resort to provide timely service across assigned areas.
• Perform other duties as assigned to support Housekeeping operations and guest satisfaction.

What You Will Bring as a Housekeeping Runner:

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• A friendly, service-oriented attitude and the ability to interact professionally with guests and coworkers.
• The ability to work independently, follow instructions, and manage assigned tasks efficiently.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• A commitment to cleanliness, teamwork, and providing excellent guest service.

Requirements:

• Must be at least 18 years old.
• Must have a valid Florida driver's license to operate company golf carts.
• Ability to stand for approximately 90% to 100% of the shift.
• Ability to lift and move up to 50 pounds.

jobs.title: Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN)
jobs.description:
Dungarvin is seeking a compassionate and detail-oriented Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to support the health, safety, and well-being of individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. In this role, you will provide person-centered nursing services under the supervision of a Registered Nurse (RN), helping coordinate healthcare, monitor individual health needs, support medication oversight, and ensure quality nursing documentation.

You will also play an important role in training and supporting Direct Support Professionals (DSPs), ensuring they understand and demonstrate competency in delegated nursing tasks and individual health care plans. This is a great opportunity for an LPN who enjoys building relationships, working as part of a collaborative team, and making a meaningful difference in people's lives.

What You'll Do

• Monitor Individual Health: Complete nursing follow-ups, health screenings, vital signs, and ongoing health monitoring. Assist the RN with required assessments and identify changes in health that need additional attention.
• Support Aspiration Risk Management: Work with the RN and interdisciplinary team to implement and monitor individualized Aspiration Risk Management Plans (CARMPs), recognize potential concerns, and ensure appropriate follow-up.
• Coordinate Nursing Care: Implement healthcare provider orders, coordinate medical appointments, participate in care planning and team meetings, and support transitions in care.
• Assist with Medication Oversight: Review Medication Administration Records (MARs) for accuracy, monitor medication documentation, address refusals and errors, and support medication administration training and delegation processes.
• Train and Support DSPs: Provide competency-based training on Health Care Plans (HCPs), CARMPs, and delegated nursing tasks. Verify staff competency before they perform delegated tasks independently and provide ongoing coaching.
• Maintain Accurate Documentation: Complete nursing notes, health assessments, care plans, health summaries, and other required records in Therap while maintaining confidentiality and regulatory compliance.
• Promote Health and Safety: Report suspected abuse, neglect, or exploitation, complete required incident documentation, and support infection prevention and communicable disease reporting.
• Collaborate with the Care Team: Communicate with the RN, Nurse Manager, case managers, guardians, healthcare providers, therapists, and DSPs to support coordinated, person-centered care.

What Makes You A Great Fit:

• Licensure: Current, unencumbered New Mexico LPN license or a Compact LPN license recognized in New Mexico.
• Clinical Experience: One year of clinical nursing experience preferred. Experience in I/DD or behavioral health is a plus.
• Training & Competency: Ability to complete all DDSD-mandated training and competency requirements.
• Physical Requirements: Ability to lift, transfer, and provide physical assistance as needed based on the service setting.
• Communication & Documentation: Strong reading, writing, and communication skills, with the ability to accurately document care, follow support plans, and collaborate with internal and external team members.
• Driving Requirements: Valid driver's license and ability to meet agency driving requirements, if applicable.
• Background Clearance: Successful completion of the required criminal background check.

WHY WORK ON OUR TEAM:

As an LPN at Dungarvin, you'll do more than provide nursing services. You'll help individuals stay healthy, safe, and supported while building relationships with the people who are part of their care. You'll also have the opportunity to develop staff, strengthen healthcare practices, and make a direct impact on the quality of care individuals receive.

If you're someone who values teamwork, enjoys helping others, and wants a role where your clinical skills make a difference, we'd love to hear from you!

IMPORTANT INFORMATION:

We believe in supporting not only those we serve but also each other, ensuring a collaborative and supportive work environment for all.
