jobs.title: Account Development Representative
jobs.description:
Nash is the autonomic logistics platform. Self-optimizing, self-healing AI Agents unify decisioning and execution across fleets, carriers, and fulfillment networks. Set the objective, and the system runs until you hit it. We’re 1,000+ customers across 20+ countries, backed by a16z and Y Combinator, building the platform for the physical side of modern commerce and powering logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in the world.


The Role

We're looking for an Account Development Representative (ADR) to help accelerate Nash's growth by generating new business opportunities with fastest-growing brands across food and retail, industrial services, logistics, and more. You'll identify and engage prospective customers through strategic outbound prospecting and marketing-generated leads, partnering closely with Marketing to execute targeted campaigns and build a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.

You'll work directly with operations and technology leaders to uncover business challenges, spark meaningful conversations, and position Nash as a trusted partner. Success in this role comes from combining high-volume outreach with a thoughtful, data-driven approach to account targeting and engagement.

You'll be part of a high-performing team that thrives on curiosity, collaboration, and impact. This role is ideal for someone who's energized by opening doors, building relationships, and creating opportunities for a technical, high-value product that's reshaping how goods move in the real world.



What You'll Do

- Generate qualified sales opportunities through outbound prospecting across email, cold calls, LinkedIn, and other engagement channels.

- Identify and qualify prospective customers by uncovering business needs, delivery challenges, and operational goals.

- Research target accounts and execute personalized outreach campaigns to engage key decision-makers.

- Schedule high-quality discovery meetings and transition qualified opportunities to Account Executives for the sales process.

- Partner closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to support coordinated account strategies.

- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities while consistently meeting or exceeding activity and pipeline generation goals.

- Maintain accurate prospect records, activity tracking, and CRM hygiene in Salesforce.

- Continuously refine outreach messaging and prospecting strategies based on customer feedback, campaign performance, and market insights.



What You'll Bring

- 0-2 years of SaaS sales experience (ideally in logistics, ecommerce, or retail tech).

- Proven success selling to operators, logistics managers, and technology buyers.

- Strong discovery and consultative selling skills. You know how to uncover the "why."

- High velocity mindset. You thrive on activity, pipeline, and experimentation.

- Proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, and a modern sales tech stack.

- Entrepreneurial spirit. You want to be part of building something from the ground up.



 Compensation & Benefits

- Competitive base salary + variable compensation (OTE aligned with top-quartile SaaS benchmarks).

- Equity in a fast-growing venture-backed company.

- Health, dental, vision, and 401(k).

- Flexible PTO and in-office culture (Charleston, SC).



At Nash, you'll work alongside a team of builders and operators who've scaled some of the most impactful logistics and SaaS businesses globally. We move fast, challenge assumptions, and stay laser-focused on outcomes. If you want to sell a product that directly impacts how the world moves, this is the place.




More about Nash http://Nash.AI


NASH IS THE PLATFORM THAT POWERS MODERN LOGISTICS.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.




WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT US

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network—combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.




JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to support our team’s growing production demands and process improvement goals across Quartermaster’s SmartMast™ systems and related marine products. Based out of our Arlington, VA office, this role will play a critical part in onboarding and transitioning production to additional contract manufacturers (CMs), reducing assembly downtime, improving first-pass yield, and freeing up our core R&D engineers to focus on next-generation design and product improvements.

The right candidate brings strong hands-on experience scaling electromechanical hardware production with external contract manufacturers, translating engineering designs into repeatable manufacturing processes, and driving continuous improvements on the production floor.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Lead manufacturing transfer, line setup, and onboarding activities as Quartermaster expands production across new and existing contract manufacturers (CMs).

 - Develop, optimize, and maintain manufacturing work instructions, assembly procedures, test fixtures, and tooling to reduce build times and prevent assembly errors.

 - Drive continuous process improvements across production lines to reduce downtime, eliminate bottlenecks, and increase first-pass yield and throughput.

 - Partner closely with Mechanical, Electrical, and Quality Engineering teams on Design for Manufacturability and Assembly (DFMA), Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), and New Product Introduction (NPI) builds.

 - Troubleshoot production-line equipment, test station, and assembly issues in real time, implementing durable corrective actions so design engineers can stay focused on future product development.

 - Track production metrics (cycle time, yield, scrap/rework rates, line capacity) and collaborate with Supply Chain and CMs to support scaling production volumes.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS (PREFERRED):

 - Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 3–5+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering for electromechanical hardware, marine electronics, aerospace/defense, or ruggedized outdoor systems.

 - Proven experience working directly with contract manufacturers (CMs) to transfer, qualify, and scale hardware production lines.

 - Strong command of DFMA principles, assembly tooling/fixture design, process validation (PFMEA, Control Plans), and lean manufacturing methodologies.

 - Hands-on experience writing clear work instructions, managing BOMs/ECOs, and troubleshooting electro-mechanical assembly and test workflows.

 - Ability to work independently and communicate clearly across internal engineering teams, supply chain, and external manufacturing partners.

 - CAD proficiency (e.g., Onshape, SolidWorks) for designing assembly jigs, fixtures, and line layouts is a plus.
   
   


WORK ENVIRONMENT:

 - Based at Quartermaster’s Arlington, VA office with flexible working hours and occasional intensive sprints aligned to production ramps and CM transitions.

 - Occasional travel (up to ~25%) to contract manufacturers, component suppliers, or integration facilities.

 - Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, G&A
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About the Role:

Cohere seeks a strategic and detail-oriented Financial Analyst to join the budget planning, forecasting, and spend management team that covers multiple high-impact areas. This role will serve as a key finance partner to business units, providing actionable insights to drive smarter decisions and optimal financial controls. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, can juggle complex budget categories, and is comfortable challenging assumptions to ensure fiscal discipline.

You will own the preparation and management of the G&A budget and forecast across Finance, Legal, People, and Corporate Affairs, monitoring headcount, vendor, and operating expenses against plan. Working closely with department leaders, you will identify variances, provide insights into key cost drivers, and support disciplined resource allocation as the company scales. Beyond supporting the G&A function, you will also play a key role in driving organization-wide workforce planning.



As our Financial Analyst, you will manage:

 - Financial planning: Support roll-up of annual planning company-wide, corporate calendaring, and consolidated P&L

 - Budgeting & Forecasting: Build and maintain department-level budgets and company-wide forecasts, working closely with business leaders to align financial plans with operational goals.

 - Financial Modeling: Develop dynamic financial models to evaluate business scenarios, investment opportunities, and operational changes.

 - Reporting & Variance Analysis: Prepare monthly reporting packages, analyze variances between actuals, forecasts, and budgets, and communicate clear explanations to department leaders

 - Business Partnering: Serve as the finance point of contact for G&A budget owners, challenging assumptions and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and cost discipline.

 - Data & Systems Management: Leverage financial systems (e.g., NetSuite, Google Sheets/Excel, Pigment) to ensure data accuracy, streamline processes, and improve reporting efficiency.

 - Workforce Planning: Support organization-wide workforce planning by developing and maintaining the workforce model, and establishing and refining key headcount and compensation assumptions.



This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you have:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Accounting, or related quantitative field. An MBA, CFA, or CPA is a plus.

 - 5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A with an emphasis on budget management and running month end operations.

 - Expert level Excel/Google Sheets financial modeling skills; familiarity with ERP systems.

 - Strong leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills, including effective communication skills at all levels within the Company and the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Proven ability to deliver change, improve and streamline processes, drive efficiency, and influence stakeholders.

 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced, constantly involving environments. Startup/scaleup experience is a plus.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Deployments Special Projects & Capabilities
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. ABOUT THE JOB

The Deployments Team orchestrates the global fielding of Anduril’s cutting-edge hardware and software products. Operating at the critical intersection of product innovation and mission execution, we manage forward logistics, complex site installations, comprehensive maintenance & repairs, field inventory management, and reverse logistics. Working in close partnership across Product, Engineering, Growth, Business Development, Technical Operations, and Mission Operations, the team is central to ensuring unparalleled customer and mission success, directly shaping the future of Anduril’s defense solutions.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Deployments Trainer & Special Projects to join our rapidly expanding team in Santa Ana, CA. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in defining and executing the strategic vision for deploying Anduril’s people and technology across a global operational footprint within a specific division. You will design and deliver training programs that raise the operational bar across Deployment Operations, building role-specific curricula and Business Line-tailored content that accelerates team readiness at scale. This role demands a sharp eye for operational excellence — you will define and own KPIs, lead cross-functional projects spanning DOps and DSAP, and serve as a subject matter expert on the systems and processes that underpin deployment execution. You will be a critical bridge between senior leadership and frontline teams, conducting deep-dive analyses, surfacing actionable insights, and ensuring that institutional knowledge is captured and disseminated across the organization.

This is a unique opportunity for an operationally driven leader who thrives at the intersection of training, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration. You will directly shape how teams are developed, how performance is measured, and how operational best practices scale alongside Anduril's expanding product lines and global missions. Your ability to translate complex operational challenges into structured frameworks, training programs, and measurable outcomes will be essential in shaping the future of Deployment Operations at Anduril.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Capability Development & Delivery

• Design and continuously evolve Deployment Operations training programs for Deployment Operations Managers, Operations and Logistics Associates, and Logistics Program Management roles, ensuring curricula reflect current operational standards and emerging best practices.

• Build comprehensive, role-specific training guides and certification pathways for Operations & Logistics Associates, Senior Operations & Logistics Associates, Deployment Operations Managers, Logistics Deputies, and Logistics Program Managers, enabling consistent performance and professional development across the organization.

• Develop and deliver Business Line-specific Deployment Operations training curricula tailored to the unique operational requirements of each line of business, ensuring teams are equipped to execute against program-specific standards and timelines.

• Serve as an operationally embedded training resource across Business Lines, accelerating team readiness by reinforcing the operational cadence, standards, and methodologies established by active programs.

• Travel to regional sites and company locations to deliver hands-on training, share best practices, and drive consistency in operational execution across the organization.

Operational Excellence & Cross-Functional Projects

• Act as subject matter expert and strategic partner to DSAP on systems design for platforms such as Oracle OTM and TMS, ensuring system configurations align with operational workflows and scalability requirements.

• Own and drive cross-functional projects spanning DOps and DSAP teams, including KPI development, On-Time Delivery Matrix, Forward Deployed inventory reporting, Inventory Adjustments, and other initiatives that strengthen operational visibility and accountability.

• Define, document, and maintain deployment KPIs and performance metrics, training stakeholders across the organization on how to interpret data, identify trends, and act on performance insights to drive continuous improvement.

• Train team members on all relevant dashboards, KPI frameworks, and reporting tools, building organizational self-sufficiency and ensuring teams can independently leverage data to inform operational decisions.

• Lead special projects and cross-functional working groups — such as developing and documenting Salesforce and GOE best practices, IRAD inventory requests, and MX Forecasting — ensuring institutional knowledge is captured, standardized, and disseminated at scale.

• Conduct deep-dive operational analyses on behalf of Directors and Senior Leadership, identifying gaps, surfacing inefficiencies, and recommending targeted improvements when leadership bandwidth is constrained.

Peer Leadership & Influence

• Define and execute the strategic KPI roadmap for Deployment Operations across multiple Business Lines, establishing long-term operational frameworks that scale proactively with Anduril’s growth trajectory and align with company-wide strategic objectives.

• Foster a collaborative, mission-focused culture that supports professional growth, employee engagement, and accountability for delivering impact.

• Champion the development and adoption of new tools, techniques, and methodologies that streamline logistics, field operations, and installation processes, embracing digital transformation in deployment and sustainment operations.

• Evaluate deployment processes and performance metrics rigorously, driving continuous improvement initiatives that reduce costs, eliminate inefficiencies, enhance reliability, and improve data quality and forecast accuracy.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 10+ years of progressive experience in operations, logistics, supply chain management, or complex program management, with demonstrated success in international or multi-site operations and at least 3+ years in a people leadership role developing managers and high-performing teams.

• Experience designing and delivering scalable training programs in an operational environment, including developing role-specific curricula, certification standards, and competency frameworks that maintain quality as teams and product lines grow rapidly.

• Deep understanding of and experience with deploying and integrating enterprise systems and tools (e.g., ERP systems like Oracle, TMS/OTM, project management platforms, data analytics tools) to drive digital transformation in operational processes.

• Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Demonstrated experience in data management, systems implementation, and KPI development, with a track record of standing up performance measurement frameworks, defining operationally meaningful metrics, and building the reporting infrastructure to track them across distributed teams.

• Deep understanding of and experience with deploying and integrating enterprise systems and tools (e.g., ERP systems like Oracle, TMS/OTM, project management platforms, data analytics tools) to drive digital transformation in operational processes.

• Proven track record of balancing and successfully executing concurrent, complex, and high-stakes projects in a manufacturing, hardware, or defense environment, with significant experience scaling operations alongside rapid organizational growth.

• Relentless and proactive mindset with a bias toward action — able to identify, pursue, and strategically engage the right stakeholders, cutting through ambiguity and organizational silos to ensure critical mission objectives are achieved.

• Exceptional peer leadership and organizational skills, including the ability to plan, schedule, and balance personnel workloads across multiple functions to meet rigorous deadlines and critical milestones, while holding cross-functional partners accountable even without direct reporting authority.

• Superior communication, strategic influence, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to operate as an effective interface across all levels of management, customers, and government representatives — navigating complex or sensitive conversations with a focus on influencing outcomes.

• Proven ability to problem-solve and strategically remove obstacles for teams, demonstrating a willingness to roll up your sleeves to tackle challenges hands-on and drive change management for new processes, tools, and ways of working.

• Demonstrated customer-focused and mission-driven mindset with a track record of delivering high-quality, impactful results in ambiguous, fast-paced, and high-pressure environments.

• Strong preference for candidates with prior experience in defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated industries where operational precision, compliance, and mission readiness are non-negotiable.

US Salary Range

$183,000—$243,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

jobs.title: Quality Inspection Technician, PCBA
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role:

The Quality Inspection Technician manages daily operations of the Incoming Inspection Room, including inspection tools, fixtures, calibration, and ESD controls. The technician will protect hardware reliability and production quality through verifying incoming PCBs, PCBAs, machined and welded mechanical parts, and other supplier materials against drawings and approved inspection requirements. The role works with Supplier Quality and Engineering to resolve inspection issues and prevent nonconforming material from entering production. The technician also supports engineering samples, product verification, and drawing and DFM improvements through accurate measurement data.



Responsibilities:

 - Inspect incoming PCB/PCBA and mechanical parts against drawings, specifications, approved inspection plans, and applicable IPC-A-600 and IPC-A-610 criteria, using critical-characteristic checks, 100% inspection, or AQL sampling as specified.

 - Apply Northwood Space’s T1 (Production) and T2 (Engineering/R&D) part pedigree requirements; verify supplier CoCs, inspection reports, traceability records, and applicable FAI/PPAP documentation and approval status.

 - Manage the Incoming Inspection Room, including measurement tools, equipment, custom fixtures, calibration schedules, records, and calibration providers; maintain ESD controls and handling practices in accordance with ANSI/ESD S20.20.

 - Record inspection results and material traceability in the manufacturing system; identify and transfer nonconforming material to the MRB cage and coordinate disposition with the Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) and Responsible Engineer (RE).

 - Provide dimensional measurement, inspection, and product verification support for engineering samples, prototypes, and first articles; conduct Gage Repeatability and Reproducibility (Gage R&R) studies to verify measurement system capability.

 - Share inspection data and feedback with Engineering and suppliers to support drawing corrections, design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements, and supplier quality investigations.



Basic Qualifications:

 - 3+ years of hands-on incoming or quality inspection experience with PCB/PCBA and/or mechanical parts, including working knowledge of IPC-A-600 / IPC-A-610 acceptance criteria and ESD controls and handling practices.

 - Proficiency in interpreting PCB/PCBA and complex mechanical engineering drawings, including GD&T, datum references, dimensional tolerances, and critical characteristics; ability to follow risk-based inspection plans, including 100% inspection and AQL sampling.

 - Hands-on proficiency with precision measurement and inspection equipment, including handheld tools, VMMs, optical inspection systems, and custom fixtures, plus experience managing calibration schedules, status tracking, and records.

 - Experience identifying and documenting nonconforming materials, communicating quality issues to Supplier Quality (SQE) and Engineering, and using Manufacturo or similar ERP/MES systems to record inspection results, maintain material traceability, and manage NCR/MRB processes.



Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience in aerospace, high-reliability electronics, or electromechanical manufacturing; familiarity with AS9100.

 - Experience managing calibration programs, using ISO/IEC 17025-accredited calibration providers, and supporting Gage R&R or other measurement system studies.

 - Familiarity with APQP, PPAP, AS9102 FAI, and different quality and inspection requirements based on part pedigree as (Production) and (Engineering/R&D).

 - Experience with PCB/ PCBA inspection (e.g., bow/twist, holes, plating, surface finish) and mechanical machining or weld inspection.

 - IPC-A-600 or IPC-A-610 certification.

 - Experience with CMM



Additional Information:



To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.



Northwood Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Northwood Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. 



If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know at accommodations@northwoodspace.io

jobs.description:

👋 Hello! I am Tim, CEO and Co-Founder at Kayzen, and I am looking for an SVP Performance Partnerships to accelerate our growth with non-Gaming performance advertisers in the US.

We already have customers in the US and are ready to scale our presence with performance-focused advertisers. You will lead the commercial motion for this customer segment: using your existing market access to win new advertisers, turn demand into active campaigns and build sustainable revenue. You will work directly with our founders and international teams. The role is deliberately focused on GTM and commercial execution.

About Kayzen

Kayzen is an AI powered enterprise grade demand-side platform (DSP) driving the democratization of programmatic media across mobile apps and CTV. We empower top app developers, agencies, brands, and performance marketers to execute self-serve or managed user acquisition, retargeting, and brand campaigns. Guided by positivity, curiosity, collaboration and ownership, we equip global marketing teams with advanced programmatic technology to unlock scale and sustainable growth. Processing over 400 billion daily ad requests across 1.6 billion unique users, Kayzen delivers up to 1 billion daily impressions across 180 countries. Each second, our platform runs millions of machine learning decisions that produce exceptional results for our clients.

🤝 The Team

You will partner closely with Kayzen’s founders and commercial leadership, and work with customer success, marketing, product and engineering colleagues across our global team. Together, we help advertisers run measurable campaigns across mobile apps and CTV audiences.

The Role

You will own US new-business growth for Kayzen’s direct performance customer segment,  consisting primarily of mobile app developers. Success requires a proven ability to access decision-makers, diagnose growth needs, position a programmatic solution, close business and develop accounts into sustained spend.

Responsibilities

• Build and execute a clear US GTM plan with a primary focus on app developers and a secondary focus on other performance driven advertisers

• Activate an existing network of performance marketing and user-acquisition decision-makers to generate qualified opportunities quickly

• Personally lead the full sales cycle: from outbound prospecting and discovery through demos, commercial negotiation, close and launch

• Feed customer needs, market intelligence and product feedback back into commercial, marketing and product teams

• Own measurable new-business and revenue targets with a strong focus on execution and conversion

• Once your repeatable GTM motion is proven, scale it by building a GTM team for the US market targeting performance focused direct advertisers

Requirements

• Significant quota-carrying new-business sales experience in mobile / performance CTV in the US market

• An established, active network of decision-makers at mobile app developers, and other performance advertisers, with evidence of converting relationships into revenue

• A demonstrated record of personally sourcing, winning and growing substantial new advertiser business

• Deep understanding of app advertising, programmatic media buying and key advertiser outcomes and metrics

• Commercial fluency across DSPs and the wider AdTech ecosystem, with the ability to sell complex products consultatively

• Strong hands-on hunter mentality, ownership of pipeline and comfort operating in a lean, fast-moving business

• Excellent communication, negotiation, prioritization and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Ability to collaborate effectively with distributed teams and work directly with senior leadership

jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest helps Pinners discover and do what they love. Most of that discovery happens on three surfaces: Homefeed, Search and Related Pins. The Home & Search Quality team decides what hundreds of millions of people see every month on those surfaces. We build the retrieval, ranking and blending systems that make each one personal, relevant and worth coming back to.

We're looking for a Tech Lead for ranking and blending who can drive engineering work across teams and turn state-of-the-art machine learning into better experiences for Pinners. You'll work on large-scale, low-latency systems and models that directly move Pinner engagement and business metrics.

What will you do:

• Set the technical direction for ranking and blending on Homefeed, Search and Related Pins, and move the three surfaces toward shared models and shared wins.

• Build and adapt large foundation models (transformer-based user and content models) into ranking models for each surface.

• Optimize for long-term value: rank and blend for what brings Pinners back, not only for the next click, while keeping results relevant and high quality.

• Develop signals for relevance, quality and intent (for example, LLM- and VLM-based embeddings) that are reused across the stack.

• Make the final ranking stage learned and adaptive, replacing hand-tuned rules and weights.

• Partner with retrieval, foundation-model, infrastructure and product teams so improvements land across the full stack, from candidate generation to the final page.

• Mentor and tech-lead a team of 7-10 engineers.

What we are looking for:

• Languages: Python, Java

• Machine learning: PyTorch, TensorFlow

• Big data processing: Spark, Hive

• Experience building ranking or recommendation systems at scale, for feeds, search or both

• Strong modeling skills, including multi-objective optimization, sequence-based user modeling, online/offline bias and model scaling

• Hands-on experience using LLMs and VLMs to drive product impact

• Experience with large-scale, low-latency production systems and online experimentation

What skills are preferred but not required?

• Search relevance experience, especially semantic relevance modeling

• Experience with reinforcement learning, whole-page optimization or long-term (retention) objectives

• Experience with generative AI models

• Experience making ML models more efficient to train and serve

• Experience working closely with product managers and designers to ship ML-driven, user-facing products

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field—or equivalent practical experience.

• Minimum 7 years of industry experience in ML engineering / applied ML / software engineering, including meaningful time operating as a Staff-level (or equivalent) IC delivering complex production systems

Title: Senior Deal Desk Operations Manager

Location: United States, EST (Remote)

Experience: Senior Level

Job Function: Business Transformation

Employment Type: Full Time

Industry: Computer and Network Security

Job Summary:

The Senior Deal Desk Operations Specialist is an advanced individual contributor responsible for independently managing complex Deal Desk transactions across new business, expansion, and renewal activities, ensuring accurate execution throughout the quote-to-close process.

The role applies advanced functional knowledge to review commercial deal structures, interpret contractual terms, validate transaction and subscription data, and resolve complex operational issues involving quoting, booking, billing, and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR).

Working closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Salesforce administrators, the position supports the resolution of transactional exceptions and maintains operational accuracy across commercial processes and systems.

The role also serves as a knowledgeable resource for Deal Desk processes, provides guidance to colleagues, identifies recurring operational challenges, and recommends improvements to established workflows. The position contributes to the implementation of approved process and system enhancements while operating independently within established policies, procedures, and decision-making authority.

Job Responsibilities:

• Deal Desk Transaction Execution: Independently manage and coordinate complex Deal Desk transactions across new business, expansions, and renewals, including quote preparation, validation, approval coordination, booking, and post-booking activities, ensuring accurate and timely execution in accordance with established processes.

• Commercial Deal Review: Review and validate complex commercial deal structures, including multi-year agreements, co-terming, contract amendments, non-standard pricing, and subscription modifications, identifying inconsistencies and ensuring alignment with approved commercial terms and internal policies.

• Contract Interpretation and Operational Accuracy: Interpret contractual terms and translate approved commercial agreements into accurate quoting, booking, billing, ARR, renewal, and subscription records, collaborating with relevant stakeholders to resolve discrepancies.

• Salesforce and Data Integrity: Maintain and validate the accuracy and completeness of Salesforce opportunities, quotes, contracts, subscriptions, account hierarchies, ARR information, and supporting documentation, identifying and correcting data inconsistencies within established procedures.

• Salesforce and Data Integrity: Maintain and validate the accuracy and completeness of Salesforce opportunities, quotes, contracts, subscriptions, account hierarchies, ARR information, and supporting documentation, identifying and correcting data inconsistencies within established procedures.

• Cross-Functional Deal Coordination: Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to address deal exceptions, clarify operational requirements, facilitate transaction approvals, and ensure accurate execution of commercial agreements.

• Finance and Downstream Operational Coordination: Coordinate with Finance and other relevant teams to investigate and resolve recurring booking, ARR recognition and re-recognition, subscription, and downstream operational discrepancies, escalating systemic issues or decisions outside established authority as appropriate.

• Process Improvement Support: Identify recurring operational issues, process gaps, and opportunities to improve transaction accuracy and efficiency; recommend practical solutions and contribute to the implementation of approved improvements within established Deal Desk processes.

• Systems and Workflow Enhancement Support: Collaborate with Salesforce administrators and Revenue Operations to document operational requirements, participate in testing, validate system changes, and support the implementation of approved enhancements to Deal Desk workflows and related systems.

• Subject-Matter Guidance and Knowledge Sharing: Provide functional guidance to colleagues on complex deal structures, contractual scenarios, Salesforce processes, and operational requirements; maintain process documentation, share best practices, and support consistent application of established Deal Desk procedures.

jobs.title: Quality Inspector, PCBA
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role:

The Quality Inspector manages daily operations of the Incoming Inspection Room, including inspection tools, fixtures, calibration, and ESD controls. The technician will protect hardware reliability and production quality through verifying incoming PCBs, PCBAs, machined and welded mechanical parts, and other supplier materials against drawings and approved inspection requirements. The role works with Supplier Quality and Engineering to resolve inspection issues and prevent nonconforming material from entering production. The technician also supports engineering samples, product verification, and drawing and DFM improvements through accurate measurement data.



Responsibilities:

 - Inspect incoming PCB/PCBA and mechanical parts against drawings, specifications, approved inspection plans, and applicable IPC-A-600 and IPC-A-610 criteria, using critical-characteristic checks, 100% inspection, or AQL sampling as specified.

 - Apply Northwood Space’s T1 (Production) and T2 (Engineering/R&D) part pedigree requirements; verify supplier CoCs, inspection reports, traceability records, and applicable FAI/PPAP documentation and approval status.

 - Manage the Incoming Inspection Room, including measurement tools, equipment, custom fixtures, calibration schedules, records, and calibration providers; maintain ESD controls and handling practices in accordance with ANSI/ESD S20.20.

 - Record inspection results and material traceability in the manufacturing system; identify and transfer nonconforming material to the MRB cage and coordinate disposition with the Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) and Responsible Engineer (RE).

 - Provide dimensional measurement, inspection, and product verification support for engineering samples, prototypes, and first articles; conduct Gage Repeatability and Reproducibility (Gage R&R) studies to verify measurement system capability.

 - Share inspection data and feedback with Engineering and suppliers to support drawing corrections, design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements, and supplier quality investigations.



Basic Qualifications:

 - 3+ years of hands-on incoming or quality inspection experience with PCB/PCBA and/or mechanical parts, including working knowledge of IPC-A-600 / IPC-A-610 acceptance criteria and ESD controls and handling practices.

 - Proficiency in interpreting PCB/PCBA and complex mechanical engineering drawings, including GD&T, datum references, dimensional tolerances, and critical characteristics; ability to follow risk-based inspection plans, including 100% inspection and AQL sampling.

 - Hands-on proficiency with precision measurement and inspection equipment, including handheld tools, VMMs, optical inspection systems, and custom fixtures, plus experience managing calibration schedules, status tracking, and records.

 - Experience identifying and documenting nonconforming materials, communicating quality issues to Supplier Quality (SQE) and Engineering, and using Manufacturo or similar ERP/MES systems to record inspection results, maintain material traceability, and manage NCR/MRB processes.



Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience in aerospace, high-reliability electronics, or electromechanical manufacturing; familiarity with AS9100.

 - Experience managing calibration programs, using ISO/IEC 17025-accredited calibration providers, and supporting Gage R&R or other measurement system studies.

 - Familiarity with APQP, PPAP, AS9102 FAI, and different quality and inspection requirements based on part pedigree as (Production) and (Engineering/R&D).

 - Experience with PCB/ PCBA inspection (e.g., bow/twist, holes, plating, surface finish) and mechanical machining or weld inspection.

 - IPC-A-600 or IPC-A-610 certification.

 - Experience with CMM



Additional Information:



To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.



Northwood Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Northwood Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. 



If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know at accommodations@northwoodspace.io

jobs.title: Robotics Applications Engineer: Activation and Support - Aerospace & Defense
jobs.description:
Summary

GrayMatter Robotics is a well-capitalized Physical AI company headquartered in Los Angeles, building Factory SuperIntelligence (FSI) through systems that learn, adapt, and develop genuine process intelligence across every part they touch. Our robots take on the tedious, hazardous, and ergonomically demanding work that has kept manufacturing dependent on a shrinking skilled workforce, delivering superhuman performance. Robotics has a demo problem. GMR doesn't. Our systems are in active production today, adapting autonomously to real geometries, real materials, and real process variation without reprogramming. We deliver our system through a Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model that converts capital expenditure into an operating subscription, making Physical AI accessible to the manufacturers who need it most. We hire people who want to solve hard physical problems at an industrial scale.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Want to be the person who keeps delivered robotic cells humming on the production line? As the Robotics Applications Engineer, Activation & Support at GrayMatter Robotics (GMR), you will support the integration, evolution, and optimization of GMR systems at Aerospace & Defense customer sites. You make sure each cell is fully operational, fits the customer's workflow, and delivers consistent, high-quality results on surface treatment manufacturing processes. You will work with our systems, mechanical, electrical, and software engineers and with customer production teams, from the first conversation about the part through the day operators run the cell on their own. You are the customer's on-site hero whenever needed. 





WHAT YOU'LL DO

You take a cell from the customer's requirements to a stable production run, and you leave the operators ready to run it without you.

 - Understand the process first: Before activation, work with customers and internal teams to learn the manufacturing process, cell requirements, part specifications, and integration constraints, so the cell fits into production from day one.

 - Shape the cell with engineering: Partner with our systems, mechanical, electrical, and software engineers to validate or adjust cell layouts, fixtures, sanding parameters, calibration requirements, and system configurations.

 - Bring the cell to life: Configure, calibrate, and test robotic cells, including robots, cameras, sensors, safety devices, networking, and peripheral equipment.

 - Prove it on the developed customer process: Set up and test the cell on the customer's manufacturing process, including installing, troubleshooting, and maintaining control components such as proximity sensors, relays, and vacuum ejectors.

 - Validate what comes next: Run proof-of-concept evaluations and pilot studies on-site to confirm system capability for new part families and new business opportunities.

 - Feedback loop: Contribute process improvements, share what you learn, and document it, so GMR best practices improve at every touchpoint.

 - Hand over with confidence: Lead operator training sessions, write workflow documentation, and prepare customer-facing materials that let production teams run the system independently.

 - Step in when called: Support deployed cells in your area. You are their batman whenever needed.


EXPORT CONTROL REQUIREMENTS

In order to comply with the export regulations of the United States Government, it is required that the applicant must fall under one of the following categories: (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (i.e. current green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158.





WHAT YOU BRING

You bring technical depth, steady problem solving, and the ability to work comfortably on a customer's production floor.

 - A get-it-done attitude in the field: Comfort providing field support for deployed cells at customer sites. No job is too big and no job is too small, and you strive to get things done because production for the customer must go on.

 - Bachelor's degree or higher in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

 - The ability to solve technical problems effectively, efficiently, and independently.

 - Experience with system testing, validation, or verification of hardware and software systems.

 - Clear communication and strong interpersonal skills for working with internal and external stakeholders.

 - Willingness to work on-site at customer facilities for hands-on installation, testing, and field support in real manufacturing environments.

 - Work authorization in the United States, maintained throughout your employment, beginning at the time of hire.

 - Eligibility to access ITAR-controlled technical data as a U.S. person, and the commitment to handle ITAR-controlled information and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) in line with GMR's compliance requirements.

 - The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance when a customer or program requires one.

 - Must meet export control requirements in the United States and maintain ongoing work authorization beginning at the time of hire through the entirety of employment.


BONUS POINTS

 - 2 to 3 years of hands-on robotics experience, ideally with industrial robot cells.

 - Industry experience in a manufacturing environment, such as manufacturing process development or manufacturing engineering.

 - Experience programming 6DOF robots for surface finishing applications.

 - Experience in process engineering within a manufacturing environment.


WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE

You win when a customer's cell is fully operational, matched to their workflow, and delivering consistent, high-quality results, with operators who run it confidently on their own. Along the way, we look for cells configured, calibrated, and tested on the customer's manufacturing process, proof-of-concept results that give the team a clear view of new part families, and documentation and training that make each deployment easier than the last. Your manager sets specific targets with you at the start of the role. 



WHERE AND HOW YOU'LL WORK

You work in the Aerospace & Defense organization alongside engineering and customer teams, with regular time on customer sites for installation, testing, and field support.

 - Reports to: Aerospace & Defense

 - Location: Camden, Arkansas (or within a 90-minute drive at legal speeds)

 - Travel: Regular travel to customer sites

jobs.title: Fraud Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Our Fraud team's mission is to help companies detect and prevent fraud using Plaid's financial network data. We believe that transaction patterns, device signals, identity linkages, and behavioral data are dramatically underleveraged tools in fraud prevention. Our products — including Protect and Signal — operate at network scale and depend on real-world investigation and research to stay ahead of adaptive adversaries.

 

As a Fraud Intelligence Analyst, you will sit at the intersection of live fraud investigation, applied data science, and product innovation. You will lead complex investigations, translate findings into detection improvements, and collaborate tightly with Data Science, ML, and Product teams to shape the next generation of Plaid's fraud capabilities. This is not a purely operational role — your research directly drives features, model inputs, and product design.

Responsibilities:

Live Fraud Investigation & Reconstruction

 - Lead investigations into complex fraud cases across identities, accounts, devices, and transaction surfaces

 - Provide support to day-to-day fraud operations including SEVs and alert triage

 - Reconstruct attacker sequences and hypothesize actor intent and tooling

 - Distill patterns from noisy signals into clear narratives and actionable insights

 - Bridge investigation outcomes to product and model improvements

Signal & Tool Utilization at Scale

 - Operate across Plaid's fraud tooling — dashboards, alerting systems, network signals, and analytics platforms — to detect and validate anomalies

 - Stress-test existing capabilities, identify systemic gaps, and define new detection primitives

 - Proactively identify gaps in internal fraud tooling and automation, driving enhancements to improve efficiency and scale

Product & Model Partnership

 - Collaborate with Data Science, ML/AI, and Product teams to improve labeling, feature sets, evaluation frameworks, and model decay monitoring

 - Surface data quality limitations and systematically formalize missing features

 - Translate exploratory research into reusable feature pipelines, model inputs, or rule augmentations

 - Participate in product discovery, roadmap planning, and post-launch evaluation to ensure fraud-awareness by design

Deep Applied Fraud Research

 - Conduct longitudinal and structural analysis of how fraud types manifest in Plaid network data — entity linkages, temporal patterns, attack rotations, tool chains

 - Experiment with network/graph analysis, sequence mining, anomaly detection, and custom heuristics where off-the-shelf approaches fail

Ecosystem Monitoring & Knowledge Leadership

 - Continuously survey external fraud trends, adversary techniques, tooling, and emerging threat vectors

 - Proactively perform threat modeling of abuse surfaces and initiate research proposals when patterns emerge

Case Studies & Reporting

 - Produce clear, evidence-backed technical reports and case studies for product, engineering, operations, legal, and executive stakeholders

 - Document investigation workflows, attack classifications, and proof-of-concept detection logic

 - Drive post-incident learning by capturing lessons from fraud incidents and feeding them back into defenses

Qualifications:

 - 5+ years of applied fraud experience in a high-velocity environment (fintech, consumer payments, banking, SaaS, marketplace risk, or security research)

 - Investigator mindset: pattern synthesis, hypothesis testing, and skilled triage between signal and noise

jobs.title: Credit Intern
jobs.description:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.



The challenge

Wayflyer funds eCommerce businesses, and every funding decision comes down to understanding how those businesses really work and where they can go wrong. This role exists to help us get better at that. You'll learn the risks first-hand, working alongside the people who underwrite, sell and manage our customers.




What you'll actually do

 - Get to grips with the risks of running an eCommerce business, and of Wayflyer funding one

 - Help coordinate regular calls with customers, so we understand their business and funding needs

 - Support a team of Analysts who underwrite our customers

 - Work with our sales and operations teams to understand how they win and manage customer relationships

 - Learn our loan portfolio and portfolio management tools, including how to spot when it’s time to exit a risky relationship

 - Work with colleagues across the business (you won’t stay in one lane for long)



What this role could turn into 

Interns here work on live deals, not side projects:

 - Owning a live process end to end, not just supporting it

 - Working real credit deals of up to $500K, with real responsibility for the outcome

 - A route into our graduate hiring pipeline, for the people who show what they can do



Who thrives here

You’re articulate, curious and a self-starter. You sweat the details, and you go after things without waiting to be asked. You’re passionate about FinTech and eCommerce, and you want to learn how underwriting, credit risk analysis and portfolio management work from the inside. You’ll probably end up doing things that aren’t in this job description. That’s not a warning - it’s the point.



We hire for range

 - You’re going into your final year of an undergraduate degree

 - Your major is Accounting, Finance, Economics, General Business or Statistics

 - You’ve shown interest in credit beyond the classroom, through an investment club, a student-managed endowment or anything similar

 - You’re comfortable relocating to Charlotte for the summer

 

Location and working policy

📍Charlotte, North Carolina. This is a 2.5 month internship, and we would love to have you in the office 5 days a week because that’s where you’ll learn the most.



The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.



By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at privacy@wayflyer.com or review our privacy notice at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice. https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.*

jobs.title: Developer Relations Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-08328-6 cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics https://www.oxcan.org/news/prior-labs-and-oxford-cancer-analytics-partner-to-advance-liquid-biopsy-and-clinical-decision-making-in-lung-disease to preventing train failures with Hitachi https://siliconangle.com/2025/12/01/prior-labs-debuts-tabular-ai-foundation-model-scales-10-million-rows/. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ https://priorlabs.ai/about with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter https://www.linkedin.com/in/frank-hutter-9190b24b/, Noah Hollmann https://www.linkedin.com/in/noah-hollmann-668b9010b/, and Sauraj Gambhir https://www.linkedin.com/in/sauraj-g/, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP https://priorlabs.ai/blog-posts/priorlabs-sap as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.



We’re growing our Developer Relations team to meet developers where they are. You’ll own developer relations for the US, ideally from New York (we’re also open to London, Amsterdam or Berlin with regular US travel), and help build the programs that scale our community beyond what any one person can reach: our own hackathons and the TabPFN Ambassador program. This is an early, high-ownership role. You’ll shape how Prior Labs shows up for developers, not just execute a playbook.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own DevRel in your region. Be the face of TabPFN locally: find the right meetups, conferences and university groups, then show up with talks and hands-on workshops.

 - Teach TabPFN to technical audiences. Deliver content that works for ML researchers, data scientists at enterprises, and developers who've never heard of tabular foundation models.

 - Co-run the Ambassador program. Recruit, onboard and support community ambassadors across the US and Europe, and help make the program self-sustaining.

 - Co-run our hackathons. Help plan and run Prior Labs hackathons, from challenge design to judging and follow-up.

 - Create technical content. Notebooks, demos, tutorials, blog posts and short videos that grow out of what you hear from developers.

 - Close the feedback loop. Bring what you learn in the field back to our product and research teams.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN 6 MONTHS

 - You've built a regular cadence of TabPFN talks, workshops and meetups across your region.

 - The Ambassador program is running and sustainable, co-managed across the US and Europe.

 - You've co-run at least one Prior Labs hackathon.

 - You have a repeatable library of TabPFN talks and workshops that others on the team can reuse.


ABOUT YOU

Must-haves

 - Startup mindset. You're comfortable with ambiguity, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and enjoy building things from zero.

 - You can teach technical topics to anyone. You pick up new technical topics quickly and can present them clearly to researchers, practitioners and beginners alike.

 - Open to regular travel, up to 50%. Events, workshops and conferences across your region and occasionally beyond.

 - Hands-on Python and ML/data science experience: you can build a working demo or notebook yourself.

Nice-to-haves

 - Experience running community programs such as ambassador programs (especially student ambassador programs), meetups or hackathons

 - Prior DevRel, developer advocacy, or technical community experience, ideally at an AI/ML startup

 - A public track record: talks, workshops, blog posts, videos, or open-source contributions

 - Familiarity with tabular ML (gradient boosting, scikit-learn, pandas) or foundation models

 - An existing network in the US East Coast or London data/ML community



We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.




LIFE AT PRIOR LABS

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.




OUR COMMITMENTS

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy https://priorlabs.ai/recruiting-data-privacy page

About Ethos

Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

Ethos is on a mission to make financial security simple and accessible for every family. Building on our success in life insurance, we are launching a best-in-class annuities platform designed to provide families with reliable retirement income streams. As our Senior Manager, Annuities Sales, you will be a foundational leader responsible for building and scaling this critical new business. We are looking for a strategic, hands-on leader who can build the go-to-market playbook and operational engine while rolling up their sleeves as a player-coach to drive our initial sales success.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Own the entire sales funnel and revenue targets for the annuities division, operating as a hands-on player-coach who actively sells, coaches, and drives weekly execution

• Build and scale a high-performing team of licensed sales and operations professionals, establishing rigorous coaching rhythms, clear performance metrics, and effective playbooks to consistently raise close rates

• Operate a hands‑on player‑coach who actively sells, coaches, and drives weekly execution

• Architect and manage the complete operational backbone—including licensing, suitability, rollovers, and commissions—to ensure an efficient and seamless customer experience

• Influence product and portfolio strategy using customer insight and unit economics; turn findings into requirements for education, quoting, e‑app, and servicing

• Shape go‑to‑market strategy with Marketing; tighten the loop from lead quality to scripts and funnel changes

• Establish coaching rhythms (call reviews, shadowing, certifications) that consistently raise close rates and customer trust

• Design and implement scalable operational processes for everything from application to policy administration, ensuring a seamless and efficient customer experience on our platform

Job Summary

Loenbro is currently seeking an Project Engineer to join our West Electrical Management team. The Project Engineer supports the Project Manager and other project participants by ensuring the success of each project through the technical accuracy of all electrical aspects, from preconstruction through closeout.

This role partners closely with Project Managers, Superintendents, the Preconstruction Group, customers, vendors, subcontractors, and field teams to deliver projects safely, on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with contract requirements, applicable codes, and quality standards.

• Cooperate and communicate with the Project Manager and project participants to create efficient project methods and maintain project profitability.

• Support development of electrical estimates and the Schedule of Values for billing; coordinate with other divisions on estimates and attend job walks to ensure quality estimate development.

• Assist the Project Manager in developing Site-Specific Health and Safety Plans (SSHEP) and setting up Project Kick Off Meetings.

• Ensure all activities comply with OSHA and NFPA 70E electrical safety standards and company safety protocols.

• Provide project administration, including reviewing electrical permitting, bonding, and RFIs.

• Assist with development of Electrical Subcontract Agreements and update electrical estimates and projects with change orders.

• Attend site meetings as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

Required:

• 2+ years of electrical construction experience.

• Electrical construction and installation experience.

• Understanding of electrical systems, including power distribution, lighting, and controls.

• Knowledge of electrical equipment, including switchgear, transformers, and distribution panels.

• Diverse background in electrical systems, low voltage, and instrumentation.

• OSHA and NFPA 70E compliance knowledge.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Microsoft Project.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to function well in high-paced, stressful environments.

Preferred:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a similar field.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment:

• Combination of office and active construction site environments, with the majority of time spent at project sites and in outdoor conditions as required.

• Frequent walking on uneven terrain and active construction sites.

• Potential exposure to noise, dust, chemicals, weather conditions, confined spaces, and other environmental factors.

• Ability to climb ladders, stairs, and access elevated work areas as needed.

• Ability to lift and carry job-related materials and equipment as necessary.

• Ability to travel up to 10%, as required.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities.  If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Process Engineer
jobs.description:
ShipMonk isn't just a 3PL — we're the tech-powered growth partner for ecommerce brands, running 12+ owned fulfillment centers across the US, Canada, the UK, and Europe so our merchants can stress less and grow more.

The Senior Process Engineer owns process efficiency across the critical fulfillment paths in our Kentucky (KY2) building. You will find where labor and time are being lost, then drive the system and process changes that lower cost per unit while holding or improving service.

Your scope covers every process path in the building, from inbound through returns. Your sharpest focus is direct-to-consumer outbound: replenishment, pick, and pack. You will also lead the work to establish engineered labor standards for the site.

This is a floor-first role. The analysis only counts once it changes how work is done on the floor, so you will spend as much time with operators and supervisors as you do in the data.

What you'll do

Process analysis and improvement

• Analyze efficiency across every process path in the building and rank opportunities by cost and service impact.

• Lead improvement work in D2C outbound, with primary focus on replenishment, pick, and pack.

• Build the business case for each change, including labor savings, service effect, and capital or system requirements.

• Run pilots and time studies on the floor, then measure results against a baseline before scaling.

Pick path, slotting, and layout

Engineered labor standards
