• Keep standards current as processes, order profiles, and systems change.

• Partner with operations leaders so standards feed labor planning, productivity reporting, and coaching.

System and data

• Define requirements for WMS and system changes with product and engineering teams, then validate them on the floor.

• Build the analysis yourself: pull and model operational data to find root causes and size opportunities.

• Turn findings into clear standard work, training, and visual tools that supervisors and associates can run with.

Leadership and partnership

• Work daily with site operations, inventory, and workforce planning leaders to land and sustain changes.

• Leverage learnings and impact in KY2 to roll out to full network.

What you bring

• 7+ years of process or industrial engineering experience in fulfillment, distribution, or e-commerce operations.

• A track record of lowering cost in D2C outbound, specifically replenishment, pick, and pack, without giving up service.

• Hands-on experience with pick path redesign and slotting, from analysis through go-live.

• Experience building and maintaining engineered labor standards, including time study and work measurement.

• Strong data and AI skills: you write your own SQL, build your own models, use AI tools to speed up analysis and problem solving, and are comfortable with large operational datasets and BI tools.

• Scrappy and self-directed: you work independently, get results with the tools at hand, and drive ideas forward with our Product Development and Operations teams in a startup environment.

• Proven ability to translate data into floor execution, with changes that supervisors and associates adopted and sustained.

• Working knowledge of WMS logic for waving, batching, replenishment, and task assignment, and experience writing requirements for system changes.

• Clear communication with audiences from hourly associates to senior leadership.

• Bachelor's degree in industrial engineering, supply chain, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Ability to work on-site in a warehouse environment, including time on the floor across shifts as projects require.

Preferred

• Apparel fulfillment experience is a major plus: high SKU counts with size and color variants, seasonal turnover, each-pick profiles, and heavy returns volume.

• Experience in a 3PL or multi-client environment, where process design has to work across different merchant profiles.

• Experience with labor management systems, slotting software, or simulation tools.

• Exposure to goods-to-person, sortation, or other fulfillment automation.

About ShipMonk

ShipMonk isn't just a 3PL; we're a growth partner for merchants. We provide cutting-edge technology and a network of owned and operated fulfillment centers that empower high-growth ecommerce and DTC brands to stress less and grow more. With over 2,500 employees across five countries, we're on a mission to revolutionize fulfillment by providing everything from the fastest click-to-delivery and real-time inventory to custom solutions—all with a merchant-first mindset.

Our all- inclusive pricing means predictable costs, with no hidden fees or surprises. ● Committed to the Future: We invest over $10 million annually in research and development to ensure our technology and services continually evolve, helping merchants plant roots with a partner who is here to stay.

jobs.title: Enterprise Systems Manager
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role:

The Enterprise Systems Manager will be responsible for building the administration, optimization, and integration of Northwood's core enterprise applications, including ERP, manufacturing execution (MES), product lifecycle management (PLM), procurement, and financial systems. This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on role at the intersection of business operations and technology. You will partner closely with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, Finance, Quality, and IT to ensure our systems are reliable, integrated, scalable, and aligned with business needs.



The ideal candidate combines strong technical systems expertise with a solid understanding of operational processes. You should be comfortable with troubleshooting integrations, configuring applications, identifying process inefficiencies, and independently leading system enhancement projects from concept through implementation. This is an opportunity to play a key role in developing the systems infrastructure that will support Northwood's continued growth.



Responsibilities:

 - Serve as a primary administrator and subject matter expert for Northwood’s enterprise applications, including ERP, MES, PLM, procurement, and financial systems, managing configurations, workflows, upgrades, and ongoing maintenance.

 - Design, implement, and maintain integrations, APIs, and automated workflows with internal teams and software vendors; monitor and resolve system issues, integration failures, and data synchronization errors.

 - Partner with Security Engineering and GRC to implement role-based access controls and permissions approval processes, while maintaining system documentation, standard operating procedures, and data governance practices.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to identify process inefficiencies and lead system enhancements and automation projects from requirements gathering through implementation, testing, training, and deployment.

 - Establish and execute an enterprise systems roadmap that supports Northwood’s growth, prioritizing improvements and partnering with IT and Infrastructure teams to define, procure, and implement on-premises and cloud resources.

 - Develop reporting capabilities and partner with IT Operations Engineering and business teams to implement intuitive dashboards that improve visibility into system metrics, data accuracy, and operational performance.



Basic Qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 - 5+ years of experience in enterprise systems administration, ERP implementation, or business systems management.

 - Hands-on experience administering, configuring, and optimizing ERP or other enterprise applications, as well as supporting system integrations, troubleshooting technical issues, and working with APIs and automation tools.

 - Strong understanding of procurement, inventory, manufacturing, and financial business processes.

 - Experience translating business requirements into system enhancements and independently leading implementation projects.

 - Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret national security clearance or higher.



Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience administering ERP platforms, including workflows, reporting, custom fields, user permissions, and system integrations.

 - Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES), product lifecycle management (PLM), or procurement platforms.

 - Familiarity with APIs, integration middleware, scripting, and data management tools.

 - Understanding of manufacturing operations, inventory control, production planning, and engineering change processes.

 - Familiarity with traceability, quality management, and operational controls in regulated manufacturing environments.

 - Experience supporting multi-entity or international business operations.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

jobs.title: Founding Recruiter
jobs.description:
WHAT HANOVER PARK DOES

Hanover Park https://hanoverpark.com/ builds AI systems that run financial operations for investment firms. We combine software and fund administration to help fund CFOs adopt AI in the workflows they’re responsible for every day.

We’ve raised $31 million from Emergence Capital, Lux Capital, Susa Ventures, and fund CFOs from Bain Capital, Clearlake, CD&R, and Hellman & Friedman.

Fund administration is our starting point. Our ambition is to build the financial infrastructure that supports how the world’s capital is operated, governed, and allocated. Over time, we believe these systems will help investment firms make decisions about their largest acquisitions and how they deploy capital.

Stripe for payments. Ramp for expenses. Hanover Park for investments.

 
 

The role

Engineering is covered. Now the business side has to catch up.

Sales, operations and scaling fund accounting/fund services - every non-technical hire that makes Hanover Park run is sitting in this seat. Hiring has been distributed across the leadership team and it's worked, but it doesn't scale. Referrals are pouring in and real business talent is sitting on the table because no one owns the function end-to-end.

As our Founding Recruiter for Business & Operations, you're the first person at Hanover Park whose full-time job is to scale every non-technical team. You own every search outside of engineering, you build the playbook every future recruiter will run on, and you turn Hanover Park into a real recruiting machine.

 
 

What you'll work on

 - Full-cycle hiring across all non-technical functions including fund accounting/fund services which is 40% of our current team

 - Sourcing sharp ICs at the Associate-to-Senior level who've operated inside high-growth fintech, financial services, or B2B SaaS

 - The playbook — interview loops, scorecards, sourcing channels, outreach, offer benchmarks — built from scratch

 - Pipeline health across every open search: pass-through rates, time-to-offer, offer acceptance

 
 

What we're looking for

Need:

 - 5+ years recruiting business, operations, or go-to-market talent — ideally into fintech, financial services, or B2B SaaS

 - Genuine breadth — comfortable opening a finance search in the morning and a sales search in the afternoon

 - High ownership — if a candidate goes cold Friday, you're texting them Sunday

 - Instinct for quality — you know within one conversation whether someone has actually done the work or just sat near it

Nice to have:

 - Experience building recruiting infrastructure from scratch at a seed-to-Series B company

 - Familiarity with Ashby or a comparable ATS

 
 

This isn't the right fit if

 - You need a sourcing team to build your top of funnel

 - You want a 12-month ramp period

 - You hand candidates off to a coordinator after the first call

 
 

Why now

Private markets are a $100 trillion asset class running on outdated software. We're fixing that — and the team we hire in the next 12 months is the determining factor. The inbound pipeline is full, the brand wins candidates, and the next recruiter inherits the playbook you build.

If that sounds like your kind of problem, let's talk.

 
 

Equal opportunity

Hanover Park is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

We're committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of protected status.

For accommodations during the application or interview process, reach out to hr@hanoverpark.com.

Hanover Park is headquartered in NOMAD, New York City. This role is on-site five days per week.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network—combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.




JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Quality Engineer to strengthen our quality systems and support rising production volumes across Quartermaster’s SmartMast™ systems and related marine products. This role will help us reduce defects and field returns, lead structured root-cause investigations, and keep our hardware manufacturing and deployment operations audit-ready as we scale globally. The right candidate has strong hands-on experience building practical quality management processes for electromechanical hardware in demanding environments, and can partner effectively across engineering, supply chain, and contract manufacturers to catch issues early and drive continuous improvement.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Develop, maintain, and scale our Quality Management System (QMS), standard operating procedures, and inspection protocols to ensure continuous audit readiness (e.g., ISO 9001 / AS9100 standards).

 - Lead structured root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) investigations (8D, 5-Whys, Fishbone) for manufacturing non-conformances, test failures, and field/customer returns.

 - Partner with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers during New Product Introduction (NPI) to establish Design for Quality (DFQ), PFMEA, control plans, and incoming/in-process/final acceptance test criteria.

 - Track, analyze, and report key quality metrics (yield, defect rates, RMA/field return trends, supplier performance) to drive measurable reductions in defects and hardware rework.

 - Collaborate with contract manufacturers and component suppliers on First Article Inspections (FAI), supplier audits, non-conforming material review (MRB), and corrective action follow-through.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS (PREFERRED):

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Quality Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 3–5+ years of experience in quality engineering for electromechanical hardware, marine electronics, aerospace/defense, or ruggedized outdoor systems.

 - Strong command of root-cause analysis and quality tools (CAPA, 8D, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and First Article Inspection).

 - Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and suppliers to qualify parts, resolve production defects, and enforce quality standards.

 - Familiarity with ISO 9001 or AS9100 quality frameworks and maintaining audit-ready documentation.

 - Ability to work independently and communicate clearly across remote engineering teams, field operations, and manufacturing partners.

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Six Sigma certification is a plus.
   
   


WORK ENVIRONMENT:

 - Flexible working hours, with occasional intensive sprints aligned to production milestones and audits.

 - Occasional travel to contract manufacturers, suppliers, or field deployment sites.

 - Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

jobs.title: Cell Teardown Technician
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

Form Energy is seeking a Cell Teardown Technician to support critical lab activities that enhance the robustness and reliability of our iron-air battery products. As part of the Core Technology Hardware Team, you will contribute to failure analysis efforts through battery cell teardowns, failure data collection, and post-teardown sample preparation and processing. This role requires hands-on work in the lab and close collaboration with a cross-functional team to ensure high-quality failure data documentation. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Perform hands-on lab work to disassemble cycled battery cells and support failure analysis using various handheld power tools.

 - Document teardown observations of electrode components and record failure modes to inform battery design and build improvements.

 - Prepare post-teardown electrode samples using machine tools and perform sample processing in a wet lab environment for material characterization essential to failure analysis.

 - Maintain lab tools and equipment, and ensure an organized, efficient workspace.

 - Champion lab safety by following and promoting best practices.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 2+ years experience as a lab technician or in a hands-on technician role with chemicals, mechanics or battery products.

 - Strong teamwork skills and collaborative mindset.

 - Demonstrate attention to detail in documentation and execution of tasks.

 - Experience in using and maintaining handheld power tools and lab instruments.

 - Ability to lift up to 30 lbs.

 - Comfortable working with chemicals and wearing personal protective equipment (PPE).

 - A positive, solution-oriented mindset with a drive to get things done!



 #LI-Onsite



Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 



When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. 



To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.




If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT HANOVER PARK DOES

Hanover Park https://hanoverpark.com/ builds AI systems that run financial operations for investment firms. We combine software and fund administration to help fund CFOs adopt AI in the workflows they’re responsible for every day.

We’ve raised $31 million from Emergence Capital, Lux Capital, Susa Ventures, and fund CFOs from Bain Capital, Clearlake, CD&R, and Hellman & Friedman.

Fund administration is our starting point. Our ambition is to build the financial infrastructure that supports how the world’s capital is operated, governed, and allocated. Over time, we believe these systems will help investment firms make decisions about their largest acquisitions and how they deploy capital.

Stripe for payments. Ramp for expenses. Hanover Park for investments.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You're the operator who turns a signed contract into a raving fan. You're embedded with billion-dollar CFOs as they navigate the biggest technology transformation in fund finance. This isn't "implementation." It isn't "customer success." It's the closest thing to founding a company while inside one - you are the person who makes sure the world's most sophisticated CFOs actually get value from AI.

To date, deployment has been owned by our CEO Chris and our founding team. The pipeline is overflowing, the product wins demos, and the single biggest constraint is now the gap between "signed" and "evangelist." That's where you come in. As the Founding Deployment Strategist, you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Chris and our engineering team - owning live customers, building the playbook as you go, and setting the bar that the next ten deployment hires.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Owning customer outcomes from kickoff through go-live and beyond - turning every signed deal into a reference account

 - Writing specs with engineering when a customer needs a feature to unlock value, and shipping it together in days

 - Building SOPs from scratch for workflows that don't yet exist - capital calls, NAV close, audit prep, GP reporting

 - Training CFOs and their finance teams on how to actually use Hanover Park's MCP within Claude/GPT for their daily workflows - building skills, prompts, and agents alongside them

 - Sitting in customer Slack channels as the trusted operator they DM at 11pm 

 - Partnering directly with product and engineering. When a customer needs something, you figure out whether it ships this week or never

Your only outcome metric: time to turn a signed customer into a raving fan.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2+ years of forging hard things into existence - as a founder, FDE, IB/PE associate, consultant, product manager, or engineer who never lost touch with the customer

 - High Agency. You don't need someone to tell you what to do next.

 - Real fluency (or relentless hunger to develop it) in how investment firms operate - funds, GPs, LPs, capital calls, distributions, NAV

 - Comfort sitting across from a $5B fund CFO, being the smartest person in the room on AI workflows, and the most curious one on theirs

 - Bias to ship. You'd rather prototype something today than spec it for next quarter

 - Customer obsession that borders on irrational - you'll fly out for a 30-minute meeting if it earns trust


YOU MAY BE:

 - A former founder who scaled something 0→1 and wants to do it again 

 - An ex investment banker or private equity associate who's tired of decks and wants to build

 - A product manager or engineer who loves customers more than tickets

 - A consultant (ex-McKinsey/Bain/BCG) ready to own outcomes instead of recommending them


THIS ISN'T THE RIGHT FIT IF

 - You need a customer success playbook handed to you on day one

 - You think "deployment" means quarterly check-ins

 - You want clean separation between sales, product, and post-sales


WHY JOIN NOW

We're disrupting a $100 trillion asset class that's never had financial infrastructure built for it. The pipeline is overflowing, the product wins demos, and the gap between "signed" and "evangelist" is the single biggest lever on growth. The Founding Deployment Strategist is the person who closes that gap - and writes the playbook every deployment hire after them runs on.

If that sounds like your kind of problem, let's talk.




OUR COMMITMENT

Equal Opportunity. Hanover Park is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. Please contact support@hanoverpark.com if you need assistance.

Hanover Park is headquartered in NOMAD, New York City. This role is on-site five days per week.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Leader
jobs.description:
ABOUT RUNLAYER 


AI is transforming how every company operates, but most enterprises are stuck. They want to move fast with AI Agents, tools, and workflows, but they can't do it safely. We're fixing that.

 

Our team built AI Actions for OpenAI, shipped Zapier Agents to millions of users, and launched the first remote MCP server with Anthropic. We helped establish the protocol, and now we're building the platform enterprises need to actually put AI to work.

 

Runlayer is one platform for MCPs, Skills, and Agents: purpose-built security, fine-grained governance, and complete observability so organizations can go all-in on AI across the entire company without the risk. We just raised a $30M Series A led by Felicis, with participation from Khosla Ventures, bringing our total raised to $42M. Already trusted by Gusto, Instacart, Opendoor, dbt Labs, and Decagon.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As our Revenue Operations Leader, you’ll build the metrics, systems, and operating cadence behind Runlayer’s revenue engine. You’ll define how we measure the business, turn that data into decisions for the leadership team, and make sure the story our numbers tell holds up in front of the board and investors. This is a senior, highly visible role working directly with leadership, and the scope will grow as the business does.




WHY YOU'LL THRIVE HERE

 - Impact: Define the metrics and operating model that shape how a fast-growing AI company plans, sells, and gets valued.

 - Excellence: Work alongside founders and a senior GTM team closing Fortune 500 deals.

 - Ownership: Own revenue operations end-to-end, from the first dashboard to the systems, processes, and team that scale with the company.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Define and own the core revenue metrics: ARR, pipeline, bookings, retention, expansion, and sales efficiency.

 - Build the forecasting and planning cadence that leadership runs the business on.

 - Turn GTM data into clear, decision-ready insight for leadership and the board.

 - Shape the revenue narrative and metrics that support fundraising and long-term enterprise value.

 - Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Finance on targets, capacity planning, territories, and compensation.

 - Bring structure to pricing, deal reviews, and unit economics as deal sizes grow.

 - Own the GTM systems and data foundation, with AI built into how we work.

 - Lead special projects for the leadership team as priorities shift.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Private equity experience is required. You’ve spent time as an associate (or similar) at a PE firm, ideally software-focused, and worked on multiple deals.

 - Investment banking background, typically as an analyst out of undergrad.

 - Operating experience since PE in strategic finance, BizOps, or revenue operations at a software company.

 - A clear sense of which metrics drive valuation and outcomes, and how to build and present them.

 - Strong modeling skills: driver-based, easy to audit, built for other people to use.

 - AI-native. You should already be using AI heavily in your own work.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and eager to build at an early-stage AI company.




WHAT WE OFFER

We provide a competitive package designed to attract and retain top talent who can work effectively with enterprise customers.

 - Competitive salary and equity — compensation that reflects your expertise and customer-facing responsibilities.

 - Paid time off — paid vacation, paid sick leave, and paid parental leave.

 - Professional development — budget for conferences, courses, and certifications in AI, enterprise software, and customer success.

 - Top-tier equipment — your choice of laptop and accessories to create your ideal work environment.

 - Health benefits — comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Customer interaction opportunities — work directly with innovative companies and see the immediate impact of your work.



Not quite the right fit? Reach out to careers@runlayer.com careers@anysource.com with details about your experience and interests.

jobs.title: Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager (Solutions Architects)
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

As the Sales Strategy & Operations Manager for Baseten’s Solutions Architecture organization, you’ll be the day-to-day strategy and operations partner to our Head of Solutions Architecture and the SA managers who report to them. You’ll give them the analysis and operating support to run the SA org, and turn their priorities into the plans, capacity models, and operating cadence the team runs on.

Our Solutions Architects are central to how Baseten wins and grows. Revenue is consumption-based, so a deal isn’t done at signature. It grows as customers get workloads into production and scale them. SAs drive that at every stage: technical evaluations and POCs, onboarding, and the optimization work that expands usage inside existing accounts. Capacity planning, coverage, and impact measurement all have to reflect that. You’ll sit on the Revenue Strategy & Operations team and work closely with Sales leadership, Finance, Comp, Enablement, and GTM Engineering. You’ll own the SA org’s numbers, the reviews that inspect them, and the processes and systems that keep them reliable.



WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Operating cadence: Run the reviews that show SA leaders where SA time goes and what it delivers.

 - Capacity and coverage: Build the models behind SA headcount and how SAs are allocated across segments and accounts.

 - SA analytics: Measure SA engagement, technical win rates, and impact on consumption growth.

 - Process and systems: Build the SA engagement model into our systems.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Business partnership
   
   - Partner with our Head of Solutions Architecture and SA managers as the strategy and ops lead for the org
   
   - Run SA MBRs and QBRs that give leaders a shared view of the business, drive decisions, and assign owners
   
   - Translate SA priorities into plans with clear owners and deadlines, and track them to completion

 - Planning and capacity
   
   - Run annual and in-year SA planning, including the headcount and coverage models behind it, in partnership with RevOps, Sales leadership, and Finance
   
   - Work with Comp to implement SA variable compensation

 - Analytics
   
   - Own SA analytics: utilization, engagement by segment and stage, technical win rates, POC conversion, and post-sale consumption ramp
   
   - Inspect SA-engaged pipeline and surface technical risk on key deals early

 - Process and systems
   
   - Build the SA engagement model into Salesforce and get SA managers onboarded onto it



QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3 to 5 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations, BizOps, FP&A, or management consulting, ideally including time partnering directly with sales or technical pre-sales leaders

 - Experience running business review cadences (weekly pipeline reviews, MBRs, QBRs) for a sales, SA, or customer-facing technical team

 - Hands-on experience with capacity planning: building headcount, coverage-ratio, or resource allocation models

 - Strong analytical skills: you build your own models in spreadsheets and pull your own data from Salesforce, BI tools, or directly from a data warehouse. You write SQL and don’t just rely on Claude.

 - Working knowledge of Salesforce and how pre-sales engagement fits into sales process design (stages, exit criteria, technical validation)

 - Clear, structured communication: you turn analysis into a clear recommendation and present it to sales and technical leaders

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and pace; you build the process rather than wait for one



NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience supporting Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, or Solutions Consulting orgs

 - Experience with consumption or usage-based revenue (cloud, API, or infrastructure businesses)

 - Experience measuring the impact of pre-sales or post-sale technical teams on revenue outcomes

 - Experience implementing or administering variable compensation plans for technical roles

 - Exposure to AI/ML infrastructure or developer-focused products



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world? And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now, Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value, and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

As a Delivery Expert you are the mechanism for delivering fast and delectably delicious pizzas to our hungry customers. As such, enthusiastic customer communication, positive personality, punctuality and sense of urgency are essential to success in this role. Additionally, the ability to maintain professional appearance in accordance with Domino’s and Team Fox image standards is required – you are the face of the brand! Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.

jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
WHAT HANOVER PARK DOES

Hanover Park https://hanoverpark.com/ builds AI systems that run financial operations for investment firms. We combine software and fund administration to help fund CFOs adopt AI in the workflows they’re responsible for every day.

We’ve raised $31 million from Emergence Capital, Lux Capital, Susa Ventures, and fund CFOs from Bain Capital, Clearlake, CD&R, and Hellman & Friedman.

Fund administration is our starting point. Our ambition is to build the financial infrastructure that supports how the world’s capital is operated, governed, and allocated. Over time, we believe these systems will help investment firms make decisions about their largest acquisitions and how they deploy capital.

Stripe for payments. Ramp for expenses. Hanover Park for investments.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Our #1 objective is for Hanover Park customers to be raving fans. From the moment they sign a contract to the launch of their firm, we want that experience to be filled with magical moments.

You will own migration and implementation for the most complex investment firms in the world - moving them from legacy, disconnected systems onto Hanover Park's system of record. This isn't back-office work. You'll be on the front line of some of the most consequential client relationships in private markets, with real ownership from day one.

At Hanover Park, "services is sales." This role directly drives retention and expansion on our path to becoming a billion-dollar company.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Own client migration and implementation end-to-end — from signed contract through successful launch

 - Build and continuously improve core operational processes and playbooks

 - Collaborate with fund accountants and world-class engineers to ensure operational precision and exceptional service delivery

 - Execute detailed quality control and reconciliation across historical customer financial reporting periods

 - Troubleshoot issues, identify patterns, and provide data-driven recommendations for operational improvements

 - Surface process improvements proactively and work with engineering to build them into the product




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-haves

 - Exceptional organizational and project management skills - you can track many moving pieces simultaneously without dropping the ball

 - Strong written and verbal communication - you represent Hanover Park directly with institutional clients, fund CFOs, and COOs

 - Bias toward action - you don't wait for permission or a perfect playbook to solve a problem

 - 1–7 years in fund accounting, fund administration, or investment operations, ideally supporting private equity, venture capital, private credit, or other alternative investment vehicles

 - Deep understanding of fund structures, capital calls and distributions, NAV calculations, and financial reporting across periods

Nice-to-haves

 - Prior experience in PE/VC operations or fund administration

 - CPA preferred but not required - candidates with strong practical fund accounting experience are equally valued

 - Exposure to client onboarding or data migration workflows


WHY JOIN NOW

You won't be doing meaningless ops work. You'll be solving one of the biggest problems at Hanover Park - delivering a client experience so good it becomes our strongest growth lever. You'll work closely with leadership on client escalations and strategic decisions, with direct exposure to Chris (CEO) and the founding team. The role is broad by design. Some days are strategic; some days are firefighting. Client expectations are high and timelines are tight. If that energizes you, we should talk.

You'll personally onboard the funds that determine whether Hanover Park becomes the AI-native system of record for private markets. Our first 100 customers shape the next 1,000.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYMENT

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Analyst
jobs.description:
Cleo is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and execution-focused Digital Marketing Analyst to support our digital marketing initiatives across website management, paid search, SEO, and campaign execution.

This role will help ensure our digital marketing programs launch on time, website content stays accurate and optimized, and digital experiences consistently deliver a high-quality user experience.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in content management systems, managing multiple competing priorities, troubleshooting technical issues, and collaborating across marketing and business teams. They should be equally comfortable executing website updates and analyzing performance to identify opportunities for improvement.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys owning projects from request through execution and finding ways to make digital marketing operations more efficient and effective.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Website & Digital Campaign Execution

• Manage day-to-day website updates and content publishing through Drupal, ensuring pages follow brand, SEO, accessibility, and responsive design best practices.

• Upload, format, QA, and publish marketing campaign assets, including landing pages, downloadable resources, blog articles, webinar registrations, and promotional content.

• Maintain the website’s events calendar, upcoming webinar promotions, event pages, and promotional banners.

• Publish company news, press releases, media mentions, and other time-sensitive announcements accurately and promptly.

• Coordinate webinar and video publishing workflows, including registration pages, on-demand video pages, embedded videos, and relevant promotional CTAs.

• Support ongoing website improvements, including content updates, layout refinements, and user experience enhancements.

Paid Media & Conversion Optimization Support

• Build and update landing pages supporting paid search and digital advertising campaigns.

• Implement campaign messaging changes, including headlines, copy, CTAs, forms, and conversion-focused page elements.

• Configure and validate UTM parameters, campaign URLs, conversion tracking, and landing page functionality before campaign launches.

• Support A/B testing and conversion rate optimization initiatives through tools such as Webflow Optimize.

• Review paid campaign landing page performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement and conversion rates.

• Partner with the digital marketing team to ensure advertising experiences align with campaign messaging and lead-generation goals.

SEO & Organic Website Optimization

• Publish and optimize SEO-focused blogs, landing pages, guides, and other organic search content.

• Implement on-page SEO improvements, including meta titles, descriptions, heading structures, internal links, image alt text, and content updates.

• Keep existing high-priority pages current with evolving product positioning, messaging, and search best practices.

• Support backlink acquisition through identifying relevant outreach opportunities, coordinating guest content, and executing link-building campaigns.

• Identify and help resolve broken links, outdated redirects, technical SEO issues, and other website problems affecting organic visibility.

• Monitor SEO and website performance to identify optimization opportunities.

Website Quality Assurance & Digital Tools

• Monitor the functionality of digital marketing tools and experiences, including Webflow Optimize, Walnut, Otterly, and other platforms used by the digital team.

Digital Analytics & Reporting

• Analyze landing page performance to recommend actionable improvements.

• Verify that tracking parameters and conversion events are functioning as expected.

• Coordinate with designers, developers, and content stakeholders to ensure digital initiatives are delivered accurately and on schedule.

• Hands-on experience working in a content management system (Drupal preferred).

• Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and digital performance metrics.

• Experience creating, updating, or optimizing digital campaign landing pages.

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. • Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Laurel is on a mission to return time. As the leading AI Time platform for professional services firms, we’re transforming how organizations capture, analyze, and optimize their most valuable resource: time. Our proprietary machine learning technology automates work time capture and connects time data to business outcomes, enabling firms to increase profitability, improve client delivery, and make data-driven strategic decisions. We serve many of the world's largest accounting and law firms, including EY, Aprio, Crowell & Moring, and Frost Brown Todd, and process over 1 billion work activities annually that have never been collected and aggregated before Laurel’s AI Time platform. 



Our team comprises top talent in AI, product development, and engineering—innovative, humble, and forward-thinking professionals committed to redefining productivity in the knowledge economy. We're building solutions that empower workers to deliver twice the value in half the time, giving people more time to be creative and impactful. If you're passionate about transforming how people work and building a lasting company that explores the essence of time itself, we'd love to meet you.



About The Role:

We're looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end onboarding and implementation journey for new enterprise customers. You'll sit at the center of every new deployment — orchestrating the work between customers and Laurel's implementation engineers, keeping projects on track, and ensuring every go-live is high quality, not just on time.

 

This role is for someone who is equally comfortable in a kickoff call with a customer's executive team and a technical deep-dive with an engineer. You translate complexity into clarity, manage competing priorities without losing momentum, and treat Time to Value as a guiding metric — never at the expense of the customer experience.

 

What You Will Do:

- Lead end-to-end onboarding and implementation projects from signed contract through go-live and CSM handoff.

- Orchestrate deployment of the Laurel tenant and Boomi Atom in coordination with implementation engineers.

- Guide customers through technical integration setup for Microsoft Office, Email, Phone, Video Conferencing, and SSO.

- Run kickoff calls and host ongoing office hours for end users and finance teams throughout the implementation lifecycle.

- Triage issues in real time — escalating to engineering or leadership appropriately while maintaining customer confidence.

- Coordinate with CSMs on adoption strategies and active user growth as customers move through and beyond go-live.

- Maintain clear project plans, timelines, and milestone tracking across multiple concurrent accounts using tools like Asana and Microsoft Planner.

- Translate technical concepts — integration architecture, XPATH-based mapping, API behaviors — into clear language for stakeholders at all levels.

- Apply agentic AI tools and technology-enabled workflows to scale your own effectiveness and bring creative efficiency to implementation challenges.

 

What We're Looking For:

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Strategic Management, Management Information Systems, Computer Information Systems, or a related field.

- 5+ years of project management experience delivering complex technical implementations in a B2B SaaS environment.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent customer engagements without sacrificing quality or responsiveness.

- Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana, Microsoft Planner, or comparable platforms; strong task-oriented design instincts.

- Technical aptitude to work directly with engineers — experience with Boomi, XPATH, or enterprise integration platforms is a strong plus.

- Familiarity with enterprise tech stacks: Microsoft 365, SSO protocols (SAML/OAuth), email, calendar, phone, and video conferencing systems.

- Working knowledge of or strong curiosity about agentic AI tools and process automation — you use these tools, not just know of them.

- Excellent communicator across all settings: executive briefings, customer calls, written updates, and engineering stand-ups.

- PMP, CAPM, or equivalent certification is a plus.

 
 


WHAT LAUREL IS

Laurel is building the system of record for human and agentic work.

The trust Laurel has built with regulated enterprises—and, even more importantly, their end-users— has enabled it to be the first company ever to deploy a multimodal desktop agent at scale (45K+ professionals and 70+ countries). This enables Laurel to collect work that no one else has.

 

Half of enterprise work happens in systems with no API or OS-level access which no tech—other than a multimodal desktop agent—can capture.

Laurel collects more than just metadata; it captures the work itself. And to make the data useful, Laurel builds workflows that requires the professional who did the work to label it accurately, creating a reinforcement learning flywheel that nobody else in the world has.

The result is +2B (and counting) of human-verified labels, creating what is becoming the world’s largest repository of last-mile enterprise data and workflows.

 


HOW LAUREL DID IT

Laurel developed its data infrastructure by creating the AI Billing category in professional services (legal, accounting, consulting). Laurel earned the trust of the enterprise (in the form of +$1B in profit returned) and end-users (in the form of 1.53M work hours returned) to collect all digital work, even work happening in digital systems that were previously invisible to AI.

 

Laurel is now re-running the same playbook in financial services (insurance, banks, private equity, etc). Same data infrastructure. But instead of billing, it is creating the Work Observability category to expand its feedback loop.

 


WHAT’S NEXT

Packaging its last-mile data in the form of:

 - Post-training: an open-source model on Laurel’s data improved performance by 33%, matching the frontier, at 1% of the cost.

 - Context: Feeding this data into a frontier model’s context window improves task automation by 21%.

 - This is how Laurel accelerates its growth from 4x YoY (current) to +10x YoY).

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LEAD OPERATIONS ENGINEER, GLOBAL (STARLINK)

Starlink is leveraging SpaceX’s experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy the world’s most advanced broadband internet system and largest satellite constellation. The Starlink Growth team combines deep analysis, business strategy, and operational excellence to drive customer retention, improve lifetime value, and scale the business. As a Lead Operations Engineer, you will set strategic priorities and timelines for high-impact operational initiatives while building and developing a high-performing team. You will hire and coach engineers, identify complex problems, drive scalable solutions, influence cross-functional leadership, and translate data into decisions that directly advance Starlink’s growth, profitability, and operational effectiveness.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Set strategic priorities, quarter roadmaps, and aggressive timelines for high-impact operational initiatives that improve Starlink’s customer experience, logistics, accounting, supply chain, and cross-functional operations.

• Build, hire, and coach a high-performing team of operations engineers; actively develop individual talent and raise overall team capability.

• Take extreme ownership of identifying systemic engineering and operational defects, driving rigorous root-cause analysis, and implementing comprehensive, scalable solutions.

• Lead process improvement efforts using first-principles thinking, lean methodologies, and bias for action—ruthlessly simplifying processes and removing unnecessary requirements/scope.

• Design and own data frameworks and decision systems that translate complex operational data into clear strategic insights and actions.

• Drive cross-functional alignment and influence senior leadership and partners across design, engineering, software, sales, marketing, customer service, logistics, accounting, and other teams.

• Own complex, high-visibility projects end-to-end, removing blockers, de-scoping non-essentials, and delivering results on aggressive timelines.

• Establish and continuously improve knowledge management systems, documentation standards, and team best practices that scale with the organization.

• Foster a culture of extreme ownership, bias for action, and continuous improvement within the team and across partner organizations.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 5+ years of experience in an operations, process improvement, manufacturing, and/or consulting environment.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

jobs.title: Associate, Energy Management
jobs.description:
What The Role Is

Reporting to the Manager, Energy Management, the Associate, Energy Management will be responsible for assisting in the development and execution of trading, hedging, risk management, and optimization strategies for Clearway assets. The Associate, Energy Management will work in close coordination with the Market Fundamentals, Business Development, Origination, Asset Management, Credit and Energy Risk, and Operations groups to manage Clearway’s energy management transactions while working to scale capabilities within a rapidly growing organization.

Location: Preference for candidates near existing office locations for hybrid engagements in Princeton, NJ, Denver, CO, San Francisco, CA, San Diego, CA, Houston, TX, or Scottsdale, AZ

*This job posting is open to multiple locations but represents one available position.*

If you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications but see yourself contributing, please submit your resume.

What You'll Be Doing

• Support all aspects of energy market optimization and trading for Clearway’s generation portfolio consisting of various technologies (energy storage, solar, wind, natural gas). This role will be focused on CAISO with the ability to expand to other markets.

• Analyze market conditions and optimize bid strategies encompassing day-ahead, real-time, and ancillary service products for Clearway’s merchant assets.

• Support scheduling coordinator and fuel manager activities for the merchant portfolio.

• Manage congestion and basis exposure through participation in annual and monthly CRR markets.

• Build and enhance operational procedures and tools critical to market operations.

• Develop, operate, and maintain production cost and price forecasting models to support nodal price forecasting. Work with Market Fundamentals to understand transmission and congestion patterns to inform bidding strategies.

• Assist Origination and Development with evaluating contracting opportunities around resource adequacy and renewable PPA pricing.

• Manage relationships with third-party vendors and scheduling coordinators responsible for market operations.

• Work with Credit and Energy Risk to support the internal ETRM and risk monitoring systems.

• Communicate with project stakeholders on market conditions, trading risks, and optimization opportunities.

• Support day-to-day position management and P&L reporting for trading portfolios.

• Support colleagues in targeted relationship-building activities with key customers.

• Participate in energy working groups, professional organizations, trade shows & conferences

• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

• Maintain confidentiality and sensitivity with respect to all functions of Clearway.

What You'll Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, economics, finance, mathematics, meteorology, engineering, or a related field.

• 4+ years of experience in energy trading, scheduling, resource optimization, forecasting, or other transactional industries.

• Knowledge of the energy industry and experience in CAISO (preferred), ERCOT, or PJM.

• Strong understanding of energy storage, natural gas, and renewable technologies.

• Solid understanding of power markets, including forwards, futures, swaps, and options.

• Strong analytical and quantitative background.

• Highly motivated self-starter, friendly personality, and good team player.

• Strong organizational skills with strong operational capabilities, the ability to handle multiple tasks, as well as a continuous improvement mindset.

• Able to work well with geographically dispersed, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Microsoft Excel.

• Experience across multiple ISOs.

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Be one of the Bedo 100

Albedo is making Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO) mainstream, building the infrastructure to enable every satellite mission to enter this new orbital domain. We build buses, integrated satellites, and turnkey missions for customers to thrive in VLEO, below 300 km, where proximity compounds performance and drag self-cleans debris.

As part of the first 100 employees at Albedo, you will have a big impact on Albedo’s trajectory to proliferating VLEO — whether you’re advancing hardware to increase satellite longevity, scaling production for large constellations, building next-gen flight and ground software to push performance, or enabling missions that matter for national security and our day-to-day life here on Earth.

How We Operate: Albedo takes a first-principles approach — in space and in business. We move with speed, take calculated risks, and learn quickly. We use AI regularly to create leverage in every discipline across the company. We work in-person at our Broomfield, CO HQ to maximize team and company productivity. We work hard and with urgency to compound our first-mover advantage.

Who We're Looking For: Builders who want to own outcomes, not tasks. Systems thinkers who balance precision with iteration while thinking about the big picture. Individuals who are energized by creating a category rather than competing in an existing one. You’ll join a team that has already proven what others said wasn’t feasible and is now scaling and upgrading our VLEO buses & payloads to serve mission sets across sensing, communications, and responsive operations.

If you can feel the excitement running through your veins, apply to be one of the Bedo 100.

What You'll Do

• Develop and integrate flight applications in C and C++ for telemetry management, GNC algorithm scheduling, and payload software management, each running as its own process on a publish/subscribe message bus.

• Write software for our imaging payload computer: the code that runs the imaging sensor and moves mission data from the sensor toward the ground.

• Work directly with our avionics hardware and our Yocto-built embedded Linux, including kernel and device drivers, alongside the engineers who built it.

• Benchmark our software to make sure we meet tight timing constraints, and close the gap when we don't (threading, user space vs. kernel space, offloading to hardware).

• Verify our software works end-to-end, from ground communication to spacecraft commanding, and take part in integration and test campaigns.

• Write and run automated tests using Python at every level, from software-in-the-loop to hardware-in-the-loop, and help maintain the automated CI/CD systems behind them, both software-only and with real hardware.

Your Ideal Skills and Experience:

• Strong C and C++ on embedded Linux, including multithreaded applications and how timing and threading actually behave on Linux.

• Have set up or worked in a cross-compiled environment: CMake, GDB, and a build system like Yocto, Buildroot, or PetaLinux.

• Understand trade-offs when it comes to topics such as memory, processor capacity, hardware offloading, latency/bandwidth, or build versus re-use.

• Can use version control such as Git, are comfortable with merge-request code review, and you might be pedantic about how you version your software (like using SemVer).

• Demonstrate a core competency in one, or many, of the following: networking communication, distributed computing, publish/subscribe middleware (like DDS), Linux driver development, state machine modeling, real-time operating systems, software/hardware simulations, or pick your flavor of nerding out and tell us!

• Most importantly, want to learn, and want to be challenged.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on Yocto experience (it's how we build our flight Linux).

• Software that has flown, or was built to fly: satellites, launch vehicles, aircraft, or drones.

• Software for embedded imaging sensors or camera pipelines (sensor drivers, V4L2, MIPI CSI).

• Rust.

• Lua, Python or another embedded scripting language.

• Spacecraft command and telemetry experience (CCSDS protocols, command/telemetry databases).

• Startup experience: comfortable with broad scope, moving fast, and learning along the way.

Salary Range:

$116,000 - $135,000 a year

Compensation and Benefits for Full-Time Roles:

• Employee friendly equity compensation

• 4% direct matching 401k

• Health Insurance: 100% employee coverage & 75% dependent coverage

• Parental leave and childcare coverage

• Flexible vacation and sick time from day one

• 12 company holidays

• $100 monthly wellness benefit

• Relocation package if not based in Denver

The final compensation package is subject to change if the candidate's experience and company need drive a different job level than originally slated for the position.

This includes recording, transcribing, analyzing, and evaluating your interview responses to ensure accurate, consistent, and efficient assessment of job-related skills, knowledge, and abilities. While AI tools may assist in this process, our human recruiting and hiring teams make all hiring decisions. For questions about AI use in interviews, data handling, or to request accommodations, contact Hello_HR@albedo.com

All persons hired will be required to be a U.S. citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled: Albedo is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director, Frontline Sales Performance
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it’s at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

The Director, Frontline Sales Performance will own the strategy and systems that drive sales performance across CLEAR’s airport network, translating commercial priorities into playbooks, tools, incentives, and field execution that improve conversion and sales volume. Reporting to the VP, Sales & Service, you’ll combine data-driven strategy with hands-on field leadership to identify what works, test it quickly, and scale it across the network.

What you'll do:

• Own CLEAR’s airport sales execution strategy, developing scalable playbooks, tools, quality standards, and performance frameworks that drive conversion and sales volume across the network

• Analyze sales performance, market dynamics, and field insights to set network targets, identify performance opportunities, prioritize investment, and translate data into clear actions for the field

• Build a rigorous test-and-learn engine across high-volume airports, rapidly piloting sales approaches, scripts, tools, and incentives and using results to determine what scales network-wide

• Partner with Field Operations leaders to embed sales standards, coaching rhythms, and performance cadences into existing station operations, driving consistent execution through influence and shared accountability

• Lead a high-performing team focused on sales performance intelligence and field quality, while partnering with People and Finance to design commission structures, incentives, and recognition programs that reinforce the right front-line behaviors

How you'll measure success:

• Network-wide improvement in sales conversion and volume

• Adoption and consistent execution of sales playbooks, tools, and quality standards across airport locations

• Measurable performance lift from pilots that successfully scale across the network

• Effectiveness of incentive programs in driving targeted sales behaviors and business outcomes

What you're great at:

• Translating complex performance data into clear strategies, targets, and actions that improve front-line sales results

• Building credibility with operational leaders and driving adoption across teams you influence rather than directly manage

• Moving from strategy to execution quickly, testing hypotheses in the field and adapting based on data, customer behavior, and front-line insights

• Operating as a hands-on, field-forward leader who is comfortable spending significant time in airports nationwide to understand performance firsthand and drive scalable improvement

At CLEAR, we help YOU move forward - because when you’re at your best, we’re at our best. You’ll work with talented team members motivated by our mission of making experiences safer and easier. jobs.title: Domino's Crew Member (5696)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world? And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

We are searching for qualified Domino's Crew Members with personality, hustle and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

As a Domino's Crew Member, you are often the first person to welcome and interface with Domino’s customers. As such, enthusiastic customer communication, positive personality, and punctuality are essential to success in this role. Additionally, the ability to maintain professional appearance in accordance with Domino’s and Team Fox image standards is required – you are the face of the brand! Additional duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, and make sound ethical judgments in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders with a smile!

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

jobs.title: Domino's Assistant Manager (5696)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check
