jobs.title: Public Affairs Lead
jobs.location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

The DRC is one of Wave's largest and most strategic markets. Our public policy work there is growing quickly and, given the size of the market and the number of issues we want to take on, we are creating a dedicated role to work alongside the Country Manager.

We're looking for a Public Affairs Lead based in Kinshasa to build and manage our relationships with government officials, regulators and key stakeholders, and to run several regulatory and advocacy workstreams in parallel in a highly competitive environment.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in navigating complex regulatory environments, advocating for favourable policies, and ensuring the company's interests are well represented at government level.

You will report to the Country Manager.

In this role, you will:

• Develop and execute a comprehensive stakeholder and relationship management strategy to advance Wave's interests in a highly competitive fintech market.

• Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders – the central bank, the telecoms regulator, relevant ministries, tax authorities, provincial authorities and industry associations – and ensure they understand Wave's mission and positioning.

• Run several regulatory, tax and advocacy workstreams at the same time, agreeing priorities with the Country Manager.

• Build and support key partnerships (business and advocacy-related) for the company.

• Represent Wave at key meetings and conferences, presenting our vision, mission and impact in a compelling manner.

• Advocate for policies that support innovation, financial inclusion and competition within the fintech industry, while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Monitor legislative and regulatory developments in the sector and provide recommendations to internal stakeholders.

• Collaborate with internal teams to align government and regulator relations with broader business objectives, and mitigate risks associated with the competitive environment.

• Actively participate in and advise PR and other teams on developing and implementing strategies for effective crisis management.

• Support the Country Manager in creating engagement platforms with key stakeholders, in Kinshasa and in the provinces.

• Provide strong and valuable input to build the regional Public Affairs strategy.

Key details

• The role is based in Kinshasa, with regular travel to the provinces.

• Work authorisation in the DRC is required.

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula. We run performance reviews twice a year and award bonuses to strong performers who have been with the company for more than 6 months.

• We cover 90% of your healthcare insurance premium costs for yourself and your dependents.

• We support working parents – we offer generous parental leave policies (26 weeks for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers) and subsidised childcare when you return to work.

• We help you live your fullest life now – we subsidise gym memberships and fitness classes.

• Airtime reimbursement.

• Free food and a beautiful office space.

Requirements

• A degree in Law, Finance, Business, Policy, Economics or equivalent.

• Fluency in English and French is required.

• A minimum of 8 years' experience in advocacy, government and/or regulatory relations or lobbying in a highly competitive and regulated industry (telecoms, mobile money, banking, mining, energy…), with a proven track record of impactful outcomes.

• A strong network across the DRC's government, regulatory bodies and private sector.

• Excellent writing, research and communication skills.

• Lingala and/or Swahili is a plus.

You might be a good fit if you

• Have strong, high-level networks (key decision-makers in regulatory institutions, administrations and government).

• Can run several sensitive files at once and make sound calls on priorities.

• Are excited and motivated by the power of technology to solve global problems.

• Are entrepreneurial and can think outside the box to find solutions to blockers.

• Are a clear, proactive and excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing.

• Are excellent at research and can put together well-articulated technical or non-technical briefs.

• Have exceptional political astuteness.

• Are a good team player.

• Are at ease giving presentations, rolling up your sleeves and working independently.

Our team

• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.

• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.

• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.

• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

• We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

What The Role Is

Reporting to the Manager, Energy Management, the Associate, Energy Management will be responsible for assisting in the development and execution of trading, hedging, risk management, and optimization strategies for Clearway assets. The Associate, Energy Management will work in close coordination with the Market Fundamentals, Business Development, Origination, Asset Management, Credit and Energy Risk, and Operations groups to manage Clearway’s energy management transactions while working to scale capabilities within a rapidly growing organization.

Location: Preference for candidates near existing office locations for hybrid engagements in Princeton, NJ, Denver, CO, San Francisco, CA, San Diego, CA, Houston, TX, or Scottsdale, AZ

*This job posting is open to multiple locations but represents one available position.*

If you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications but see yourself contributing, please submit your resume.

What You'll Be Doing

• Support all aspects of energy market optimization and trading for Clearway’s generation portfolio consisting of various technologies (energy storage, solar, wind, natural gas). This role will be focused on CAISO with the ability to expand to other markets.

• Analyze market conditions and optimize bid strategies encompassing day-ahead, real-time, and ancillary service products for Clearway’s merchant assets.

• Support scheduling coordinator and fuel manager activities for the merchant portfolio.

• Manage congestion and basis exposure through participation in annual and monthly CRR markets.

• Build and enhance operational procedures and tools critical to market operations.

• Develop, operate, and maintain production cost and price forecasting models to support nodal price forecasting. Work with Market Fundamentals to understand transmission and congestion patterns to inform bidding strategies.

• Assist Origination and Development with evaluating contracting opportunities around resource adequacy and renewable PPA pricing.

• Manage relationships with third-party vendors and scheduling coordinators responsible for market operations.

• Work with Credit and Energy Risk to support the internal ETRM and risk monitoring systems.

• Communicate with project stakeholders on market conditions, trading risks, and optimization opportunities.

• Support day-to-day position management and P&L reporting for trading portfolios.

• Support colleagues in targeted relationship-building activities with key customers.

• Participate in energy working groups, professional organizations, trade shows & conferences

• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

• Maintain confidentiality and sensitivity with respect to all functions of Clearway.

What You'll Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, economics, finance, mathematics, meteorology, engineering, or a related field.

• 4+ years of experience in energy trading, scheduling, resource optimization, forecasting, or other transactional industries.

• Knowledge of the energy industry and experience in CAISO (preferred), ERCOT, or PJM.

• Strong understanding of energy storage, natural gas, and renewable technologies.

• Solid understanding of power markets, including forwards, futures, swaps, and options.

• Strong analytical and quantitative background.

• Highly motivated self-starter, friendly personality, and good team player.

• Strong organizational skills with strong operational capabilities, the ability to handle multiple tasks, as well as a continuous improvement mindset.

• Able to work well with geographically dispersed, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Microsoft Excel.

What Would Be Nice

• MBA or MS in a related field.

• Experience across multiple ISOs.

No visa sponsorship or any kind of sponsorship for employment authorization is available for this role, now or in the future.

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Director of Product Marketing

Who We Are?

Founded in 2012 out of the Stanford Social Algorithms Lab, NovoEd is an enterprise talent development technology provider that enables organizations to scale high-impact learning, mentoring, and practice. Built on proven learning science, the NovoEd Platform drives engagement, collaboration, and skill application to develop a future-ready workforce. Global enterprises rely on NovoEd to foster deep capability-building and continuous workforce transformation.

Who Are You?

Enterprise L&D is changing fast. AI is reshaping how organizations build skills, buying committees are larger and more skeptical, and nearly every vendor now claims to “transform” learning. The companies that win in this environment are the ones that can say clearly — and prove — why they are different, and who they are different for. That’s the opportunity in front of you: build NovoEd’s product marketing function on top of a strong, proven product, with the autonomy to shape how the market understands us and the backing to make it stick.

You’ll lead our existing product marketing team and own positioning, messaging, launches, competitive intelligence, and sales enablement across the NovoEd Platform — Learn+, Mentor+, Practice+, and NovoAI. Reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, you’ll be the connective tissue between Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, with a true seat at the strategy table.

What Will You Do?

Build the Product Marketing Function

• Assess our current positioning, messaging, launch process, enablement assets, and competitive knowledge to set clear priorities for the function

• Define the product marketing operating model: what PMM owns, how it engages with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, and the rituals and artifacts that make it repeatable

• Build the toolkit — messaging frameworks, launch tiers, templates, and a single source of truth for positioning that the whole company actually uses

• Lead and develop the existing product marketing team through coaching, skill development, and performance management, shaping roles and responsibilities as the function matures

• Establish the metrics that show product marketing’s impact honestly: win rates, sales cycle velocity, launch adoption, competitive win/loss, and pipeline influence

Own Positioning, Messaging, and the Market Narrative

• Lead positioning and messaging for the NovoEd Platform and each product (Learn+, Mentor+, Practice+, NovoAI), grounded in learning science, customer outcomes, and real differentiation

• Build buyer persona and buying committee frameworks — L&D, HR and talent leaders, business-unit executives, IT, and procurement — and the messaging each needs to say yes

• Shape the category story: how NovoEd defines applied, collaborative capability-building in a market crowded with LMS, LXP, and AI-generated content vendors

• Partner with the VP of Marketing on brand narrative, and ensure every campaign, web page, and sales conversation tells one consistent story

Be the Voice of the Market to Product

• Partner with Product Management as a strategic peer on roadmap priorities, pricing and packaging, and go-to-market readiness

• Run a continuous market and customer insight program — win/loss analysis, customer interviews, analyst conversations, and call reviews — and turn findings into decisions, not decks

• Own competitive intelligence: track the landscape, build battlecards, and make sure Sales knows how to win against every alternative, including “do nothing” and “build it ourselves”

Lead Product Launches and Go-to-Market

• Build and own a tiered launch framework that coordinates Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support from early planning through post-launch adoption

• Plan and execute launches that move markets and customers — not just release notes — with particular care for AI capabilities, where clarity and credibility matter most

• Partner with the Director of Demand Generation to turn positioning into campaigns, content, and offers that create pipeline

Enable Sales and Customer Success

• Equip Sales, Growth Managers, and Customer Success with the narrative, pitch decks, demo stories, discovery guides, objection handling, and ROI frameworks they need to win and expand

• Partner with Sales leadership on enablement priorities and feedback loops, measuring what actually gets used and what actually moves deals

• Develop customer proof — case studies, references, outcome data, and advocacy programs — in partnership with Customer Success

• Support expansion and renewal motions with messaging that helps existing customers see the value of the full platform

What Skills Are Needed For This Role?

Experience & Skills

Required

• 7+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, with at least 2 years in a senior or leadership role

• Demonstrated experience building or scaling a product marketing function — defining its charter, processes, and operating model — not just inheriting one. Direct experience managing and developing product marketers

• Proven cross-functional leadership: a track record of aligning Product, Sales, and executive stakeholders through influence rather than authority

• Mastery of positioning and messaging fundamentals, with examples of work that measurably changed how buyers perceived a product

• Experience leading launches end to end for complex enterprise products, ideally across a multi-product platform

• Track record of sales enablement that improved win rates or deal velocity in an enterprise (deal size $100K+, long sales cycle) environment

• Strong research skills: comfortable running customer interviews, win/loss programs, and competitive analysis, and translating them into clear recommendations

• Exceptional writing and storytelling — you can make complex products simple without making them generic

• A team player - we’re a small, all-hands-on-deck kind of team who work closely and collaboratively to meet our goals

• Excellent communication and organization skills that enable you to succeed in a fast-paced, team-based environment.

Strongly Preferred

• Experience in EdTech, HR Tech, or enterprise SaaS with complex buying committees and multiple stakeholder personas

• Experience marketing AI-powered products and helping skeptical buyers understand what the AI really does

• Experience shaping pricing and packaging strategy

• Experience building analyst relations programs with firms covering learning and talent technology

• Hands-on familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, and a sales enablement platform (Highspot, Seismic, or similar)

What you need to be successful in this role

• You are a builder by nature. Creating a function from first principles energizes you more than running someone else’s playbook.

• You lead through influence. Product, Sales, and Customer Success see you as a partner who makes their jobs easier, and you earn alignment rather than demand it.

• You are a systems thinker. You build frameworks, templates, and operating rhythms so great product marketing doesn’t depend on heroics.

• You are close to the customer. You spend real time with buyers and users, and your messaging sounds like them, not like us.

• You are intellectually honest. You tell Product when the market doesn’t care, tell Sales when the deck isn’t working, and change course based on evidence.

• You choose clarity over cleverness. Differentiation is something you prove, not something you claim.

• You are comfortable managing several initiatives at once and are willing to change course based on evidence or changing priorities

Why Will You Love NovoEd?

At NovoEd, the culture is one of high energy with an entrepreneurial atmosphere, combined with the stability and backing of Fidelity’s Devonshire Investors.

• A collaborative work environment

• Fun remote social events

• Annual in-person all-company meeting

jobs.title: Associate Director, Business Process Owner
jobs.description:
Purpose

Own the end-to-end governance, health, and continuous improvement of assigned clinical business processes, ensuring processes are inspection-ready, scalable, and aligned to enterprise priorities and regulatory expectations. Partner across Clinical Development Operations and enabling functions to translate strategy into clear process outcomes, drive adoption through change management and learning alignment, and monitor process performance signals to proactively address risk and improve execution. Role may be filled as a Sr. BPO depending on experience and process areas.

Responsibilities

• Serve as the accountable owner for assigned clinical business processes across their lifecycle (Engage → Evaluate → Execute → Measure → Sustain), defining process scope, intended outcomes, and decision rights.

• Establish and maintain an end-to-end process governance model (standards, forums, escalations, and stakeholder alignment) to ensure consistent global execution and a unified, single voice to the business.

• Own process health and sustainability by defining and monitoring key process signals/metrics, identifying emerging issues and risks, and driving timely mitigation and continuous improvement.

• Translate business and regulatory needs into clear process requirements and partner with Process Excellence roles (e.g., process design/engineering) to ensure documentation is complete, consistent, and inspection-ready.

• Act as the authoritative point of contact for process questions within the domain; curate and maintain process knowledge content and ensure availability of fit-for-purpose guidance for end users.

• Lead cross-functional stakeholder engagement to align priorities, trade-offs, and adoption plans, ensuring the right SMEs are engaged at the right time and decisions are transparent and durable.

• Partner with stakeholders to ensure change narratives, communications, and role-based training enable effective adoption and sustained performance.

• Coordinate and coach a domain SME network to support process adherence, identify improvement opportunities, and reinforce standard ways of working.

• Partner with system and business owners to ensure process-to-system alignment, impact assessment for changes, and effective implementation support (e.g., acceptance criteria, UAT input, and readiness planning).

• Embed innovation and digital/AI enablement into process oversight and improvements where appropriate, ensuring changes are controlled, compliant, and measurable.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred (e.g., life sciences, engineering, or related discipline).

• Minimum of 8 years clinical process management experience required with demonstrated experience owning and governing end-to-end business processes in a regulated environment (clinical development, GxP, quality systems, or similar).

• Strong understanding of clinical development operations and the regulatory/inspection context; ability to apply this knowledge to process decisions and risk management.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional alignment and stakeholder management, including conflict resolution and escalation when needed.
• Experience defining process performance measures, monitoring process health, and driving continuous improvement using data and structured problem solving.
• Familiarity with process design/documentation standards and methods (e.g., process mapping/BPMN, Lean/Six Sigma concepts), including partnering effectively with process architects/engineers.
• Experience partnering with technology/system owners on process-to-system alignment and change impacts (requirements, readiness, and UAT support).
• Strong change leadership skills, including partnering on communications, training alignment, and adoption/sustainment planning.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate complex process topics into clear guidance for diverse audiences.
• Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, global environment and manage multiple priorities with sound judgment and accountability.

Lead Clinical Care. Empower Others. Make a Difference.

At Dungarvin, we're looking for a Registered Nurse (RN) who brings strong clinical judgment, leadership, and a passion for improving the lives of others. This is more than a traditional nursing position. You'll take an active leadership role in the health, safety, and well-being of individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. You'll oversee nursing services, coordinate health care, manage clinical risks, and ensure individuals receive quality, person-centered care while maintaining their dignity, independence, and personal choice.

You'll also serve as a clinical leader and resource for Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs) and Direct Support Professionals (DSPs), providing training, guidance, and oversight to help ensure safe and consistent care.

What You'll Do

• Lead Clinical Care: Provide nursing oversight, complete health assessments, monitor changes in medical conditions, and coordinate follow-up care.
• Coordinate Health Services: Partner with physicians, families, guardians, therapists, and interdisciplinary teams to coordinate appointments, implement medical orders, and ensure continuity of care.
• Manage Clinical Risks: Lead aspiration risk management and develop Comprehensive Aspiration Risk Management Plans (CARMP) in collaboration with other clinical professionals.
• Oversee Medication Safety: Ensure accurate medication records, safe medication administration, appropriate documentation, and compliance with nursing delegation requirements.
• Train & Develop Staff: Provide clinical training, competency assessments, and ongoing guidance to DSPs and LPNs on medication administration, health care plans, and delegated responsibilities.
• Supervise LPNs: Provide clinical oversight, training, evaluation, and support to LPNs while ensuring nursing responsibilities are appropriately delegated.
• Maintain Documentation & Compliance: Complete and oversee health care plans, progress notes, and clinical documentation in Therap. Ensure compliance with New Mexico DD Waiver standards, nursing regulations, and organizational policies.
• Collaborate & Advocate: Participate in care planning meetings, clinical assessments, incident reviews, and audits while advocating for the health, safety, and individual needs of those we support.

What Makes You A Great Fit:

• Education & Licensure: Current, valid Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of New Mexico is mandatory.
• Nursing Experience: Professional nursing experience with strong clinical assessment, care coordination, and decision-making skills.
• I/DD Experience: Prior education and/or experience in working with developmentally disabled individuals, long-term care, or home health care is highly valued.
• Clinical Leadership: Ability to train, mentor, and provide clinical oversight to LPNs and DSPs, including competency assessments and nursing delegation.
• Communication Skills: Strong interpersonal and organizational skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with families, medical professionals, staff, and interdisciplinary teams.
• Clinical Judgment: Ability to identify health risks, solve problems, manage competing priorities, and make sound clinical decisions.
• Driving Requirements: Valid driver's license, vehicle insurance, and a driving record that meets agency insurance policy requirements are non-negotiable.
• Background Clearance: Successful clearance of a criminal background check for licensing requirement.

WHY WORK ON OUR TEAM:

You'll have the ability to influence more than day-to-day operations. Your leadership will directly impact the people we support, the employees you develop, and the overall success of your programs. If you're someone who enjoys leading people, solving problems, taking ownership, and making a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

We believe in supporting not only those we serve but also each other, ensuring a collaborative and supportive work environment for all. jobs.title: Domino's General Manager (5673)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically General Managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Partner Delivery Manager, Air & Space Delivery Team
jobs.description:
CONSEQUENTIAL WORK. DEDICATED PEOPLE.



ABOUT ONEBRIEF


Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.


WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Air Force and Space Force organizations need planning tools that fit the way their staffs make decisions, coordinate across commands, and execute missions. A successful implementation depends on more than a software rollout: it requires someone who understands air and space operations, can earn the trust of planners, and can translate their workflows into practical, sustained use.

As a Partner Delivery Manager, you will onboard new commands, help existing customers realize sustained operational value, and support qualified growth opportunities. You will bring Air and Space expertise to exercises, customer workflows, demonstrations, and pilots while making each delivery more repeatable. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Air & Space Delivery Operations Manager.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own assigned new-command onboarding from the Growth handoff through a conditions-based transition to Mission Success. Define customer outcomes, coordinate delivery, and surface risks early.

 - Help air and space planners translate operational processes into useful Onebrief workflows; train and coach users in person and remotely. Validate Space Force use cases on their own merits rather than assuming Air Force workflows transfer directly.

 - Support existing customers alongside Mission Success through exercises, planning events, workflow improvements, training, and coordinated issue resolution so they realize sustained operational value.

 - Partner with Growth and Mission Success on scoped demonstrations, pilots, and net-new and expansion opportunities. Define the customer problem, required resources, success criteria, and next decision.

 - Build proficiency in Onebrief and Onebrief AI, and provide basic Atom Engine support in partnership with the Atom Engine Delivery Team.

 - Share customer needs, product feedback, and after-action lessons with the appropriate teams; turn validated insights into reusable workflows, demonstration assets, and delivery playbooks.

 - Remain comfortable and ready to pivot beyond your primary customer base to support other customers, delivery teams, and surge requirements as GDT priorities evolve.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience supporting operational planning, coordination, or execution in an Air Force or Space Force headquarters, operations center, wing, or comparable joint environment.

 - Working knowledge of air or space planning and the ability to explain how staff organizations, operational workflows, and decision makers interact.

 - Experience independently coordinating a complex onboarding, implementation, exercise, or operational event across multiple stakeholders.

 - Ability to build trust with customers, teach new tools and workflows, and communicate clearly with operational and technical stakeholders.

 - Strong technical aptitude and the ability to learn complex software, troubleshoot initial issues, and coordinate resolution. Experience implementing software or leading change across classified and unclassified environments.

 - Current Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI, ability to access DoD facilities, and readiness to travel more than 50% of the time, both within the continental United States and internationally.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in an air operations center, the Joint Planning Process for Air, or the Air Tasking Cycle and its associated systems and outputs.

 - Experience supporting Space Force mission planning, space operations centers or the integration of space capabilities into joint or combined operational planning.

 - Experience with modeling, simulation, wargaming, or operational demonstrations for air or space customers.

 - Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, operational planning, analysis, or customer delivery. Familiarity with effective prompt engineering, critically evaluating AI-generated outputs, and leveraging AI Agents or automation to streamline repeatable workflows and improve execution.




INDICATORS OF SUCCESS

Customer needs and priorities evolve, and success in this role requires adaptability and resilience. The outcomes below illustrate what success typically looks like approximately six months into the role:

 - Assigned onboarding and delivery commitments meet customer-agreed outcomes, with risks surfaced early and a clear handoff to Mission Success.

 - Existing customers receive effective exercise, planning, or workflow support that helps them realize operational value.

 - Scoped demonstrations, pilots, or expansion engagements contribute to clear customer decisions, and internal partners receive actionable customer feedback.

 - Validated lessons or assets are reused by the team, reducing preparation effort or time-to-value for a comparable engagement.


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

About Nayya

Founded in 2019, Nayya is on a mission to connect people’s most important information, so they can thrive in their health and wealth. Powered by AI and advanced analytics, Nayya’s platform transforms complex benefits experiences into intuitive, seamless, and ongoing interactions—meeting people's real world needs. Engineering Manager, Site Reliability Engineering

Nayya

Job Summary

We are looking for a passionate and driven Engineering Manager, Site Reliability Engineering to lead our SRE team at Nayya. In this role, you will combine strong technical expertise with people leadership to build a high-performing team that ensures the reliability, scalability, and performance of our platform. This is a hands-on leadership role where you will actively contribute to design, write code, and engage directly in incident response alongside your team.

As an Engineering Manager at a fast-paced, growth-stage startup, you will be a key partner to engineering, product, and data leadership - setting the technical direction for infrastructure and operations while developing the people and processes that make it all work. We are seeking a leader who thrives in an environment that prioritizes impatience, excellence, resilience, and courage - someone who is excited about leading teams that make an immediate impact while pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

You will own the roadmap for reliability and infrastructure, drive strategic decisions, and foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and technical excellence across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership & Team Building

• Build and lead a high-performing SRE team by hiring, onboarding, and retaining top engineering talent.

• Provide regular coaching, mentorship, and career development support to direct reports, helping engineers grow into senior technical and leadership roles.

• Conduct meaningful performance reviews, set clear goals, and create individual development plans aligned with team and company objectives.

• Foster a team culture rooted in ownership, psychological safety, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Technical Strategy & Execution

• Define and drive the SRE roadmap in partnership with engineering, product, and data leadership, ensuring alignment with business priorities.

• Directly contribute to the design and implementation of highly available systems while guiding the team's technical approach.

• Establish and evolve standards for infrastructure as code, observability, CI/CD, incident management, and performance tuning.

• Partner with software engineering teams to embed reliability practices into the software development lifecycle, including SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Serve as the primary point of contact for SRE across the organization, translating technical reliability concepts into business impact for non-technical stakeholders.

• Collaborate with product, software engineering, and data teams to define and implement best practices for reliability, performance, and scalability.

• Represent the SRE team in planning and prioritization discussions, advocating for infrastructure investments and AI enablement.

Operational Excellence

• Own and continuously improve incident management processes, including on-call rotations, escalation procedures, and blameless postmortems.

• Balance rapid delivery with system stability, ensuring reliable deployment pipelines and minimal downtime.

• Drive a data-informed approach to reliability by establishing and tracking key metrics, SLIs, and error budgets.

• Adapt quickly to evolving business needs and emerging technologies, delivering incremental improvements with a focus on learning and iteration.

Qualifications

Experience

• 7+ years of professional experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or related roles, with at least 2 years in a people management or team lead capacity.

• Proven track record of leading, and scaling engineering teams in a fast-paced startup or growth-stage environment.

• Strong technical background with hands-on experience building and maintaining high-performance, scalable systems.

• Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, Ruby, Go, JavaScript, or similar.

• Extensive experience with AWS, specifically:

• VPC networking, Route 53, ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, and RDS (Postgres/Aurora)

• Data infrastructure provisioning (EMR, Glue, Redshift, Step Functions, Athena)

• Deep understanding of infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred) and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred).

• Strong knowledge of site reliability practices, incident management, monitoring, and alerting. Familiarity with Datadog or similar observability platform(s) and tooling is a plus.

Mindset & Values

• People-First Leadership: Genuine commitment to developing engineers, creating inclusive teams, and leading with empathy and accountability.

• Agility: Ability to adapt to rapidly changing priorities and shifting technical landscapes while keeping your team focused and effective.

• Excellence: Commitment to high standards for reliability, performance, scalability, and team culture.

• Courage: Willingness to make difficult decisions, have hard conversations, and step up to complex technical and organizational challenges.

• Technical Depth: Staying close to the codebase and infrastructure, leading by example through hands-on contributions

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in a growth-stage startup or similar high-growth company.

• Familiarity with microservices, serverless architectures, and cloud-native technologies.

• Experience partnering with executive leadership on technical strategy and organizational design.

The salary range for New York based candidates for this role is $174,000- $210,000. We use a location factor to adjust this range for candidates that are located outside of geographic region of our New York office. Placement within the salary band is determined based on experience.

jobs.title: Business Development, VIP Acquisition Lead
jobs.description:
Phantom https://phantom.com is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.



Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 https://www.forbes.com/sites/ninabambysheva/2026/02/23/inside-phantoms-battle-plan-to-win-the-crypto-fueled-superapp-war/ and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026 https://www.cnbc.com/worlds-top-fintech-companies-2026/! 



We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Phantom is looking for a Business Development Lead to acquire and grow relationships with high-value individual traders across Phantom’s suite of trading products.



You’ll bring an established book of VIP client relationships along with a proven ability to turn trusted relationships into business. Your primary responsibility will be to win these traders’ business for Phantom and build lasting relationships that drive sustained trading activity.



You’ll own the commercial relationship from initial outreach through acquisition and ongoing growth, partnering with our VIP team to deliver a strong client experience. You’ll also help shape Phantom’s offering for high-value traders by bringing their needs and feedback into product and commercial decisions.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Acquire high-value traders. Build and execute a plan to bring individual VIP clients to Phantom, drawing on your existing relationships and developing new opportunities through referrals, targeted outreach, and existing industry networks.

 - Own the acquisition process. Manage prospecting, qualification, product positioning, commercial discussions, and conversion, with clear accountability for acquisition results.

 - Build compelling client propositions. Understand each trader’s goals, preferences, and current platform relationships, and work with internal teams to develop offers that earn their business.

 - Drive activation and ongoing growth. Partner with the VIP team to support onboarding, help clients become active traders, and deepen their use of Phantom’s advanced trading platform.

 - Manage lasting relationships. Serve as a trusted commercial contact, anticipate client needs, address barriers to adoption, and identify opportunities to grow trading activity and referrals.

 - Represent the client internally. Work with Product, Growth, Marketing, and Support to translate client feedback into improvements to Phantom’s trading experience and VIP offering.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - An established, active book of personally managed relationships with individual VIP crypto traders.

 - Experience in VIP relationship management, or client acquisition at a centralized exchange or comparable crypto trading platform.

 - A demonstrated track record of acquiring clients, retaining their business, and growing trading activity, supported by measurable results.

 - Strong understanding of spot and perpetual futures trading, trader economics, and the factors that influence platform selection.

 - Excellent relationship-building, consultative selling, negotiation, and communication skills.

 - Strong commercial judgment, analytical skills, and ownership of targets and outcomes.




COMPENSATION

Competitive base compensation and substantial performance-based earnings tied to acquiring and retaining high-value trading clients. The performance-based earnings will reflect delivery of agreed KPIs.



Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

 

 - Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

 - Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

 - Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.



Benefits (only available to full-time employees)

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered 

 - Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

 - Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

 - 401(k) retirement plan

 - Wellness stipend

 - Weekly meal stipend

jobs.title: Equipment Technician IV
jobs.description:
Perform Maintenance duties required to support production goals while complying with quality standards and safety requirements.  Diagnose production and / or packaging equipment to determine repair needs.  Perform repairs in a timely manner and complete all required documentation in accordance with cGMP’s and department SOP’s.  Maintain equipment functionality through the preventative maintenance program.

This is a Monday-Friday 6PM-2:30AM Float position.

Job Details

This position is responsible for the following:

• Maintain a clean and organized work area during and at the end of each shift.
• Assist in achieving environmental, health, and safety goals by working safely and observing all general plant and department safety policies.
• Performs all assigned duties according to departmental SOP’s and cGMP’s.
• Remains current on proper procedures by reviewing current, revised, and new SOP’s relating to the job and to the department.
• Completes and remains current with all required cGMP and safety training.
• Performs maintenance and repairs of production / packaging equipment to support the on-time delivery to customers, with a minimum amount of downtime.
• Assist with set-up and changeovers of production / packaging equipment.
• Troubleshoots equipment and coordinate corrective actions to reduce or eliminate defects, rejects, or equipment downtime.
• Completes all required documentation associated with the repair and maintenance of production and / or packaging equipment.
• Provides guidance and training to less experienced mechanics to ensure PM’s, line set-up and changeovers are performed within established requirements.

• Education - Two-year Associate’s Degree in Industrial Maintenance, Industrial Systems, Instrumentation, Electrical Systems, Electronics or similar field with a minimum of two (2) – three (3) years of experience in industrial maintenance performing mechanical/electrical repairs OR High School diploma or GED equivalent with three (3) – five (5) years of experience in industrial maintenance performing mechanical/electrical repairs.
• Experience: Technical - Mastery in Electrical & Mechanical Troubleshooting. Proficiency in Maintenance Methods. Proficiency with multiple types of industrial manufacturing equipment.
• Experience: Regulatory - Experience working in a cGMP or FDA regulated manufacturing environment preferred.

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

• Detail-oriented and self-motivated
• Excellent hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity.
• Excellent math skills; ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide.
• Ability to read, comprehend, write, and communicate effectively in English.
• Ability to carry out detailed written or oral instructions.
• Ability to work and communicate with others in a professional and effective manner, within a team-oriented environment.
• Basic user knowledge and understanding of Windows-based computer systems such as Microsoft Office, with an ability to learn other computer-based systems.

• Physically able to lift up to 40 lbs. for men and 35 lbs. for women.
• Physically able to bend, climb, lift, squat, stoop, and stretch to reach frequently.

• Working knowledge of Filling/Packaging equipment.

jobs.title: Financial Data Manager
jobs.description:
Financial Data Manager

Counterpart is the first Agentic Insurance™ platform, combining trusted insurance expertise with cutting-edge AI to deliver tailored management and professional liability solutions. By integrating Agentic Underwriting™, Agentic Broker Services™, Agentic Risk Mitigation™, Agentic Claims Management™, Agentic Coverage™, and Agentic Capacity™ into one powerful platform, Counterpart empowers brokers - and the businesses they serve - to do more with less risk. Backed by A rated carriers, Counterpart has been recognized by CB Insights as a 2025 “Top 50 Insurtech,” by Great Place to Work, and by Business Insurance as one of its 2025 “Best Places to Work.”

We're seeking a Financial Data Manager to design and deliver the data workflows that power Counterpart's financial and accounting systems. You will report to Pricing & Analytics and serve three primary customers: the finance function, the analytics function, and broker services (billing). You will translate insurance accounting concepts — written and earned premium, unearned premium reserves, commissions, and cash application — into clear data requirements. You will then partner with engineering to build them. This is a design and project management role at the intersection of finance, data, and product.

YOU WILL

• Design data-driven workflows that feed Counterpart's financial and accounting systems and the downstream processes that depend on them.

• Translate finance, analytics, and billing requirements into clear data models, source-of-truth definitions, and technical specifications.

• Own the definitions behind core insurance accounting measures — written premium, earned premium, unearned premium, commissions, and ceded amounts — so every team reports the same number.

• Partner with engineering to implement these workflows, and manage the projects end to end from scoping through delivery and adoption. Enable resilient systems that can handle edge cases (even with easy manual override)

• Serve as the primary data partner to the finance function for the monthly and quarterly close, reconciliations, and audit support.

• Support broker services on billing and invoicing data, including installment schedules, cash application, and commission accuracy.

• Build controls and automated checks that catch premium, billing, and bordereau discrepancies before they reach carriers or auditors.

• Design and maintain the carrier and bordereau reporting pipelines, and make sure the outputs tie to the general ledger.

• Document data lineage, change tracking, business rules, and known limitations so finance and analytics users can self-serve with confidence.

• Prioritize a backlog of finance data requests, and set expectations with stakeholders on scope, sequence, and timing.

• Identify manual finance processes that data and automation can remove, and build the business case to fix them.

YOU HAVE

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, economics, information systems, or a related field.

• 5+ years in financial data management, financial systems, insurance operations, or a comparable analytical role.

• A working knowledge of insurance accounting concepts, including written premium, earned premium, unearned premium reserves, and commissions.

• Practical SQL skills — you can query, join, and validate data on your own without waiting on an analyst.

• Experience writing requirements for engineering teams and managing delivery against them.

• Strong project management skills, and a track record of shipping cross-functional work with finance and technical partners.

• Clear written communication, and the ability to explain data decisions to accountants and engineers alike.

• Experience with data warehouses and business intelligence tools (Snowflake, Looker, dbt, or similar) is a plus.

• Insurance, insurtech, or fintech experience is highly desirable.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:

• Stanley Wang, Director, Pricing Analytics: Before joining Counterpart, Stanley worked as an actuary within the pricing solutions and methods team at USAA to combine actuarial pricing with data science models. Before that, he was a leading data scientist for Digital Partners, a Munich Re Company where he specialized in building data science models and insights for leading insurtech companies. He has had many other relevant roles such as capital modeling, risk management etc. He lives in New York with his growing family.

• Tobias Schuler, Chief Underwriting Officer: After becoming a Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society & working as a consultant actuary at EY for several years, Tobias went on to drive the actuarial data & systems teams at QBE. He further leveraged his deep insurance & technical expertise at Munich Re Digital Partners in North America, where he headed data & analytics & oversaw the data infrastructure behind some of their largest programs.

• Newton Truong, Engineering Manager: Newton joins Counterpart with 7+ years of experience in platform and data engineering. In his last company Thrive Market, he had a hand in building out new microservices and architecting data pipelines with Airflow and Spark. He's vegetarian and loves trying new restaurants when traveling. Nowadays he's busy keeping up with his 2-year-old and doing outdoor activities with his family.

COUNTERPART'S VALUES

• Conjoin Expectations - it is the cornerstone of autonomy. Ensure you are aware of what is expected of you and clearly articulate what you expect of others.

• Speak Boldly & Honestly - the only failure is not learning from mistakes. Don't cheat yourself and your colleagues of the feedback needed when expectations aren't being met.

• Be Entrepreneurial - control your own destiny. Embrace action over perfection while navigating any obstacles that stand in the way of your ultimate goal. Leverage AI ruthlessly. We measure success by outcomes, not lines of code written. Use every available AI tool to ship faster and think more strategically.

• Practice Omotenashi ("selfless hospitality") - trust will follow. Consider every interaction with internal and external partners an opportunity to develop trust by going above and beyond what is expected.

• Hold Nothing As Sacred - create routines but modify them routinely. Take the time to reflect on where the business is today, where it needs to go, and what you have to change in order to get there.

• Prioritize Wellness - some things should never be sacrificed. We create an environment that stretches everyone to grow and improve, which is fulfilling, but is only one part of a meaningful life.

WE OFFER

• Fully remote workplace

• Unlimited Vacation: We offer flexible time off, allowing you to take time when you need it.

• Work from Anywhere: Counterpart is a fully distributed company, meaning there is no office. We allow employees to work from wherever they do their best work, and invite the team to meet in person a couple times per year.

• Stock Options

• Health, Dental, and Vision Coverage

• 401(k) Retirement Plan

• Parental Leave

• Home Office Allowance: to set up your home office with the necessary equipment and accessories.

• Wellness Stipend

• Book stipend

• Professional Development Reimbursement

• No working birthdays: Take your birthday off, giving you the opportunity to relax, enjoy your special day, and spend time with loved ones.

• Charitable Contribution Matching

Our estimated pay range for this role is $110,000 to $150,000. Base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, market data, location, internal equitability, and experience.

We are committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported and connected at work - regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against qualified applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law, rule, or regulation.

jobs.title: Buyer - Altius 600
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB
We are seeking a highly motivated Buyer to join our Procurement team. In this role, you will support procurement activities for key programs, manage supplier relationships, and ensure on-time delivery of critical materials and services. This position is ideal for someone hungry to grow, eager to learn, and ready to thrive in a high-growth, mission-driven company. Join us if you're looking for:

• Opportunity for Growth: Be part of a scaling organization with endless opportunities to develop your skills and advance your career. Gain hands-on experience in procurement and supply chain operations.

• Fast-Paced Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology with a dynamic, innovative team.

• Impactful Work: Support critical programs that make a difference in national security.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Purchase Order Management: Create, issue, and manage purchase orders to meet production and program needs.

• Supplier Coordination: Maintain relationships with suppliers, monitor performance, and resolve issues related to quality, delivery, and pricing.

• Problem Solving: Quickly resolve supply chain disruptions, delivery delays, and quality issues to keep projects on track.

• Order Tracking: Monitor and expedite orders to meet deadlines and production schedules.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, manufacturing, and program teams to align procurement with company goals.

• Data & Process Management: Maintain accurate records, track procurement KPIs, and identify opportunities to streamline processes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, business, or related field

• 2+ years of supply chain experience, including technical procurement

• Ability to read technical drawings and blueprints

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong organizational and time-management skills.

• Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.

• Proficiency in Excel; experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) is a plus.

• Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills

US Salary Range

$93,000—$124,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

jobs.title: Revenue Strategy & Operations (AI Natives, AI Strategics, Labs)
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

As the Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager for Baseten’s AI Natives, AI Strategics, and Labs segments, you’ll be the day-to-day RevOps partner to the leaders who run them: our Sales Leaders across AI Natives & Strategics and our Head of Sales for Labs. You’ll give them the analysis and operating support to run their segments, and turn their priorities into the plans, targets, and operating cadence the segments run on.

These segments cover some of Baseten’s largest and fastest-growing customers. Revenue is consumption-based, so growth comes from workloads scaling inside existing accounts as much as from new logos, and planning, forecasting, and pipeline management have to reflect that. You’ll sit on the Revenue Strategy & Operations team and work closely with Finance, Comp, Enablement, Territory Ops, GTM Engineering, and Sales leadership. You’ll own the segments’ numbers, the reviews that inspect them, and the processes and systems that keep them reliable.



WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Segment planning: Turn segment leaders’ priorities into joint plans with clear decisions, owners, and deadlines, and track them to completion.

 - Operating cadence: Run segment MBRs, QBRs, and forecast reviews so leaders understand the business, decisions get made, and every follow-up has an owner.

 - Planning and targets: Build the models behind annual and in-year planning for the segments: headcount, quota, and pipeline targets.

 - Pipeline and forecasting: Inspect deals, pressure-test commits, and surface risk early in a business where revenue moves with customer usage.

 - Segment analytics: Own funnel and consumption analytics, and build analytics products with GTM Engineering that flag risks and opportunities early.

 - Process and systems: Build the segments’ sales processes into our systems and get segment managers onboarded onto them.
   
   

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Business partnership
   
   - Partner with our Heads of Sales for AI Natives and Labs as the RevOps lead for their segments
   
   - Bring segment leaders the analysis they need to decide where to focus and invest
   
   - Translate segment strategy into joint plans with clear decisions, owners, and deadlines, and track them to completion
   
   - Run segment MBRs and QBRs that give leaders an accurate, shared view of the business, drive decisions, and assign owners

 - Planning, targets, and capacity
   
   - Run the annual and in-year planning process for the segments
   
   - Build the capacity, quota, and pipeline models behind segment targets, in partnership with the VP of RevOps and Finance
   
   - Work with the Comp team to implement segment compensation plans and track their impact

 - Pipeline, forecasting, and analytics
   
   - Run segment forecast reviews: inspect deals, pressure-test commits, and surface risks early
   
   - Own segment funnel analytics: stage conversion, win rates, new logos, activations, renewals, consumption trends, and product mix
   
   - Build segment analytics products with GTM Engineering that surface risks and opportunities early and often

 - Operations and process
   
   - Build the segments’ sales processes into our systems (Salesforce and the wider GTM stack)
   
   - Partner with Enablement to onboard segment managers onto seller motions and tools



QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3 to 5 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations, BizOps, FP&A, or management consulting, ideally including time partnering directly with sales leaders

 - Experience running forecast and business review cadences (weekly forecast calls, MBRs, QBRs) for a sales segment or region

 - Hands-on experience supporting annual planning: building capacity, quota, or pipeline coverage models

 - Strong analytical skills: you build your own models in spreadsheets and pull your own data from Salesforce, BI Tools, or directly from a data warehouse. You write SQL and don’t just rely on Claude.

 - Working knowledge of Salesforce and sales process design (stages, exit criteria, forecast categories)

 - Clear, structured communication: you turn analysis into a clear recommendation and present it to sales leaders

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and pace; you build the process rather than wait for one



NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with consumption or usage-based revenue (cloud, API, or infrastructure businesses)

 - Experience supporting enterprise or strategic segments with large, concentrated customers

 - Experience implementing or administering sales compensation plans

 - Exposure to AI/ML infrastructure or developer-focused products



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

jobs.title: Domino's General Manager (5629)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically General Managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Direct Support Professional (DSP) / Caregiver
jobs.description:
A Direct Support Professional (DSP) caregiver provides direct support, positive direction, instruction, and assistance to individuals with mental, intellectual & developmental, and physical disabilities.  The ultimate goal is to empower individuals with disabilities to live as independently and comfortably as possible while maintaining their dignity and respect.

• Person-centered, patient, and kind
• Dependable, adaptable, flexible
• Observant and detail oriented
• Positive role-model for others and able to work on a team
• Committed to creating a respectful and collaborative environment
• Computer skills for documentation

We believe in supporting not only those we serve but also each other, ensuring a collaborative and supportive work environment for all. At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

As a Service Technician, you will be responsible for diagnosing, maintaining and repairing Lucid Motors vehicles.  You will demonstrate your passion for sustainable transportation and creatively solve problems in a fast-paced environment.   As a Service Technician, it is expected to have ASE certifications obtained within 6-8 months of hire date.     Lucid will reimburse the cost associated with successful completion.
