• Confidently repair basic and major mechanical issues and perform basic electrical and mechanical diagnosis

• Maintain a high knowledge level of High Voltage (HV), Low Voltage (LV), and general electric vehicle systems

• Follow correct repair order documentation procedures, i.e. The Three C's

• Effectively work with the appropriate software suite to properly and completely document all customer vehicle interactions

• Effectively communicate and collaborate with other members of the service team (i.e., advisor, manager, etc.) as well as customers.

• Ability to demonstrate and teach learned technical skills/knowledge with others

• Demonstrate attention to detail and passion for creating positive client experiences

• Ability to work remotely and support mobile service team as needed

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

• 2-5 years of experience as an automotive service technician, including previous experience with EV/HEV diagnosis and repair

• Knowledge of High Voltage systems, Low Voltage systems, and Electric Vehicle powertrains

• Customer facing experience exhibiting excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to use applications such as Microsoft Office as well as learn proprietary DMS software

• EPA 609 Certification

• Willingness to complete Lucid provided CPR training post hire

• Valid driver’s license with no suspensions within the past year. Drivers under 21 must have maintained a Driver’s License for a minimum of 3 years and successfully complete Lucid Training upon hire

Preferred Qualifications:

• ASE Certifications (A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, L3, L4 - ADAS)

• Experience in luxury automobile repair environments

$31—$43 USD

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
Lifeforce is hiring a Controller to own accounting and cash management across the company. Your first focus will be our partnership with the Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC), a growing network of in-person franchise clinics across multiple states. You'll design and own how money moves between each ULC clinic's medical practice entity, its franchise entity, and Lifeforce, and you'll make sure every dollar is tracked, reconciled, and reported correctly.
This is a hands-on role. You'll use AI and automation tools to build and keep improving the workflows for reconciliations, cash transfers, month-end close, and executive reporting as the clinic network grows.
You'll start as an individual contributor and build out the finance team as the network grows. Over time, you'll become Controller for all of Lifeforce. You'll work closely with leadership, the ULC team and franchise owners, and our outside accountants.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (Web Applications)
jobs.description:
ABOUT

Atlas is the concierge & charge card for high-net-worth individuals and their companies. We pair 24/7 concierge access with no-preset-limit spending, giving members insider access to dining, luxury travel, and experiences that are otherwise impossible to get. We've crossed $1B in annualized transaction volume and are backed by Y Combinator, Elad Gil, O1 Advisors, Eric Schmidt, and other leading fintech and consumer investors. The team is lean, senior, and fast-moving, with experience across Apple, Robinhood, Rimowa, and more.




THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to lead the design of Atlas's web applications. Our web app is where members run both their financial lives and their lifestyles — from managing business expenses, balances, and points to planning itineraries and booking dining, flights, and hotels. It needs to be as precise as a financial tool and as delightful as the experiences it unlocks.

This is a product-driven role. You'll own your work end to end: defining requirements, designing and prototyping, partnering with engineering through the build, and owning QA and testing until it ships to the exceptional standards we hold ourselves to, and that our members expect. You'll bring native fluency in the web — what makes web platforms fast, effective, and powerful — and an AI-forward way of working that gets ideas into real, testable prototypes quickly.

You'll be part of the Atlas design team, reporting to the Design Director, and working closely with Engineering, and Concierge teams. You must be based in our NYC (SoHo) or SF (FiDi) office, with an expectation of at least three days (Tue-Thu) per week in person.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own product areas of the Atlas web app end to end, from shaping requirements and success criteria through design, build, QA, and launch.

 - Design across the full member experience on web, from financial workflows like business expenses, balances, and points to lifestyle flows like itineraries, dining, and travel.

 - Help shape the concierge tools behind the scenes, partnering with our concierge team to design the internal workflows that power member bookings and requests.

 - Prototype early and often, using AI tooling to build interactive, testable web prototypes.

 - Partner closely with engineering to make smart tradeoffs, review builds in detail, and hold a high bar for polish before anything ships.

 - Own quality: partner with stakeholders to run QA passes, usability testing, and post-launch checks to make sure what ships matches what was designed.

 - Explore experimental UI patterns that bring delight and fun to everyday tasks, while keeping core interactions clear and dependable.

 - Raise the bar for visual and interaction craft across the web product, contributing to shared patterns and the design system.




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years of product design experience, with a demonstrable focus on shipping web applications.

 - A track record of acting as a product owner: defining requirements, making tradeoffs, and seeing work through to launch and beyond.

 - Native fluency in the web: responsive layouts, browser behavior, accessibility, performance, and the conventions that make web products feel fast and capable.

 - Excellent visual design skills, with a strong eye for typography, layout, and detail.

 - A rock-solid grasp of interaction design fundamentals, including hierarchy, states, feedback, navigation, and information architecture, plus motion design.

 - An AI-forward way of working, with hands-on experience using AI tools to prototype, build, and test on the web.

 - Curiosity for experimental UI patterns, and the judgment to know when delight serves the user.

 - Comfort designing data-rich, high-stakes flows, such as payments, spending, or account management.

 - An outstanding portfolio showing shipped web products with strong craft.




COMPENSATION

 - Competitive salary, equity, and 401K

 - Full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision insurance)

 - Generous vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - Complimentary Atlas membership



The salary range for this position is between $172,000 - $215,000, plus equity options at Atlas. This range may vary depending on a variety of factors considered in compensation decisions, including but not limited to skills, experience, training, degrees, and certifications. The salary range is just one aspect of our comprehensive total compensation package, which includes a range of benefits. This is a full-time, exempt **position.

In accordance with the New York City Human Rights Law, the stated salary range reflects the base pay for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, education, and skill level.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of background checks and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist I, Biostatistics
jobs.description:
At Alamar, we are passionate about enabling our customers to make scientific discoveries that translate into clinical outcomes and benefit patients. Our team is growing quickly as we develop innovative approaches to measure critical protein biomarkers from liquid samples that can enable the earliest possible detection of disease. We believe the next frontier in biology is enabled by measuring proteins at higher sensitivity in highly multiplexed assays at the push of a button, which is something only Alamar can do. As we build our team, we seek collaborative, driven, intellectually curious people committed to solving complex challenges. Our culture rewards accountability and cross functional teamwork because we believe this enables the kind of breakthrough thinking that will accelerate our mission.

We are seeking a Senior Scientist, Biostatistics to provide statistical and biostatistical expertise within Bioinformatics, supporting product development and scientific programs across the organization. The scientist will partner with product development teams, Field Application Sciences, and external industry and academic collaborators to shape study designs, analyze data, interpret findings, and translate evidence into practical decisions.

The role combines hands-on statistical work with close scientific partnership. You will help teams and collaborators answer meaningful questions with fit-for-purpose study designs and analyses, communicate results clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences, and ensure that scientific evidence informs the development and improvement of our products.

Responsibilities

Study Design and Statistical Consultation
- Partner with Bioinformatics and cross-functional colleagues to frame scientific questions and recommend appropriate study designs and analysis plans
- Advise on endpoints, controls, sample size, power, inclusion criteria, data collection, and analysis methods for feasibility, performance, and product development studies
- Review protocols, analysis plans, and study materials for statistical rigor and alignment with intended claims and use cases
- Help troubleshoot study execution and data quality issues, identifying their implications for analysis and interpretation

Data Analysis and Interpretation
- Analyze data from assay evaluations, validation studies, field studies, and other product development activities using appropriate statistical and biostatistical methods
- Apply methods such as regression, generalized linear models, mixed-effects models, survival analysis, diagnostic performance metrics, and resampling or simulation approaches as appropriate to the question
- Develop reproducible analysis workflows and clear visualizations, reports, and presentations that explain results, uncertainty, limitations, and implications
- Interpret findings in collaboration with scientific and product teams, distinguishing robust evidence from exploratory signals

Scientific Collaboration and Communication
- Support external industry and academic collaborators with study planning, data review, analysis, and scientific communication
- Present analytical approaches and findings to collaborators, adapting explanations to audiences with different levels of statistical expertise
- Work with Field Application Sciences and other internal partners to capture collaborator feedback, recurring analytical needs, and opportunities to improve study resources or products
- Contribute to abstracts, manuscripts, technical reports, and other scientific materials as appropriate

Product Development and Cross-Functional Partnership
- Work with product, assay development, laboratory, clinical, and commercial-facing teams to connect study evidence with product requirements and development decisions
- Translate field observations and collaborator questions into testable hypotheses, analysis plans, and recommendations for product improvement
- Support assessment of product performance across relevant populations, sites, instruments, workflows, and use conditions
- Contribute statistical documentation and analysis records within applicable quality processes and regulatory expectations

Qualifications

- Ph.D. in Biostatistics, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative field; or a **Master’s degree** in one of these fields with substantial relevant industry experience
- 5+ years** of experience applying statistical or biostatistical methods in biotechnology, diagnostics, life sciences, healthcare, or a related setting
- Strong grounding in study design, estimation, uncertainty, hypothesis testing, and interpretation of experimental or clinical data
- Proficiency in R; working knowledge of Python is a plus
- Experience selecting and applying statistical methods to real-world scientific questions, and explaining assumptions and limitations
- Ability to communicate clearly with collaborators and cross-functional teams, including audiences without formal statistical training
- Strong scientific writing, organization, and collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with diagnostic assay development, analytical or clinical validation, or evaluation of molecular or other life science products
- Experience supporting external academic or industry research collaborations
- Familiarity with diagnostic performance measures such as sensitivity, specificity, predictive values, ROC analysis, and confidence intervals
- Experience with repeated-measures, multi-site, longitudinal, or high-dimensional data
- Familiarity with regulated product development, quality management systems, and documentation expectations (e.g., FDA, CLIA, or ISO 13485 contexts)
- Peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, or contributions to technical reports
- Experience using AI-enabled tools to support statistical programming, data exploration, literature review, or scientific communication, with sound judgment in evaluating generated outputs

The base salary range for this full-time position is $150,000 - $160,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The ranges displayed on each job posting reflect the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries but are subject to change if the leveling of the role is adjusted.

Please Note - We participate in E-Verify to confirm authorization to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Adv Practice Reg Nurse PNE
jobs.description:
The Advance Practice Registered Nurse PNE reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics, Corporate Compliance Program and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines, and all regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Advance Practice Registered Nurse PNE is a licensed registered nurse (RN) and performs functions in accordance with clinical privileges and/or the written collaborative agreement and within the specialty of the collaborating physician. The licensed Advanced Practice Registered Nurse functions autonomously and collaborates with other health care professionals to provide high-quality, cost-effective healthcare to patients, manage health care systems, and influence health care decision-making through expert clinical reasoning, research, and theory-based practice.

Responsibilities:

• Provides direct care to patients which demonstrates clinical expertise and advanced knowledge.
• Diagnoses and manages acute and chronic health problems within specialty area of practice.
• Collaborates and consults with physicians and other health care professionals in area of clinical expertise.
• Develops educational systems and strategies for teaching patients, families and staff on topics related to area of expertise.
• Mentors graduate students in aspects of advanced practice.
• Actively participates in and/or conducts research pertinent to area of expertise.

Clinical

• Conducts comprehensive assessments of patients’ health status by taking health histories and performing advanced physical examinations in specialty area.
• Provides direct clinical care to patients as needed.
• Orders and interprets laboratory and diagnostic tests to establish diagnoses and develop a comprehensive treatment plan.
• Orders/prescribes medications, therapies, interventions, and procedures according to clinical privileges.
• Documents in the medical record all care provided and/or procedures performed for which the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse is responsible. Collaborates with all members of the multidisciplinary team to develop and direct an individualized and comprehensive treatment plan.
• Coordinates the discharge planning process with patients, families, and all members of the multidisciplinary team.
• Consults with other specialties and disciplines as appropriate to meet all health care needs of patients.

Leadership

• Participates in unit/departmental/divisional or hospital committees/task forces and professional organizations.
• Advocates for patients, families, nursing staff and other members of the healthcare community.
• Assists in the development of policies and procedures in clinical area of expertise to establish standards for clinical practice.
• Consults with NM leadership in the identification, evaluation and problem solving of clinical system and process issues.
• Collaborates with NM leadership teams to develop, implement and evaluate strategic plans for quality improvement initiatives, utilizing evidenced based practice guidelines as appropriate.
• Collaborates with physicians to lead changes in clinical practice.

Education

• Teaches and counsels patients and families in preventive care, medical conditions, plan of care, anticipated outcomes, and the use of prescribed treatments and drugs.
• Develops and participates in programs to meet educational needs of the clinical team related to area of expertise
• Serves as a role model and preceptor for graduate students.
• Provides formal and informal education to both internal and external groups pertinent to area of expertise.
• Provides formal and informal educational programs to nursing staff graduate students and other healthcare professionals pertinent to specialty area.
• Collaborates with academic institutions to provide and promote clinical learning experiences and educational programs for APRN’s, PA’s, physicians in training and all health care professionals.

Research/Quality/Outcomes

• Identifies relevant areas of clinical research and assists with development and coordination of research protocols and quality projects.
• Participate in/review evidence-based research/guidelines and apply to clinical practice.
• Collaborates with the multidisciplinary teams to conduct research and participate in clinical trials within area of expertise.
• Participate in service-line specific quality initiatives and development of outcome metrics.

Required:

• Master’s degree from an accredited school/college of nursing
• Registered Professional Nurse (IL) license
• Advance Practice Registered Nurse (IL) license
• Advanced Practice Registered Nurse certification by a national certifying body as approved by the Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation

OR

• Master of Science in Nursing Degree from a school/college of nursing
• Registered Professional Nurse (IL) license
• Advance Practice Registered Nurse (IL) license
• Advanced Practice Registered Nurse certification by a national certifying body as approved by the Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
• Basic Life Support for Healthcare Providers (American Heart Association) certification
• Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification required as specified by department
• Controlled substance license and DEA registration required as specified by the department

Preferred:

• 2 years of clinical experience in area of specialty.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Scientist, Open-Endedness
jobs.description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is seeking a highly experienced, creative, and talented Machine Learning Researcher (Open-Endedness) to join our team.

Open-Endedness is an emerging area of machine learning that aims to automate never-ending innovative processes of discovery and exploration.  The Open-Endedness Team, led by Ken Stanley, investigates in particular how a continual chain of deep transformative creativity can be maintained that far exceeds the derivative creativity seen in current models.  In effect, the systems developed on this team will go beyond simply solving problems posed by users, to conceiving the future unimagined directions of science itself.

To realize this vision, we’re seeking a broad tapestry of ML expertise to facilitate daring and unconventional investigations, including but not exclusive to pre-training, fine-tuning, RLHF, distillation, mechanistic interpretability, Bayesian and statistical methods, and quality diversity (QD) techniques.

What You'll Be Building

• Designing, implementing, and modifying generative models (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models, multimodal models) through unconventional pipelines to achieve unconventional behaviors

• Unconventional evaluation techniques, including subjective evaluation and the evaluation of interestingness

• Creative approaches to investigating, understanding, and visualizing the internal representations of large models, encompassing mechanistic interpretability but also going in new directions beyond it

• Quality diversity (QD) algorithms like MAP-Elites, novelty search with local competition, POET, OMNI, minimal criterion novelty search, etc., with LLMs or other large models potentially being updated on the inner loop.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

• Significant ML academic and/or industrial experience in ML, PhD in quantitative disciplines ideal, but will consider self-taught researchers with exceptional achievements

• Publications in relevant conferences, such as NeurIPS, ICML, AAAI, ICLR, GECCO, ICCC

• Expertise in ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow/Jax); and/or QD algorithm implementation; and/or neuroevolution algorithm implementation

• World-class expertise in at least one research area within ML

• Experience in training and deploying ML models on distributed computing services (g. AWS/GCP/Azure, or clusters)

• Excellent communication skills

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range

$288,000—$480,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Adv Practice Registered Nurse
jobs.description:
The Advanced Practice Registered Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics, Corporate Compliance Program and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines, and all regulatory and accreditation standards.

The APRN Certified Nurse Practitioner is a licensed registered nurse (RN) and performs functions in accordance with clinical privileges and/or the written collaborative agreement and within the specialty of the collaborating physician. The licensed Advanced Practice Registered Nurse functions autonomously and collaborates with other health care professionals to provide high-quality, cost-effective healthcare to patients, manage health care systems, and influence health care decision-making through expert clinical reasoning, research, and theory-based practice

Responsibilities:

• Provides direct care to patients which demonstrates clinical expertise and advanced knowledge.
• Diagnoses and manages acute and chronic health problems within specialty area of practice.
• Collaborates and consults with physicians and other health care professionals in area of clinical expertise.
• Develops educational systems and strategies for teaching patients, families and staff on topics related to area of expertise.
• Mentors graduate students in aspects of advanced practice.
• Actively participates in and/or conducts research pertinent to area of expertise.

Clinical

• Conducts comprehensive assessments of patients’ health status by taking health histories and performing advanced physical examinations in specialty area.
• Provides direct clinical care to patients as needed.
• Orders and interprets laboratory and diagnostic tests to establish diagnoses and develop a comprehensive treatment plan.
• Orders/prescribes medications, therapies, interventions, and procedures according to clinical privileges.
• Documents in the medical record all care provided and/or procedures performed for which the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse is responsible. Collaborates with all members of the multidisciplinary team to develop and direct an individualized and comprehensive treatment plan.
• Coordinates the discharge planning process with patients, families, and all members of the multidisciplinary team.
• Consults with other specialties and disciplines as appropriate to meet all health care needs of patients.

Leadership

• Participates in unit/departmental/divisional or hospital committees/task forces and professional organizations.
• Advocates for patients, families, nursing staff and other members of the healthcare community.
• Assists in the development of policies and procedures in clinical area of expertise to establish standards for clinical practice.
• Consults with NM leadership in the identification, evaluation and problem solving of clinical system and process issues.
• Collaborates with NM leadership teams to develop, implement and evaluate strategic plans for quality improvement initiatives, utilizing evidenced based practice guidelines as appropriate.
• Collaborates with physicians to lead changes in clinical practice.

Education

• Teaches and counsels patients and families in preventive care, medical conditions, plan of care, anticipated outcomes, and the use of prescribed treatments and drugs.
• Develops and participates in programs to meet educational needs of the clinical team related to area of expertise
• Serves as a role model and preceptor for graduate students.
• Provides formal and informal education to both internal and external groups pertinent to area of expertise.
• Provides formal and informal educational programs to nursing staff graduate students and other healthcare professionals pertinent to specialty area.
• Collaborates with academic institutions to provide and promote clinical learning experiences and educational programs for APRN’s, PA’s, physicians in training and all health care professionals.

Research/Quality/Outcomes

• Identifies relevant areas of clinical research and assists with development and coordination of research protocols and quality projects.
• Participate in/review evidence-based research/guidelines and apply to clinical practice.
• Collaborates with the multidisciplinary teams to conduct research and participate in clinical trials within area of expertise.
• Participate in service-line specific quality initiatives and development of outcome metrics.

Required:

• Master of Science in Nursing Degree from a school/college of nursing
• Registered Professional Nurse (IL) license
• Advance Practice Registered Nurse (IL) license
• Advanced Practice Registered Nurse certification by a national certifying body as approved by the Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
• Basic Life Support for Healthcare Providers (American Heart Association) certification
• Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification required as specified by department
• Controlled substance license and DEA registration required as specified by the department

Preferred:

• 2 years of clinical experience in area of specialty.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

jobs.title: Domino's Delivery Driver (5619)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world? And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now, Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value, and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

As a Delivery Expert you are the mechanism for delivering fast and delectably delicious pizzas to our hungry customers. As such, enthusiastic customer communication, positive personality, punctuality and sense of urgency are essential to success in this role. Additionally, the ability to maintain professional appearance in accordance with Domino’s and Team Fox image standards is required – you are the face of the brand! Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week, and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check
• Must pass Motor Vehicle Record Check, meeting company-specific standards

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Editorial Director
jobs.description:
ABOUT ATLAS

Atlas is the concierge & charge card for high-net-worth individuals and their companies. We pair 24/7 concierge access with no-preset-limit spending, giving members insider access to dining, luxury travel, and experiences that are otherwise impossible to get. We've crossed $1B in annualized transaction volume and are backed by Y Combinator, Elad Gil, O1 Advisors, Eric Schmidt, and other leading fintech and consumer investors. The team is lean, senior, and fast-moving, with experience across Apple, Robinhood, Rimowa, and more.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Editorial Director to own and develop the content function across the company.

We are an invite-only technology and lifestyle business serving a high-net-worth clientele. Our members come to us for exceptional access, experiences, and service across dining, travel, and events. Content plays an important role in delivering that experience, helping our members discover the right places, make informed decisions, and access experiences they wouldn't necessarily find on their own.

We're looking for someone with exceptional editorial judgment, a strong sense of taste, and an instinct for what makes something genuinely worth knowing about. Our approach to luxury is modern, relaxed, and approachable. We value curation over volume, substance over hype, and personality over formality.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both shaping an editorial vision and doing the work to bring it to life. You'll be responsible for researching, developing, writing, editing, and maintaining content, while establishing the standards and processes that will eventually support a small, dedicated editorial team.

You'll report to our Co-Founder & Chief Designer and work closely with the Product Design, Engineering, and Concierge teams to make content a central part of the member experience across surfaces. You must be based in our NYC (SoHo) office, with an expectation of at least three days (Tue–Thu) per week in person.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own editorial direction: Establish and develop the company's editorial voice, standards, and approach to content across dining, travel, events, and other lifestyle categories.

 - Create and curate content: Personally research, write, edit, and produce high-quality content, recommendations, guides, and other editorial materials.

 - Maintain editorial quality: Ensure content is accurate, engaging, relevant, and consistently reflects the company's standards and point of view.

 - Develop content strategy: Determine what content we should produce, how it should be organized, and how it can best serve our members across the company's products and services.

 - Build editorial processes: Establish practical workflows and systems for researching, creating, editing, organizing, and maintaining content.

 - Work across teams: Collaborate with Product Design, Engineering, and Concierge to integrate content into our technology and improve how it is created, managed, and delivered.

 - Use technology thoughtfully: Explore ways to use technology, automation, and AI to make content production more efficient and scalable without compromising quality.

 - Build a small team: Initially own the function directly, with the opportunity to hire and manage one or two additional content team members as the business grows.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience in editorial, content strategy, or digital publishing, ideally within luxury lifestyle, travel, dining, hospitality, or media.

 - Exceptional writing, editing, and research skills, with strong editorial judgment and an instinctive understanding of what makes an experience or recommendation genuinely special.

 - A strong personal sense of taste and cultural awareness, with an appreciation for modern, understated, and approachable luxury.

 - Experience managing content across multiple categories, formats, or digital channels.

 - An interest in technology and an understanding of how digital products, structured content, and automation can improve traditional editorial workflows.

 - Someone who is equally comfortable developing an editorial strategy and sitting down to research, write, edit, or organize content themselves.

 - Highly organized, resourceful, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving environment.

 - Some experience mentoring, managing, or developing other people is a plus.

We're looking for someone who combines the editorial judgment and taste of a great lifestyle publication with the resourcefulness and operating mindset of someone who enjoys building something from the ground up.




COMPENSATION

 - Competitive salary, equity, and 401K

 - Full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision insurance)

 - Generous vacation policy and paid company holidays
   
   

The salary range for this position is between $159,000 - $186,000, plus equity options at Atlas. This range may vary depending on a variety of factors considered in compensation decisions, including but not limited to skills, experience, training, degrees, and certifications. The salary range is just one aspect of our comprehensive total compensation package, which includes a range of benefits. This is a full-time, exempt **position.

In accordance with the New York City Human Rights Law, the stated salary range reflects the base pay for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, education, and skill level.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of background checks and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Structural FEA Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

The Structural Design and Analysis team is seeking a highly motivated Senior Structural FEA Engineer to support and lead the structural analysis effort on medium to large projects for a generation IV Nuclear Power Plant, and related scaled prototype and test plants. This role is responsible for the technical accuracy of assigned analyses and their alignment with project requirements, working collaboratively with an integrated design team.

Responsibilities

• Support structural design and analysis activities for Kairos Power (KP) reactor vessels and related structures (both nuclear and non-nuclear).

• Work directly with the Civil Structures, Materials Modelling, Thermal Fluids, Nuclear Design, Piping Design, Reactor Systems, and Safety Analysis teams to integrate designs that meet functional, structural integrity, manufacturability, schedule, cost, and other project requirements.

• Develop hand calculations and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) models for analyzing structures, systems, and components (SSCs) in compliance with Kairos Power (KP) internal standards and guidelines, project requirements, and industrial codes and standards, such as ASME BPVC Section III Divisions 1 and 5 and Section VIII Divisions 1 and 2.

• Perform model verification and validation (V&V) activities, including sensitivity studies and uncertainty quantification (UQ) analyses.

• Support the Software Quality Assurance (SQA) activities for analysis software and tools.

• Prepare organized and well-written technical reports and presentations to describe assumptions, methods, results, and conclusions from work performed.

• Review other engineers’ models, calculations, and reports for technical accuracy and consistency with applicable requirements.

• Plan and coordinate assigned structural analysis work, including defining analysis tasks, estimating effort, establishing milestones, and communicating technical dependencies and risks to project delivery.

• Evaluate the impact of changes to designs, materials, loading conditions, or analysis methods on completed analyses, and maintain traceability between analysis models, supporting inputs, and applicable design revisions.

• Provide technical leadership by learning, developing, and coordinating new techniques, standardizing procedures, and providing technical instruction and mentoring to department staff.

• Mentor and train entry-level engineers in stress analysis and life assessment techniques.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Material Science, or related field and at least 5 years of relevant structural analysis experience; or a PhD and at least 2 years of relevant structural analysis experience

• Proficiency in commercial FEA packages (Ansys or Abaqus)

• Experience in development of scientific code and software using Python, C++, Fortran, or similar programming languages

• Working experience with industrial codes and standards (ASME, ASCE, API, AISC, ACI, ISO, etc.)

• Familiarity with Computer-Aided Design (CAD) modelling

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Ansys Workbench/APDL and LS-DYNA

• Experience with ASME BPVC Section III, Division 5

• Experience with SolidWorks and SpaceClaim

• Experience with creep and fatigue assessment methods for metallic or graphite components subject to elevated-temperature, irradiation, and/or corrosive environments

• Experience with heat transfer and thermal stress analysis

• Experience with explicit dynamics analysis, including seismic, impact, and vibration simulations

• Experience with presenting and supporting the technical basis for structural analyses and designs during regulatory reviews, external technical reviews, or audits

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Excellent knowledge of FEA and other spatial/time discretization techniques for partial differential equation (PDE) systems

• Knowledge of uncertainty quantification (UQ), verification and validation (V&V), and model calibration

• Responsible, flexible, open to new ideas, collaborative in nature with full buy-in to the Kairos Power mission

• Team player with excellent verbal, written communication/presentation, and interpersonal skills; must be able to interact and communicate effectively at all levels of the organization.

• Ability to work with highly collaborative team

• Ability to solve problems quickly and efficiently

• Prioritizes and ensures safety of one self and others

• Ability to proactively collect, manage, and transfer knowledge

• Ability to seek different and novel ways to create efficiencies when working on problems, challenges, and issues

Physical Demands

• Ascending or descending ladders, stairs, scaffolding, ramps, scissor lifts, articulated boom lifts, and the like

• Remaining in a stationary position for prolonged periods

• Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another

• Communicating with others to exchange information

Environmental Conditions

• General office environment

• Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned

• High-concentration, demanding, and fast-paced

• Prototyping/testing environment

• Manufacturing/industrial environment

Safety and PPE

• Reading and interpreting hazardous warning signs

• Reporting issues with equipment or unsafe conditions

• Wearing proper PPE, to include face mask, face shields, gloves, safety footwear, or other PPE as required

Travel

• Some travel may be required (up to 10%)

Certification

• None required

Additional Requirements

• Occasionally requires schedule flexibility.

• Occasionally requires extended hours to support launch and critical project timelines.

jobs.description:
Lumos is looking for Service Operations Technicians to bring the future of connectivity to our customers. In this role, you'll be responsible for installing, testing, and maintaining services and equipment in homes and businesses. Technicians set up fiber facilities, including Multi-Ports, and remove company-owned ONTs as needed. You will handle provisioning, testing, maintenance, and troubleshooting of GPON/PON, routers, switches, DSL equipment, and more. Additionally, you’ll install cross-connects at cross-connect and LCC cabinets for fiber circuits. Working onsite with customers and in collaboration with our Service Operations Center (SOC), you’ll play a key role in ensuring seamless connectivity.

Why Lumos:

Lumos is transforming the future of connectivity by building one of the nation's fastest-growing 100% Fiber Optic networks. Through T-Fiber, our joint venture with T-Mobile, we're working toward a shared goal of connecting 12 to 15 million homes by 2030 while expanding access to reliable, high-speed internet in the communities we serve.

Here, you'll find more than a job, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, take ownership of your work, and help shape how we grow. We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and believe the best ideas come from people who are curious, solutions-oriented, and ready to build what's next.

What You'll Do:

• Conducts advanced OTDR traces & fiber characterization.

• Installs and troubleshoots basic voice, data, video services, & CPE (Residential Gateways, Routers, etc.).

• Manages data entry tasks, including updating trouble tickets, orders, timesheets, etc.

• Serves as a SME in operating, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing RSB CO, Remote, DLC, and COLO equipment.

• Supports RSB engineering projects, including the installation of GPON cards, turning up new Access Gear & Splitters, upgrading ONTs, and working on equipment upgrades.

• Assists Network Operations on troubleshooting, isolating, and resolving operational & hardware issues related to RSB CO, Remote, DLC, and COLO equipment.

What You'll Bring:

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Experience interacting directly with customers to troubleshoot.

• Safe driving record.

• Experience using MS Office Suite.

• Proficient in network cabling, basic electrical systems, basic telephony, and grounding/bonding (ANSI/EIA/TIA-607).

• Experience maintaining power equipment, including rectifiers, batteries, and generators.

• Ability to read & understand cross-connects for fiber LCC cabinets & splitters.

• Extensive experience with advanced GPON and fiber-based services & equipment.

• Working knowledge of voice services (SIP), video services, LAN/WAN service & hardware.

• Proficient in IP subnetting.

• Supports the development of Operations Service Technicians on the team.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

• 1+ year Fiber or Telecom industry experience required.

• High School Diploma or equivalent required.

• Valid, fully unencumbered Driver’s License required.

• Must reside within 30 minutes’ driving distance of assigned reporting location.

• Committed to continuous learning & process optimization.

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to climb utility poles (where applicable) and work at heights.

• Utilize handle extension and stepladders as required.

• Ability to work in attics, crawl spaces, and confined areas.

• Capable of lifting and transporting 50 lbs. over a distance of 50 feet.

• Near-constant use of sight, speech, hearing, comprehension, and reasoning.

Benefits & Perks:

Our commitment to communities includes recruiting and rewarding the Lumos team members who are working together to build a brighter tomorrow.

We have:

• Competitive compensation packages, including bonus options for eligible positions.

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with access to professional support for life’s challenges.

jobs.title: Domino's Assistant Manager (5619)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Chemical Technician II, 3rd Shift
jobs.description:
The Chemical Technician II is responsible for supporting operations by staging and moving manufacturing materials around the site via forklift, pallet jack, or hand.  Performing production floor support activities such as stocking materials, obtaining samples, changing filters, labeling and packaging finished materials.  Preparing tanks to receive production batches, perform compounding/transferring operations, and loading/unloading of bulk materials. Performs housekeeping tasks.  Works under the direction and supervision of more experienced operations team members.

This role will be on 3rd Shift, 10:45PM-7:00AM Mon-Fri.

The hiring rate for this role is $23.59/hr + $2/hr Shift Differential

Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Activities and duties may vary depending upon site specific needs and daily work assignments. Essential functions may include, but are not limited to:

• Moves manufacturing materials as required, including by hand.

• Prepares packaging, obtains samples, changes filters, labels and loads drums, totes, and tankers with finished product.

• Prepares tanks to receive production batches by transferring material or performing water rinsing to meet schedule requirements.

• Follows standard operating procedures including entering variables and monitoring transfers for compounding/blending materials making adjustments as needed.

• Records data and maintains paperwork and spreadsheets associated with assigned work, judging for accuracy and completeness of data.
• Follows safety procedures when handling materials and operating equipment.
• Maintains a safe and clean work environment by performing assigned housekeeping tasks.
• Follows verification process to ensure highest quality standards are met.
• Obtains assistance from higher level production personnel if problems arise or normal instructions are insufficient.

Minimum Requirements:

• High School Diploma or equivalent (GED) or 3+ years of relevant manufacturing work experience.
• This job may require the periodic use of a respirator. Proper fit of the respirator requires the employee to be clean shaven.
• Must regard safety as a core value; must serve as role model for other employees and encourage adherence to safety practices, policies and procedures.
• Must be able to actively contribute in a team based environment, encourage open communication and positive interaction with peers and management to effectively reach a common goal.
• Must have a strong service and quality focus, be able to address issues effectively when problems arise, and take initiative to understand root cause then communicate/educate team in a timely manner.
• Must demonstrate proficiency in essential tasks of the job and a willingness to learn and share knowledge; must take initiative to cross-train and sustain acquired skills.
• Must have demonstrated record of flexibility and dependability in order to support production and customer focus.
• Must have a strong detail orientation and be able to follow written and oral instruction.
• Must be able and willing to work overtime, including short-notice requests.
• Ability to stand on feet for several hours
• Mechanical aptitude

Preferred Requirements:

• Associate certificate/2 years of college or equivalent experience preferred.
• EHS & Quality training desired, hazardous materials training desired.
• Fork lift and Yard Truck experience desired.
• 1-2 years chemical manufacturing or applicable experience strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Domino's Assistant Manager (5612)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Dispatchable Field Service Representative
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

As a Dispatchable Field Service Representative, you’ll be on the front lines providing operations and maintenance expertise on water treatment systems for our customers from one of a variety of industries. This mission critical role involves working on a variety of technologies including, media filtration, softening, reverse osmosis (RO), ion exchange (IX), de-oxygenation, electro deionization, and ultrafiltration (UF).

Key Characteristics

• Conduct maintenance and calibration activities
• Consult with customer management and operation teams
• Excellent mechanical know how and problem-solving skills
• Ensure contract compliance of volume and quality specifications
• Operate, monitor, and optimize equipment performance

Duties & Responsibilities

• Carry out mechanical, electrical and controls troubleshooting on equipment such as valves, air compressors, ejectors, process pumps, blowers, and instrumentation
• Create and maintain site paperwork, and provide customers with detailed technical summaries of work performed
• Maintain inventory of spare parts and adequate supply of chemicals and replacement parts Monitor and maintain chemical injection systems
• Perform analytical testing such as: turbidity, hardness, chlorine, pH, CO2, O2, SDI, TOC, in addition to various other site-specific testing requirements
• Review customer plant installations and compare against WTS reference drawings (P&IDs, electrical schematics, general arrangement, etc.)
• Other duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and remotely with project teams
• Provide customers with informal training around operation and maintenance of their system

Education & Experience

Required:

• High School Diploma / GED / Home School Certification OR international equivalent
• 2+ years’ experience of service/maintenance or equivalent in an industrial environment
• Valid Driver’s License

Preferred:

• Bachelor or Associates Degree in Science/Engineering (STEM) or technical certificate in Instrumentation

Working Conditions:

• Ability to travel within the region as needed

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Financial Services
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Senior Software Engineer Financial Services

At the heart of the PlayStation Network is the Commerce Platform, servicing 30+ million customers daily. The platform delivers services including product browsing, purchasing, subscription fulfillment, and payment options.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior level Engineer to help drive the ongoing evolution of PlayStation’s Global Financial Systems, with a strong focus on building event-driven pipelines and intuitive frontends. While your initial focus will be delivering scalable solutions for PlayStation’s finance systems, anticipate growth potential to expand into other areas across the business, driving efficiency and innovation.

Responsibilities:

• Lead & Innovate: Architect and develop robust, event-driven microservices in Go, designed to manage high-volume, real-time financial transactions and data flows.

• Modernize & Refine: Translate legacy ETL and reporting systems into the modern tech stack, moving from NodeJS, Informatica to primarily React and Go

• Collaborate & Impact: Work multi-functionally with teams across engineering, product management, finance, and compliance to ensure solutions are resilient, compliant, and strategically aligned.

• Leverage AI/ML: Pioneer the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning to automate manual finance tasks such as reconciliations, reporting, forecasting, and financial journal creation-enhancing accuracy, efficiency, and innovation.

• Real-Time Excellence: Design, deploy, and optimize streaming technologies like Kafka to deliver real-time financial insights and ensure rapid response capabilities.

• Strategic Integration: Advocate and facilitate seamless integration of microservices across diverse financial applications and services, driving scalability, reliability, and future-proof solutions.

Skills and Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field – or equivalent professional experience

• 6+ years of experience in large-scale software engineering, specializing in event-driven architectures and distributed systems.

• Expertise in Golang or similar languages, building highly scalable, real-time microservices as well as REST APIs

• Proficiency in designing, building and maintaining single-page applications using React or similar frameworks

• Capability to automate financial processes such as payment settlements and reconciliation, revenue recognition, and royalties, with consideration of how to extend similar solutions to non-financial systems.

• Proficiency in SQL and data modeling with a wide variety of databases. Nice to have experience with additional reporting databases such as Oracle and Snowflake.

• Experience working with cloud platforms, including managing hybrid cloud/on-prem environments in AWS.

• Proficiency with the following tools (or similar): Issue Tracking (e.g. JIRA, Service Now), Collaboration (e.g. Confluence, Trello), Communication (e.g. Slack, Webex, Skype for Business), Version Control (e.g. Github), Automation (e.g. Jenkins, Ansible, CloudFormation, Terraform)

• Extensive experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD). You should be proficient in automating build, test, and deployment processes using modern CI/CD tools and platforms (e.g. Github Actions, Jenkins, etc).

Why SIE?

This is your opportunity to be at the forefront of designing and implementing pioneering technology that powers a global entertainment leader. You’ll work on exciting, impactful systems that touch millions of users, while also having the flexibility to grow your skills and contribute across various business areas.

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive salary

• 401K with company match, education assistance, generous paid leave, and more

• On-site gym and café

• Break rooms with networked PlayStation consoles and monthly game voucher

• Remote work flexibility with opportunities to collaborate across global teams

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.

$177,300—$265,900 USD

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.

We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.

Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.

jobs.title: Patient Access Specialist
jobs.description:
The Patient Access Specialist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NMHC, adheres to the organizations Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Hours:

Schedule 3:30p-12:00A

Alternating Weekends

Week 1: Sun, Tues, Weds, Thurs, Fri

Week 2: Mon, Weds, Thurs, Sat

Rotational holiday coverage.

Responsibilities:

• Consistently practices Patients First philosophy and adheres to high standards of customer service. This includes setting an example to peers, coworkers, etc. by fostering a team atmosphere.
• Responds to questions and concerns.
• Forwards, directs, and notifies Team Lead or Operations Coordinator of extraordinary issues as necessary.
• Maintains patient confidentiality per HIPAA regulations.
• Provides exceptional customer service to patients which establish a positive first impression of Northwestern Medicine.
• Exceeds all consumer requests and alerts management of issues or concerns that require escalation.
• Correctly identifies and collects patient demographic information in accordance with organization standards.
• Interacts with various hospital departments and physicians offices to effectively schedule and direct patients through the NMHC systems in a patient/customer friendly manner.

• Performs medical necessity checks as necessary for scheduled services, communicates options to patient if appointment fails.
• Informs patients of any issues with securing the financial account for their encounter.
• Completes out-of-pocket estimations as requested by patients.
• Provides training and education as needed.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
• Completes other duties assigned by manager.
• Cross-training between various departments will take place to ensure coverage.

• Uses effective service recovery skills to solve problems or service breakdowns when they occur.
• Utilizes department and hospital policies and procedures to complete assigned tasks.
• Adheres to all department policies and compliance requirements.

• Other duties as assigned.

• Communicates information to the patient regarding questions about physician referrals, insurance referrals and consultations.
