jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Enterprise Security
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.



We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.




THE ROLE:

You will build and operate the security controls that protect Parallel's people, devices, and corporate systems: the SaaS applications we run on, the laptops we work from, and the identities, OAuth grants, and AI tools that connect them. You build these controls and run them yourself, working closely with IT.

You will work across endpoint security, device trust, SaaS hardening, third-party app access, and data loss prevention. You will bring corporate signals into our detection platform and help respond when something goes wrong. You will favor controls that are automated and enforced by default over ones that depend on people remembering a policy.




ABOUT YOU:

You have deep, hands-on experience securing a modern corporate environment: SaaS-first, cloud identity, and a macOS fleet. You know how attackers actually get into companies like ours, through phishing, stolen sessions, over-permissioned OAuth apps, and unmanaged devices, and you put controls where they break those paths. You can judge whether a control is worth its cost and noise before we buy or build it.

You treat corporate security as an engineering problem. You automate checks and fixes through APIs rather than clicking through admin consoles, and you would rather ship a control that covers most of the company this month than a perfect one next year. You can roll out a change that touches every employee without breaking how people work, and you work well with IT, engineering, and the rest of the company to get it adopted.




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE:

 - Several years building and operating security controls in corporate, SaaS, or cloud environments

 - Experience deploying and running EDR across a macOS fleet, including rollout, tuning, and response, and using MDM to enforce hardening

 - Strong understanding of identity in SaaS environments: SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth, SCIM, and conditional access, with hands-on experience in Okta, Google Workspace, or similar

 - Experience designing and rolling out device trust, so company data and systems are reachable only from managed, healthy devices

 - Experience hardening Google Workspace and other SaaS applications, including third-party app and OAuth access, admin roles, and sharing controls

 - Experience running data loss prevention that catches real data leaving without burying the team in alerts

 - Strong coding and automation skills in Python, Go, or similar, including working against SaaS and MDM APIs and with infrastructure as code

 - Experience writing detections for corporate and endpoint activity, and responding to incidents involving them

 - Experience with SOC 2, customer security audits, or securing AI tools and agents is a plus




LIFE AT PARALLEL

We believe in a fully in person work culture 5 days a week. We’re building strong offices in San Francisco, Palo Alto, Austin, and New York. Your office and in office days will depend on your team, and we will walk you through the details during the interview process. We’re a flat, talent-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems.



We seek like-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values:

 - Own customer impact: It’s on us to ensure real-world outcomes for our customers.

 - Obsess over craft: Perfect every detail because quality compounds.

 - Accelerate change: Ship fast, adapt faster, and move frontier ideas into production.

 - Create win-wins: Creatively turn trade-offs into upside.

 - Make high-conviction bets: Try and fail. But succeed an unfair amount.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary

 - Generous equity

 - Visa sponsorships

 - 401K plans

 - Daily lunch & office snacks

 - Dinner at the office

 - Unlimited vacation

 - Caltrain pass reimbursement

jobs.title: Domino's Delivery Driver (5612)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world? And schedules that work with you, not against you? You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Right now, Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. As a Delivery Expert you are the mechanism for delivering fast and delectably delicious pizzas to our hungry customers. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

jobs.title: Manager, Corporate Events

jobs.description:
Role Purpose

At NBCUniversal, the Corporate Events Department produces high-impact experiences for clients and C-suite executives across some of the most recognized brands in media and entertainment — from marquee tentpole events and corporate initiatives to brand activations and large-scale client programs.

The Corporate Events Manager is an experienced event lead who independently drives small to mid-sized programs from ideation through execution while also contributing to larger-scale events as part of a broader team. This individual brings 5–7 years of experience in events, hospitality, entertainment, or related industries, along with a proven ability to lead programs, navigate complex logistics, and collaborate effectively across stakeholders. The Manager serves as a key partner to internal teams, clients, vendors, and executives, balancing strategic thinking with flawless execution. This position may provide guidance and oversight to Coordinators, Associates, Pages, or project-based team members depending on event staffing and department structure.

This role is built for an events professional who is already working at the Manager level. The ideal candidate brings strong, Manager-level hospitality experience, is confident and polished interacting with C-suite executives, and has the knowledge to take on programs immediately after starting. In return, the role offers a clear path for growth within the department, with the opportunity to advance to Senior Manager and Director roles over time.

Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The position reports to a Vice President within the Corporate Events Department. At NBCUniversal, you’ll have opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact alongside some of the industry’s most talented professionals.

Job Duties

Event Leadership & Execution

• Lead small to mid-sized programs from initial planning through on-site execution and post-event reconciliation
• Take ownership of assigned programs immediately upon starting, applying established Manager-level hospitality expertise with minimal ramp-up
• Contribute to larger-scale and high-profile events in partnership with senior team members, owning specific workstreams, logistics, vendors, or operational components within the broader program
• Oversee all aspects of assigned events, including venue sourcing, vendor coordination, run-of-show development, premium sourcing, guest experience, and on-site logistics
• Partner closely with internal stakeholders and clients throughout the planning and execution process, facilitating meetings and ensuring clear communication and follow-through
• Interface directly with clients and C-suite executives with professionalism and discretion
• Serve as a trusted, polished point of contact for C-suite executives and VIP guests, anticipating needs and delivering white-glove hospitality
• Develop and track event budgets, process invoices, and support post-event reconciliation
• Negotiate contracts, track deliverables, and maintain detailed production timelines
• Coordinate event registration, attendee communications, and guest management to ensure a seamless experience
• Produce or oversee the creation of digital and printed event materials in collaboration with vendors and internal/external partners
• Travel domestically and internationally to execute and support events
• Provide on-site support across the department’s broader event portfolio as needed

Team Collaboration & Department Support

• Provide guidance and day-to-day direction to Associates, Coordinators, Pages, and project-based team members assigned to events
• Foster a collaborative and supportive working environment while helping junior team members strengthen their event management skills
• Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams on complex programs and department initiatives
• Contribute to operational improvements, internal processes, and shared departmental resources
• Maintain awareness of emerging trends across hospitality, food and beverage, entertainment, sports, venues, experiential marketing, and premium gifting

Basic Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work experience
• 5+ years of experience in events, hospitality, entertainment, experiential marketing, production, client services, or related fields
• Demonstrated experience independently leading and executing events from concept through completion
• Experience working with executive-level stakeholders, clients, vendors, and cross-functional teams
• Current or recent experience at the Manager level (or equivalent) in events or hospitality, with direct ownership of programs, budgets, and vendor relationships
• Proven track record of leading high-touch hospitality programs for executive, client, and VIP audiences
• Demonstrated comfort and credibility interacting directly with C-suite executives

Desired Characteristics

• Solid project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple events and timelines simultaneously
• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
• Experience managing budgets, contracts, production schedules, and vendor relationships
• Ability to remain adaptable, resourceful, and solutions-oriented in high-pressure environments
• Collaborative team player who can effectively guide and support project teams
• Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences
• Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and event registration platforms
• Knowledge of current trends within hospitality, entertainment, food and beverage, sports, experiential marketing, and premium gifting
• Ability to hit the ground running and take full ownership of programs from day one
• Interest in long-term growth within the department, with a path toward Senior Manager and Director roles

Additional Requirements

• Willing to work in New York, NY
• Able to travel up to 40%
• Work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the event schedule

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $90,000 - $105,000  (bonus eligible).

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Inside Delivery
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

• Creating a strategic roadmap and services architecture for how Scout Motors will sell and transact new and used vehicles to retail customers, from purchase through delivery.

• Supporting and driving the definition and design of the ideal transaction process from an operational perspective (documentation, information flows, and third-party integrations).

• Leading vehicle registration compliance efforts across all active and future sales markets, including program build-out, process design, and cross-functional enablement.

• Developing and documenting comprehensive knowledge of vehicle sales and registration requirements across all states, counties, and localities.

• Designing and operationalizing transaction and delivery workflows and an efficient operating model that ensures a scalable, reliable, customer-centric experience.

• Partnering closely with product managers and engineers to translate operational needs into requirements, prioritize improvements, and develop scalable tools and vendor integrations for end-to-end vehicle sales transactions and deliveries, including documentation, payments, financing, registration, and delivery readiness.

• Leading the operational implementation of AI and automation across the transaction and delivery journey, identifying practical use cases that reduce manual work, improve document accuracy, and help customers complete their purchase and prepare for delivery.

• Owning business testing, rollout, and team adoption of new tools, with clear escalation paths and appropriate human review; measuring impact on transaction completion time, accuracy, team productivity, and the customer experience to guide ongoing improvements.

• Creating a technical support model for sales transaction workflows and operating models.

• Coordinating with Finance to define and build systems that accurately recognize vehicle revenue, ensuring alignment between operations and financial reporting.

• Participating in vendor evaluations and providing operational insight for standard operating procedures, transaction policies, and retail training.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.

• This role requires 4 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

• 10+ years experience managing automotive sales transactions.

• Deep technical acumen and comprehensive regulatory knowledge, especially in vehicle registration and titling requirements.

• Proven experience in early-stage companies: building teams, policies, tools, and pivoting from design to operational execution.

• Experience implementing AI or automation in operational workflows and working closely with product managers and engineers to deliver scalable tools and measurable improvements in efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.

• Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams, with a focus on fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.

• Collaborative mindset and ability to bring together both internal and external teams behind a common vision; skillful at organizational navigation and cross-functional collaboration at all levels; ability to develop effective partnerships and relationships.

• High agency with capability to independently solve problems and develop strategic, sustainable solutions.

• Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

• 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

• Corporate Vehicle Program with: Eligibility for 1 assigned vehicle A mobility stipend

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $150,000.00 - $181,250.00

Internal leveling code: M7

Notice to applicants:

• To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.

• Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

• Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

• Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Linear Electric Machines
jobs.description:
Hyliion is committed to creating innovative solutions that enable clean, flexible and affordable electricity production. The Company’s primary focus is to develop distributed power generators that can operate on various fuel sources to future-proof against an ever-changing energy economy.

Job Purpose

The Principal Engineer, Linear Electric Machines is the technical authority for the Linear Electric Machine (LEM), the permanent-magnet linear motor/generator at the heart of every KARNO™ generator. Each 200 kW KARNO Core uses four LEMs to convert free-piston motion into power on a native 800 VDC bus, and the same machine is the building block for Hyliion’s multi-megawatt U.S. Navy and data center systems. This position is the single technical authority for the LEM, accountable for electromagnetic and mechanical design, insulation and materials, test and qualification, certification, and supplier and manufacturing readiness across the current production machine and future generations. The role works with the LEM engineering team in Cedar Park, TX to scale in-house LEM production to volume at target cost, yield, and reliability, and partners with the Hyliion R&D team in Cincinnati, OH.

AI at Hyliion

At Hyliion, AI is core to how we work. We equip every team member with leading AI tools and count on you to use them — to move faster, solve harder problems, and help us realize the full potential of KARNO technology for the world.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Design authority: Serve as the single accountable technical owner for the KARNO LEM across its lifecycle (requirements, architecture, design, verification, release, production, and field performance) for both the current production design and future generations.

• Technical leadership: Provide technical direction and mentoring to LEM engineers; lead design reviews and set LEM design standards, analysis methods, and tools.

• Electromagnetic design: Own electromagnetic design and optimization of tubular permanent-magnet linear machines, including topology, magnet and winding design, magnetic circuit, force constant, cogging/detent force, losses, efficiency, and demagnetization margin, using 2D/3D FEA and analytical models correlated to test data.

• Mechanical design: Own translator, stator, and housing mechanical design, including translator structural integrity and fatigue of high-cycle reciprocating components, air-gap eccentricity and radial side load, tolerance stack-ups and GD&T, thermal management, and mechanical interfaces to the KARNO Core and position sensing.

• Insulation and thermal: Own the stator insulation system and thermal design, including insulation materials and processes, temperature sensing, partial discharge and E-field stress under inverter-fed operation, thermal modeling, and thermal aging for long-life continuous duty.

• Machine–drive integration: Partner with power electronics, controls, and systems teams on machine–drive co-design: 800 VDC architecture, inverter interface, position feedback, and transient load-step performance.

• Next-generation roadmap: Define and execute the LEM technology roadmap for higher power density, higher efficiency, and lower cost, including topology and magnet-array studies, coil and core concepts, and scaling for multi-megawatt KARNO systems.

• Manufacturing scale-up: Lead DFM/DFA for the in-house LEM line: define critical-to-quality characteristics and process windows for stator and translator manufacturing and assembly; drive fixtures, tooling, work instructions, travelers, and repair procedures; and improve yield, cycle time, and cost from prototype rates to volume production.

• Test and validation: Define the LEM verification and production test strategy, including end-of-line testing (force constant, back-EMF, resistance, insulation resistance, hipot, surge, partial discharge), test-rig characterization of losses and efficiency across operating conditions and temperature, and qualification and life testing.

• Supply chain: Own technical specifications and supplier qualification for critical LEM materials and components (permanent magnets, soft magnetic materials, conductors and insulation materials, high-voltage interconnects, and sensors); drive second-sourcing, incoming inspection, and cost reduction with Sourcing and Quality.

• Quality and reliability: Lead DFMEA/PFMEA, reliability modeling, root cause analysis (8D), MRB/NCR disposition, and corrective action for build and field issues, using KARNO Cloud telemetry and teardown findings to close the loop into design.

• Certification and configuration control: Maintain LEM certification (UL 1004-series via NRTL, including critical-components list control) and support KARNO-level UL 2200, MIL-STD, and customer requirements; own drawing and ECN release in the PLM system and ensure changes are assessed for certification impact before release.

• Technical representation: Represent the LEM in customer, U.S. Navy, partner, and supplier technical reviews; contribute to invention disclosures, patents, and technical proposals.

• Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned, needed, or required for the business.

Qualifications

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Qualifications include:

• Education, Experience and Certifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Electromechanical Engineering or a closely related field required; MS or PhD focused on electric machines, electromagnetics, or power conversion strongly preferred. 12+ years designing, developing, and releasing electric motors or generators, including permanent-magnet machines taken from concept through production (10+ years with an MS; 8+ years with a PhD). Demonstrated technical leadership on multidisciplinary engineering programs, including mentoring engineers and leading design reviews. Demonstrated ownership of both the electromagnetic and mechanical design of an electric machine product, or deep expertise in one with substantial hands-on depth in the other. Track record launching or scaling electric machine production: winding and insulation systems, magnet assembly, end-of-line test, and supplier development. Experience with linear machines (linear alternators, free-piston generators, tubular PM machines, or linear actuators) strongly preferred. Experience with high-voltage (800 V class), inverter-fed machines and insulation system qualification and certification (e.g., UL 1004, UL 1446, IEC 60034-18-41) preferred.

• Skills and Abilities Expert command of electric machine theory: PM machine design, magnetic materials (NdFeB grades and demagnetization, soft magnetic materials), loss mechanisms (copper, core, magnet eddy current), and force ripple and cogging. Expert in 2D/3D electromagnetic FEA (ANSYS Maxwell, JMAG, Altair Flux, or COMSOL) and analytical sizing and optimization in MATLAB/Simulink or Python; proficient with coupled thermal and structural analysis (Motor-CAD, ANSYS Mechanical, or equivalent). Strong mechanical design fundamentals: 3D CAD (Siemens NX preferred), GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis, and fatigue of high-cycle components. Working knowledge of power electronics and motor control: field-oriented control, inverter-driven insulation stress, and machine–inverter co-design. Hands-on test and measurement: test-rig and fixture design, efficiency mapping, winding analyzers (surge, PD, hipot), data acquisition, and correlation of test data to models. Manufacturing and quality tools: DFM/DFA, DFMEA/PFMEA, SPC and process capability, 8D/root cause analysis, MRB, and supplier qualification (APQP/PPAP-style). Strong knowledge of and hands-on experience applying electric machine standards and certification (UL 1004, UL 1446, UL 2200, IEC 60034, NEMA MG 1, IEEE). Hands-on technical leader who mentors engineers, drives decisions with data, and balances technical depth with schedule and cost priorities in a fast-growing company. Clear communicator with executives, customers, U.S. Navy reviewers, suppliers, and certification bodies; fluent user of AI tools to accelerate analysis, data review, documentation, and design exploration.

Role Classification and Working Conditions

This is a salaried, exempt-level position. This position typically works in a production/assembly/engineering lab environment.

Physical/Other Requirements

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 20 kg (44 pounds).

• Ability to work safely around strong permanent-magnet assemblies, high-voltage test equipment, and pressurized systems, following Hyliion safety procedures and PPE requirements.

• Ability to travel, as needed, by plane, automobile, etc., including regular travel to Hyliion’s Milford, Ohio R&D facility and to supplier sites (estimated ~20%).

We are not accepting candidates who require sponsorship for this role at this time.

Benefits:

• Medical Plans, with PPO or HDHP options

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, disability, veteran status.  If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to otherwise participate in the employment selection process, please direct your inquires to Hyliion’s human resources department at HR@hyliion.com.

jobs.title: Domino's General Manager (5609)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Customer Experience
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Customer Experience (CX) team and help shape how home service businesses get support, hear from us, and succeed with Jobber.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, electricians, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber, they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn't like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That's why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!



Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail's Canada's Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada's Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. We've come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we've just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkfZmHrRLx4&list=PLoktA_D-2UEnxMLfCe93bANKXVXd2bdN8&index=24.




THE TEAM

Customer Experience (CX)'s mission is to set service providers up to succeed with Jobber every day.

We own our in-product support experience, sign-up and onboarding, and cart and checkout, along with the customer profiles, industry success playbooks, and AI-powered tools that help each provider reach the next growth milestone that matters to their business. CX also owns customer trust at Jobber: how we earn it, and how we measure it.

CX is a horizontal team, which means our work touches every part of Jobber. We partner with product, design and engineering teams throughout the company, and with leaders across Customer Success, Support, Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations, to set goals and track progress.




THE ROLE

Reporting to the VP, Customer Experience Innovation, you will lead product strategy and execution for key areas of the CX roadmap. You'll work alongside our CX leadership team across Product, Engineering, and Design to set direction, define what success looks like, and deliver results.

This is an opportunity to take on some of Jobber's most important customer problems, with a clear mandate to rethink how we support, coach, and communicate with our customers using AI. Your work will span our customer channels and the AI agents behind them, proactive coaching built on customer profiles and industry success playbooks, and omni-channel communications in and out of the product. The areas you own may shift as our priorities do.




AS A SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER, CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE, YOU WILL:

 - Lead end-to-end product development for key CX initiatives, from discovery and strategy through to delivery.

 - Get close to our customers, talking with service providers and our Marketing, Support, and Success teams to understand their pain points first-hand.

 - Use data and customer insights to drive decisions, identifying the biggest opportunities, sizing their impact, and measuring results.

 - Think in systems, connecting support, communications, and the in-product experience so they work as one for our customers.

 - Work horizontally across Jobber, partnering with other product teams and with Customer Success, Support, Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations to prioritize key strategies and initiatives.

 - Shape how AI supports our customers and teams, including when to automate, when to bring in a person, and how we measure quality and trust.

 - Define and execute the roadmap, balancing short-term wins with long-term innovation.

 - Own the outcomes for your area, with accountability for how easily customers get help, how quickly their issues are resolved, and how successful they are with Jobber, and report on progress to senior leadership.




TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU SHOULD HAVE:

 - Proven experience as a Senior Product Manager in a SaaS or technology company, with a track record of driving measurable outcomes.

 - Experience owning customer-facing products in areas like onboarding, adoption, retention, or customer support. We care more about how you've improved customers' lives than which industry you've worked in.

 - A deep curiosity about customers. You talk to customers regularly, dig into their pain points, and bring what you learn back to your team.

 - Strong systems thinking, with the ability to connect customer needs, product experiences, and business outcomes, and to explain complex systems simply.

 - Strong analytical skills. You're comfortable getting into the data yourself, and you know how to turn what you find into a clear recommendation.

 - A track record of leading through influence, ideally on a horizontal or platform team, aligning product teams and business stakeholders around shared goals.

 - A strong ability to translate across technical and non-technical domains. You're comfortable going deep on trade-offs with engineers and bringing business stakeholders along.

 - A commitment to earning customer trust, building experiences that serve customers for the long term.

 - Exceptional communication, strategic thinking, and execution skills, with the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and motivate teams around bold goals.




BONUS POINTS (BUT NOT A DEAL-BREAKER) IF YOU HAVE:

 - Experience building chat, messaging, or omni-channel communication products.

 - Experience building AI or LLM-powered products, such as AI agents, assistants, or help desk platforms (for example, Fin or Zendesk AI).

 - Experience working closely with Customer Success, Marketing, or Support organizations.

 - Experience in vertical SaaS or serving small businesses.




LOCATION

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person. We prefer candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo. We're also open to exceptional candidates working remotely in Canada.




COMPENSATION

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $120,120, a midpoint of $171,600, and a maximum salary of $223,080, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills and experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. You'll also have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

What you can expect from Jobber:

 - A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

 - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

 - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

 - To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.



A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

jobs.title: Vehicle Body Damage Inspector (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Auto Body Preppers with a minimum of 6 months of professional automotive prepping experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Entry-level Auto Body Repair Technician, you’ll be expected to prep vehicles for paint, including sanding, masking, taping, bagging, unbagging/tear down, and buffing.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Pay Range: $22 - $24 / Hourly

2nd Shift Schedule: Monday-Thursday 6:30pm - 5:30am

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of paint roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see other roles available to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

• Paint Prepper (min 6 months professional experience): prepare vehicles for cosmetic paintwork, including sanding, masking, taping, bagging, unbagging/tear down, and buffing

• Entry-Level Painter (min 1 year professional experience): prime vehicles and perform final sanding before the vehicle is painted, along with buffing, touch-up, paint mixing, and airbrush.

• Mid-Level Painter (min 3 years professional experience): match/mix paint color and use water-based paint to paint the vehicle inside our paint booths

• Experienced Painter (min 5 years professional experience): painting (base coats, tri-coats, solid, metallic, and clear coats), blending adjacent panels, and paint correcting vehicles.

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

• Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles

• Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

• Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

jobs.title: Sr. Specialist, Material & Chemical Conformity
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

The Senior Specialist, Material & Chemical Conformity will serve as a key subject matter expert responsible for ensuring Scout Motors’ products, components, and materials meet applicable material and chemical regulatory requirements. Reporting to the Director, Sustainability & Product Stewardship, this role will independently lead complex compliance activities, regulatory impact assessments, supplier escalations, and program controls supporting product development, manufacturing, and vehicle launch.

The role will translate evolving material and substance regulations into practical requirements, standards, processes, and system controls for Scout and its supply base. Working closely with Engineering, Procurement, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, EHS, Legal, and suppliers, the Senior Specialist will provide technical guidance, resolve complex compliance issues, strengthen data and process governance, and support consistent execution of Scout’s Material & Chemical Conformity program.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Product Material & Chemical Compliance

• Lead complex material and substance compliance activities for Scout products, components, and assemblies throughout product development and change-management processes.

• Interpret and apply applicable requirements including TSCA, PFAS restrictions, California Proposition 65, REACH, RoHS, SCIP, GADSL, and other material and restricted-substance requirements relevant to Scout products and supply chains.

• Translate regulatory and internal requirements into practical product requirements, supplier expectations, compliance criteria, and operating procedures.

• Review and resolve complex IMDS, material declaration, and restricted-substance compliance issues requiring senior-level judgment or cross-functional coordination.

• Maintain and continuously improve Scout restricted, prohibited, and declarable substance requirements and related material compliance standards.

• Partner with Engineering and product teams to evaluate material or component changes and identify potential compliance impacts before implementation.

Regulatory Intelligence & Program Governance

• Monitor emerging material and chemical regulations and assess potential impacts to Scout products, components, suppliers, and business processes.

• Lead regulatory impact assessments and develop recommendations, implementation requirements, and transition plans for new or changing obligations.

• Establish and maintain material compliance procedures, standards, controls, decision criteria, and supporting documentation.

• Coordinate implementation of regulatory changes across affected functions, systems, suppliers, and product programs.

• Maintain visibility into regulatory risks, open compliance issues, implementation gaps, and required decisions, escalating material concerns as appropriate.

• Support development of program metrics, reporting, and management reviews that provide clear visibility into compliance status, risks, and priorities.

Supplier Compliance & Issue Resolution

• Partner with Procurement, Supplier Quality, Engineering, and suppliers to establish and maintain material and chemical reporting expectations throughout the supply chain.

• Lead resolution of significant supplier material-compliance issues, including incomplete or inaccurate declarations, restricted-substance findings, and recurring reporting deficiencies.

• Assess supplier compliance risks and support development of corrective actions, recovery plans, and escalation strategies where requirements are not being met.

• Provide technical guidance to suppliers and internal stakeholders regarding material declaration requirements, restricted substances, and Scout compliance expectations.

• Support supplier readiness and product-launch activities by ensuring material compliance requirements and critical data are addressed in alignment with program milestones.

Systems, Data Governance, & Compliance Assurance

• Establish and maintain controls that support the quality, completeness, traceability, and reliability of material and chemical compliance data.

• Serve as a key business stakeholder for material compliance systems and digital tools, defining business requirements and supporting configuration, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement.

• Identify opportunities to improve automation, data quality, efficiency, and visibility across material compliance processes.

• Support compliance audits, internal assessments, and regulatory or customer inquiries by ensuring required records, evidence, and supporting documentation are accurate and available.

• Lead investigation and resolution of significant material or substance compliance nonconformances and support implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

• Provide technical guidance and subject-matter support to other Material & Chemical Conformity team members on complex regulatory, supplier, data, and system issues.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.

• This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

• Travel: Occasional business travel to Scout Motors’ facilities and suppliers will be required. Valid driver's license required.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Environmental Science, Toxicology, Engineering, or a related scientific or technical field required; advanced degree preferred.

• 7+ years of progressive experience in material compliance, product stewardship, regulatory compliance, chemical compliance, or related disciplines supporting manufacturing or product development.

• Strong working knowledge of material and substance regulations and frameworks such as TSCA, PFAS restrictions, California Proposition 65, REACH, RoHS, SCIP, GADSL, and related requirements.

• Demonstrated experience interpreting regulatory requirements and translating them into product, supplier, process, or system requirements.

• Strong working knowledge of IMDS and automotive material-declaration processes, including experience resolving complex supplier or product-compliance issues.

• Experience leading regulatory impact assessments, compliance investigations, corrective actions, or audit-readiness activities.

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex compliance data, identify risks and gaps, and translate findings into practical recommendations and actions.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills with the ability to influence Engineering, Procurement, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, suppliers, and other functions without direct authority.

• Ability to operate independently, manage multiple priorities, and provide technical guidance in a fast-paced product-development and manufacturing environment.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

• 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $110,000.00 - $135,000.00

Internal leveling code: IC8

Notice to applicants:

• To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.

• Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

• Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

• Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Domino's Delivery Driver (5609)
jobs.description:

That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now, Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value, and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences, and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be apart of, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

jobs.title: Lead, Retail Network Readiness
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

The Lead, Retail Network Readiness will coordinate and integrate Administration’s work required to support the development and launch of Scout Motors’ retail network. Reporting to the Vice President, Administration, this role will work across Real Estate, Facilities, Security, Environment, Health & Safety, Workplace Services, Sustainability & Product Stewardship, and other Administration functions to ensure key requirements, milestones, dependencies, risks, and readiness activities are clearly understood and actively managed.

The Lead will coordinate Administration activities supporting retail development and launch, maintaining visibility into milestones, dependencies, schedule and cost pressures, and unresolved issues that could affect timely and successful store openings. The role will also serve as a key coordination point with Commercial Operations and other business functions such as IT, Legal, Procurement, and Finance where cross-functional dependencies affect Administration’s ability to meet retail launch requirements. The position will provide senior leadership with a clear assessment of Administration progress and readiness for each retail launch, including material risks, unresolved issues, and decisions requiring leadership attention.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Retail Network Integration & Readiness

• Lead Administration planning and coordination for new retail locations across the United States.

• Establish and maintain the Administration retail delivery framework, including required functional deliverables, key workstreams, milestones, ownership, dependencies, and launch requirements.

• Integrate functional plans across Administration departments into an integrated Administration plan for each retail location.

• Track progress against key milestones and identify schedule, scope, cost, resource, or execution risks that may affect successful retail openings.

• Lead Administration readiness reviews for upcoming retail locations, ensuring critical requirements, open issues, and dependencies are visible and appropriately addressed.

• Develop repeatable planning, readiness, governance, and AI-enabled workflow approaches that can scale as Scout’s retail network expands.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Dependency Management

• Serve as the primary Administration coordination point for cross-functional dependencies affecting retail development and launch activities.

• Partner with IT, Legal, Procurement, Finance, Sales, HR, and other functions to identify and resolve dependencies that may affect Administration deliverables or launch execution.

• Clarify ownership, sequencing, and handoffs where responsibilities span multiple functions or teams, and challenge unclear ownership, missed commitments, or execution gaps that could affect readiness.

• Drive resolution of cross-functional barriers by bringing the appropriate stakeholders together, facilitating decisions, and escalating unresolved issues when necessary.

• Identify and manage interdependencies across locations, workstreams, and functional activities to identify potential conflicts or emerging risks early.

• Build strong working relationships across Administration and partner functions to support effective execution in a matrixed environment.

Risk, Issue & Performance Management

• Identify, assess, and maintain visibility into risks, issues, decisions, and dependencies affecting retail development and launch.

• Assess execution challenges and determine which risks require leadership attention, escalation, or intervention.

• Establish and maintain governance routines, reporting mechanisms, and escalation paths to support timely issue resolution and accountability.

• Develop launch reporting, dashboards, and executive-level updates that provide clear visibility into milestones, financial considerations, risks, dependencies, and decisions.

• Leverage AI-assisted analysis to synthesize information across workstreams, identify emerging risks or dependencies, surface inconsistencies or gaps, and improve the timeliness and quality of leadership reporting, while ensuring outputs are appropriately reviewed and validated.

• Monitor Administration-related retail costs, forecasts, and financial pressures in partnership with functional owners and Finance, escalating significant variances or funding risks.

• Track corrective actions and recovery plans for areas at risk of missing key commitments or launch requirements.

Strategic Programs & Expansion Support

• Support selected strategic expansion, market-entry, and enterprise initiatives requiring cross-functional Administration planning and coordination.

• Structure emerging or ambiguous initiatives by identifying workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies, risks, decision points, and required deliverables.

• Support development of cross-functional plans, governance mechanisms, and executive materials for complex initiatives spanning multiple functions or geographies.

• Use lessons learned from retail expansion and other strategic initiatives to strengthen Administration’s planning, governance, and execution practices.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.

• This role requires 4 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

• Travel: Periodic business travel to other Scout Motors’ facilities will be required. Valid driver's license required.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, or a related field required; advanced degree and/or PgMP certification preferred.

• 10+ years of progressive experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, business operations, expansion planning, project/program management, or related disciplines.

• Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional programs with multiple workstreams, dependencies, stakeholders, and competing priorities.

• Proven ability to establish integrated plans, governance mechanisms, risk-management processes, and reporting structures for large or evolving programs.

• Strong understanding of integrated planning and execution, including schedule, dependency, risk, cost, issue, and readiness management.

• Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information, identify emerging risks, and use AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve analysis, reporting, and decision support for senior leadership.

• Proven ability to influence outcomes, drive accountability, and facilitate resolution across functions without direct authority.

• Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to operate effectively in a matrixed environment.

• Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and create structure in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving organization.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

• 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $140,000.00 - $170,000.00

Internal leveling code: IC7

Notice to applicants:

• To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.

• Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

• Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

• Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Domino's Assistant Manager (5608)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
