jobs.title: Domino's Assistant Manager (5605)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Web and Connected Experiences
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer 3 (SW3) to help build and evolve Crunchyroll's connected-device applications.

In this role, you will develop and maintain high-performance streaming experiences on Living Room Devices such as Smart TVs and Gaming Consoles while contributing to shared client architecture, reusable application frameworks, and cross-platform capabilities used across connected devices. You will collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow software engineers to deliver scalable, reliable, and user-focused experiences.

The ideal candidate combines strong development experience with modern software engineering practices and a solid understanding of TypeScript, client-side application architecture, and maintainable frontend systems.  We are considering candidates for our San Francisco, CA office.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and Maintain Connected Device Applications

Design, develop, and optimize Living Room applications while contributing to scalable client-side solutions that improve maintainability and performance.

Build Shared and Reusable Solutions

Contribute to reusable libraries, application frameworks, tooling, and architectural patterns that reduce duplication and improve consistency across applications.

Collaborate Across Teams

Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering partners to understand requirements, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and deliver high-quality solutions aligned with business goals.

Technical Leadership and Ownership

Lead technical initiatives within your area of responsibility, make informed design decisions, and help establish engineering best practices.

Code Reviews and Engineering Excellence

Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and maintain high standards for code quality, testing, reliability, and documentation. Leverage AI-assisted development tools and automation to improve engineering productivity while ensuring code remains maintainable, secure, and thoroughly validated.

Debugging and Problem Solving

Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues across application layers, including platform-specific behavior, performance bottlenecks, and production incidents.

Performance and Reliability

Optimize application startup time, memory usage, responsiveness, and playback experiences across connected-device environments.

Mentorship and Team Growth

Provide guidance and mentorship to other engineers while helping improve team processes, technical standards, and knowledge sharing.

Documentation

Create and maintain clear technical documentation for systems, architecture decisions, development workflows, and feature implementations.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because you have...

Experience

• 5+ years of professional software development experience building production applications.

• Experience developing and maintaining large-scale client-side applications.

Frontend & TypeScript Expertise

• Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript.

• Experience building scalable applications using modern frontend frameworks such as React, Vue, Angular, or similar technologies.

• Strong understanding of application architecture, state management, modular design, and reusable component patterns.

Technical Leadership

• Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects, influence architectural decisions, and drive engineering best practices.

• Experience balancing short-term product delivery with long-term maintainability and scalability.

AI-Assisted Development & Automation

• Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software development, debugging, testing, and documentation.

• Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated solutions, validate correctness, and apply established engineering practices to ensure code quality, security, and maintainability.

• Proactive mindset toward identifying opportunities to improve developer productivity through AI and automation.

Problem Solving

• Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex issues across multiple application layers.

• Ability to analyze performance, reliability, and user experience challenges and implement effective solutions.

Collaboration

• Proven ability to work effectively with distributed teams and manage dependencies across multiple stakeholders.

• Experience partnering with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

Communication

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience building applications for connected devices, Smart TVs, game consoles, mobile platforms, or other consumer-facing products.

• Experience with video streaming technologies, DRM, and content delivery networks (CDN).

• Familiarity with shared codebases, monorepos, platform frameworks, or cross-platform application architectures.

• Experience with event-driven architectures and modular application design.

• Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software quality practices.

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

• Experience working in performance-constrained environments where startup time, memory usage, and responsiveness are critical.

• Experience improving engineering workflows through AI-assisted tooling, automated code reviews, test generation, or developer productivity initiatives.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

• Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.

• Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.

• Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance

• Health Saving Account HSA program

• Health care and dependent care FSA

• 401(k) plan, with employer match

• Employer paid commuter benefit

• Support program for new parents

• Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

jobs.title: Contracts Manager
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role:

Northwood is hiring a Contracts Manager to own the full lifecycle of commercial agreements and government contracts, from first draft to execution to amendments. As a part of our legal team, you will strategically impact the business, helping negotiate customer, vendor, and partner contracts that protect the company while supporting the fast pace of our operations. This is a hands-on role for someone with experience running high volume technology contracting and can build the processes that let it scale. 



Responsibilities:

 - Own the contract lifecycle management system: intake, workflows, approvals, signature, and the central repository. Track obligations, renewals, expirations and amendments, and upcoming deadlines to stakeholders.

 - Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of agreements in conjunction with legal counsel. Lead redlining with customer and vendor legal and procurement teams.

 - Identify legal, financial, and operational risks and ensure that contracts align with privacy, security, and revenue obligations.

 - Develop and maintain a contract playbook, fallback positions, and approval matrix.

 - Design scalable processes including by building/refining standard templates, clause libraries, and self-serve paper for low-risk deals.



Basic Qualifications:

 - 7+ years of contract management or commercial contracting experience, with at least 3 years at a software or technology company.

 - Proven record of negotiating complex enterprise agreements independently.

 - Strong working knowledge of technology contract terms: IP licensing, data privacy, information security, liability and indemnification considerations.

 - Clear, concise writing and the ability to explain legal concepts to non-lawyers.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Human Resources Generalist

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: People Operations
Location: Austin, TX / On-site
Reports to: Regional HR Business Partner
Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Classification: Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

As a Senior Human Resource (HR) Generalist at Loenbro, you’ll provide advanced regional HR support to employees, managers, and operational leadership across assigned projects and locations. You’ll lead complex employee relations matters, workplace investigations, performance management, corrective action, policy interpretation, and manager coaching while promoting consistent application of company policies and employment practices.

You’re a trusted HR partner to field leadership, collaborating with Human Resource Business Partner (HRBPs), HR Site Coordinators, and Shared Services to address sensitive employee matters, mitigate risk, and support operational needs. You’ll provide guidance on complex HR issues, supports and develops management capabilities, and helps ensure consistent HR practices across multiple projects and locations. You’ll maintain an on-site presence based on business needs and provides leadership and guidance on employee relations matters within its assigned region.

Role & Responsibilities

Employee Relations & Investigations

• Lead complex employee relations matters, workplace investigations, and conflict resolution across assigned projects and locations.

• Evaluate sensitive employee concerns, identify potential risks, and recommend appropriate resolutions in partnership with HR leadership and Legal, as needed.

• Guide managers through performance concerns, corrective action, disciplinary decisions, and employee separations.

• Ensure thorough documentation, confidentiality, and consistent application of company policies and employment practices.

Manager Coaching & HR Leadership

• Serve as a senior HR resource to operational leaders, providing guidance on employee relations, performance management, policy interpretation, and workforce matters.

• Coach and advise managers on effective employee communication, conflict resolution, documentation, and appropriate HR practices.

• Support managers in addressing recurring employee concerns and identifying opportunities to improve employee engagement and workplace effectiveness.

• Provide guidance and informal mentorship to HR Generalists and HR Site Coordinators, as appropriate.

Regional & Project Support

• Provide advanced HR support across assigned projects, locations, and business units based on employee population, operational needs, and the complexity of HR matters.

• Maintain an appropriate on-site presence to support field leadership, employees, and project operations.

• Partner with HR Site Coordinators to assess employee concerns, determine appropriate next steps, and ensure timely escalation and resolution.

• Support project mobilization, demobilization, workforce transitions, and other operational changes requiring HR expertise.

Policy, Compliance & Risk Management

• Interpret and apply company policies and employment practices consistently across assigned locations.

• Identify potential employee relations, compliance, and workplace risks and partner with HR leadership and Legal to determine appropriate action.

• Maintain accurate investigation records, employee relations documentation, and supporting information in accordance with company requirements.

• Support compliance initiatives and recommend improvements to HR practices, processes, and documentation.

HR Partnership & Process Improvement

• Partner with HRBPs and the HR Shared Services Manager to ensure alignment between regional HR support and centralized HR processes.

• Collaborate with Shared Services to resolve complex employee matters while allowing routine HR transactions to remain within the appropriate centralized function.

• Identify trends in employee relations matters and recommend proactive solutions to improve consistency, reduce risk, and strengthen manager effectiveness.

• Support the development and standardization of HR practices across projects, regions, and operating companies.

Skills

• Independently managing complex or sensitive employee relations matters and workplace investigations.

• Strong knowledge of HR practices, employment policies, and applicable federal, state, and local employment laws.

• Proficient in advising operational leaders and managers on performance concerns, corrective action, conflict resolution, and employee-related decisions.

• Ability to assess employee relations risks, exercise sound judgment, and recommend appropriate solutions in partnership with HR leadership and Legal, as needed.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate sensitive information professionally and effectively.

• Excellent problem-solving, critical-thinking, organizational, and documentation skills.

• Ability to manage competing priorities and provide HR support across multiple projects, locations, and business units.

• Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information with discretion.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and experience using HRIS and other business systems.

Qualifications

Required:

• 5+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including significant experience in employee relations, workplace investigations, performance management, and manager coaching.

Preferred:

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Construction, engineering, industrial, or other project-based organizations experience.

• Multi-site or multi-state organization with geographically dispersed employees experience.

• Experience mentoring or providing guidance to HR Generalists, HR Site Coordinators, or other HR team members.

• Professional HR certification, such as Professional in Human Resources (PHR), Senior Professional in Human Resources (SPHR), Society for Human Resource Management-Certified Professional (SHRM-CP), or Society for Human Resource Management-Senior Certified Professional (SHRM-SCP).

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment:

• Ability to work in an office environment with occasional travel to job sites as needed.

• May require flexibility to support onboarding and HR needs aligned with construction schedules.

• Ability to travel to assigned project sites and company locations based on business needs.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO)

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities.  If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers’ capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Manufacturing team is seeking a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers’ capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead the development and implementation of multiple complex manufacturing processes from concept to design

• Develop novel processing solutions for assembly of solid fuel rocket motors at high volumes

• Establish engineering standards and best practices

• Independently evaluate and recommend significant capital equipment with ROI analysis

• Manage CapEx projects from concept to implementation

• Control project budgets of significant scale with on-time and on-budget delivery

• Develop process flows, simplifying complex and critical operations into user friendly operations that maintain exceedingly high levels of safety and quality.

• Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.

• Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production

• Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, developing production ready processes

• Mentor and guide new engineers

• Manage and optimize established full rate production processes

• Communicate complex technical concepts across all levels of the organization

• Travel to suppliers to do initial sourcing work, solve ongoing production issues, and implement quality procedures as needed

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science

• 10+ years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or product processing

• Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver processes and products on time in a safe manner that meets or exceeds the required parameters defined by the product

• Demonstrated continuous improvement and process development skills and techniques

• Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.) Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus.

• A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning

• U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• High rate production experience with safety critical industries

• Hands-on experience solid fuel rocket motors

• New product development experience

• Factory commissioning experience

• Demonstrated experience with large and complex CapEx projects

US Salary Range

$158,000—$210,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Tax Accountant
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role:

Northwood Space is looking for a Tax Accountant to help build the tax function. You will own day-to-day tax activities, coordinate with external advisors, and establish scalable processes that support our expanding operations. Working closely with Finance, Accounting, Legal, and operational teams, you will bring structure to complex tax matters and help the company make informed business decisions as we continue to grow and scale.



Responsibilities:

 - Own the tax compliance calendar and coordinate federal, state and local filings with external advisors, ensuring accurate supporting schedules, timely submissions, and appropriate documentation.

 - Manage sales and use tax compliance, including registrations, nexus assessments, exemption certificates, and evaluating the tax treatment of ground station services and equipment purchases.

 - Support income tax provisions, tax account reconciliations, estimated payments, and financial reporting by preparing workpapers and coordinating technical reviews with external tax specialists.

 - Partner with Finance, Legal, and business teams to assess tax considerations for new ground station locations, customer contracts, capital investments, and expansion into new jurisdictions.

 - Build scalable tax processes, internal controls, and documentation; improve ERP tax configurations and data quality; and serve as the primary internal contact for tax notices, audits, and advisor requests.

 - Identify and evaluate potential tax credits, incentives, and opportunities in partnership with external advisors, including those related to research and development, manufacturing, and infrastructure investment.



Basic Qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 3+ years of tax experience in public accounting, corporate tax, or a combination, with hands-on experience preparing or reviewing tax filings and supporting schedules.

 - Working knowledge of U.S. federal and state business taxation, including income tax and sales and use tax, with the ability to research unfamiliar issues and recognize when specialist guidance is needed.

 - Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with proficiency in Excel and accounting systems and the ability to independently manage deadlines and build processes in an evolving environment.



Preferred Qualifications:

 - CPA designation, progress toward CPA licensure, or a graduate degree in Taxation or Accounting.

 - Experience at a startup or growing company, particularly in aerospace, telecommunications, infrastructure, manufacturing, or another business with significant physical assets.

 - Exposure to international tax compliance, VAT/GST, transfer pricing, or tax considerations associated with operating across multiple jurisdictions.

 - Experience with income tax provisions under ASC 740, fixed asset tax depreciation, R&D tax credits, or tax process automation using NetSuite or a similar ERP.



Additional Information:



To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.



Northwood Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Northwood Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: The Manager of Material Planning and Analytics
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

The Manager of Material Planning and Analytics is responsible for ensuring raw materials, components, and sub-assemblies are delivered to Form Energy pilot lines and production sites to support production needs at optimal efficiency. This individual must fully understand Form Energy’s supply chain and production operations, as well as be an expert on their assigned product or commodities. In this role, you would deploy inventory strategies, be responsible for product change and associated material planning implications, manage and solve exceptions, and drive supplier execution. This role involves daily management of supply and constraints, status reporting and escalation, supplier engagement, and the relentless pursuit of operational excellence and continuous improvement.

In this role, you will build and manage a team of world-class Material Planners. This important role will report to the Senior Manager, Global Supply Chain Planning & Controls and will directly support our growing Supply Chain and Manufacturing teams.

 Relocation assistance is available. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Create and deploy supply requirements to the supply base via MRP which achieves production, inventory and cost objectives. Ensure demand from all sources (production, aftermarket, engineering, etc.) is supported appropriately.

 - Manage planning system parameters and master data to optimally reflect supply chain capabilities and plan supply.

 - Apply analytics and supply chain expertise to manage system parameters and meet target inventory and service level goals while minimizing costs and obsolescence.

 - Build and maintain operational partnerships with assigned suppliers. Act as the primary interface with suppliers on delivery status, issues and resolution. Escalate to commercial or technical partners when required (GSM, accounts payable, quality, engineering, etc.).

 - Support onboarding and training of new suppliers to ensure operational excellence and compliance with Form’s supply chain processes and policies.

 - Coordinate supplier ramp up and down for new product launches, ensuring suppliers deliver shipments needed to support production targets.

 - Deliver clear-to-build status, material coverage, run-out reports and other analyses as needed. Provide data-driven decision support to the broader organization through what-if and scenario planning (as examples).

 - Manage engineering changes to minimize obsolete inventory and ensure continuous supply.

 - Hire, coach, and develop material planners

 - Set priorities, assign workload, and conduct performance reviews

 - Build a culture of accountability, data-driven decisions, and cross-functional partnership

 - Partner with IT and other business stakeholders on planning process and system improvements.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 7+ years’ experience in manufacturing, finance, or supply chain management.

 - Strong knowledge of MRP/ERP with a solid understanding of discrete manufacturing, bills of material, product lifecycle management, procure to pay processes and supply chain operations.

 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to evaluate and analyze data to enable operational decision-making or present clear recommendations to leadership.

 - Demonstrated skills in supplier operational and relationship management.

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Finance, Industrial Engineering or similar discipline. CPIM or APIC training is a plus.
   




WHERE YOU'LL WORK:


This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. Relocation assistance is available.



 #LI-Onsite



Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 



When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. 



To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.

jobs.description:
With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world’s most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

Digital Risk Protection Engineering is hiring a full-time Engineer to own the credential data pipelines behind Digital Risk Protection: the ingestion path that turns raw stolen-credential data from infostealer logs, breach dumps, and combolists into the exposure records customers rely on. The role pairs that engineering ownership with the daily operational duties that keep the product serving customers, including domain approvals, instance provisioning, and data-correctness triage.

What You'll Do:

• Own the domain approval queue, reviewing and approving customer domains within the requester's working day

• Provision and backfill customer instances, including during live prospect evaluations

• Triage data-correctness escalations from CSMs and account teams, tracing each case from the customer's view back to the raw source log

• Build, release, and maintain the infostealer, dump, and combolist ingestion pipelines and the shared libraries the platform builds on

• Deliver the HIBP parity backlog and the historical non-HIBP backlog in the reference index

• Maintain routing parity on every published dump, applying the corporate-domain versus personal-domain rules

• Administer API access for internal consumers such as research analysts

What You'll Bring:

Required

• Production experience building and operating ETL or data-ingestion pipelines, including parsing semi-structured and malformed source data

• Working knowledge of Elasticsearch and AWS-hosted data services

• Ability to debug end to end, from a customer-facing UI or API symptom to the originating log record

• Clear written communication with non-engineering stakeholders under time pressure

Preferred

• Familiarity with credential-exposure or threat-intelligence data (infostealer logs, breach dumps, combolists)

• Experience owning an operational queue alongside a development backlog

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Inference Product
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

We're looking for product-minded backend and distributed systems engineers to build the API layer that powers Model APIs, Baseten's hosted endpoints for the latest open-source models. Every request to Model APIs passes through the systems this team owns: authentication, rate limiting, routing, metering and billing. You'll make that layer fast, reliable and easy to build on, and use it to ship new products that change how developers use models at scale. You'll work where infrastructure meets product. The systems you build decide how customers experience performance, how capacity is shared across a global GPU fleet, and how inference is packaged and sold. You'll join a small, high-impact team that partners closely with inference, and product, and you'll own your work from design through production. This role is ideal for engineers who like owning high-scale production systems, care about developer experience, and want their work to directly shape how AI infrastructure is priced, packaged and delivered.

 

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

You'll get to work on these types of projects on our Inference Platform:

 - Introducing Baseten Grid https://www.baseten.co/blog/introducing-baseten-grid/

 - Introducing Baseten Hosted Tools https://www.baseten.co/blog/introducing-baseten-hosted-tools/

 - Frontier Gateway https://www.baseten.co/blog/introducing-baseten-frontier-gateway/


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and operate the API layer behind Model APIs: request handling, authentication, rate limiting and routing, with high availability and low added latency.

 - Own usage metering and billing infrastructure: accurate, real-time accounting for every request, and the flexibility to support new pricing and packaging models.

 - Build the rate-limiting and capacity systems that balance customer throughput against fleet utilization, at scale and in real time.

 - Ship new products at the API layer that change how developers use models, from routing across models to features that make building on Model APIs easier.

 - Turn platform capabilities into a strong product experience: usage visibility, self-serve controls, and clear, predictable API behavior.

 - Instrument the edge with deep observability and alerting, so issues are caught and fixed before customers notice.

 - Partner with the Model APIs, inference, and product teams to get new capabilities to customers quickly and safely.

 - Own projects end to end, from design through deployment, on-call and iteration on customer feedback.

 

REQUIREMENTS

 - Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 3+ years building and operating distributed systems, backend infrastructure, or large-scale APIs where reliability, latency, and scale are first-class concerns.

 - A proven track record of owning low-latency, reliable backend services, including rate limiting, auth, quotas, metering, and migrations.

 - Infrastructure instincts with a feel for performance: profiling, tracing, capacity planning, and SLO management.

 - Comfort debugging performance and reliability issues across multiple layers of the stack, from application behavior down to runtime and infrastructure internals.

 - A strong sense of developer experience. You think about how systems are used, not just how they work.

 - Eagerness to learn new languages, frameworks, and systems, and a real interest in inference engineering. Prior ML or LLM experience isn't required, though experience with model serving or inference systems is a plus.

 - Excellent written communication and collaboration skills, including writing clear design docs and working across functions.



NICE TO HAVE

 - Deep Kubernetes experience, including operators and custom resources, plus familiarity with service meshes or API gateways.

 - Experience with distributed scheduling, autoscaling, or service orchestration.

 - A background in developer-facing infrastructure or APIs, or contributions to open-source infrastructure or ML systems.

 - Familiarity with observability tooling, CI/CD systems, or release automation.



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

jobs.title: Senior IOS Engineer
jobs.description:
About SimpliSafe

We’re a high-tech home security company that’s passionate about protecting the life you’ve built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we’ve created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you’re building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don’t just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.

We’re embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state-of-the-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.

Why are we hiring?

Well, we’re growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

What We're Doing

The Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) organization owns the full user experience from the moment someone unboxes their SimpliSafe system through their entire life as a subscriber. The Onboarding Experience team owns one of the first steps in that journey: setting up and pairing new hardware devices like doorbells and cameras. Your work will ensure the pairing and setup experience is a seamless and straightforward introduction to SimpliSafe’s app and monitoring features.

What You’ll Bring

• Domain expertise: You've shipped and maintained production iOS apps. You're comfortable, or can quickly get comfortable, building UX in UIKit and SwiftUI. Experience with Bluetooth LE, CoreBluetooth, Wi-Fi provisioning, or video is a nice-to-have, but not required to apply.

• Technical judgement: You’ve shipped a short term fix, and then gone back and done it right. You can navigate real-world tradeoffs with a good design in mind. You know when to use AI agents and when to do things yourself.

• A UX focus: You’ve advocated for users even when the technical problems got hard.

• Ownership: You’ve taken a feature from idea to production and stayed with it after launch. When something breaks, you dig in without waiting to be asked.

• Curiosity: You’re curious about every part of the stack (hardware, firmware, cloud services), and you get excited to partner with engineers in other specialties to build something cool.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Designing, building, and maintaining the app pairing and setup flows for hardware: from device discovery and Bluetooth LE connection, to Wi-Fi setup and first-run experience, to camera live streaming and audio.

• Getting your hands on early versions of devices; partnering with UX designers, hardware, firmware, and backend peers to create good user experiences across our stack.

• Owning broad swaths of features from idea to definition to implementation.

• Improving the reliability, testability, and observability of the setup experience.

• Growing the team around you through feedback and code reviews.

How We’ll Evaluate You

• New devices ship on time and are delightful to use.

• Setup and pairing success rates improve, and customers reach a working device faster.

• The technical designs you lead hold up in production, and risks surface early rather than late.

• You are a solid contributor to the day-to-day work of the team: design discussions, technical documents and threads, PR reviews, and of course the code itself.

How We’ll Support You

We’ve kept the team intentionally small, but we cover all our bases. You'll have dedicated product and design partners and an engineering manager who cares about your growth and provides regular feedback. You’ll have iOS, Android, and backend developers as peers. You’ll have a Digital Foundations team that supports the app as a whole and builds tools to make your life easier. You’ll have access to an agent with custom skills and context (we use Claude Code) and plenty of tokens to drive it.

What Values You’ll Share

• Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.

• Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.

• No Ego - Maintaining a “no job too small” attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.

• One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.

• Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.

• Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.

What We Offer

• A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive

• A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here)

• Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.

The target annual base pay range for this role is $117,300 - $156,400

This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees’ job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.

Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.

We’re committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.

We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact careers@simplisafe.com.

jobs.title: Technology Product Owner - Clinical and Scientific Affairs, No 3rd party candidates, Orange County, CA
jobs.description:
No 3rd party candidates

This role is on-site in Orange County, CA 3 days/week

We have been working with this fortune 100 life sciences client for over 20 years and you will be joining our team of 50+ professionals.

We are seeking an experienced Technology Product Owner who understands Clinical and Scientific Affairs workflows and can operate at the intersection of business process, data, technology, and innovation.

The contractor will build trusted partnerships with Clinical and Scientific Affairs stakeholders, understand their end-to-end workflows and friction points, establish and maintain a prioritized technology roadmap, and coordinate delivery across internal technology teams, data/analytics, cybersecurity, quality, vendors, and enterprise platforms.

This role is not a project coordinator or hands-on application administrator. It requires someone who can understand the business problem, challenge and clarify requirements, identify where technology can meaningfully improve the process, and then lead the technology product lifecycle from discovery through delivery, adoption, and value realization.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical & Scientific Affairs Partnership

• Serve as a dedicated technology partner to Clinical and Scientific Affairs leaders and teams.
• Build a strong understanding of Clinical and Scientific Affairs processes, workflows, data needs, pain points, and priorities.
• Lead discovery sessions around business problems and “work to be done” before defining technology solutions.
• Translate business needs into technology capabilities, product requirements, use cases, and a prioritized backlog.
• Establish a regular cadence with Clinical, Scientific Affairs, and Technology stakeholders to maintain alignment on priorities and roadmap.

Technology Product Ownership

• Own and continuously evolve the Clinical technology roadmap and prioritized product backlog.
• Evaluate existing enterprise capabilities before introducing new solutions.
• Coordinate solution design and delivery across enterprise platforms, data and analytics, integrations, automation, AI, and external solutions.
• Manage dependencies, risks, priorities, and trade-offs across multiple initiatives.
• Drive solutions from discovery and requirements through implementation, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

Clinical Data, Digital & AI Enablement

• Partner on opportunities to improve access to and appropriate use of clinical and scientific data.
• Support technology capabilities that improve data discovery, access, workflow automation, analytics, evidence generation, and reuse.
• Identify appropriate opportunities for AI and automation across Clinical workflows while ensuring responsible use, traceability, quality, and appropriate human oversight.

Cross-Functional Delivery

• Connect Clinical and Scientific Affairs needs with R&D, Data & Analytics, Enterprise IT, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Quality, Legal, Regulatory and external technology partners.
• Ensure solutions are scalable, supportable and appropriate for a regulated environment.
• Translate complex business and technology topics into clear recommendations, roadmap choices, and decision points for leadership.

Required Experience & Skills

• Strong experience as a Technology Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Technology Partner, or similar role.
• Experience partnering with Clinical, Scientific Affairs, Medical Affairs, or related life-sciences functions.
• Good understanding of the clinical study lifecycle and associated business processes, data, and technology needs.
• Proven ability to conduct discovery, understand business processes and pain points, and translate them into technology products and roadmaps.
• Experience managing a product backlog and prioritizing across multiple stakeholders and competing business needs.
• Strong understanding of data, integrations, workflows, analytics, automation, and modern SaaS/cloud technology.
• Familiarity with AI/GenAI use cases in Clinical or regulated environments is highly desirable.
• Experience operating within healthcare, MedTech, pharmaceutical, or another regulated environment strongly preferred.
• Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and executive communication skills.
• Ability to influence across business and technology organizations without direct authority.

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS

Patient Minded - I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight - I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action - I am empowered and hold myself accountable.

Grow Talent - I own my development and invest in the development of others.

Win Together - I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters - I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity - I create an environment of awareness and respect.

jobs.title: Principal Product Specialist - AI Security
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal Product Specialist to join our team. This is a Remote role, based in the USA, reporting to the Director, Product Specialist in the PM - Security AI department. Drive product strategy and cross-functional execution for a Principal-level area within Zscaler’s Security AI portfolio, shaping how enterprise customers securely adopt AI agents and agentic workflows. The role owns outcomes end-to-end: identifying the highest-leverage bets, aligning Engineering, Design, Security Research, and GTM on them, and shipping capabilities that measurably improve customer security posture.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Contribute to the multi-quarter strategy and roadmap for a Principal-level area of the Security AI portfolio, grounded in customer problems, market signal, and the evolving threat landscape

• Lead cross-functional execution with Engineering, Design, Security Research, and GTM to ship differentiated capabilities on a predictable cadence, with clear success metrics tied to customer outcomes

• Run structured discovery with enterprise customers, partners, and the field; translate qualitative insight and product telemetry into crisp requirements and measurable outcomes

• Shape portfolio-level decisions: frame product bets, contribute to platform and architecture direction, and align adjacent PM teams around a coherent Security AI narrative

• Drive clarity at every altitude—write sharp PRDs and launch narratives, brief executives and stakeholders, and represent the product to customers, analysts, and partners

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity, comfortably building the path as you walk it, and seeing dynamic environments as opportunities to create something meaningful.

• You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embraces a challenge culture with respectful candor, and continuously builds trust.

• You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for both internal and external users, and anchoring all product decisions in solving real-world problems.

• You are a pragmatic builder who is obsessed with iterating and shipping, happy to roll up your sleeves to balance technical excellence with rapid user value.

• You champion simplicity by distilling complex problems and technical concepts into precise, clear, and actionable plans.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 5+ years of product experience, including at least one full cycle contributing on an enterprise-grade product from discovery through scaled launch

• Proven track record shipping platform, developer-facing, or security products in environments that demand real technical depth

• Working fluency in at least one of: AI/ML systems, cloud security architecture, and identity protocols—sufficient to hold technical depth with engineers and make informed trade-offs

• Strong cross-functional leadership and executive communication; able to influence without authority and drive clarity in ambiguous, matrixed environments

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency

• Familiarity with agentic systems or emerging AI/agent protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A), prior PM experience on AI or Workloads platform, data protection, or SASE/Zero Trust products

• Experience partnering with security researchers or red teams; comfort reasoning about adversarial threat models against AI systems

• Hands-on technical fluency—reads code, builds prototypes, or interprets API/telemetry data to accelerate decisions with engineering

WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Main challenge

We are looking for a Lead VFX Artist to lead the VFX discipline across our games, combining strong artistic expertise with team coordination, visual direction, and pipeline development. You will work closely with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio to ensure a consistent visual and technical quality across all VFX, while supporting project and studio goals.

You will oversee the VFX process from initial concepts and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Working with our proprietary engine and in-house tools, you will also contribute to the evolution of our VFX workflows, standards, and technology.

What it means on a daily basis

• VFX Team Leadership: Oversee and coordinate the VFX team, establish priorities, and ensure deadlines and quality targets are met. Identify and remove systemic blockers early and proactively adjust resources and scope.
• Visual Direction & Quality: Work with the Art Director to ensure visual and technical unity across all VFX. Review completed work against artistic, technical, and gameplay requirements and advance VFX quality through regular reviews.
• Cross-Team Collaboration: Collaborate with Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other teams. Provide constructive feedback to internal and external partners.
• VFX Pipeline: Oversee the entire VFX pipeline, from initial concept and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery.
• Standards & Workflows: Establish and maintain VFX standards, workflows, tools, and best practices. Ensure effects meet performance and platform requirements.
• Team Development: Participate in recruitment, mentor VFX artists, and foster team growth and development.

What success will look like

After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the studio's projects, VFX workflows, team structure, and production requirements. You will have established effective working relationships with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio.

After 6 months, you will be independently driving VFX priorities, supporting the team in delivering against project goals, and contributing to the evolution of VFX standards, workflows, and quality across the studio.

Who you would be working with

You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with VFX artists, Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other art and development teams. You will also collaborate with internal and external partners throughout the production process.

Your recruitment journey

• HR Screen Call
• Test
• Second Interview
• Final Interview

Where this role can take you

This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in VFX leadership, expand your responsibilities across the wider art discipline, and contribute to the development of VFX standards, workflows, and technology. You will also have access to development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

• Demonstrated advanced expertise in real-time VFX for games, supported by a strong portfolio.
• Strong knowledge of visual effects techniques for creating real-time VFX in a 3D game engine.
• Strong knowledge of industry-standard game engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, or CryEngine.
• Solid understanding of game development and how VFX contribute to gameplay, visual feedback, and the overall player experience.
• Experience creating particle systems and VFX in 3D packages such as Maya, Houdini, or 3ds Max.
• Experience with VFX techniques and plugins for 3D software packages such as RayFire, Krakatoa, FumeFX, AfterBurn, or Maya Fluids.
• Ability to establish priorities, manage workflows, and coordinate a VFX team while maintaining quality and delivery standards.
• Ability to take initiative, provide creative input, and positively accept and apply feedback.
• Willingness to work with in-house tools and contribute to the development and improvement of proprietary game technology.
• Expertise in GLSL or HLSL would be beneficial.
• Previous experience in mobile game development would be a plus.
• Some experience with animation would also be a plus.
• Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment.

WHO YOU ARE

• You are a creative and experienced VFX professional who can combine artistic vision with an understanding of production and technical requirements.
• You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different disciplines and stakeholders.
• You are comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback and using it to improve both your own work and the team's output.
• You can organise priorities, identify blockers, and proactively find solutions in a production environment.
• You are interested in developing people, processes, and workflows alongside the quality of the VFX itself.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

• Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
• Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
• Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
• Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
• Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

• Permanent contract and full-time position with excellent social benefits.
• 25 vacation days per year.
• Private medical health insurance.
• Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
• Flexible work-from-home hybrid model.
• Free language courses.
• Your birthday off!
• 2 months of remote work.
• Merit-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
• Career development opportunities.
• Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona.
• ...and Thursday after-work beers!
• Salary range (based on responsibilities, experience, internal equity and market benchmarks): 65k-75k gross/year
• Applicable Collective Agreement: Comercio del Metal de Barcelona

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com

If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

jobs.title: Account Supervisor, Public Affairs
jobs.location: New York, N.Y. or Washington, D.C.
jobs.description:
ABOUT BERLINROSEN

BerlinRosen is part of Orchestra, a strategic communications and marketing company built for today’s complex and fragmented world. From decoding audiences to designing bold strategies, Orchestra integrates people, platforms, and stories that stick to help clients build lasting influence. The company offers programs that span from the highest level strategic business counsel through to tactical execution. Orchestra brings together 700+ people with experience across consumer and lifestyle, technology, nonprofit and philanthropy, real estate, sports, travel, hospitality, and more. Made up of leading firms BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communications professionals, and Versus Media Group, a strategy-first political media team. Learn more at www.orchestraco.com.

People of all backgrounds and abilities are strongly encouraged to apply. Orchestra is committed to building and maintaining a diverse staff, and recognizes that its continued success depends on hiring and retaining high-quality creative professionals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Opportunities for advancement exist, and we are committed to helping all staff develop and grow.

ABOUT THE PUBLIC AFFAIRS TEAM

Our Public Affairs team is a group of 50+ strategists, campaign managers and communications experts who help clients navigate high-stakes political, regulatory and reputational challenges. We lead integrated campaigns across media, stakeholder engagement, advocacy, research and paid media, coordinating seamlessly across internal teams and external partners to drive outcomes for clients across healthcare, nonprofits, technology, land use, education, infrastructure and other sectors. The team works on fast-moving state and national campaigns across a wide range of issues, collaborating with a strong network of advisors, consultants and local partners in markets across the country.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

BerlinRosen is seeking an Account Supervisor, Public Affairs to join our public affairs team. You will lead daily client relations, plan and execute day-to-day project deliverables, support and lead junior staff, and conceptualize integrated strategies, pitches and media placements. This role not only leads the day-to-day work, but sees around the corners to anticipate clients’ needs and quickly assess the strongest team approach to meet them. Working closely with client leads and internal staff, this position will manage up and down, delegating to peers and junior staff and developing and advancing strategy with senior leaders. This is an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about issues that cities face, both in New York and across the country—including land use and urban planning, social issues, housing, sustainability, economic development and health care.

Role location: This role is based in our New York, N.Y. or Washington D.C. office on a hybrid basis. The team is in-office 3 days per week.

ACCOUNTABILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

As an Account Supervisor, Public Affairs, you will…

• Lead development and execution of large-scale communications strategies along with teammates

• Drive high-touch, daily client communications with the same client leads: brainstorming, flagging concerns and problem-solving

• Manage a team of junior staff on each account you lead, strategically influencing deliverables’ quality and staff development by delegating, modeling smart practices and providing feedback

• Conceptualize and drive new story angles and other media opportunities for clients: such as landing feature stories even when there is no news to announce, or drafting a persuasive and compelling pitch on behalf of a client for a high-profile interview, award or conference

• Serve as a trusted advisor to clients on communications and public affairs strategy, track policy, cultural, and political developments as it relates to client work to inform strategy

• Work closely with senior team leaders on capacity planning to ensure that the team is running efficiently

• Place numerous stories through persistence and creativity, identifying new targets and trying new approaches until the story lands

• Contribute to business development and growth efforts

Essential skills:

• A minimum of 5 years of experience with strategic communications from working in politics, government or advocacy or with a PR agency, media outlet or in-house communications team

• Ability to handle multiple assignments at once, work quickly and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

• Demonstrated relationships with reporters and strong news sense

• Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, with varying levels of staff, clients, the media, etc.

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work with a team to meet group objectives

• Proficient in Google and Microsoft software suites

WORKING AT BERLINROSEN

Salary range (commensurate with experience and skills): 85,000-110,000

We're part of Orchestra, the first communications company built for today’s media landscape. Since 2022, it’s acquired nine firms, including: BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communication professionals. Learn more at: www.orchestraco.com.

To ensure that applicants are matched with the job that best suits their qualifications and interests, information that you submit may be shared with our network agencies. By providing your information, you are consenting to allow us and our subsidiaries to keep your information on file and to contact you regarding job opportunities, recruitment events and other related updates.
