jobs.title: Revenue Specialist
jobs.description:
Salary: $90,000
Reports To: VP of Consulting Services

Position Summary:

The Revenue Specialist will work alongside Hub clients to help them grow and diversify their revenue streams. This includes, but may not be limited to, small dollar fundraising, major gifts, corporate philanthropy, advertising, sponsorships, events, and other emerging income sources.

This is both a strategic and execution role, working closely with the Hub’s consulting team to diagnose challenges, identify and enact solutions, and help client newsrooms get closer to sustainability over time. Some measurements we use to gauge success in this role would be client revenue growth, donor base growth, reduction in reliance on philanthropic funding, and other relevant KPIs.

We’re interested in meeting candidates with a range of experiences and backgrounds—if you have a track record of driving revenue growth for organizations in one or more lines of business, and if you enjoy navigating new territory and finding solutions to problems, we invite you to apply.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Strategy & Revenue Growth

• Identify revenue growth opportunities and diagnose blockers for Hub client organizations. Your ultimate goal is to help organizations diversify revenue and reduce dependence on any single funding source/

• Design and run revenue sprints and experiments, independently or alongside client partners.

• Deliver strategic presentations and revenue assessments to clients and leadership teams

• Provide accurate and actionable strategic guidance grounded in data and up-to-date industry context

Service Development & Innovation

• Audit and refine existing Hub services and documentation within your focus areas – regularly making improvements based on new learnings and experiments. Work under your purview should always be evolving or be validated as still effective.

• Retire or adapt services that no longer drive value

• Pitch new service offerings internally to the Leadership and Sales teams, based on your findings from sprints and experiments with clients

Project Leadership & Collaboration

• Manage timelines and milestones for client projects

• Coordinate and communicate with other specialists and leadership, ensuring a seamless, high-quality client experience

• Share insights and learnings from your independent work internally to strengthen cross-team knowledge

• Delegate task work relevant to your sprints or projects, when applicable, to other Hub team members or to contractors to ensure quality control

Representation & Thought Leadership

• Serve as an in-house expert, answering questions from clients, Hub leadership, and peers when called upon.

• Represent NRH in external environments like conferences, webinars, and in prospective client conversations when called upon.

• Contribute to the Hub’s marketing efforts by sharing and promoting your learnings and results virtually in places like LinkedIn and the Hub’s newsletter.

• Help position NRH as a leader in revenue diversification for news organizations

What Your Day to Day Work Will Include:

• Moving forward revenue sprints and projects with client organizaitons—keeping tabs on timelines, communicating with clients, and documenting milestones. Your are on top of your collective workload and the progress and challenges of each of your clients

• Executing ‘big picture’ deliverables within your purview, such as a comprehensive annual revenue review

• Liaising with other members of the Hub team when handoffs are needed or when support is needed that doesn’t fall under your direct purview

• Sharing learnings and wins in the Hub Slack space with other Hub team members and clients when applicable

• May be called upon to aid in hiring and onboarding, training, and mentorship of employees and contractors as related to this role, once onboarded and settled

Ideal Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience working in one or more of the following revenue areas in journalism or nonprofits: major donors, corporate philanthropy, advertising, or events

• Comfort with data and analytics. You can review a data set—website traffic, revenue, list growth—and not only understand it but see trends and opportunities within and translate those things to others.

• Demonstrable experience leading, developing and executing revenue strategy in a professional environment.

• Excellent interpersonal and problem-solving skills. Ability to adapt to new situations, solve problems on the fly, and communicate with those around you. Teamwork and resourcefulness required, and confidence to ask for advice when needed

• Empathy, communication, respect, patience, and a willingness to help out, whether it's the Hub, a member you serve, or someone else!

• The ability to self-motivate, self-manage and work remotely.

• Bonus: Experience in the public media sector or the for-profit media sector

How Your Success Will Be Measured:

• Jointly with the rest of the consulting team, we will track and aim to hold ourselves accountable for client outcomes and transformation. That includes things like YoY revenue growth and hitting revenue targets.

• Services under your purview evolve under your direction—they improve and change based on new learnings, industry developments, and your experiments that you drive

• You ideate and hardwire new services, driven by experiments you run with clients that generate positive outcomes.

• You represent the Hub effectively and in a positive light:

• you are empathetic, kind and respectful of others

• you communicate promptly and effectively and tailor your communication to your audience

• you help others grow their knowledge in your focus areas—people are better off having worked with you

• you are dependable to clients and to your colleagues; you hit deadlines and deliver quality, error-free work

Benefits of working at the Hub include:

• 100% remote team

• Annual performance reviews with merit-based increases and opportunities for advancement

• Full health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

• 401k plan with 6% match, immediately vested

• Home office stipend and cell phone reimbursement

• Flexible work hours with a generous vacation policy

• Life insurance

• Contribute to a mission-driven organization with a diverse and inclusive team of people who are passionate about helping news organizations build financial sustainability—because the public deserves access to quality journalism.

This position will remain open until 12/11/26.

How to Apply:

All applications should be submitted through this job post.

The Hub is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

About News Revenue Hub

News Revenue Hub (NRH) is a nonprofit consulting organization dedicated to helping newsrooms build long-term financial sustainability. We partner with journalism organizations of all sizes to strengthen revenue strategy, grow and retain audiences, and develop diversified, integrated income streams that support impactful journalism.

Our consulting approach is practical, data-informed, and systems-oriented. We work alongside newsroom leaders to diagnose challenges, design clear pathways to growth, and implement strategies that lead to measurable results.

When we succeed, the organizations we serve are stronger, more resilient, and better positioned to provide high-quality, trustworthy journalism to their communities.

jobs.title: Shift Lead, DashMart - Reno
jobs.description:
About the Team

DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality. Customers order their convenience, grocery, retail, and prepared foods in the DoorDash app, and our team members fulfill orders in a real, brick-and-mortar store for Dashers to deliver. We’re open early and close late - some sites even run 24/7!

About the Role

DashMart is looking for a motivated and experienced individual that excels in fast-paced, physical environments and is excited to roll up their sleeves and actively engage in day-to-day operations.  In this role, you will work within a local fulfillment center supporting Site Management running great shifts, and delegating tasks. As a Shift Lead, you will have shift responsibility for fulfilling orders in a warehouse environment and maintaining inventory, and in some locations, this involves preparing food in a light-prep kitchen.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Be an Owner: Take ownership of your assigned shifts, including warehouse and kitchen processes, safety/cleanliness, quality, and training. Maintain accountability for inventory, equipment, and other company assets to ensure they are properly handled, stored, and protected from loss or theft.

• Delight Customers: Ensure customer orders are delivered with high quality by executing orders accurately, communicating with customers when issues arise, and making sure Dasher pickups go smoothly.

• Lead: Guide Operations Associates through their shift by ensuring the team works safely and productively and serving as the point of escalation for daily operations.

• One Team One Fight: Support operations in both the warehouse and kitchen, assist with day-to-day tasks, and lead by example. You will be expected to engage in professional and respectful interactions with team members and customers, ensuring a positive and safe atmosphere in the warehouse while providing a high-quality experience for our customers.

• Help improve operations: Contribute ideas to improve our quality and customer experience.

We’re excited about you because…

• You’re self-motivated, positive, and a team player. You work well with others, and you bring a great attitude to your work each and every day. You have high integrity and are excited to delight customers.

• You have a proven track record of success in food and beverage, warehouse, and/or retail environments.

• You’re able to be on your feet and move heavy products. You are excited and physically able (with or without accommodation) to lift up to 50 lbs., depending on the needs of the specific site, and can operate a pallet jack and hand truck.

• You have the ability and desire to obtain and maintain a food handling certificate. (DoorDash will provide this training)

• You have a high school diploma or GED equivalent. A college diploma is even better but not required.

• You are at least 18 years of age.

• You're organized and proficient in Google Docs and Google Sheets.

• You have flexibility in your schedule. Depending upon the scheduling needs of the hiring site, you can be available for a number of different shifts a week.

Benefits

• Market Competitive pay

• Opportunity for pay increases twice a year based upon performance

• Paid time off (PTO) and sick leave

• Health benefits starting Day 1 (Medical, Dental, & Vision)

• 401k match

• Gym membership reimbursement (up to $75/month)

• Monthly DashPass subscription (including access to Lyft discounts for full-time employees)

• Employee Assistance Program

• Career advancement opportunities

Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only

We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC, and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023, and resumed using Covey Scout for Inbound again on June 29, 2024.

The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: Covey

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.

Base Pay:

$21.10—$21.10 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools: To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview.

How it works: Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support - rather than replace - human decision-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI-enabled tool  in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law.

Data Retention, Privacy & Bias Audit: Data collected during this process is retained in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy https://help.doordash.com/en-us/legal/article/ax-privacy-notice and applicable state laws. In compliance with New York City Local Law 144, the independent bias audit summary for Metaview is publicly available for review at https://trust.warden-ai.com/metaview/application-review.

jobs.title: Capture Strategist
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. This role sits at the intersection of business development and strategy. The right candidate builds trust with customers early, understands competitive dynamics, and knows how to turn a well-shaped opportunity into a winning proposal. They will work closely with growth, engineering, mission, product, and leadership teams across the full opportunity lifecycle.



Responsibilities:

 - Own capture strategy for priority opportunities across U.S. Government, international government, and commercial customers, from opportunity identification through award

 - Build and manage customer relationships ahead of formal solicitations to understand mission needs, procurement timelines, and decision criteria

 - Assess competitive landscape and develop win themes, teaming strategy, and differentiated positioning

 - Lead black hat assessments, price-to-win analysis, and go/no-go recommendations

 - Serve as primary author and project manager for proposals, coordinating inputs across business development, engineering, product, mission management, legal, and finance

 - Build and maintain capture playbooks, competitive intelligence, and reusable proposal infrastructure



Basic Qualifications:

 - 5+ years in capture, business development, or proposal strategy roles in aerospace, defense, government technology, or other complex technical industries

 - Experience shaping opportunities pre-RFP, including customer engagement, competitive positioning, and teaming strategy

 - Experience leading or supporting responses to RFIs, RFPs, or similar solicitations

 - Ability to work in-person in Los Angeles or Washington, DC



Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience in the space industry, including familiarity with SATCOM, RF, and communications infrastructure

 - Experience capturing U.S. Government opportunities, including defense, civil, or national security agencies

 - Experience with commercial or international customer capture, strategic bids, or partnership development

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Software Engineer on Collections Infra, you’ll help scale the infrastructure behind Notion’s database block. Databases power views, boards, charts, forms, and the workflows customers use to run their companies; as Notion grows into larger enterprise deployments and AI-native work, those systems need to become faster, more reliable, and ready for much higher concurrency. This team sits between infrastructure and product, building backend architecture that improves the customer experience while becoming a platform other Notion teams can build on. You’ll work on problems like database load performance, microservices, high-volume writes from agents, and the flexibility that makes Notion databases powerful and hard to scale.

This role can be based in either San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, you’ll understand how Collections Infra supports Notion’s database block, ship improvements to database performance or reliability, and build context on the scale challenges behind larger enterprise workspaces and AI-driven write volume.

 - You’ll use AI as a real engineering collaborator: to learn unfamiliar systems faster, explore debugging paths, generate tests, summarize traces or logs, and pressure-test implementation plans before shipping.

 - You’ll contribute to the team’s work to make databases faster and more reliable at P95 scale, especially as customers build larger centralized databases with more concurrent usage.

 - By the end of your first year, you’ll have helped raise the quality bar for Collections infrastructure through better architecture, observability, documentation, or system boundaries that make future work easier to build on.

 - You’ll partner with senior engineers and product-facing teams to evolve Collections as a platform, balancing internal developer needs with the external customer experience of databases.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with interest in performance, reliability, scalability, and systems that need to hold up under real customer load.

 - Curiosity about distributed systems, microservices, and data-layer trade-offs; experience in these areas is helpful, but we care most about your ability to learn quickly and reason from first principles.

 - Practical comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript, or the ability to ramp quickly in a codebase where those tools matter.

 - Grit and truth-seeking in technical problem solving: you can iterate when the first approach does not move P50/P95 performance, and you’re motivated by finding the real bottleneck.

jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer, AI Enablement
jobs.description:
About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role

The AI Enablement team gives every team at Extend the AI tooling it needs to do its best work. We pair directly with business users in finance, support, claims, sales, recruiting, and operations to understand how they work, then build the agents, connectors, and skills that change it. This is an engineering role first. Sitting beside a business user is how you find the right problem. Solving it takes real engineering judgment about agent harnesses, protocols, security, and reliability.

You will build on the platform that turns one-off prototypes into durable, secure, measurable tooling: MCP connectors to the systems we run on, agent-to-agent (A2A) integrations, a shared library of agent skills, and the evaluation practice that tells us whether any of it actually works.

What You'll Do

• Pair with business users to run workflow analysis and process mapping, find the highest-leverage problems, and turn ambiguous requests into scoped technical plans.

• Design and ship secure MCP connectors to Extend's internal systems and third-party SaaS: finance, CRM, data warehouse, expense management, product analytics, support, ATS, and the long tail beyond.

• Build agent-to-agent integrations using A2A and similar protocols, so specialized agents can delegate to each other safely across domains.

• Choose and configure the right agent harness or orchestrator for each job, and build multi-agent patterns (planner/executor, specialized sub-agents) where they genuinely help.

• Stand up Extend's evaluation practice for agents and skills: golden datasets, regression suites, LLM-as-judge, tracing, and drift detection. Every shipped skill should have a way to prove it works and to notice when it stops working.

• Build and curate the shared library of agent skills every team composes from. Codify patterns and raise the floor for what a safe, high-quality skill looks like. Treat every engagement as a source of reusable skills and connectors.

• Design credential scoping and vending for agent connectors: per-user, per-skill, per-connector keys, OAuth/OIDC where it fits, least-privilege everywhere.

• Build the risk-tier and review model for shared skills, including sandboxing and dependency scanning for skills that pull in untrusted packages. Partner with legal, security, and privacy on governance review for agents that touch sensitive data or take autonomous actions.

• Instrument the platform end to end with OpenTelemetry so every MCP call, skill execution, and credential use is visible in Coralogix.

• Own adoption. Write self-serve guides, onboard teams, and run the feedback loop between what shipped and what users actually need. The work is done when the team using it is self-sufficient.

• Mentor more junior engineers on the team in evals, agent design, and secure integration work.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years shipping production systems, and you can point to where they held, where they broke, and what you changed.

• Proficient in TypeScript/Node, Python, or Rust.

• Hands-on experience building with MCP and at least one agent framework or harness (Claude Code, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Google ADK). Familiarity with A2A or other agent interoperability protocols.

• Experience designing and running evals for LLM or agent systems, and using the results to make shipping decisions.

• You can build real third-party integrations: OAuth flows, credential scoping, webhooks, pagination, rate limiting, retries.

• You've built developer tooling, platforms, or internal tools that other people depended on, and you measure that work by adoption.

• You can work directly with non-technical stakeholders: run a working session, challenge assumptions constructively, and explain trade-offs in plain language.

• Comfortable on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3) with solid security fundamentals: IAM, KMS, serverless attack patterns.

• Familiarity with AI governance and legal or privacy review processes, including risks around data access, permissions, tool use, and autonomous actions.

• You use AI tooling every day and have opinions about what works.

Nice to Have

• Eval and observability tooling: LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry, Coralogix, Datadog.

• LLM application security: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and agentic applications, prompt injection defense, agent sandboxing.

• AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or similar infrastructure-as-code.

• Background in platform engineering, internal developer platforms, or enterprise integration.

• Prior IC role at an early-stage startup with a small team and a wide surface area.

Expected Pay Range: $155,000 - $170,000 per year salaried*

* The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

Life at Extend:

• Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment.

• Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits.

• Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly.

• Generous, flexible paid time off policy.

• 401(k) with Financial Guidance from Morgan Stanley.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, Intelligence Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and next generation national security products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Anduril’s AIS team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead, and scale a high-velocity team responsible for the software and user-interface ecosystem powering next-generation hardware platforms and System-on-Chip (SoC) devices. In this role, you will balance people leadership, technical direction, and operational execution, ensuring your team delivers robust, mission-critical web applications that are rigorously tested and validated.

• Team Leadership & People Management: Mentor and retain a high-performing team of front-end and full-stack software engineers.

• Technical Strategy & Architecture: Guide the architectural direction for mission-critical web UIs, ensuring high reliability, test coverage, low latency, and seamless state synchronization with underlying hardware and backend services.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, Embedded Systems Engineers, Backend Leads, and Hardware teams to align UI roadmaps with customer delivery milestones.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of software development experience with deep expertise in modern web ecosystems, including TypeScript, modern CSS/SCSS, and React (with state management tools such as Redux Toolkit).

• Experience using RESTful APIs and addressing common challenges, such as state management and concurrency

• Experience with front-end testing methodologies and tools, such as React Testing Library, Cypress, and Jest

• Experience with serialization and deserialization frameworks like Protobufs

• Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance, at a minimum.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior experience leading teams at the intersection of hardware/embedded devices and software interfaces (e.g., SoC integration, robotics, IoT, or edge computing).

• Technical breadth covering backend/systems programming languages (C, C++, Rust, or Go) and modern microservice architectures.

• Experience with IPC models in embedded contexts

• Experience implementing authentication and authorization in classified or air-gapped environments.

US Salary Range

$220,000—$292,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Vision - New Platforms
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:

As a Vision Software Staff Engineer, you will act as the technical lead for the software and embedded architecture definition of the real-time, high-definition video processing, imaging, and intra-body illumination systems at the heart of a new generation surgical robotic platform.

You will drive the deep integration of cameras, image sensors, and vision processing pipelines into complex, multi-processor embedded architectures, bringing sound engineering judgment to the trade-offs between hardware, software, and algorithms, and procedure-specific product requirements.

Critical to the success of this role is experience diagnosing and debugging complex vision systems end-to-end – from sensor and optics through the video pipeline to software – driving root cause investigations and collaborating with hardware and algorithms teams to resolve difficult, multi-disciplinary issues. Familiarity with working in a regulated industry and with design controls for medical devices is a plus.

The successful candidate must excel at evaluating design trade-offs through detailed technical deep dives, proof-of-concept development, and rapid iteration, translating rough requirements into robust, well-reasoned embedded software architectures.

A strong sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required, as is the ability to make the work fun and interesting. Supporting you will be a development and management team that knows and cares about what you are doing and wants you to succeed.

Essential Job Duties

• Lead the definition of hardware, software, and algorithms architecture for the real-time video processing engine, image sensors, and intra-body illumination systems of a new generation surgical robotic platform, from concept through implementation.
• Drive the integration of cameras, image sensors, and vision processing pipelines into complex, multi-processor embedded architectures, ensuring robust interfaces between hardware, FPGA/ISP, and software components.
• Evaluate multiple design trade-offs for the embedded vision software architecture through detailed technical deep dives, proof-of-concept development, and rapid iteration.
• Lead bring-up and integration of new, high-performance cameras and image sensors, and the integration and evaluation of advanced camera pipeline video processing algorithms.
• Diagnose and debug vision system issues end-to-end – sensor, optics, video pipeline, and software – leading root cause investigations in close collaboration with hardware, algorithms, and systems engineering teams.
• Drive development and enhancement of the color and power control functions for intra-operative illumination.
• Lead formal risk analyses for vision and illumination subsystems; identify additional hardware requirements and develop software mitigations to minimize potential failures.
• Design and develop offline simulation environments and hardware/software diagnostic tools that accelerate development, debug, and test.
• Perform and guide detailed design, development, documentation, and verification of embedded vision software and supervisory state machines, in compliance with regulatory requirements and Intuitive's internal guidelines.
• Contribute broadly across the video and vision software stack, including extension of current processing frameworks to new hardware platforms.
• Apply high-level and specialized imaging/vision expertise to deliver innovations and problem-solving approaches that can be leveraged across multiple products.
• Mentor and guide engineers across the vision team.

Required Education and Training

• Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.
• A minimum of 12 years of experience developing and supporting embedded systems, with significant focus on video, imaging, or vision systems (or 8 years with a Master's degree, or 5 years with a PhD).

Required Skills and Experience

• Fluent in designing and developing mission-critical, cross-platform code in C/C++ for embedded, real-time, Linux-based systems, including application-level and driver-level development for multi-core and multi-processor architectures.
• Deep familiarity with integrating cameras, image sensors, and vision processing pipelines into complex embedded architectures, including hardware, software, and algorithm interfaces.
• Demonstrated ability to debug and diagnose complex vision system issues through root cause investigation and close cross-functional collaboration with hardware and algorithms teams.
• Demonstrated ability to evaluate design trade-offs for embedded software architectures through detailed technical deep dives, proof-of-concept development, and rapid iteration.
• Direct experience with imaging devices – e.g., cameras, light sensors, video/graphics hardware – including sensor and camera bring-up, configuration, and integration.
• Fluent with image-processing concepts, camera pipeline video processing algorithms, and video processing frameworks.
• Working knowledge of Python or other scripting languages for diagnostics, automation, and test.
• Demonstrated experience and comfort with all phases of the product development lifecycle, including design, documentation, implementation, debug, verification, validation, and transfer to manufacturing.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Knowledge of image-processing, CUDA, ML, and/or FPGA integration (e.g., Vivado and other FPGA development tools).
• Familiarity with communication protocols such as TCP/IP, CAN, and serialization protocols.
• Experience designing software products in a regulated industry or for mission-critical applications; comfort with concepts of design input, design output, traceability, risk analysis, and mitigations.
• Leadership of medical technology projects from inception through field validation to launch; strong understanding of the medical product ecosystem.
• Familiarity with rapid development and rapid prototyping tools.
• Demonstrated capacity to relate to and mentor all levels of employees.

Working Conditions

• none

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

Kairos Power is seeking a highly skilled and safety-focused Maintenance Lead to build and lead a fit-for-purpose maintenance program for our Salt Production Facility (SPF). The facility includes a range of process and utility systems, with differing operating risks and regulatory requirements. The Maintenance Lead will develop and implement maintenance practices that support safe, reliable operations and meet the requirements applicable to each system and activity.

This role will work closely with Process Design, Operations Engineering, and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) to prioritize maintenance, establish effective work planning and spare-parts practices, and develop the maintenance team and systems needed to support the facility.

Responsibilities

• Develop risk-based preventive and corrective maintenance practices appropriate to the equipment, operating risks, and applicable requirements.

• Lead the creation of maintenance work packages, including procedures, tools, materials, and safety protocols.

• Develop practical work orders and job plans, including labor, tools, materials, and coordination needs.

• Plan and schedule maintenance activities in coordination with the operations team to support safe execution and minimize downtime.

• Supervise the execution of maintenance tasks to ensure quality, safety, and compliance.

• Support the establishment and continuous improvement of a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

• Manage spare parts inventory and procurement processes for critical equipment.

• Conduct root cause analysis of equipment failures and implement corrective actions.

• Promote safe work practices, continuous improvement, and collaboration within the maintenance team.

• Build and implement a practical, fit-for-purpose maintenance program for SPF equipment and systems.

• Manage and mentor a team responsible for maintenance planning, scheduling, and execution.

• Establish performance expectations, provide regular feedback, conduct performance evaluations, and address performance and development needs for direct reports.

• Monitor maintenance backlog, preventive maintenance completion, and recurring equipment issues; use findings to adjust maintenance practices and escalate resource needs.

• Verify that required equipment isolation, permits, and operational releases are in place before maintenance begins, in coordination with Operations and EHS.

• Collaborate closely with operations to ensure safe and coordinated maintenance work.

• Ensure maintenance work follows applicable regulatory, company, and site requirements, including Process Safety Management (PSM) requirements where applicable.

• Support long-term reliability and safety of chemical plant systems and equipment.

• Prioritize maintenance based on equipment condition, failure history, and consequences of failure.

• Coordinate maintenance performed by employees, contractors, and equipment vendors.

• Support equipment troubleshooting, commissioning, and return-to-service activities.

• Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

• Associate’s degree in mechanical, electrical, industrial technology, or a related field; Bachelor’s degree preferred

• 7+ years of maintenance experience in a chemical or industrial plant environment

• 3+ years of leadership or supervisory experience in a maintenance or reliability role

• Experience establishing or significantly improving maintenance programs in chemical processing or comparable industrial facilities is preferred

• Strong knowledge of Process Safety Management (PSM) and associated compliance requirements

• Experience supporting equipment commissioning and transitioning new equipment or facilities into routine maintenance is preferred

• Experience with developing and executing preventive maintenance programs

• Proficiency in reading technical schematics, P&IDs, and maintenance documentation

• Experience implementing or configuring a CMMS, including equipment records, preventive maintenance schedules, and spare-parts data is preferred

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

• Strong knowledge of Process Safety Management (PSM) and associated compliance requirements

• Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance methods, including task and interval selection based on equipment needs, operating conditions, and failure history

• Ability to assess equipment condition and performance, troubleshoot failures, and identify root causes and corrective actions

• Ability to prioritize maintenance based on equipment criticality, condition, failure consequences, and operational needs

• Ability to delegate work based on employee qualifications and workload, establish clear expectations, and provide constructive feedback to address performance and development needs.

• Ability to develop maintenance work packages and schedules addressing resources, safety controls, and operational constraints

• Proficiency in using a CMMS to manage equipment histories, work orders, backlogs, and completion trends

• Knowledge of critical spare-parts planning and inventory control, including compatibility, lead times, and availability

• Ability to interpret schematics, P&IDs, equipment manuals, and procedures to plan and oversee maintenance

• Strong communication, team leadership, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work with highly collaborative team

• Ability to solve problems quickly and efficiently

• Prioritizes and ensures safety of oneself and others

• Ability to proactively collect, manage and transfer knowledge

• Ability to seek different and novel ways to create efficiencies when working on problems, challenges and issues

Physical Demands

• Ascending or descending ladders, stairs, scaffolding, ramps, scissor lifts, articulated boom lifts and the like

• Setting up and transferring temporary structures (e.g. scaffolding, ladders)

• Moving self in different positions to accomplish tasks in various environments including tight and confined spaces

• Remaining in a stationary position, often standing, or sitting for prolonged periods

• Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another

• Adjusting, moving, transporting, installing, positioning, or removing objects up to 50 pounds in all directions

• Communicating with others to exchange information

• Operating motor vehicles, heavy equipment or machinery

• Use hand tools

Environmental Conditions

• Low temperatures

• High temperatures

• Outdoor environment or elements such as precipitation and wind

• Noisy environments

• Small and/or enclosed spaces

• Odors or fumes from chemicals or chemical reactions

• Elevated heights

• High-concentration, demanding and fast-paced

Safety and PPE

• Reading and interpreting hazardous warning signs

• Manipulating, cleaning and disposal of hazardous materials

• Reporting issues with equipment or unsafe conditions

• Color identification: detecting, distinguishing, recognizing and identifying colors

• Wearing proper personal protective equipment (PPE), to include face mask, face shields, gloves, safety shoes, and other PPE as required

• Handling of beryllium containing materials

Travel

Certification

• Capable of obtaining lift certification and training others

Additional Requirements

jobs.title: Developer Outreach Lead
jobs.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role in a nutshell:

At Chainguard we're focused on securing the software supply chain. Our growing developer community reflects the genuine passion of users sharing their successes, best practices and innovation around the tools they use. We're hiring a Developer Outreach Lead for a high-impact, highly technical role that puts the needs of developers and their communities at the heart of everything we do: building new and lasting relationships with developers, community leaders and the organizations where our users get the most benefit and support.

This is a player-coach role. You'll lead our outreach programs from day one with potential to build a team around you as the function grows. Reporting to the Head of DevRel, you'll join a highly collaborative, world-class Developer Relations team. As someone developers know and trust, you'll bring technical credibility to help builders get hands-on. You'll be a vital link between Chainguard and the developer communities we serve, working hand in hand with our product, engineering and marketing teams.

What you'll do

• Build our strategy to engage and support the communities that matter most to our users

• Start with what developers need, and build outreach programs that lead help developers go from a first look to secure workflows.

• Establish genuine relationships with community leaders, meetup organizers, open-source maintainers and foundation members, and nurture them over the long term so Chainguard is a trusted partner, not just a sponsor

• Represent Chainguard at meetups, conferences and partner events across the Bay Area and beyond, with roughly 40% travel

• Manage programs that recognize our most passionate and knowledgeable community members, and extend our reach into developer and DevOps communities

• Show up where practitioners already are (GitHub, Reddit, LinkedIn, community forums, conferences and meetups) and be a trusted voice there by publishing tutorials, giving talks and showing code

• Track activation and sustained usage from your programs, and double down on what helps developers succeed

• Be the voice of the developer inside Chainguard, bringing community feedback to product and engineering so what we build reflects what developers actually need

• Partner across our Marketing org (product marketing, brand and social) and GTM teams to align community efforts with our go-to-market motion and help us scale programs with target accounts

What we're looking for

• A proven record of driving developer adoption: programs, engagement or content that led people to actually use something, beyond views and likes

• A public body of work: code shared on GitHub, plus technical videos, tutorials or talks you've delivered

• 7+ years of technical experience with a true software engineering foundation

• 5+ years building technical communities and ambassador or champion programs, whether in DevRel, technical instruction or professional services

• An established personal brand with deep influence in at least one developer channel like GitHub, LinkedIn, Reddit or community forums (a leadership or advisory board role in a framework community like Python or Django counts too)

• Active involvement in DevOps or application security communities, with trusted, long-term relationships with meetup organizers, community leaders and open-source maintainers. You're already in the circle

• Outgoing, personable and highly collaborative: you thrive working across product, engineering and marketing, and you lead with empathy for what developers need

• Hands-on experience with AI agents and a point of view on how developers are enabling them today

Nice to have

• DevRel leadership experience, as both a program lead and people manager

• Maintainer or leading contributor to an open-source project, ideally in the DevOps or application security space

• Experience with our ecosystem partners

• Familiarity supporting account-based programs alongside a go-to-market team

Base Salary Range

$151,000—$178,000 USD

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

• We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.

• We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.

• We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.

• We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

• Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.

• Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

• 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.

• ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.

• 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Scientist/Senior Scientist, Upstream, Process Development & Manufacturing (Biologics)
jobs.location: Menlo Park, California, United States; Remote; Waltham, Massachusetts, United States
jobs.description:
About Us:

Oruka Therapeutics (Nasdaq: ORKA) is developing novel biologics designed to set a new standard for the treatment of chronic skin diseases. Oruka’s mission is to offer patients suffering from chronic skin diseases like plaque psoriasis the greatest possible freedom from their condition by achieving high rates of complete disease clearance with dosing as infrequently as once or twice per year. Oruka is advancing a proprietary portfolio of potentially best-in-class antibodies that were engineered by Paragon Therapeutics and target the core mechanisms underlying plaque psoriasis and other dermatologic and inflammatory diseases. For more information, visit www.orukatx.com

As we build our core team, we're seeking top talent in different functional areas who are not just looking for a job, but an opportunity to be part of something bigger.  Someone who is passionate about making a difference and eager to contribute to establishing an engaged, inclusive, and positive company culture.

Job Title: Scientist/Senior Scientist, Upstream, Process Development & Manufacturing (Biologics)

Location: Remote OR Hybrid 3 days/week if located near office in either Waltham, MA or Menlo Park, CA will be required.

Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Scientist/Senior Scientist to support cell culture and cell line development activities. This role will be instrumental in contributing to early-phase process development and delivery of clinical trial material at CDMOs. The ideal candidate will collaborate cross-functionally within the CMC team including downstream, analytical, and drug product and other stakeholders such as QA, regulatory, and program management.  The successful candidate will help support CMC strategy in a fast-paced, innovative environment. This individual will be an integral part of a growing team with an opportunity to contribute towards developing best-in-class biotherapeutics.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive cell line development and upstream cell culture process development, oversee manufacturing execution at external CDMOs.

• Contribute technical expertise to early-phase upstream process development, scale-up, and tech transfer to secure reliable drug substance supply.

• Serve as person-in-plant (PIP) during critical manufacturing campaigns, troubleshooting and resolving issues in real time.

• Proactively identify technical and development risks and implement phase-appropriate mitigation strategies.

• Manage upstream timelines and deliverables to ensure on-time material delivery and seamless handoffs to downstream, analytical, and drug product teams.

• Apply phase-appropriate QbD principles and analyze process data to guide development decisions.

• Travel up to 25% to support on-site CDMO activities.

Qualifications

• PhD with 3+ years or Master’s with 5+ years of industry experience in Biological Sciences focused on upstream process development and/or cell line development.

• Strong hands-on expertise in CHO cell line and/or cell culture process development, scale-up, and bioreactor operations; experience with monoclonal antibody (mAb) production preferred.

• Solid understanding of upstream process parameters and product quality attributes, with experience troubleshooting during clinical manufacturing.

• Experience supporting or leading upstream tech transfer to CDMOs.

• Familiarity with phase-appropriate cGMP requirements and regulatory expectations for biologics development.

• Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret process and manufacturing data.

Compensation:

• An appropriate financial package will be developed for the successful candidate to include a competitive base salary and equity, with a performance-related bonus opportunity.

• The anticipated salary range for candidates, is $161,000-187,000. The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the type and length of experience within the job, type and length of experience within the industry, education, etc. Oruka is a multi-state employer and this salary range may not reflect positions that work in other states.

We're looking forward to hearing how you can contribute to our team and mission. Join us in shaping the future of our company and making a real impact every day.

Salary Range for the Role

$161,000—$187,000 USD

What We Offer:

• A chance to be part of a vibrant startup culture where your work can directly impact bringing new medicines to patients.

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• A supportive and inclusive team environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work.

• Opportunities for professional growth and development.

The Compliance team at MongoDB manages the strategy, execution, and maintenance of our global security certifications and regulatory requirements. We ensure that our cloud database products meet the rigorous security standards required by our customers in the most highly regulated industries worldwide.

We act as the primary interface between external auditors and our internal Product, Engineering, and Legal teams. Our goal is to translate complex regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes, maintaining a compliant and audit-ready posture across our diverse portfolio.

The Program Manager (Public Sector) is a senior-level individual contributor role responsible for the lifecycle management of our most sensitive US government authorizations. This role acts as a lead for high-stakes workstreams involving FedRAMP High, DoD IL5+, CJIS, and ITAR. Unlike the Analyst level, this role takes full ownership of complex federal assessments and leads the continuous monitoring strategy for our Atlas for Government product. This role is a key resource for interpreting NIST 800-53 controls and translating them into technical requirements for our engineering teams.

This role can be based out of one of our offices or remotely in the US.

Responsibilities:

• Lead Federal Authorizations: Drive end-to-end execution of federal assessments, serving as the primary lead for 3PAOs, agency sponsors, and the FedRAMP PMO

• Own Continuous Monitoring (ConMon): Manage the heartbeat of our federal posture, including vulnerability analysis, reporting, and the strategic maintenance of our POA&M

• Architect Security Artifacts: Lead the technical review and annual updates for core FedRAMP artifacts (SSP, ISCP, IRP) to ensure they reflect our evolving architecture

• Technical Advisory: Act as a consultant to Engineering and Ops, ensuring configurations like FIPS 140-2/3, boundary protection, and identity management align with DoD mandates

• Future-Proofing: Perform gap analyses for emerging mandates (e.g., CMMC, GovRAMP) and define the technical roadmap for remediation

jobs.description:
AbbVie Oncology Discovery seeks a highly motivated, skilled biologist with expertise in Oncology or Immuno-Oncology. The successful candidate will play a key role in discovering novel cancer-targeting strategies and developing technology platforms that enable biologics-based anti-cancer drugs, with the aim of generating future clinical programs. Working in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment, the Scientist I will collaborate with diverse experts both within and beyond their own scientific discipline.

Key Responsibilities:

• Serve as a key source of technical expertise and laboratory techniques
• Explore and develop new methods, techniques, and in vitro cellular and biochemical assays for use in oncology discovery programs
• Design, conduct, and interpret controlled experiments to investigate the biology and mechanisms of action of biologics-based therapeutics (e.g., antibodies, multi-specifics, antibody-drug conjugates)
• Rigorously analyze, interpret, and troubleshoot data; document results accurately and communicate them promptly
• Stay closely aligned with project goals and adjust experimental plans as needed; complete studies on schedule to support milestone decisions
• Contribute and collaborate as a key member of a matrixed team, under the guidance of a senior research scientist

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree with typically five years of experience, or Master’s degree with typically two years of experience, in Cell/Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Immunology, or a related field
• Extensive hands-on laboratory research experience and a commitment to a lab-based role that demands rigorous, high-quality experimentation
• Broad expertise in standard biochemistry, cell biology, molecular biology, and immunology techniques (e.g., mammalian cell culture, cell-based and biochemical assays, flow cytometry)
• Able to contribute independently within a team while actively collaborating with partners
• Demonstrated strength in verbal and written communication
• Strong organizational skills and experience using data analysis software (e.g., Microsoft Excel, FlowJo, GraphPad Prism)

Preferred:

• Prior experience in profiling immune cell composition, phenotypes, and functional status within the tumor microenvironment in mouse models
• Proficient in culturing primary immune cells (e.g., macrophages, T cells) and conducting in vitro functional immunoassays
• Strong skills in multi-color flow cytometry
• Previous experience in biologics or biologic-based drugs, either in an academic or industrial setting
• Working knowledge of bioinformatics databases and tools

Key Leadership Competencies:

• Builds strong relationships with peers and cross functionally with partners outside of team to enable higher performance
• Learns fast, grasps the 'essence' and can change the course quickly where indicated
• Raises the bar and is never satisfied with the status quo
• Creates a learning environment, open to suggestions and experimentation for improvement
• Embraces the ideas of others, nurtures innovation and manages to reality

jobs.title: Director of Security
jobs.description:
Marksman Security is built on serving our clients and building careers – just like yours. We are trusted by some of the most well-known companies and properties in the country while remaining dedicated to building personalized security solutions that solve the needs of every customer we support. Named as a nationally recognized Top Workplace in 2024 and 2025 by USA Today, Marksman's customized approach to security services will provide you with the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed. Our core values of being Unified, Transparent, Innovative, Committed and Accountable help us in providing unparalleled service and support in all that we do. If you are looking for a meaningful career, a culture of excellence, and the ability to make a difference, we want to talk to you!

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

1. Professional Conduct and Guest Services (Concierge Focus)

• Exemplary Professional Presence: Maintain a consistently polished, professional, and immaculate uniform and personal presentation, serving as a positive and credible first impression for the property.

• Proactive Engagement: Act as the primary point of contact for all building occupants and guests, providing proactive assistance, clear directions, and timely information with a naturally outgoing, engaging, and hospitable demeanor.

• Tenant Relations: Professionally and promptly assist tenants with building-related inquiries, access issues, and security concerns, establishing positive rapport and escalating complex matters to management as necessary.

• Visitor Management: Efficiently manage the visitor sign-in/sign-out process, verify identity, issue temporary badges, and announce guest arrivals in accordance with established security protocols.

• Ability to provide high level customer service in a fast paced setting

• Maintain access control procedures set by building management.

• Ensure visitors and vendors are properly signed in prior to accessing the building.

• Identify all tenants and/or visitors upon arrival.

• Observe departing personnel to guard against theft of tenant or building property.

• Assist tenants and visitors with directions and general business information.

• Provide excellent Customer Service to all parties encountered while on duty.

2. Security and Loss Prevention Operations

• Access Control: Strictly enforce building access control policies, ensuring every individual (tenant, vendor, or visitor) follows proper entry procedures (key card/badge usage) and preventing unauthorized entry or "tailgating"

• Assist in the Coordination and/or conduct site-specific “on the job training”, client–specific training and annual refresher training for staff by adhering to Marksman / Titan training standards.

• Foot Patrols: Conduct regular, documented security patrols of the property's interior and exterior perimeter, including common areas, parking garages, and vacant tenant spaces, identifying and reporting safety hazards or security vulnerabilities.

• Supervise operations of an assigned Client site on assigned shift.

• Surveillance and Monitoring: Proficiently operate and monitor the Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) system, alarm panels, and other life safety systems, noting and responding to all unusual activities.

• Emergency Response: Serve as a primary responder to all alarms and critical incidents (e.g., medical emergencies, fire alarms, suspicious activities, unauthorized persons), following established emergency procedures and coordinating with building management and first responders.

• Develop staff in both technical and professional skills through performance management (coaching, recognition, etc.).

• Ensure the Client Site is provided with high quality security services to protect people and property.

• Manage a team of security officers, including participating in scheduling, payroll, training, coaching, development and support.

3. Documentation and Incident Management

• Report Writing: Prepare detailed, accurate, and professional written reports on all security-related incidents, daily activities, unusual occurrences, and patrol observations using required digital platforms.

• Critical Incident Escalation: Immediately and effectively escalate all critical incidents and emergencies to the appropriate building management, security contacts, and law enforcement agencies, ensuring a timely and organized response.

• Maintain clear, accurate logs pertaining to people or property including packages.

• Clearly and accurately record data such as property damage, unusual occurrences, and malfunctioning of equipment, to building and Titan management.

• Key and Access Card Control: Assist with the accurate inventory and issuance of all building keys and access cards, ensuring documentation is current and that credentials for terminated personnel are immediately deactivated and reconciled.

• Report directly to Director and/or Marksman / Titan Management.

• Handle all escalated security issues or emergency situations appropriately.

4. Minimum Qualifications of Director of Security:

• Education and/or Experience: High School diploma or general education degree (GED) and 3 years prior satisfactory employment as a security officer or directly related experience. Must be at least 18 years of age.

• Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: Valid Security License if required by state, driver’s license as applicable.

• Language Skills: Must have the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English. Bi-lingual considered a plus.

• Other Qualifications: Ability to pass pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check. Must maintain a working telephone number though which we can contact you.

• Physical Demands: The physical demands are based on the contract and must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. A list of these job duties is inclusive of, but not limited to: candidates must be able to stand for extended periods of time; be able to lift, push, and/or pull at least 50 lbs.; be able to accommodate foot patrols on the interior &; exterior of the assigned facility; be able to perform assigned duties regardless of inclement weather.

5. Pay and Benefits of Director of Security: $70,000

6. Benefits of Director of Security

• Paid time off and paid holidays
• Medical/ Dental/ Vision/ Supplemental insurance
• Opportunities for career growth and promotion
• Skills-enhancing training

EOE/M/F/D/V

jobs.title: Eastern Communications Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
Are you inspired by the idea of supporting our nation’s critical infrastructure and securing communications for first responders, utilities, and transportation?
 
Are you interested in being part of a fast-paced, growing company with opportunities to expand your knowledge base across a wide range of mission critical technologies?
 
Company Overview
Eastern Communications, Ltd. is a critical communications provider based in Long Island City, Queens, NY. Founded in 1976, and acquired from original ownership in 2020, Eastern provides infrastructure, technical services, field replacement parts, and maintenance to a range of end users including public safety, transportation, utilities, and the federal government. The company has earned its exceptional reputation for delivering the highest quality products and services over its 45+ year history. In February 2023, we acquired Iowa-based RACOM Corporation. Since then, both PMC Wireless and GenComm have joined the team and the company now comprises 350 employees across 18 locations nationwide, creating one of the largest mission critical communications companies in the United States.
 
Role Overview
The Eastern Communications Ltd. Accounting Manager will play a crucial role in driving our organization's financial insights and decision-making. In this role, you will report to the Controller daily and will be primarily responsible for working in the ERP system with oversight of general ledger transactions, preparation and review of financial statements, and complex accounting issues as they arise. As part of our dynamic team, you’ll have the chance to grow both personally and professionally and contribute to our company's success in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Scout Space is building a new way to see and operate in space: with a new paradigm of data empowering every satellite to make space safer. We are looking for people who bring excitement and energy to our organization, are curious and eager to learn, and want to help drive our programs forward.

• Support day-to-day business operations and cross-functional projects across Scout's engineering, program, finance, and administrative teams.

• Help develop, document, and improve internal processes, workflows, and systems to support a rapidly growing aerospace company.

• Support business operations activities, including purchasing, vendor coordination, financial tracking, and operational reporting.

• Support operational planning and logistics for Scout's office, engineering lab, equipment, and facilities.

• Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve cross-team coordination, and implement operational improvements.

• Pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Operations, Finance, or a related field

• Rising juniors, seniors, or graduate students only

• Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail

• Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets

• Clear written and verbal communication skills

• Preferred: Demonstrated interest in space, aerospace, or hardware startups

Benefits & Perks

• Flexible work hours

• Free Scout Swag!

• Opportunities for professional development and growth

• A dynamic and collaborative work environment at the forefront of space technology

• Be a part of a team that is making history!

Our positions are based in Reston, Virginia, with much of our team operating in a hybrid or remote fashion.

This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

Scout Space Inc. does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor.
