jobs.title: Account Executive, SMG
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY:

The Account Executive, SMG plays a key role in OpenGov’s growth by converting qualified leads into new customer relationships. This position serves as the primary point of contact for prospective customers through the full sales cycle — from discovery to contract signature — for a defined set of OpenGov products. The AE will partner closely with the POD Leader in their territory, Solution Engineers, and other cross-functional teams to drive new business in the State and Local Government market.

This role represents a progression from Sales Development, emphasizing ownership of the full sales process in addition to prospecting, opportunity management, and closing new business within a defined territory. The AE will demonstrate strong consultative selling skills, business acumen, and the ability to tailor OpenGov’s value proposition to government leaders.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own the full sales cycle from qualified lead to closed opportunity.

 - Manage a defined territory and build relationships with prospects in local and state governments, school districts, and special districts.

 - Conduct discovery calls to understand prospect needs, pain points, and desired outcomes.

 - Deliver tailored product demonstrations and proposals in collaboration with Solution Engineers.

 - Prospect into your territory for the assigned OpenGov Product(s) to generate pipeline, and drive consistent prospect engagement.

 - Develop account and opportunity strategies to achieve or exceed quarterly quota targets.

 - Execute structured sales processes using MEDDIC methodology and maintain accurate pipeline data in Salesforce.

 - Negotiate pricing in alignment with OpenGov’s standards and policies.

 - Collaborate with marketing on regional campaigns and events to increase brand awareness and pipeline.

 - Contribute feedback on messaging, customer trends, and product-market fit to internal stakeholders.

 - Participate in team enablement sessions and share best practices for prospecting, discovery, and closing.




REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field (or equivalent experience).

 - 2+ years of professional sales experience, including at least 1 year in a quota-carrying role (inside sales, SDR, or similar).

 - Demonstrated success converting qualified leads into closed deals.

 - Strong communication, presentation, and consultative selling skills.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 - Familiarity with Salesforce (or similar CRM) and structured sales methodologies such as MEDDIC or SPIN.

 - Collaborative and team-oriented approach to working with SDRs, peers, and cross-functional partners.

 - Passion for technology, problem-solving, and improving how governments serve their communities.

 - Competitive drive, self-motivation, and resilience under pressure.

 - Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency

 - Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings or events (up to 25%).



Compensation:

Boston, MA: $120,000 - $160,000

On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

 

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

We pride ourselves in being respectful and supportive of others while shining brightly through our innovative, high-quality products. There isn’t one superstar at Riverside. We take turns leading the way as we climb to the summit.

• Continuous improvement: As a learn-as-we-go organization, we rely on each other to continuously improve everything we touch to make it better, more efficient, more sustainable, and more endearing to customers, consumers, employees, vendors, partners and the community. jobs.title: Stagiaire Procesautomatisering & AI (binnen Microsoft Copilot)
jobs.description:
Tijdens je stage krijg je de mogelijkheid om meerdere opdrachten op te pakken, zoals bijvoorbeeld:

• Ondersteunen bij het opzetten van een effectieve Copilot-governance structuur.
• Automatiseren en optimaliseren van kwaliteitsprocessen.
• Ontwikkelen van AI-agents voor het verzamelen en samenvatten van nieuws- en marktontwikkelingen binnen R&D en QA.
• Verbeteren van het IT-issue- en meldingssysteem.
• Identificeren van nieuwe mogelijkheden voor automatisering binnen de organisatie.
• Vertalen van businessvraagstukken naar praktische AI- en automatiseringsoplossingen.

Je werkt samen met verschillende afdelingen en stakeholders en krijgt veel ruimte om initiatief te nemen en eigen ideeën uit te werken.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een enthousiaste stagiair die energie krijgt van innovatie, procesverbetering en AI.

Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van: Business IT & Management, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Bedrijfskunde (met een sterke interesse in IT), ICT (met interesse in businessprocessen) of een vergelijkbare opleiding.

Daarnaast:

• Heb je affiniteit met AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate en proces automatisering.
• Begrijp je hoe bedrijfsprocessen werken of wil je hier meer over leren.
• Kun je bedrijfsvraagstukken vertalen naar digitale oplossingen.
• Werk je zelfstandig en neem je initiatief.
• Beschik je over goede communicatieve vaardigheden.

Belangrijk: Je hoeft geen ervaren programmeur te zijn of complexe programmeertalen te beheersen. Voor deze stage vinden we het belangrijker dat je begrijpt hoe organisaties en processen werken én interesse hebt in hoe AI en technologie deze processen kunnen ondersteunen. Daarom sluiten studenten met een businessachtergrond en sterke IT-affiniteit vaak goed aan bij deze opdracht.

Wat bieden wij?

• Een uitdagende stage binnen een innovatieve en internationale organisatie.
• Begeleiding door professionals op het gebied van Lean, IT en procesverbetering.
• Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ontwikkeling.
• Werken met de nieuwste Microsoft AI-oplossingen, waaronder Microsoft Copilot.
• Een stage waarin je direct impact maakt op de manier waarop mensen werken.

Over het bedrijf

Eurofins Scientific is een internationaal beursgenoteerd life sciences bedrijf dat haar klanten voorziet van hoogwaardig laboratoriumonderzoek en advies. Eurofins is wereldwijd marktleider op het gebied van bio-analytische testen voor levensmiddelen, water, milieu, cosmetica, farmaceutische producten en contract research voor agro science. Onze mensen bij Eurofins leveren een belangrijke bijdrage aan wereldwijde thema’s op het gebied van onder meer milieu, voedselveiligheid en algehele gezondheid.

De geaccrediteerde laboratoria van Eurofins Milieu bieden in Nederland een uitgebreid pakket aan chemische, fysische en biologische analyses in alle milieu matrices. Door jarenlange ervaring heeft zij uitvoerige kennis op het gebied van zowel routinematige analyses als niet standaard analyses waaronder analyses van bijzondere verbindingen en microverontreinigingen. Eurofins is marktleider op het gebied van specialistisch onderzoek; opdrachtgevers zijn onder meer waterkwaliteitsbeheerders, Rijkswaterstaat, provinciale en gemeentelijke overheden, milieu-adviesbureaus, industrie en aannemers. Circa 600 gemotiveerde deskundigen verzorgen het traject van monstername tot aan de digitale rapportage van de analyseresultaten. Analyses vinden voornamelijk plaats in de grote laboratoria in Amsterdam (Eurofins Omegam) en Barneveld (Eurofins Analytico).

Walden Security is currently recruiting experienced Court Security Officers. CSOs will provide armed security to courthouses under the USMS contract.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Includes the following and other duties may be assigned:

Perform entrance control: Enforce the District’s entry and identification system which includes operating security screening equipment to detect weapons, contraband, and prohibited items, checking items such as handbags, briefcases, computers, packages, baby carriages, wheelchairs, etc.

Perform roving patrol: Patrol court facilities and grounds of the facility in accordance with applicable post orders.

Perform stationary post assignments: Stand guard at stationary posts which include (but not limited to) monitoring closed-circuit television, duress alarm systems and other security equipment, courtrooms, judge chambers, and jury rooms.

Perform garage parking and pedestrian control: Where applicable, direct traffic and control lights on court facility properties, as described in the post orders and/or standard operating procedures.

Enforce law and order: Enforce federal law while in the performance of assigned duties. This includes (but not limited to) detaining any person attempting to gain unauthorized access to Government property, or a court proceeding(s), or attempting to commit acts that imperil the safety and security of Government employees, property, and the public.

Prepare reports and records: Prepare various reports and records regarding contract performance issues, such as labor hours worked, accidents, fire, bomb threats, unusual incidents, or unlawful acts that occurred within the court facility area.

Court attendance: Responsible for securing unattended courtrooms, an inspection of courtrooms prior to a proceeding, testing of security devices, and other duties concerning security of the court area.

Preserve order: Responsible for providing security presence in the courtroom, enforcing federal law and judicial orders within the courtroom, enforcing local court rules regarding prohibited items, and providing protection to court proceedings as circumstances dictate.

Requirements

Education and/or Experience: High school diploma or general education degree (GED). At least three (3) calendar years of verifiable experience as a certified law enforcement officer or its military equivalency (Master-at-Arms, CGPD, Security Forces Specialist, etc.); all three (3) years must have occurred within the last seven (7) years. The experience must have included general arrest authority.

Language Skills: Must have the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English. Must possess the ability to understand, explain, interpret, and apply rules, regulations, directives, and procedures.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: Must have a valid driver's license from state of residency and a safe driving record for the past five years; Must receive clearance from the Department of Justice. Must have completed or graduated from certified Federal, state, county, local or military law enforcement training academy and able to provide certification as proof.

Other Qualifications: Must be at least 21 years of age; Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check.

Position Summary/Objective:

As a Licensed Maintenance Technician, you are responsible for contributing to the company’s operational performance through maintenance program compliance and work order scheduling including reactive and preventative maintenance for technical and non-technical components. Shift Hours Saturday-Monday 7pm-7am

Primary Responsibilities:

• Demonstrate and uphold Riverside Natural Food’s Core Values.

• Understand and lead compliance with both Health and Safety and Food Safety practices.

• Attending breakdown call. Independently troubleshoot and resolve both mechanical and electrical issues.

• Escalate recurring problems to supervisor and work on eliminating them.

• Perform minor repairs, equipment set up, change over, overhaul, fabrication as needed.

• Perform preventive maintenance on manufacturing equipment including food mixer, slab forming machine, horizontal wrapper, robotic pick and place system, case packer, tunnel oven, conveyors, etc.

• Provide technical assistant / advice in Preventive Maintenance optimization effort.

• Assist outside contractors and ensure GMP policies are being adhered to.

• Performs work in accordance with established maintenance processes and practices including but not limited to recording work done, recording data for analysis, logging spare parts consumed, cleaning up work area, etc.

• Participate in cross functional continuous improvement initiative.

• Responsible for the highest standards of housekeeping & safety in all aspects of the job.

• Other duties as assigned.

Reporting Relationships

• This position report directly to the Maintenance Supervisor

Key Qualifications/Requirements

• Minimum 5 years of experience as Millwright Mechanic or Maintenance technician

• Required certified NOC 7311 or "Red Seal" Millwright Mechanics or Provincial Electricians Ticket (433A, 442A, 309D)

• Working experience with equipment such as vertical wrapper, horizontal wrappers, robotics pick and place, tunnel oven is an asset

• Knowledge of PLC, robotics, HMIs, and controls (Allen Bradley) preferred

• Ability to read technical drawings and electrical schematics

• Hands on working experience with the following is preferred

• Power transmission systems

• Electric and electronic controls

• Pneumatic and hydraulic systems

• Welding, brazing, and soldering

• Servo and electric motors

• lubrication types and systems

• Proven machining skills using lathes, milling, and drill press

• Rigging and hoisting experience is an asset

Please note this role as a new vacancy.

Salary Range

$40.25—$45.25 CAD

At Riverside, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation and job posting practices. The range above reflects the target compensation for the position at the time of posting. Exact compensation will be determined based on experience, skill set, education, and training, as well as other organizational needs, while balancing internal equity.

What we expect:

• Values-led: You’ll be a member of a thoughtful and compassionate team that prioritizes respect, teamwork and resourcefulness along with a good dash of fun. Sometimes, even making granola bars is hard, and life’s too short to take ourselves so seriously that we don’t enjoy the journey.

• Unparalleled experiences and opportunities: We’re still determining who we are and what we can be. Help us shape what this organization will look like and what we’ll offer the world, into the future. This means rolling up your sleeves and sometimes building the process – fast! – while employing it. At Riverside, progress occasionally means proceeding imperfectly, and we’re okay with that, as long as we’re staying true to our values and learning and improving along the way.

• Access to everyone: We’re a flat organization with few silos which means you’ll have full access to everyone from our founders to our production staff. Even when employees dress up, they wear steel-toed shoes. So don’t be shy. Speak up, share your ideas and go places you normally wouldn’t – like the plant, or the boardroom.

• Personal development: We’ll support and empower you to chart your own path and reach any heights you set for yourself. Career paths at Riverside are carved by the people walking on them, not dictated by leaders. Count on us to give you the training and tools to grow and progress.

• Gratitude: As a growing business, we can’t always offer formal recognition like awards programs, but we do show our true gratitude and appreciation. At Riverside, we’re all in this together and we value you.

• Be a Riverside Brand Ambassador: Stay relentlessly close to our consumers and represent the brand in every interaction, decision, and deliverable. Bring the consumer voice into your work by protecting product quality, availability, and experience, acting early when standards slip, and delivering consistent value that earns trust, advocacy, and long-term brand love.

What We Offer:

• Values-led: We don’t cut corners or step on anyone or anything on our way to our summit. There is no winning at all costs here. Every step you take must align with our values, no compromises.

• Courageous determination: As a family-run, rapidly growing business, we are often challenged to find ways to deliver that aren’t obvious or easy. You must be willing to try, ask and answer challenging questions, test and learn, turn over every stone, keep moving forward and help us find a way through. Resourcefulness and grit will be your constant companions at Riverside and will serve you well.

• Humility: We’re a small (but growing) fish in a sea of whales and sharks. We know the products we offer are some of the healthiest and most sustainable, but we don’t brag about it, and know we have a steep path ahead. We pride ourselves in being respectful and supportive of others while shining brightly through our innovative, high-quality products. There isn’t one superstar at Riverside. We take turns leading the way as we climb to the summit.

• Continuous improvement: As a learn-as-we-go organization, we rely on each other to continuously improve everything we touch to make it better, more efficient, more sustainable, and more endearing to customers, consumers, employees, vendors, partners and the community. We own our mistakes and learn from them as we wind our way to the top.

Wait! There’s more!

• Immerse yourself in our comprehensive benefits program, with Riverside taking care of the costs!

• RRSP matching or 401k matching for an empowered financial journey

• Eligibility to participate in Riverside's Profit Sharing Plan

• Join Employee-Led Resource Groups (ERGs) championing mental health, sustainability, diversity, women, and LGBTQ+ rights

• Develop your career further through our Riverside University program and with our Tuition Reimbursement Program

• An open concept work environment that embodies our Values

How to Apply:

If you have the commitment to excellence, the energy, the attitude and experience we need, then please submit your resume to careers(AT)riversidenaturals.com with the job title you are applying for in the subject line or click the apply button!

Riverside Natural Foods Ltd. is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you have a disability and require accommodation in the interview process, please let us know when you apply. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, due to volume, please note that only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

These tools do not make final hiring decisions. All decisions related to screening, interviewing, and selection are made by our Talent Acquisition and hiring teams.

jobs.title: Domino's Assistant Manager (5604)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Production Utility Operator
jobs.description:
At Botanic Tonics, we believe being present is powerful, but in today's world it's very hard to do this a lot of the time. We exist to help people make the most of every moment—to reset, re-think, and then re-engage with themselves, others, and the world around them.

feel free products are thoughtfully crafted with noble kava root and other functional botanicals that have been used for centuries. Our feel free CLASSIC tonic and capsules contain noble kava root and natural kratom leaf, delivering calm, focused energy without caffeine. Our feel free Kava Maté combines noble kava root with yerba mate for elevated, sustained energy with 60mg of natural caffeine per serving. These unique blends are designed to create a state of chilled energy, helping to clear your mind and elevate your mood, so you can be more present and in the moment.

Founded in 2020, we now serve over 6 million servings monthly and are available in more than 27,000 retail locations nationwide. Our premium plant-based supplements are manufactured in an FDA-registered, cGMP-certified production facility in Broken Arrow, Oklahoma, where quality, science, and safety guide everything we do.

Position Overview:

The Production Utility Operator supports production, packaging, and material handling activities throughout the manufacturing process. This role helps maintain product flow, packaging efficiency, inventory accuracy, and overall production performance while supporting Production Technicians and Processing Operators as needed. 

This is a hands-on role requiring attention to detail, flexibility, teamwork, and the ability to work across multiple production areas. The Production Utility Operator is expected to develop working knowledge of production and processing operations and actively participate in cross-training opportunities that support operational flexibility and future growth.



Responsibilities:

 Packaging & Line Support 

• Load empty bottles and packaging materials onto production lines. 

• Monitor product flow and promptly report issues or downtime. 

• Inspect bottles, labels, caps, and packaging for quality concerns. 

• Pack finished product into cartons, apply labels, and stack cartons onto pallets safely and accurately according to work instructions. 

• Assist with startup, shutdown, line clearance, changeovers, cleaning, and sanitation activities. 

• Supply materials and packaging components to production areas and support inventory accuracy. 

Flex Coverage & Cross-Training 

• Support Processing Operator work (material staging, weighing, batching support, and CIP/sanitation) once trained and signed off by a supervisor. 

• Support Production Technician work (operating and monitoring automated equipment, startup/shutdown, changeovers, and first-level troubleshooting) once trained and signed off. 

• Follow the same SOPs, work instructions, and safety requirements as the role being covered, and escalate issues the same way that role would. 

• Participate in cross-training and show willingness to learn new equipment and processes as operations automate. 

Quality & Compliance 

• Follow all cGMP, food safety, sanitation, and safety requirements. 

• Verify packaging materials and finished goods meet company standards. 

• Report product equipment or process concerns to supervisors. 

• Maintain accurate production documentation as required. 

• Support audit readiness and compliance activities. 



Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent required. 

• Manufacturing or production experience preferred; machine operation experience a plus. • Strong attention to detail and reliability; comfortable in a fast-paced, repetitive-task environment. 

• Mechanical aptitude and ability to use hand tools and perform basic equipment adjustments. 

• Basic computer proficiency and ability to navigate production software and manufacturing systems. 

• Ability to obtain forklift certification. 

• Ability to read and understand work instructions, safety procedures, and production documentation. 

• Experience with automated, PLC-controlled, or HMI-controlled equipment preferred. 

• Experience with ERP, scanning, or inventory management systems preferred. 

• Knowledge of cGMP, food safety, or Lean manufacturing practices preferred. 

• Team player with a positive attitude and willingness to learn and cross-train.



Physical Requirements & Work Environment: 

• Ability to lift up to 57 pounds. 

• Ability to stand, walk, climb, bend, and reach regularly. 

• Comfortable working around machinery and in varying conditions. 



Benefits:

Competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision, 401(k) with company match, and paid time off. 



Equal Opportunity Employer:

Botanic Tonics is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applicants in accordance with applicable laws.


BENEFITS OVERVIEW: COMPREHENSIVE MEDICAL, DENTAL AND VISION PLANS, 401K MATCH, FAMILY LEAVE, PTO & PAID HOLIDAY SCHEDULE.




BOTANIC TONICS IS AN EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. CANDIDATES ARE CONSIDERED FOR EMPLOYMENT WITHOUT REGARD TO RACE, CREED, COLOR, NATIONAL ORIGIN, AGE, SEX, RELIGION, ANCESTRY, VETERAN STATUS, MARITAL STATUS, GENDER IDENTIFY, SEXUAL ORIENTATION, NATIONAL ORIGIN, LIABILITY FOR MILITARY SERVICE, OR ANY OTHER CHARACTERISTIC PROTECTED BY APPLICABLE FEDERAL, STATE, OR LOCAL LAW. IF YOU ARE INTERESTED IN LEARNING THE STATUS OF YOUR APPLICATION, PLEASE NOTE YOU WILL BE CONTACTED DIRECTLY BY THE APPROPRIATE HUMAN RESOURCES CONTACT PERSON IF YOU ARE SELECTED FOR FURTHER CONSIDERATION. BOTANIC TONICS RESERVES THE RIGHT TO DEFER OR CLOSE A VACANCY AT ANY TIME.

jobs.title: GNC and Astrodynamics Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Scout Space Inc. is excited to announce our 2027 internship program! We are seeking candidates across engineering and operations fields. Please see the role definitions below for these opportunities. Most internship opportunities are remote, but may involve in-person opportunities.

Scout Space is building a new way to see and operate in space: with a new paradigm of data empowering every satellite to make space safer. We are a rapidly-growing team; we are deploying real solutions to orbit over the next 2 years; and our work will transform the face of spaceflight. We are looking for people who bring excitement and energy to our organization, are curious and eager to learn, and want to help drive our programs forward.

Responsibilities

• Utilize modern computing, modeling, and simulation tools (e.g., C/C++, Python, GMAT, STK), processing and estimation algorithms, and virtual systems to rapidly develop and iterate traditional and novel solutions for relative navigation, orbit determination, ongoing astrodynamics R&D, and next-generation Space Domain Awareness (SDA)

• Support mission planning and ConOps development for operations such as RPO, ISAM, and dynamic resident space object detection, cataloging, and characterization

• Configure and simulate dynamic mission scenarios requiring high accuracy and repeatability (with different data modalities and sensor configurations) to most effectively conduct in-space autonomous operations

• Interface with other engineering teams (CV/AI, Payloads, Systems, etc.), ensuring effective communication and documentation to justify selected GNC algorithms and to ease integration with other systems

Requirements

• Pursuing a Master's or PhD in Astrodynamics, GNC, or related engineering field

• Thorough experience with Python (required) and C++ (desired)

• Highly preferred: Demonstrated experience using astrodynamics and GNC technologies in a business or project environment

Benefits & Perks

• Flexible work hours

• Free Scout Swag!

• Opportunities for professional development and growth

• A dynamic and collaborative work environment at the forefront of space technology

• Be a part of a team that is making history!

• Compensation is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Standard pay for these internships is $30/hour.

Don't fulfill all the qualifications listed above? If you still feel like you might be a good fit, please feel free to APPLY ANYWAY. We believe in a well-rounded team, and this sometimes means that someone with out-of-context knowledge can contribute just as well as someone with very explicit alignment with our capabilities needs stated.

Our positions are based in Reston, Virginia, with much of our team operating in a hybrid or remote fashion.

This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

Scout Space Inc. does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor. To conform to US Government space technology export regulations, applicants must be a US citizen, lawful permanent resident of the US, a protected individual as defined by 8 USC 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorization from the US Department of State.

We’re Proud to Prioritize Mental Health. Scout Space has been recognized with the Bell Seal for Workplace Mental Health by Mental Health America. This certification reflects our ongoing commitment to creating a supportive environment where mental well-being is valued, protected, and openly talked about. We know that when people feel seen and supported, great work happens, and that is the kind of culture we are building here at Scout Space.

jobs.title: Mental Health Clinical Faculty (Part-Time): Duluth, MN
jobs.description:
Opportunity at a Glance

Chamberlain College of Nursing needs qualified Mental Health Clinical Faculty (part-time) in our Bachelors of Science in Nursing program in Duluth, MN.

Teaching is onsite (in clinical setting) with one of our clinical partners. Schedule: most commonly 12-hour rotations (7a-7p) for three to four consecutive days.

Mental-Health Nursing course overview:

Emphasis is on the dynamics of an individual’s ability to function in society. The course focuses on content relative to anxiety, self-concept, thought disorders, mood alterations, addictive behaviors, organic brain dysfunction, abuse and violence issues. It also incorporates health promotion and wellness issues such as stress management and personal growth. Therapeutic communication techniques, individual and group therapy practices and community mental-health resources are also incorporated.

Today, more than ever before, the next generation of nurses needs you. Your passion. Your expertise. Your heart.

If you are passionate about nursing and advancing your career through the power of education, we eagerly invite you to step forward and apply today. Will you join us?

Responsibilities

In this role, the clinical instructor:

• Implements the College's philosophy, curriculum, program outcomes, and course objectives through clinical teaching and service to the College, community, health system and profession.
• Assumes responsibility for all autonomous aspects of individual teaching assignments.
• Plans clinical experiences for and provides direct supervision and evaluation of nursing students delivering nursing care to an individual or group of individuals.
• Evaluates and provides documented feedback to student on level of performance based on course objectives.
• Is available for remediation of students as required or needed.
• Orients and maintains current knowledge related to agency/clinical policies, procedures, and expectations with the assistance of the agency/clinical personnel.
• Develops and posts written clinical assignments consistent with student's knowledge base, skill competency and individual learning needs.
• Grades homework, quizzes, tests, lab assignments, clinical paperwork and other written work in a timely manner
• May teach didactic course content under supervision of course coordinator.
• Keeps course coordinator informed of all student and agency issues and concerns.
• Reports to the dean or assistant dean: a course coordinator will also provide direct oversight.

You are encouraged to explore this opportunity if you have:

• A master's or doctoral degree in Nursing from a regionally accredited college or university
• An unencumbered professional nursing license in the state of Minnesota.
• At least two years professional experience within last five years in the area of instruction as a registered nurse
• Teaching or precepting experience is preferred but not required
• Have genuine passion for nursing, education, and lifelong learning
• Have exceptional subject matter expertise with excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Are eager to serve students and colleagues with passion, respect and care
• Operate with a sense of responsibility and purpose with the desire to enrich colleagues, students and the broader community.
• Illinois RN License will be required to teach all courses (course assignments prioritized to professors who are currently licensed in Illinois)

Thank you for applying for this outstanding opportunity today!

Chamberlain Visiting Professor Position - Campus

Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. jobs.title: IFS Developer (Full-time Onsite position)
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY                                                                                                       
The IFS Developer is responsible for designing, developing, configuring and supporting solutions within IFS 10, including configurations and customizations, along with supporting integrations and reports.
Working closely with all areas of the business, the IFS Developer creates and supports ERP-related process improvements. The developer will manage solutions across Development, Test and Production environments using established Application Life Cycle Management practices to improve internal business processes.
 
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Component Repair Technologies, Inc. (CRT) began as a locally family-owned business, with operations in Mentor, OH since 1985, and grew into a global leader (500+ employees) in the aerospace MRO sector.  Specializing in the repair and overhaul of turbine engine components, CRT proudly serves the world’s largest airlines and jet engine manufactures. jobs.title: Mold Technician - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Mold Technician is responsible for maintaining the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of injection molds and supporting equipment to ensure uninterrupted production. This position plays a key role in producing quality parts by troubleshooting mold-related issues, minimizing downtime, reducing scrap, and supporting production goals. The Mold Technician is expected to demonstrate strong situational safety awareness, promptly escalate safety concerns, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhances the culture order of Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost . Success in this role directly impacts operational performance, customer satisfaction, and the company's commitment to manufacturing excellence.

Main Responsibilities:

• Perform mold installation, removal, machine setup, material setup, and process startup/shutdown to ensure safe and efficient production.
• Monitor assigned production zone performance by tracking and responding to key performance indicators (KPIs), including OEE, equipment downtime, scrap, schedule adherence, and workplace organization.
• Verify job setups, process parameters, and production conditions to ensure quality parts are produced and approved processes are maintained.
• Troubleshoot molding processes, respond to machine alarms, remove stuck parts, and resolve process or equipment issues to minimize downtime and maintain production flow.
• Document daily activities, process changes, troubleshooting efforts, and production losses with accurate and detailed notes to support communication and continuous improvement.
• Inspect molds following maintenance, repair, or modification by performing dimensional re-verifications and confirming production readiness before release.
• Maintain molds, auxiliary equipment, material distribution systems, water lines, and related tooling through cleaning, minor repairs, date wheel changes, and preventative maintenance activities.
• Promote a safe, clean, and organized work environment by maintaining 5S standards, demonstrating situational safety awareness, and promptly escalating safety concerns.
• Support the development of team members by training and mentoring less experienced Mold Technicians and sharing technical knowledge and best practices.
• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to reduce scrap, improve equipment performance, increase process stability, and enhance overall operational efficiency.
• Assist with mold trials, new product launches, engineering evaluations, and validation activities as needed.
• Support maintenance, engineering, quality, and production teams by providing technical expertise during troubleshooting and improvement initiatives.
• Maintain inventory of commonly used tooling, fittings, hoses, and setup supplies while identifying replenishment needs.
• Participate in cross-functional meetings, safety initiatives, audits, and training activities to support departmental and organizational objectives.
• Recommend improvements to standard work, procedures, tooling, and processes to enhance safety, quality, efficiency, and equipment reliability.
• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned to support business and operational needs.

Required

• High School Diploma or General Education Diploma (GED) required.

Preferred

• Previous experience in plastic injection molding, mold setup, process technician, or a closely related manufacturing role, or an equivalent combination of education, technical training, and relevant experience.
• Ability to safely operate overhead cranes and rigging equipment or obtain certification as required by company policy.
• Basic mechanical aptitude with the ability to safely use hand tools, measuring devices, and maintenance equipment.
• Ability to read and interpret process sheets, setup instructions, safety procedures, technical manuals, and engineering documentation.

• Experience with 500–1,900 ton injection molding machines (Nissei, Krauss Maffei, Engel, or equivalent).
• Knowledge of Scientific Molding and Decoupled Molding principles.
• Experience with mold process monitoring systems, including cavity pressure transducers, sensors, and data acquisition equipment.
• Experience programming, operating, or troubleshooting six-axis robots (Nachi, Fanuc, or equivalent).
• Technical certifications or formal training such as RJG Master Molder, Paulson, Routsis, AIM, or equivalent industry-recognized programs.
• Experience using manufacturing performance metrics such as OEE, downtime, scrap, cycle time, and schedule adherence to improve production performance.
• Demonstrated participation in continuous improvement, root cause analysis, or scrap reduction initiatives.

Work Environment:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee occasionally works near moving mechanical parts and is exposed to a manufacturing environment.  The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

• Work is primarily performed in a fast-paced plastic injection molding manufacturing environment supporting production operations.
• Regular exposure to moving machinery, automated robots, overhead cranes, forklifts, conveyors, hydraulic and pneumatic systems, and other industrial equipment.
• Frequent exposure to hot molds, heated plastic, water systems, lubricants, hydraulic oils, compressed air, and electrical equipment while performing setup, troubleshooting, and maintenance activities.
• Periodic exposure to elevated temperatures, humidity, vibration, dust, noise, and slippery walking surfaces resulting from manufacturing operations.
• Required to wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hi-vis attire, hearing protection, steel-toe footwear, gloves, and any additional PPE required for specific tasks.
• Must safely work around suspended loads, pinch points, stored energy sources, and other hazards associated with mold changes, equipment setup, and manufacturing processes while following all lockout/tagout and machine safety procedures.
• Position requires flexibility to respond to production issues, machine alarms, equipment failures, and changing production priorities throughout the shift.
• Regular interaction with Production, Maintenance, Quality, Engineering, Tool Room, and Materials personnel to support safe, efficient, and reliable manufacturing operations.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.

jobs.title: SAP MM Consultant
jobs.description:
ABOUT TESSERA

Tessera is an AI platform that drives business transformation and unlocks new value for enterprises. The Platform's agents deliver governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half.




ROLE SUMMARY

We are seeking a senior SAP MM Consultant to own materials management and its data on SAP S/4HANA migrations and data harmonisation: the material master, purchasing, inventory and the open documents that run them. You own the target design, the MM data migration from mapping to cutover, and the proof that it works after the load. This is a doer role, not an advisory one.




HOW THE WORK IS DIFFERENT

Tessera is a software company, not a services firm: we do not sell hours, and the Platform's AI agents do the heavy lifting — process analysis, data profiling, conversion and validation. You bring the SAP judgment: you specify the work, check what comes back against SAP models, tables and real data, and own the calls a client signs.

Our success measure is the client's adoption of the Platform. A consultant leaves and takes the capability with them; when you leave, the capability stays with the client. That is why we hire SMEs on a path to become Forward Deployed Engineers, one of the most sought-after roles in tech, with Platform certification and support from our FDE team along the way.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Materials and procurement design. Own the material master design — views, plant and storage data, MRP data, units of measure — and the interfaces with plant maintenance, projects and finance. Work through the MM simplification items and use fit-to-standard to decide what to keep, change or retire.

2. MM data migration ownership. Own the MM data migration workstream end to end: object scope, source-to-target field mapping, value mapping and transformation rules, load order and sign-off criteria. Keep the mapping document as the system of record for every mapping decision, and track each open point from workshop to closure.

3. Mock loads, validation and reconciliation. Run iterative mock loads and dress rehearsals. Pilot on a selective test batch before full loads. Read the load logs and classify each failure as a data defect, a mapping defect, a configuration gap or a tooling issue. Check units of measure, material types, valuation classes, blanks and duplicates before each load, and show a reconciliation after it: record counts, field-level samples and checks in target transactions.

4. Cutover and hypercare. Set the open PO and requisition cut-off rules, the inventory freeze and the load timing for cutover. Support dress rehearsals and production loads, and own data issues in your object scope during hypercare.

5. Client engagement. Lead mapping workshops with business data owners and drive each issue to sign-off, on several engagements at once, with clear written handoffs.

6. AI agents and adoption. Set the requirements and acceptance criteria the agents work to, act as the final quality gate on their output, turn findings into reusable rules, and enable the client's team to run the Platform on their own.




DATA OBJECTS IN SCOPE

You own the functional design, mapping, validation and sign-off for MM data objects. The core objects cover the procure-to-pay chain: material master, suppliers, purchasing master data, requisitions and agreements, purchase orders, and goods receipts and invoices. Inventory, valuation, classification and batches are desired. Maintenance, project and service procurement and supplier EDI set you apart.




TECHNICAL & FUNCTIONAL SKILLS

Material master: material types, views and organisational levels, field selection, units of measure and conversions, valuation classes, MRP data and classification.

Purchasing: requisitions and purchase orders, account assignment categories, info records, source lists, contracts and scheduling agreements, release strategies and pricing in purchasing.

Inventory management and valuation: goods movements and movement types, stock types, physical inventory, price control and valuation areas, posting period dependencies, and the SAP S/4HANA inventory data model (MATDOC).

Invoice verification and integration: logistics invoice verification, GR/IR clearing, account determination for inventory postings, and integration with FI, CO, PM, PS and SD.

Business Partner and CVI: supplier conversion to Business Partner through CVI — BP roles and groupings, number ranges, field mapping, the CVI Cockpit and synchronisation, the usual tax and bank data errors, and their impact on procure-to-pay.

Data migration: field and value mapping, SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit (staging tables), BAPI and IDoc-based loads, load order driven by master data dependencies, error-log analysis, validation before the load, and a reconciliation you can show — including mapping from Oracle or another ERP where fields have no direct target.

Client-facing: run workshops with procurement, inventory, maintenance and plant owners; present design decisions, trade-offs and risks to business and technical stakeholders; hold the scope boundary and say no in a way that keeps the relationship; get decisions recorded and signed off.




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years in SAP MM configuration, used in the last 2 to 3 years.

 - 2+ full data migration lifecycles to SAP S/4HANA (from SAP ECC, Oracle or another ERP) with functional ownership of MM data objects — mapping, validation and sign-off, not only process or configuration roles.

 - Several mock loads or dress rehearsals, with data defects resolved across cycles, and at least one production cutover.

 - Hands-on CVI: supplier conversion to Business Partner on at least one SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration.

 - A CV with named engagements: client, year and your own deliverable.

 - One concrete case of AI or automation in your own SAP work: the task, the tool and the result. Drafting documents with a chatbot does not count.

 - Experience delivering to large enterprise clients in a distributed team, with strong written discipline.

 - Based in the United States.

 - Fluent English.

 - Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Maintenance and project procurement: MRO and spare parts, reservations, and MM–PM and MM–PS integration.

 - Experience in utilities or another asset-intensive industry.

 - Migration and cleansing tools such as SAP Data Services, Syniti or SNP.

 - SQL or basic ABAP literacy, to run reconciliation queries and read table structures.

 - SAP MDG for supplier and material data.

 - Central procurement on SAP S/4HANA.

 - More than one SAP S/4HANA transition path: greenfield, brownfield or selective data transition.

 - Work in regulated or audit-heavy environments (SOX).

 - SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement certification.

jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role:

The Indirect Commodity Manager will be responsible for developing and executing global sourcing strategies across a broad portfolio of indirect spend categories that support the company's manufacturing and business operations. As the organization's first dedicated indirect procurement leader, this individual will establish sourcing strategies, supplier partnerships, and procurement processes that drive value across global sites. The role will serve as a trusted business partner to Engineering, Facilities, Operations, Finance, Legal, and other functional leaders to ensure sourcing decisions align with business objectives while optimizing cost, quality, service, and risk.



The initial category portfolio includes service purchase orders, indirect materials and supplies, capital equipment, manufacturing and facility equipment, land and property leases, and construction-related contracts supporting both ongoing operations and future expansion.



Responsibilities:

 - Develop and execute global sourcing and category strategies for indirect spend, including services, indirect materials, capital equipment, facilities, construction, and real estate-related agreements.

 - Lead strategic sourcing initiatives from market assessment and supplier selection through contract negotiation and implementation, ensuring optimal cost, quality, service, and risk outcomes.

 - Negotiate commercial agreements, pricing, terms and conditions, and long-term supplier contracts while partnering with Legal to ensure appropriate contractual protections.

 - Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Facilities, Finance, and other business leaders to support capital projects, operational needs, and strategic business initiatives across global sites.

 - Build and manage strategic supplier relationships through performance management, business reviews, continuous improvement initiatives, and risk mitigation strategies.

 - Analyze spend, supplier performance, and market intelligence to identify opportunities for cost savings, supplier optimization, process improvements, and total cost of ownership reductions.



Basic Qualifications:

 - 5–8+ years of strategic sourcing, procurement, or commodity management experience

 - Experience negotiating complex commercial agreements

 - Demonstrated success managing indirect procurement categories

 - Knowledge of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) 



Preferred Qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or related field

 - Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPM, CIPS, or equivalent

 - Experience sourcing construction projects, CapEx, facilities services, or real estate agreements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Anduril Imaging team develops state-of-the-art imaging systems across both hardware and software, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The team is heavily involved in utilizing computer vision, perception, electro-optical, infrared, and sensor data to give our war fighters and allies an advantage.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Camera Systems Engineer, you will be play a key role in the development of new infrared camera systems. A Camera Systems Engineer works with optical, mechanical and electrical engineers to bring together a single camera design. This role requires creative problem-solving to meet the customer specifications while balancing the complexity of the design. A camera systems engineer is responsible for understanding the various engineering aspects of the design and how they interact across domains (Mechanical, Electrical, Optical).

This role is heavily focused on prototype camera testing. The camera systems engineer will be responsible for modeling camera performance metrics (Responsivity, Operability, etc.) and then implementing the testing to verify. This typically involves writing engineering code (MATLAB, Python, etc.) to command/control the prototype cameras, infrared blackbody sources while sampling power supplies, temperature sensors and multimeters. The Camera Systems Engineer typically leads the image performance evaluation and testing. Often, the Camera Systems Engineer will be the one to uncover issues and therefore needs excellent communication skills to collaborating across teams to quickly and effectively resolve issues.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Works directly with all the engineering disciplines to drive the design to be compliant with the specifications.

• Develop and maintain software for radiometric modeling, testing automation, data analytics, and report generation.

• Conduct root cause analysis on prototype failures, develop troubleshooting guides, and collaborate with engineering teams on corrective actions and failure analysis.

• Generate clear test work instructions for technicians and provide training on equipment usage.

• Analyze test data, document findings, and generate detailed reports to identify defects, provide feedback for product enhancements, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

• Contribute feedback to early-stage test design for new product introduction (NPI) processes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of experience in a related technical field

• Bachelor’s degree in Physics, Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Experience with numerical modeling, preferably with radiometry and/or optics.

• Experience with data acquisition and processing with tools like MATLAB, Python, or other programming languages.

• Familiarity with test automation and report generation concepts.

• Foundational understanding of root cause analysis principles for hardware, software, and firmware, with a desire to develop these skills further.

• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Experience with camera assemblies and involving the integration of electrical, opto-mechanical, and software/firmware systems.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Masters in Physics, Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field

• Knowledge of infrared systems, including their performance requirements and verification methodologies.

• Experience with cryogenic testing equipment.

• Familiarity with test equipment such as power supplies, electronic loads, thermal chambers, function generators, spectrum analyzers, data acquisition and measurement sensors.

• Experience with computer hardware communication protocols: USB, Ethernet, RS232, RS485, PCIe, HDMI, CAN, etc.

• Work with Design, Quality and Manufacturing Engineering teams to support customer returns and failure analysis.

• Contribute feedback to early-stage test design for test processes supporting early-stage products (NPI).

• Analyze test data, document results, and provide detailed reports to identify defects and areas for improvement.

• Collaborate with design engineers to provide feedback and recommendations for product enhancements based on test outcomes.

• Optimize test strategies for efficiency and effectiveness, reducing test time without compromising quality.

• Maintain and calibrate test equipment to ensure precision and reliability.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance testing processes and methodologies.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Physics, Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields

• 3+ years of relevant industry experience with emphasis on manufacturing test and product sustainment.

• Experience with data acquisition and processing with MATLAB, Python and other programming languages.

• Experience with test automation and report generation.

• Strong root cause analysis skills of non-conforming hardware, software, and firmware.

• Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal and communication skills.

• Experience working on projects that involve the integration of electrical, opto-mechanical, and software/firmware systems.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Knowledge of infrared systems, including their performance requirements and verification methodologies.

• Experience with cryogenic testing equipment.

• Familiarity with test equipment such as power supplies, electronic loads, thermal chambers, function generators, spectrum analyzers, data acquisition and measurement sensors.

• Experience with computer hardware communication protocols: USB, Ethernet, RS232, RS485, PCIe, HDMI, CAN, etc.

jobs.title: Operations Support Analyst
jobs.description:
Why Paragon? In 2014, Paragon was incepted in a Starbucks coffee shop with a simple strategy — build the MGA that we would want to work for. Years later, Paragon is one of the fastest growing MGAs in the country. Our secret? A dedication to diversity and agility. We realized from the start that a commitment to thinking, acting, and rewarding “different” would resonate within the industry. It is hard to argue with results, and the results are clear. Our diverse team of talent is reshaping an industry that has weathered “boring” and is long overdue on “different.” Whether it comes by offering better pay, benefits or growth opportunities, we will continue to aggressively invest in talent to drive our business forward. Change is here, come be a part of it with us.

Formed as a broadly diversified MGA, Paragon supports retail agents and insurance carriers, and reinsurers with our strong underwriting talent, broad capabilities, sophisticated operations, and varied business interests. Our goal: To help our partners do business better. And we do.

The Operations Support Analyst will work a remote schedule.

Responsibilities:

• Performs standard duties utilizing developed procedures for agency appointments, ensuring all agents of record are in compliance.

• Clears OFAC reports for agents and agencies entered into MGA IMS System.

• Manages internal & external agent licensing documents, running NIPR reports when necessary.

• Work with management to create, modify, update and implement company’s policies.

• Enforces adherence to requirements and advises internal team when action is needed.

• Acts in a proactive manner; works with agents and underwriting assistants to resolve problems and appropriately escalate issues to their underwriter and manager.

• Ability to build and maintain close working relationships with agents, underwriters, and peers and assist others by answering questions and responding to requests.

• Daily Reconciliation between Agency Management System and Billing Vendor System.

Requirements:

• 1 – 2 years of relevant industry experience preferred.

• Proficient with Microsoft Word, Excel, and other database software.

• Prior Experience with Concept One agency management system preferred.

• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

• Ability to multi-task and prioritize work efficiently, and ability to problem solve and leverage available resources.

• Proven service-oriented ability with high level of responsiveness and demonstrated ability to self-manage workload.

• Ability to communicate effectively with internal and external partners both verbally and in written communication.

• High School Diploma required; College degree or Industry designations a plus (AINS, AIS)

The base salary offered for the successful candidate will be based on compensable factors such as job-relevant education, job-relevant experience, training, licensure, demonstrated competencies, geographic location, and other factors. Discretionary incentive compensation may be awarded. Jencap also offers a range of benefits and programs, based on eligibility, which currently include but are not limited to; comprehensive health care coverage, a 401k plan, and tuition reimbursement.  Jencap is an emerging and rapidly growing leader in the industry and as such, we approach talent acquisition as an opportunity to identify the best talent. Therefore, the level of the role and compensation may vary depending upon the best available candidate.

Ready to have your voice heard, your talents properly utilized and to become a valued part of a rapidly growing organization? You’re in the right place.

Paragon is a dynamic, bold, and tenacious company. Join us as we continue to chart new paths, open doors and grow together.

Paragon is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, marital or familial status, disability status, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to fostering a work community where every colleague feels welcomed, valued, respected and heard, as we believe that that creating an environment where every employee feels included and empowered, helps us to deliver the best outcome to our clients.

jobs.title: Domino's General Manager (5603)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.
