jobs.title: Research Assistant - 1  (Job 1462)
jobs.description:
About Us

DLH delivers improved health and national security readiness solutions for federal programs through science, research and development, systems engineering and integration, and digital transformation. Our experts in public health, performance evaluation, and health operations solve the complex problems faced by civilian and military customers alike by leveraging advanced tools – including digital transformation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud enablement, modeling, and simulation, and more. DLH is dedicated to the idea that “Your Mission is Our Passion” and brings a unique combination of government sector experience, proven methodology, and unwavering commitment to innovation to improve the lives of millions.

Overview

We are seeking a part-time Research Assistant to join our multidisciplinary team supporting manuscript development and finalization (e.g., drafting outlines, writing, creating tables and figures, formatting), literature reviews (e.g., search terms, pulling articles, extracting information), and epidemiologic research (e.g., analyses, drafting analysis plans). Our team includes lead researchers (epidemiologists, biostatisticians), data managers, and analysts who collaborate to design, conduct, and publish research studies for various government clients.

The ideal candidate will have strong writing and organizational skills, familiarity with literature review methods, and comfort working with both quantitative and qualitative data, as well as the ability to delve into various public health topics. You will support DLH researchers and government clients across the full research lifecycle — from manuscript outlines and literature reviews to data collection, coding, and analysis — and contribute to studies addressing significant public health issues.

This position has potential for full-time employment and offers opportunities for professional development, exposure to diverse research methods and topic areas, and cross-disciplinary collaboration. It is well suited to candidates early in their research careers seeking hands-on experience across the manuscript and data lifecycle.

Responsibilities

• Writing Support: Contribute to manuscript outlines, Draft background sections based on agreed-upon outlines, address feedback from research leads and collaborators, & Prepare and format reference lists and in-text citations (e.g., EndNote)

• Literature Reviews: Conduct systematic and ad hoc searches of literature databases (e.g., PubMed), documenting search terms and articles retrieved; review scientific literature for key study characteristics, including study population, study design, main outcome, and exposure; populate literature review tables accurately and raise questions to the research lead as needed & compile key associations to support meta-analyses

• Manuscript Submission: Identify and follow journal-specific submission requirements & Format manuscript text, tables, figures, and references

• Presentation Development: Draft slides based on agreed-upon outlines, Format slide decks with consistent themes, & select appropriate templates, logos, and images

• Client Report Formatting: Identify and follow specified formatting or template requirements, & assist with formatting text and figures

• Data Collection and Analysis: Quantitative Support, Data Collection: Identify and review validated research instruments, Program and test questionnaires in REDCap & administrative support (e.g., participant contact and tracking)

• Analytic Support and Preparation: Review table inputs to identify errors and spot-check results, Format tables for accuracy and consistency, & Provide general analysis support and results summaries

• Qualitative Research Support, Data Collection: Support participant recruitment, Support interview scheduling, maintain participant tracking systems, participate in interviews and take notes as needed, provide general research support as needed

• Codebook Development: Review transcripts prior to codebook development, Format and clean transcripts during the review process, develop codebooks in collaboration with the research team, & Upload transcripts and codebooks into qualitative analysis software (e.g., NVivo, Dedoose).

• Data Coding: Support coding of transcripts & take thematic notes to support future analysis

• Analysis: Participate in analysis workshops to discuss themes and develop manuscript outlines & identify supporting quotes for each outline section or theme following outline development

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree with 1-2 years of relevant experience

• Coursework or applied experience in epidemiologic methods, biostatistics, or research design

• Prior experience with literature reviews, scientific writing, or data collection preferred but not required

• Excellent oral and written communication and organizational skills

• Ability to collaborate within teams and to work independently

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office; familiarity with REDCap, NVivo, Dedoose, or statistical software (e.g., SAS, R, SPSS) a plus

• Driven to learn new methodological approaches, topical areas, software languages, or other skills as needed

EEO

DLH Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.  DLH will provide reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities and disabled Veterans who need assistance to apply.

DLH is committed to maintaining a fair and authentic interview process

jobs.title: Sr. Additive Manufacturing Technician
jobs.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.


SR. ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING TECHNICIAN


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced team member to join our growing Metal Additive Manufacturing team at our brand new Indianapolis facility.

In this role, you will be responsible for operating advanced metal additive manufacturing systems and software to ensure dental products are fabricated at the highest quality standards while meeting customer delivery deadlines. You’ll work directly with metal print workflows including build preparation, machine operation, print monitoring, post processing, and quality inspection.

This role requires strong attention to detail, technical precision, and comfort working with digital manufacturing tools in a fast-paced production environment.

If you’re excited to help disrupt an industry status quo and contribute to building and scaling a world-class Metal Additive Manufacturing Department against aggressive growth targets, this is the place for you. We don’t just want to offer you a job — we want to help you build a long-term career by providing meaningful opportunities for growth.


SHIFT TIMES

 - M-F 1st shift

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Machine Operation & Setup: Prepare prints, calibrate, and operate industrial metal laser powder bed fusion equipment, annealing furnace, wire EDM, and CNC mill.

Powder Management: Safely handle, sieve, mix, and recycle metal powders (CoCrMo & Ti64) following environmental, health, and safety (EHS) protocols.

Post-Processing: Perform critical post-build operations, including de-powdering, part removal from build substrate, support structure removal, and build plate resurfacing.

Quality Assurance: Inspect finished parts using precision measurement tools to ensure dimensional accuracy and compliance with engineering drawings and CAD models.

Maintenance & Troubleshooting: Perform routine preventative maintenance on AM equipment. Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, or software issues to minimize machine downtime.

Process Improvement & Leadership: Analyze failed builds to determine root causes and recommend adjustments. Train, mentor, and guide junior technicians on best practices and safety standards.

Documentation: Maintain records of build logs, material lot numbers, maintenance activities, and quality inspections for full production traceability.

 
 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience: Minimum of 2+ years of hands-on experience in EITHER Metal Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing) OR CNC Machining.

 - Technical Literacy: Proven ability to read and execute manufacturing work instructions and comfortable with digital manufacturing workflows (i.e. CAD files, STL files).

 - Mechanical Aptitude: Strong mechanical skills and experience using standard hand tools, power tools, and precision measurement instruments.

 - Quality Control: Experience with inspection techniques capable of verifying production meets internal quality standards.

 - Problem-Solving: Excellent diagnostic skills with a track record of troubleshooting complex mechanical or manufacturing process issues.

 - Safety-First Mindset: Willingness and ability to strictly adhere to safety protocols, including wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as respirators when handling fine metal powders.

 - Physical Requirements: Ability to lift, push, or pull 50 lbs.(i.e. move heavy build plates) and capable of standing for extended periods of time.




BONUS POINTS FOR

 - Associate’s degree or technical certificate in Advanced Manufacturing, Machining, Engineering Technology, or a related field.

 - Experience with AM build preparation software (e.g., Materialise Magics, Oqton/Oqcam, etc.).

 - Experience with heat treatment processes or wire EDM operation.

 - Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles (5S, Six Sigma).

 - Experience working in the medical device or dental industry.




WHY JOIN US

 - Help launch the additive manufacturing team at dandy and shape the future production operations and culture.

 - Assist in the development of world class additive manufacturing capability at scale for the dental industry.

 - Build hands-on experience in advanced digital dental manufacturing.

 - Gain opportunities for career growth in advanced manufacturing at a fast growing, fast paced company.

For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Dandy also fully complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. If you require any accommodations for your interview or have any questions beforehand, rest assured that we will do everything we can to meet your needs. Visit Dandy Careers https://www.meetdandy.com/careers/ for more! 

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you consent to Dandy collecting, storing, and processing your personal information for recruitment purposes in accordance with our Privacy Policy https://www.meetdandy.com/privacy-policy/ and GDPR regulations. You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your data at any time by contacting Privacy Requests https://www.meetdandy.com/privacy-requests/.

jobs.title: Domino's Crew Member (5603)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world? And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

We are searching for qualified Domino's Crew Members with personality, hustle and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

As a Domino's Crew Member, you are often the first person to welcome and interface with Domino’s customers. Additionally, the ability to maintain professional appearance in accordance with Domino’s and Team Fox image standards is required – you are the face of the brand! jobs.title: Lead Operations Specialist - San Diego, CA
jobs.description:
About the Job

Location: San Diego - 92121, CA (Onsite)
Department: Operations
Reports to: Operations Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $26–$30 Per Hour

About Ever

Ever is building the future of auto retail. As the first AI-native auto retailer, we are building the next $100B+ automotive business, starting with electric vehicles.

Based out of San Francisco and expanding nationwide, we are backed by leading investors and led by former tech & automotive professionals from Uber, Tesla, Rivian, Apple, Amazon, Carvana, J.P. Morgan, BCG, and more. After our recently completed Series B financing, we have raised around $200M in total equity and debt funding. We are growing rapidly and actively recruiting exceptional talent – to set a new frontier in the largest sector of the US retail economy.

Learn more about us at evercars.com.

About the Role

As Lead Operations Specialist, you’ll run day-to-day lot operations at our San Diego site and lead a small team of three Operations Specialists. This is a working lead role: you’ll spend much of your day doing the same hands-on lot, inventory, readiness and logistics work as your team, while also setting the daily plan, training and coaching the team, and owning the accuracy of inventory, keys and vehicle readiness. Reporting to the Operations Manager in Costa Mesa, you’ll be the on-site leader and first point of escalation for inventory discrepancies, carrier issues and readiness problems, partnering closely with sales, reconditioning and logistics. It’s a role for an experienced operations professional who leads by example and takes full ownership of their site.

What You’ll Do

• Lead a team of three Operations Specialists: build schedules, cover time off, track attendance and assign daily priorities across lot, readiness and logistics work

• Train new team members on SOPs, safety practices, inventory systems and vehicle handling standards, and take part in interviewing new Operations Specialists

• Run daily huddles and shift handoffs so open issues, deliveries and inbound units are clear to everyone

• Coach the team on quality and accuracy, give regular feedback and flag performance concerns to the Operations Manager

• Serve as the on-site leader and escalation owner for the San Diego site, keeping the Operations Manager in Costa Mesa informed of issues and priorities

• Own site safety, including daily lot safety walks and enforcing PPE and vehicle-handling standards

• Own vehicle queues and lot layout across work-in-progress and finished inventory to maximize throughput and space

• Own site inventory accuracy: lead regular lot audits, reconcile physical inventory against system records, resolve discrepancies and escalate what can’t be resolved on site

• Own the key management system and ensure every key is accounted for and matched to its vehicle

• Keep inventory at sellable quality and charge levels per SOP, routing units that need reconditioning or escalation to the right team

• Set and enforce presentation standards, and perform final readiness checks on vehicles before customer deliveries and test drives

• Coordinate inbound and outbound vehicle flow with carriers, verifying condition and documentation at check-in and release and resolving discrepancies

• Drive vehicles between lots, showrooms, service partners and chargers, plan team moves efficiently, and pitch in on cleaning and prep during busy periods

• Track and report site metrics such as inventory accuracy, readiness turnaround and on-time delivery prep, and propose SOP and process improvements

What You Bring

• 3+ years of experience in vehicle logistics, fleet operations, auto reconditioning, dealership operations or a related field

• 1+ year leading, training or coordinating a team in an operations, warehouse or automotive setting

• Hands-on experience running lot audits, inventory reconciliation and key control

• Strong attention to detail, catching condition issues, documentation gaps and inventory discrepancies before they become problems

• Ability to plan and prioritize a shift’s work in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while keeping accuracy and quality high

• Clear, timely communication, raising issues early and keeping the team and stakeholders informed

• Availability during high-volume periods, weekends and month-end close

• Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record

Technical Skills

• Experience with vAuto, Cox Automotive, CDK, and/or other similar software/tools

• Comfortable learning and working in proprietary inventory management software, and able to teach the team to use it

• Comfortable using mobile tracking apps and reporting dashboards to monitor inventory and site metrics

Preferred Experience

• Familiarity with EV charging infrastructure and EV readiness standards

• Experience at a high-growth startup, used-car retailer or rental/fleet operator

• Experience creating or improving SOPs and training materials

• Bilingual in English and Spanish

Physical Requirements

• Stand, walk, bend, kneel, crouch and reach while working in and around vehicles for extended periods

• Safely enter, exit and drive vehicles for reconditioning, testing, moves and deliveries

• Work outdoors in varying weather conditions

• Occasionally lift, carry, push or pull up to 50 lbs, using equipment or help for heavier items

Compensation and Benefits

The hourly pay range for this San Diego-based position is $26–$30 per hour, depending on relevant experience, qualifications and internal equity.

Ever offers health, dental, and vision coverage, as well as time-off benefits.

Equal Opportunity

Ever is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to characteristics protected by applicable law and provide reasonable accommodations during the application and interview process.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Autonomy Systems Engineering, Vehicle Platform & Control Interfaces
jobs.location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States; Las Vegas, Nevada, United States; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States
jobs.description:
Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn't just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.

The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, vehicle platform, safety, infrastructure, and operations to build the safety case for our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas and to shape the vehicle platform that comes next.

Mission Summary:

Motional is defining its next-generation robotaxi platform together with Hyundai Motor Group. The requirements we deliver over the coming year will set how the autonomy software commands and monitors the vehicle: steering, braking, propulsion, redundant command paths, and behavior under faults. These decisions are hard to change once the vehicle is designed, and getting them right early is one of the highest-leverage things we can do for the program.

As Principal Engineer, you will own Motional's vehicle control and interface requirements for this platform and be our lead systems engineering voice with Hyundai Motor Group's vehicle engineers. We are looking for someone who has done this before: brought up a new vehicle platform for an automated driving or ADAS system, lived with the consequences of early interface decisions, and knows what to ask for the second time around. You will draw on that experience and on what we learned deploying our current fleet, drive the key architecture trade-offs to a decision, and carry the requirements through to verification on prototype vehicles.

What you'll be doing:

• Own the vehicle control and interface requirements for Motional's next-generation platform, from first draft through release and verification.

• Lead technical engagement with Hyundai Motor Group's vehicle engineering teams, including in-person workshops in Korea, and drive open questions to closure.

• Lead trade studies on control interface architecture (for example, torque and steering angle commands versus acceleration or trajectory-level interfaces) and bring stakeholders to a decision backed by data.

• Turn lessons learned from our current fleet into clear, verifiable requirements on the vehicle platform and on the signals it reports back to the autonomy system.

• Work with Safety and the vehicle platform team on the functional safety concept for the control path: redundancy, fault handling, degraded operation, and arbitration with base-vehicle safety functions.

• Partner with Sourcing on the vehicle interface controller supplier: requirements, acceptance criteria, and schedule risk.

• Maintain the system description, interface definitions, traceability, and verification strategy for the vehicle interface subsystem.

• Set technical direction and mentor systems engineers working on vehicle control.

What we're looking for:

• BS in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics, Computer, or equivalent Engineering; MS preferred.

• 10+ years of engineering experience, including at least one full vehicle platform bring-up for an ADAS or automated driving system: defining the interface to a new vehicle, working through prototype builds with the automaker or supplier, and taking the platform to validated operation.

• Hands-on experience with vehicle motion control or drive-by-wire systems (propulsion, braking, steering), and with writing and negotiating interface requirements with an automaker or Tier 1 supplier.

• Working knowledge of automotive functional safety (ISO 26262) applied to vehicle control: safety goals, ASIL allocation, fault handling, and degraded modes.

• Strong analytical skills across vehicle dynamics, data analysis, and systems analysis.

• Excellent written and verbal communication; effective at driving decisions across organizations and cultures.

• Ability to read C++ control software; Python or similar for data analysis.

• Experience leading cross-team technical work and mentoring engineers.

Bonus points(not required):

• Experience bringing up more than one vehicle platform, or platforms from more than one automaker.

• Familiarity with automotive E/E architectures and in-vehicle networking (CAN, Automotive Ethernet).

• Supplier management experience (statements of work, sample acceptance, joint testing).

• Hardware-in-the-loop or test track development for vehicle control systems.

• Korean language proficiency.

Physical Demands:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and at times for long periods; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds.

Travel Requirements (greater than 20%):

Expected to travel to Korea for engineering workshops and to our Las Vegas, Pittsburgh and Boston sites as needed for the business.

Working Environment:

The work environment characteristics described here represent those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The team member is regularly exposed to mechanical and computer parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to fumes and/or airborne particles. The noise level in the environment is low to moderate.

Motional AD LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified applicants. All applicants will receive impartial consideration without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic data, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation or other legally protected status. Motional AD LLC is a Drug-free workplace.

#LI-RR1

The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus or company equity. $200,000—$275,000 USD

Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.

Our journey is always people first.

We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.

Scale up, not starting up.

Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.

Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit  www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

As a member of the Programmatic Sales & Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in driving Pinterest’s advertising growth and revenue through a full-funnel sales strategy. As the primary partner to clients, you’ll drive deal creation, oversee campaign setup, and ensure seamless launches. Leveraging data-driven strategies, you will proactively optimize performance, uncover growth opportunities, and deliver exceptional results that maximize client value and business impact. Through close collaboration with cross-functional teams, you’ll help shape solutions that maximize business impact, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results for advertisers at every stage of the funnel.

What you'll do:

• Develop and execute full-funnel, programmatic sales strategies for top-tier clients, driving measurable business results across awareness, consideration, conversion, and retention.

• Build and maintain executive-level relationships with clients and agency partners, leading strategic deal negotiations, QBRs, and educational sessions focused on ad tech innovation.

• Serve as a subject matter expert on Pinterest’s programmatic ad offerings and digital ecosystem trends, influencing media strategies and solution adoption.

• Advise on best practices in programmatic buying, data integration, measurement, and optimization to maximize campaign performance on Pinterest’s platform.

• Serve as point of contact for programmatic campaigns working with Ops teams to manage deal creation, campaign setup, technical troubleshooting, and real-time optimizations.

• Leverage data-driven insights to craft actionable recommendations and guide clients toward sustained programmatic growth and ROI.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, championing Pinterest’s value in the programmatic marketplace and identifying new growth opportunities.

• AI-first programmatic and CTV selling: Uses internal AI and agentic tools to prep for exec-level conversations, including account research, partner mapping, POVs, and QBR narratives tied to full-funnel goals and deal strategy.

• AI-powered campaign insights (full funnel): Applies AI to quickly analyze programmatic and CTV performance (pacing, win rates, audience/creative signals, conversion trends) and turn findings into clear optimization and investment recommendations, validated against source-of-truth reporting and measurement (including Clean Rooms).

• AI for forecasting, QA, and trend-based recommendations: Uses AI-driven insights and strategic frameworks to validate performance and revenue, forecast pipeline and live deal outcomes (pacing, win rates, spend/revenue outlook), and translate programmatic marketplace trends into QBR-ready recommendations for senior stakeholders.

What we’re looking for:

• Minimum 8 years in client-facing digital media sales roles, with deep expertise in programmatic advertising, ad tech, or media strategy.

• Advanced understanding of full-funnel digital advertising solutions, including brand, consideration, and conversion strategies, with specialized knowledge in search, shopping, display, or (social a plus).

• Proven track record of building and nurturing executive-level relationships with advertisers and agency programmatic centers, developing long-term strategic plans, and negotiating high-value partnership agreements to drive measurable business outcomes.

• Strong understanding of data and measurement solutions including Clean Rooms.

• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities; skilled at translating data, macro trends, and campaign performance insights into actionable recommendations that fuel ongoing revenue growth.

• Strong consultative approach with the ability to educate, influence, and challenge executive stakeholders while crafting visionary and results-oriented media strategies.

• Excellent communicator and collaborator, thriving in fast-paced environments while ensuring operational excellence, seamless cross-functional teamwork, and project management success.

• AI for scenario planning (“what-if”): Uses AI to structure ambiguous client questions and run scenario planning for programmatic/CTV investment (funnel mix, reach vs. frequency, budget shifts, incrementality assumptions), generating testable hypotheses that inform GTM and negotiations.

• AI-enabled operational excellence: Builds AI-assisted templates, checklists, and lightweight automations to reduce manual work and improve consistency across deal creation, campaign setup/QA, troubleshooting, reporting, and in-flight optimizations.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as digital media or SaaS sales, or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.title: Domino's General Manager (5602)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically General Managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, translating leadership priorities into structured operating plans while owning complex, multi workstream initiatives from planning through delivery. You will design and evolve scalable operating models, build the dashboards and frameworks that support smart decision making, and champion the responsible adoption of AI across strategy and operations. jobs.title: Domino's Assistant Manager (5601)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You’re the boss, the big cheese, top dog. You’re a natural born leader, so maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the head honcho? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – sound judgment, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got. We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Must possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate diverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license
• Must have access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

• Recognized as the 2025 ENR Design Firm of the year for the Southeastern US

About the Role

As a Talent Enablement Specialist, you'll play an important role in supporting Atwell's talent development strategy and helping employees navigate their professional growth.

Think of this role as part college advisor and part program manager for the Atwell Academy. When a leader identifies the skills their team needs, you'll build the learning path, make sure employees are enrolled in the right courses, track their progress, and keep leaders in the loop until they reach the finish line. You'll do this for hundreds of employees.

This position will be dedicated to our Power & Energy business. You'll partner with HR Business Partners, business leaders, and employees across our power teams to deliver meaningful development experiences, strengthen career pathways, and support our internal learning and leadership programs.

From facilitating development conversations to managing participant experiences within Atwell Academy, you'll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on employee growth and engagement.

You'll join Atwell's Talent Strategy & Culture team. This is a hybrid role based out of our Denver, CO, Lakewood, CO, or Houston, TX office, with a flexible schedule and regular in-office time with the power leaders and teams you support.

What You'll Do

Career Development & Talent Planning

• Develop and maintain career frameworks and development pathways that support employee growth across career stages.

• Partner with managers and employees to create meaningful individual development plans.

• Facilitate talent review and development-planning discussions alongside HR Business Partners and business leaders.

• Recommend development opportunities aligned with employee aspirations, organizational priorities, and business needs.

Atwell Academy & Leadership Development

• Manage the participant experience for Atwell Academy's credentialed development programs, including Engineer Excellence, PM Leadership, and Strategic Pursuits.

• Translate leader requests into structured learning paths, and become the go-to expert on the Academy course catalog.

• Support participants throughout their development journey, from selection and onboarding through program completion.

• Track progress and follow up with employees and their leaders to keep development plans on schedule.

• Evaluate program effectiveness and recommend improvements to the participant experience.

Assessments, Coaching & Mentorship

• Administer and interpret approved leadership, behavioral, and skills assessments to support individual and team development.

• Provide assessment feedback and help employees translate insights into actionable development goals.

• Design, coordinate, and support mentoring programs across business lines and geographic regions.

• Partner with internal and external coaching resources to support leadership and professional development.

Onboarding & Organizational Growth

• Support the development of onboarding resources and learning pathways for new employees.

• Help employees joining Atwell through acquisitions understand available career pathways, development programs, and Atwell Academy resources.

• Collaborate with HR and business partners to create consistent, accessible development opportunities.

Program Effectiveness & Continuous Improvement

• Analyze participation data, employee feedback, and program outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.

• Monitor the effectiveness of talent development initiatives and share recommendations with stakeholders.

• Help evolve development programs as Atwell continues to grow.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Education, or a related field.

• 3–5 years of experience in talent development, learning and development, career development, or a related HR function.

• Experience coordinating or managing employee development programs from launch through completion.

• Experience administering and providing feedback on at least one validated assessment tool, such as SDI, KnowledgeSmart, or CliftonStrengths.

• Strong facilitation, coaching, and presentation skills, including experience engaging employees and senior leaders.

• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and hands-on experience with an LMS or HRIS platform.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting employees at an engineering, AEC, or professional services firm, ideally working with electrical, structural, or other technical teams.

• Experience with Absorb LMS, ADP, or Workday.

What Will Help You Succeed

• A genuine passion for helping others develop professionally.

• The business acumen to partner with technical leaders and help them put the right development in front of their teams.

• Strong relationship-building and consultative skills.

• The ability to manage multiple programs, priorities, and participant groups simultaneously.

• Confidence facilitating development conversations and presenting to different audiences.

• An analytical mindset and the ability to translate program feedback into meaningful improvements.

• A collaborative, adaptable approach to working across a growing organization.

Compensation

The anticipated salary range for this role is $70,000–$90,000 annually. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and location.

Disclaimer

While AI tools may support your application process, this role is built on human talent. Your judgment, experience, and character matter most, so we encourage you to showcase what makes you uniquely you.

Atwell does not accept unsolicited resumes from any 3rd party agencies. No fee will be paid to 3rd parties who submit unsolicited resumes to any Atwell employee. Resumes from approved vendors must be specifically requested by Atwell and approved by the Atwell Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.description:

Atwell, LLC is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. We have a strong national presence and a diverse, award-winning project portfolio. Atwell is a privately owned company, with 2,000+ passionate team members across 75+ locations and growing!

We're seeking a Learning Technology & LMS Manager to lead the administration, optimization, and evolution of our learning technology ecosystem.

As our Learning Technology & LMS Manager, you'll take ownership of the systems and tools that power employee learning across Atwell. This is a new, expanded role created to support the launch and growth of the Atwell Academy, and it covers all of our learning technology, not just the LMS.

You'll serve as the primary administrator of our Absorb Learning Management System (LMS), managing everything from system configuration and content publishing to learning pathways, automation, reporting, and technology integrations. You'll also oversee Pinnacle Series, our technical training platform, and connect our learning tools with HR and business systems like ADP and, soon, Workday.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building scalable processes, solving technical challenges, and collaborating with subject matter experts to make learning more accessible and effective. You won't be the primary content developer, but you'll be in the room as content takes shape. For example, you might turn a 28-chapter engineering manual into a structured learning path that takes employees from entry level to senior level.

You'll also play an important role in supporting Atwell's continued growth through mergers and acquisitions, helping newly acquired teams transition into our learning technology environment.

You'll join Atwell's Talent Strategy & Culture team. This is a hybrid role based out of our Southfield, MI, Orlando, FL, or Maitland, FL office, with a flexible schedule and regular in-office time to build relationships with leaders and SMEs.

What You'll Do

Learning Management System Administration

• Own the day-to-day administration, configuration, and optimization of Atwell's Absorb LMS.

• Manage user provisioning, course catalogs, learning assignments, certifications, learning pathways, and automated workflows.

• Build automations that keep learners and their leaders informed, such as enrollment triggers, progress reminders, and completion notifications.

• Maintain LMS integrations with ADP, Workday (upcoming), and other business systems to support accurate employee information and organizational reporting.

• Troubleshoot system issues and serve as the primary resource for LMS-related questions and technical challenges.

• Develop and maintain reporting dashboards that track learning participation, completion, compliance, and engagement.

Learning Content Management & Development

• Partner with subject matter experts across our Buildings & Land, Power, Hydrocarbons, and Corporate Services teams to translate training materials into engaging, LMS-ready learning experiences.

• Build learning paths that support the Atwell Academy and our Skills 360 program, helping employees move from fundamental to proficient in the skills their leaders have identified.

• Manage content publishing, version control, course organization, and learning catalog maintenance.

• Establish and maintain content governance standards, including naming conventions, permissions, taxonomy, and documentation.

• Create and maintain structured processes for training content intake, review, approval, and publication.

• Support the production, editing, and curation of video-based training, microlearning, and instructor-led content.

• Apply instructional design principles to improve the usability and effectiveness of learning resources.

Mergers & Acquisitions Integration

• Lead the assessment and migration of training content and learning technology from newly acquired companies.

• Collaborate with HR, Culture & Engagement, and business leaders to integrate existing training programs into Atwell's learning ecosystem.

• Evaluate legacy training requirements, including licensing and compliance-related programs.

• Identify gaps, redundancies, and opportunities to standardize training content and processes.

• Help create a smooth learning technology transition for employees joining Atwell through acquisitions.

Learning Technology & Innovation

• Administer and support adoption of LinkedIn Learning across the organization.

• Own administration of Pinnacle Series (Eagle Point), our engineering and technical training platform.

• Stay on top of new Absorb releases, including its growing set of AI features, and recommend what we should adopt.

• Evaluate new learning technologies, content-authoring platforms, video tools, and virtual training solutions.

• Recommend enhancements that improve the employee learning experience and support scalable program delivery.

Reporting, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

• Track learning and development KPIs, including participation, completion rates, and program effectiveness.

• Provide reporting and insights to HR and business leadership.

• Maintain accurate training records and support internal audits and compliance reviews.

• Identify opportunities to improve system performance, content accessibility, and learning administration processes.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• 6–10 years of experience in learning and development, instructional design, training content development, learning technology administration, or a related field.

jobs.title: Domino's Delivery Driver (5601)

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world? And schedules that work with you, not against you? jobs.title: Experienced Clinical Nurse- Mother/Baby 11 Prentice Full Time Nights
jobs.description:
The Clinical Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Based on the NMH framework for practice, the registered professional clinical nurse (RN) is accountable and responsible for the provision and coordination of clinically competent, evidence-based care for an assigned group of patients that includes diagnosis, outcome identification, planning, implementation and evaluation. The nurse adheres to the ANA Scope and Standards of Professional Nursing, the Code of Ethics, and the Nursing Social Policy Statement.   As a member of the clinical care and unit team, the RN participates in decision-making, teaching, mentoring, and collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advance the patient plan of care, achieve exceptional outcomes and enhance unit operations.  The RN exemplifies the components of what it means to be an NMH nurse, reflects the Mission, Vision, and Values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

The role of the professional clinical nurse is unique and essential to the care of the patient.  The nurse demonstrates that unique and essential function through the framework for nursing practice.

Advocate:

• Practices in accordance with the patient centered care model
• Develops an individualized age-specific culturally sensitive nursing plan of care for the patient that is based on the nursing process
• Incorporates the role of patient advocate into the plan of care
• Uses a team approach to develop and achieve daily patient-centered individualized care goals
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of the patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care
• Identifies potential conflict situations and facilitates resolution using established communication channels
• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient
• Protects patients by maintaining a safe environment

Clinical Expert:

• Advances clinical expertise, as demonstrated through pursuit of informal and formal continuing education opportunities and obtaining specialty certification when eligible
• Continuously enhances skills and abilities to ensure the highest quality patient care
• Shares knowledge and expertise through educating team members, patients and students
• Demonstrates critical thinking by integrating theoretical knowledge and expertise to pose relevant clinical questions when evidence and practice differ
• Identifies priorities, sets realistic and measureable goals, prescribes and implements nursing interventions in a safe and timely manner
• Develops and implements individualized education plans for patients and families using suitable instructional materials and methods
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings
• Identifies situations that require further intervention and escalates appropriately; Consults appropriate experts and resources when needed
• Participates in the formation, implementation and evaluation of team goals
• Appropriately delegates and supervises interventions to implement the plan of care
• Conveys complete, timely and accurate information at hand off at the bedside or any hand off
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice

Community Volunteer:

• Participates in one or more volunteer initiatives annually, Northwestern Memorial organized or on his/her own

Compassionate:

• Consistently demonstrates interpersonal connections with patients and families from introduction through discharge
• Proactively responds to patient concerns such as speaking to patients about possible/expected delays in plan of care
• Treats patients, families, visitors and staff in a caring manner with respect and dignity
• Facilities recovery and where appropriate helps ensure a peaceful death for patients

Professionally Engaged:

• Is a member of a professional organization or participates on an Northwestern Memorial committee or taskforce at the hospital-wide, departmental, or unit level
• Demonstrates accountability and collaborative practice with co-workers, other disciplines, and departments
• Assumes responsibility for continued professional growth and education reflecting knowledge and understanding of current nursing practice
• Serves as a community mentor for team members
• Serves as a preceptor for new team members
• Participates in the peer feedback process by conducting a constructive assessment and evaluation of peer performance
• Works collaboratively with all hospital services to accomplish daily work and maintain an environment of excellence
• Participates in the development of policies, procedures and systems to support safe and effective care and advance nursing practice at NMH through the Shared Leadership Process
• Assumes personal responsibility for meeting internal (i.e. Best People profile, ELMs, CPR, and health requirements) and external regulatory and accreditation requirements
• Identifies opportunities for innovation and quality improvement; participates in innovation projects and the quality improvement process, including unit based quality committees
• Demonstrates accountability to Northwestern Memorial strategic, operational and fiscal goals
• Exemplifies a professional image in appearance and communications

• Maintains and advances the professional image of nursing and the practice of professional nursing through an ongoing analysis of resources
• Professional Organizations, literature, electronic resources, etc.

Required:

• Graduate of an NLN accredited school/college of nursing
• Baccalaureate degree in Nursing or higher
• Current State of Illinois, Registered Professional Nurse license
• Basic Life Support (BLS) CPR through American Heart Association.
• Analytic ability (conceptual and quantitative)
• Oral, listening and written communication skills
• Strong human relation skills to interact effectively and collaborate with others in difficult situations
• Use of a keyboard to enter or retrieve data

Preferred:

• Experience in specific clinical area
• Nursing specialty certification, if eligible

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

jobs.description:
About Roofstock

Roofstock is an award-winning proptech platform that helps institutional and individual investors buy, manage and sell single-family rental properties. The company provides full-service property management, asset management and transaction services to drive portfolio performance, combining experienced local teams with proprietary AI-native technology. More than 5,500 owners trust Roofstock to manage nearly 20,000 homes across 72 markets, and the company has facilitated more than $10 billion in transactions since 2015. The Roofstock platform also includes Stessa, financial and portfolio management software used by more than 400,000 landlords and investors, and RentPrep, tenant screening and placement services for landlords. Learn more at roofstock.com.

About the Role

The Cash Accountant – Institutional owns daily cash activity for our institutional clients. This role reconciles a high volume of client bank accounts, keeps those accounts funded, and makes sure cash is recorded correctly in Otto so Property Accountants can deliver accurate monthly financial packages on time. The skills required to succeed in this role include strong reconciliation skills, attention to detail, and clear communication with accounting, AP, and property management teams.

Responsibilities

• Reconcile cash transactions daily, monthly, and at year end across operating, security deposit, and rent accounts for institutional entities

• Use the bank reconciliation module in Otto to make sure recorded balances match bank statements

• Monitor daily cash balances and transactions to make sure funds are available to cover expenses

• Flag underfunded accounts and work with Property Managers and Property Accountants to request funding

• Maintain the weekly AP Available Cash report that AP uses to pay invoices

• Prepare and post journal entries, including building import files, checking data accuracy, importing into Otto, and attaching support

• Reallocate resident payments and charges so payments are applied to the correct charge codes

• Calculate monthly management fees and Mynd fees and book the related journal entries

• Support month-end close so client reporting packages meet contract due dates

• Research cash discrepancies and answer questions from Property Accountants, AP, and property management

• Identify process improvements and automation opportunities in cash workflows

• Perform ad hoc assignments as needed

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent preferred

• 2+ years of accounting experience with bank reconciliations, ideally in real estate or property management

• Experience reconciling a high volume of bank accounts across multiple entities

• Working knowledge of journal entries and GAAP basics

• Proficiency using Excel and Google Suite products

• High degree of accuracy and attention to detail

• Planning and Organizing – ability to manage recurring daily, weekly, and monthly deadlines

• Ability to multitask – work successfully under pressure and effectively prioritize and manage time and workload

• Client Focus – dedicated to meeting the expectations of internal and external clients

• Dealing with Ambiguity – can effectively cope with change and shift gears comfortably

• Thrives in a fast-paced and start-up environment

Location

This position must be located in one of the following markets: Atlanta, GA; Phoenix, AZ; Houston, TX; Dallas-Fort Worth, TX; Charlotte, NC; Tampa, FL; or Las Vegas, NV.

Compensation

$60,000 to $81,000 range on annual base salary. Compensation may be adjusted based on experience, skills, and interview performance.

Pay Transparency

Our compensation reflects several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position represents the expected salary for this position. Ultimately, in determining your pay it will be based on several factors including location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience and other job related factors. Roofstock is a total compensation company; the base salary is only a part of
our total compensation package.

Competitive & Unique Benefits Package

• Robust health, dental, vision insurance, and more

jobs.title: Magnolia Table - Busser/Runner
jobs.description:
SUMMARY

At Magnolia, the Busser/Runner is responsible for clearing and resetting tables and running food to guests. This position works from Magnolia Table in Waco, Texas. It reports to the Assistant Front of House Manager and has no supervisory responsibilities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Ensure the highest level of guest care, in line with Magnolia’s brand

• Clean and reset tables in line with Magnolia Table process and procedure

• Assisting servers by pre-bussing tables and taking dishes to the kitchen*

• Run food and drinks to designated tables with a sense of urgency*

• Maintain dish area by cleaning and organizing dishes and containers and help with trash runs

• Ensure the outside of the restaurant is clean and free of trash or debris*

• Respond to guest needs when possible and/or communicate to a manager if necessary

• Ensure that paper towel dispensers, hand sanitizer and hand soap are all fully stocked

• Ensure a safe and clean working environment*

• Perform other duties as assigned

*Metrics evaluated on Performance Review

COMPETENCIES

• Teamwork: Contribute to a team environment supporting diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Work effectively with others, be a team player and contribute toward team goals.

• Critical Thinking: Identify and communicate challenges in day-to-day activities.

• Expertise: Eye for detail, accuracy, and complete all tasks in a timely manner. Willingness to learn and adapt to new processes and technologies.

• Communication: Actively engage in listening to teammates and guests and be open to feedback from guests, peers, and management.

• Guest Focus: Ability to proactively understand and meet guest needs, ensuring a personalized and guest-centric experience.

• Strategy and Goal Setting: Approach change with positivity and curiosity. Know your role in achieving team goals.

• Hard skills: Strong customer service skills and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment required. Ability to maintain a pleasant and professional demeanor while working with a sense of urgency required.

ELIGIBILITY QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or GED equivalent preferred

• 0-1 years of related work experience preferred

• Food Handler's license and TABC certification required upon hire

• Must be available to work weekends, nights, special events, and holidays as business needs require

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands and arms to reach, handle, feel; utilize fine motor dexterity of fingers; talk or hear and taste or smell. The employee is frequently required to stand and walk. The employee is frequently required to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee operates in a fast-paced kitchen environment. This role routinely uses sinks, dishwashers, and tools to clean kitchen appliances. The employee is frequently exposed to hot water, potentially slippery floors, garbage disposals, and cleaning chemicals. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is intermittent sounds at a level sufficient to cause hearing loss or fatigue. The employee is subject to high temperatures and low temperatures. The employee is exposed to workplace hazards.

ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS

jobs.title: Domino's Crew Member (5601)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world? And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

We are searching for qualified Domino's Crew Members with personality, hustle and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities:

As a Domino's Crew Member, you are often the first person to welcome and interface with Domino’s customers. As such, enthusiastic customer communication, positive personality, and punctuality are essential to success in this role. Additionally, the ability to maintain professional appearance in accordance with Domino’s and Team Fox image standards is required – you are the face of the brand! Additional duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, and make sound ethical judgments in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.
• Willingness to take inventory, stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in or reach-in cooler, and complete associated paperwork.
• Prepare product to Domino’s specifications and guidelines.
• Receive and process telephone orders expeditiously to ensure customer satisfaction and timely pizza delivery.
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Physical Requirements: (including, but not limited to the following):

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

• Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4”.
• Bulk product deliveries are made two to three time per week and require unloading by team members. Product ingredients and supplies may weigh up to 50 pounds and requires lifting and/or stacking.
• You may be required to occasionally crouch, squat, stoop, bend, or utilize stairs while performing job tasks.
• Hand-eye coordination required for the use of shaping pizza dough, maneuvering pizza peel and cutter, and folding of cardboard pizza boxes.

• You must be at least 16 years of age
• Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative defense, national security and space technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

The System Engineer for Voyager's Data and Cloud team is responsible for designing, building, and operating the cloud and on-premises infrastructure that supports the organization's systems, using automation to improve reliability and scale.

The position reports to the Director, Data and Cloud and is part of the Data and Cloud department. This role is based in Long Beach, California or remote within the United States.

In this role, the essential functions are:

• Design, deploy, and operate infrastructure in Microsoft Azure and AWS, including compute, storage, networking, and identity and access controls.

• Administer on-premises virtualization environments on VMware vSphere and/or Microsoft Hyper-V, including host and cluster management, capacity planning, patching, and lifecycle.

• Build, patch, configure, back up, and recover Windows and Linux servers across on-premises and cloud environments.

• Automate provisioning, configuration, and routine operations with Python and PowerShell, and manage scripts and configuration in Git.

• Develop infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Bicep) to standardize deployments across cloud and on-premises platforms.

• Plan and execute migrations of workloads between on-premises, Azure, and AWS environments.

• Monitor system health, performance, and cost; maintain backup and disaster recovery procedures; apply security baselines and remediate vulnerabilities in line with organizational policy.

• Serve as Tier 3 escalation for complex infrastructure incidents, perform root cause analysis, and maintain runbooks and documentation; partner with the Data and Cloud team and other IT teams on projects.

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with 10 years of experience in systems engineering or administration OR Master's degree in a related field with 8 years of experience OR 14 years of experience in systems engineering or administration in lieu of a degree

• Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating workloads in Microsoft Azure, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and Microsoft Entra ID

• Hands-on experience with AWS, including EC2, S3, VPC, and IAM

• Hands-on experience administering on-premises virtualization on VMware vSphere and/or Microsoft Hyper-V

• Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for infrastructure automation and administration

• Proficiency in Python scripting for automation and API integration

• Experience with Windows and Linux server administration, Git version control, and infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Bicep)

• Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance at the level required for the position and applicable government contract. The position also requires appropriate access eligibility and a need-to-know. Clearance eligibility is determined by the U.S. Government.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working in regulated or compliance-driven environments (ITAR/EAR, CUI, NIST 800-171, CMMC), including Azure Government or AWS GovCloud

Active or current DoD security clearance preferred

• Certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, VMware VCP, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate

Travel, Physical and/or Government Mandated Requirements:

• Occasional after-hours availability for maintenance windows, migration cutovers, and incident response

• Must comply with all applicable data handling and export control policies

The good faith base salary range for this role is $140,000-$170,000 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.

• Flexible Time Off (FTO), empowering employees to take the time they need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance
