jobs.description:
The Role

The Leader in Training (LIT) is an adaptable and essential part of the RISE Dispensary leadership team that prioritizes delivering memorable, positive consumer experiences. As part of the leadership team, you have a key role in actively supervising the dispensary’s daily operations, communicating priorities to team members, and optimizing the customer journey. As a Leader in Training, you will gain subject matter expertise as you rotate through critical dispensary functions supporting operations, experience, and people. The Leader in Training role puts you on a fast track to growth and is a developmental step to becoming Assistant General Manager.

Responsibilities

Operations

• Support management in overseeing the execution of all dispensary operations to ensure compliance with security, inventory, and local and state regulations.

• Monitor and maintain inventory levels, ensuring an assortment of products and communicating inventory action items with management.

• Oversee the intake and verification of deliveries, transfers, and inventory management, ensuring accuracy within the vault.

• Actively participate in leading team members to effectively execute programs, initiatives, and regionalized in-store promotions.

• Demonstrate proper cash handling, including accurately processing payments, discount application, and cash maintenance, and oversee team member execution.

Experience

• Lead by example and motivate team members to consistently deliver memorable, positive in-store customer experiences.

• Participate in “Leader On Duty” shifts to provide active supervision, team member recognition, and redirect behaviors to support the customer journey.

• Facilitate a seamless omni-channel customer experience and provide oversite to deliver consistency across in-store, drive-thru, curbside & delivery.

• Lead by example and motivate team members to deliver Loyalty goals.

• Complete and appropriately delegate assigned tasks during scheduled shifts. Ensure adequate sales floor coverage and zoning during shifts.

People

• In partnership with the General Manager or Assistant General Manager, build and retain a high-performing team by participating in selecting the best talent and leading the onboarding and training of new team members.

• Provide coaching and feedback to help team members exceed performance and behavioral expectations. Partner with management to issue accountability.

• Help facilitate the store’s team member badging process with local and state agencies.

• Maintain and coordinate scheduling of team members' shifts, meal breaks, and rest periods.

• Perform other duties as needed.

Qualifications

• At least three years of customer service or retail experience, with at least one year in a supervisory role.

• Cannabis experience preferred

• Inventory control experience preferred

• Meet the scheduling and availability requirements (i.e., ability to work a schedule inclusive of varying shifts such as mornings, days, nights, and weekends) to meet business needs

• Must have reliable, responsible and dependable attendance.

• Must be 21 years or older.

• Must pass any and all required background checks.

• Must possess a valid driver’s license or state ID.

• Must understand and comply with the rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of Green Thumb

• Must have a solid understanding of the Cannabis laws, rules and regulations, and a passion to further their understanding and knowledge of the industry and the laws.

• Prior cannabis experience not required

Skills

• Must be proactive, with a strong work ethic, attention to detail, and strong communication and leadership skills.

• Meet timelines consistently and be able to work under pressure effectively.

• Continuously open to constructive, developmental feedback, and maintaining composure even in difficult situations.

• High level of interpersonal skills in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment, often working cross-functionally.

• Ability to use standard office equipment and computer software including word processing, database management, spreadsheet applications, and email

• Highly motivated, self-directed, innovative, and able to work independently or among teams with keen judgment, common sense, and resourcefulness.

• Adapts and thrives in a demanding, fast-paced environment

• Possesses a high level of critical thinking

• Operates with a high level of professionalism and integrity, including dealing with confidential information

• Ability to resolve conflict, handle employee and customer complaints, and settle disputes

Additional Requirements

Must have the ability to perform the following tasks for prolonged periods of time (i.e., up to the duration of a scheduled shift or workday)

• Move about the dispensary in order to fulfill work assignments and assist employees and patients and/or customers in various locations of the dispensary

• Remain in a stationary position, if required, to meet the needs of the business

• Converse and communicate with individuals and groups of people directly

• Operate point of sale system, computer, and other office productivity machinery in order to use online programming and software including word processing, database management, spreadsheet applications and email

• Prepare patient and customer orders by moving and placing products

• Inspect and receive detailed information, such as patients' and/or customers' dates of birth, in-store or online orders, or inquiries

• Move inventory and materials weighing up to 30 pounds independently

• Position self to move inventory and materials in storage areas

Working Conditions

• Patient and/or customer-facing environment

• Ability to work outdoors in varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions

• Exposure to cannabis and/or allergens that might be present in an environment where cannabis is present and prevalent

A Construction Engineer oversees the construction phase of the project from a contract administration perspective once our design teams complete their approval process. The projects may involve sensitive political or environmental concerns, project coordination with property owners, dry utility companies, and local county and state agencies. The Construction Engineer works for the Timmons Group Project Manager as the project transitions from approval to bidding and through construction. The Construction Engineer manages all necessary documents associated with each project. The documents will include, but not be limited to: Bidding Documents, Payment Requisition Recommendations, Requests for Information (RFI’s), Change Orders (CO), Potential Change Orders (PCO’s), Submittals, Daily Work Reports (DWR), Punch Lists, Project Closeout Completion Letters, Bond Release, Meeting Minutes, Monthly Progress Reports, Loan Draws, Escrow Fund Releases, Material Inspection Reports and correspondence with various governmental agencies. · Prompt, concise and accurate communication with Client, Project Stakeholders, Project Manager, Inspectors and contractor

· Develop construction contract documents so that the project can be bid/negotiated with a contractor

· Maintain, review and respond as necessary to all project documents including RFI’s, material submittals, as-built plans, contractor pay requisitions and change orders

· Attend and facilitate Pre-construction meetings, Progress Meetings and other construction project related meetings with owners, contractors, sub-contractors, governmental agencies, etc. to prosecute the project

· Resolve field construction issues including frequent communication with the owner, contractor, public, utility companies, project engineers and agencies having jurisdiction

· Prepare field directives/sketches for contractor

· Apprise the Timmons Group Project Manager of the project’s progress and seek direction on all salient issues

· Review pre-bid project plans for constructability and offer suggestions to the Timmons Group Project Manager

· Perform other duties as assigned

· Graduation from college or equivalent with a bachelor’s degree, with 5+ years additional training / experience in drainage, grading, earthwork, and transportation/utility work preferred, but not required

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Haystack News http://haystack.tv/, the number one destination for news on streaming platforms, is looking for a Sr Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. Haystack is trusted by over 30 million viewers and is among the fastest-growing TV news companies in the world.

Join our team at Haystack News as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer and become a pivotal force in redefining user experiences through cutting-edge algorithm enhancements. In this role, you'll leverage your advanced statistical analysis, modeling, causal inference, experimental design (A/B testing) and data analytics expertise to drive substantial improvements in user engagement and retention, directly impacting our product's success. This is an exceptional opportunity to showcase your robust problem-solving capabilities and to thrive in a collaborative environment, working alongside a team of passionate professionals dedicated to innovation and excellence. Be part of a dynamic workplace where your contributions make a meaningful difference and help shape the future of news consumption.

 

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - PhD or M.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Economics or Operations Research with 5+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning or related quantitative field

 - 3+ years of professional experience with large-scale online ranking/recommender systems (for news feeds, shopping, ads, music, etc).

 - Deep expertise in statistical inference and experimental design: hypothesis testing, power/sample size calculations, variance reduction, etc.

 - Proficiency in causal inference methods to measure product impact.

 - Proven ability to translate offline analysis into product decisions and measurable improvements in online metrics.

 - Fluency in the Python analytics stack (pandas, NumPy), statistical modeling (statsmodels or scikit-learn) and machine learning packages such as  LightGBM and XGBoost.

 - Strong experience with SQL (e.g. postgres, snowflake, etc).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience working on consumer-facing products with millions of users.

 - Hands-on experience with orchestration/transformation tools (e.g. dbt and Airflow).

 - Experience with deep learning and being familiar with tools such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

 - Hands-on development of products/tools incorporating GenAI, LLMs, RAG, and/or Agents.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build statistical and machine learning models to improve content discovery and user engagement.

 - Work closely with ML engineers to translate models and insights into production systems.

 - Have curiosity and apply analytical skills to dive deep into data to find key insights that would impact the business.

 - Apply causal inference methods to understand the impact of potential product changes.

 - Define and build new ML features using text and multimodal embeddings and GenAI.

 - Validate offline learnings with online outcomes through AB testing. Design, execute, and analyze experiments to prove product change attribution.

Job Title: Senior ISSO

jobs.title: Experienced Clinical Nurse- Medical Oncology 14 Prentice Full Time Days
jobs.description:
The Clinical Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Based on the NMH framework for practice, the registered professional clinical nurse (RN) is accountable and responsible for the provision and coordination of clinically competent, evidence-based care for an assigned group of patients that includes diagnosis, outcome identification, planning, implementation and evaluation. The nurse adheres to the ANA Scope and Standards of Professional Nursing, the Code of Ethics, and the Nursing Social Policy Statement.   As a member of the clinical care and unit team, the RN participates in decision-making, teaching, mentoring, and collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advance the patient plan of care, achieve exceptional outcomes and enhance unit operations.  The RN exemplifies the components of what it means to be an NMH nurse, reflects the Mission, Vision, and Values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

The role of the professional clinical nurse is unique and essential to the care of the patient.  The nurse demonstrates that unique and essential function through the framework for nursing practice.

Advocate:

• Practices in accordance with the patient centered care model
• Develops an individualized age-specific culturally sensitive nursing plan of care for the patient that is based on the nursing process
• Incorporates the role of patient advocate into the plan of care
• Uses a team approach to develop and achieve daily patient-centered individualized care goals
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of the patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care
• Identifies potential conflict situations and facilitates resolution using established communication channels
• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient
• Protects patients by maintaining a safe environment

Clinical Expert:

• Advances clinical expertise, as demonstrated through pursuit of informal and formal continuing education opportunities and obtaining specialty certification when eligible
• Continuously enhances skills and abilities to ensure the highest quality patient care
• Shares knowledge and expertise through educating team members, patients and students
• Demonstrates critical thinking by integrating theoretical knowledge and expertise to pose relevant clinical questions when evidence and practice differ
• Identifies priorities, sets realistic and measureable goals, prescribes and implements nursing interventions in a safe and timely manner
• Develops and implements individualized education plans for patients and families using suitable instructional materials and methods
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings
• Identifies situations that require further intervention and escalates appropriately; Consults appropriate experts and resources when needed
• Participates in the formation, implementation and evaluation of team goals
• Appropriately delegates and supervises interventions to implement the plan of care
• Conveys complete, timely and accurate information at hand off at the bedside or any hand off
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice

Community Volunteer:

• Participates in one or more volunteer initiatives annually, Northwestern Memorial organized or on his/her own

Compassionate:

• Consistently demonstrates interpersonal connections with patients and families from introduction through discharge
• Proactively responds to patient concerns such as speaking to patients about possible/expected delays in plan of care
• Treats patients, families, visitors and staff in a caring manner with respect and dignity
• Facilities recovery and where appropriate helps ensure a peaceful death for patients

Professionally Engaged:

• Is a member of a professional organization or participates on an Northwestern Memorial committee or taskforce at the hospital-wide, departmental, or unit level
• Demonstrates accountability and collaborative practice with co-workers, other disciplines, and departments
• Assumes responsibility for continued professional growth and education reflecting knowledge and understanding of current nursing practice
• Serves as a community mentor for team members
• Serves as a preceptor for new team members
• Participates in the peer feedback process by conducting a constructive assessment and evaluation of peer performance
• Works collaboratively with all hospital services to accomplish daily work and maintain an environment of excellence
• Participates in the development of policies, procedures and systems to support safe and effective care and advance nursing practice at NMH through the Shared Leadership Process
• Assumes personal responsibility for meeting internal (i.e. Best People profile, ELMs, CPR, and health requirements) and external regulatory and accreditation requirements
• Identifies opportunities for innovation and quality improvement; participates in innovation projects and the quality improvement process, including unit based quality committees
• Demonstrates accountability to Northwestern Memorial strategic, operational and fiscal goals
• Exemplifies a professional image in appearance and communications

• Maintains and advances the professional image of nursing and the practice of professional nursing through an ongoing analysis of resources
• Professional Organizations, literature, electronic resources, etc.

Required:

• Graduate of an NLN accredited school/college of nursing
• Baccalaureate degree in Nursing or higher
• Current State of Illinois, Registered Professional Nurse license
• Basic Life Support (BLS) CPR through American Heart Association.
• Analytic ability (conceptual and quantitative)
• Oral, listening and written communication skills
• Strong human relation skills to interact effectively and collaborate with others in difficult situations
• Use of a keyboard to enter or retrieve data

Preferred:

• Experience in specific clinical area
• Nursing specialty certification, if eligible

jobs.title: Senior Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
The Nuclear Company is the fastest-growing AI tech-enabled startup in the nuclear and energy space, pioneering a fleet-scale approach to building the next generation of nuclear reactors. Through our design-once, build-many model, we're accelerating the deployment of safe, reliable, and affordable nuclear energy.

We operate with an AI-first mindset. Every employee is expected to leverage AI, technology, and the Nuclear Operating System (NOS) as integral components of their role to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. We expect every team member to continuously identify opportunities to automate workflows, enhance decision-making, improve processes, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of NOS as a strategic operating capability that enables The Nuclear Company to scale with excellence.

We hire people who are driven by purpose, thrive in ambiguity, and are energized by building what has never been built before. Our team combines intellectual curiosity with high agency, embraces candid feedback and continuous learning, and holds themselves and others to exceptional standards. Our values—Transparency, Responsibility, Unity, Scrappy, and Tenacity—guide how we hire, collaborate, and make decisions every day. They are not words on a wall; they are the standard by which we operate. TRUST is the foundation of our safety culture, fostering intellectual honesty, accountability, and open communication, while our values challenge every team member to execute with urgency, humility, resilience, and an unwavering commitment to our mission.

About the role

The Nuclear Company is seeking a Senior Systems Administrator to design, implement, and maintain the enterprise IT infrastructure that supports our rapidly scaling organization. This role is critical to ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of the systems our teams depend on daily. The Senior Systems Administrator will work closely with cybersecurity, software engineering, and operations teams to build a resilient, scalable, and secure technology foundation.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical professional who thrives in fast-paced environments, can independently manage daily administration and troubleshoot complex issues, and brings a security-first mindset to everything they build.

Responsibilities

Infrastructure Design & Management

• Design, deploy, and maintain enterprise server infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

• Administer endpoint enrollment, configuration, software deployment, inventory, and device onboarding/offboarding

• Administer Windows Server and Linux environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and PKI. Manage endpoint patching through Intune and NinjaOne

• Maintain high-availability configurations, disaster recovery plans, and backup/restore procedures

Network & Security Operations

• Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN, and connectivity issues; contribute to network design and firewall changes alongside Infrastructure based on skills and experience

• Implement and enforce security hardening standards across all systems in alignment with NIST 800-53, CMMC, or equivalent frameworks

• Monitor systems for performance, availability, and security events; respond to incidents and conduct root cause analysis

• Manage endpoint detection and response (EDR), SIEM, and vulnerability management tools

Automation & Process Improvement

• Develop automation scripts and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Bash) to streamline provisioning, configuration, and maintenance

• Build repeatable, scalable processes for system deployment and lifecycle management

• Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to reduce manual effort and improve system reliability

Identity & Access Management

• Administer identity platforms (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta, or similar) including SSO, MFA, and conditional access policies

• Manage user provisioning/deprovisioning, role-based access controls, and privileged access management

• Ensure compliance with least-privilege principles across all systems

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with cybersecurity to support compliance audits, security assessments, and remediation efforts

• Support software engineering teams with CI/CD pipeline infrastructure, development environments, and tooling

• Provide Tier 3 escalation support and mentorship to junior IT staff

• Document architecture, procedures, and runbooks to support operational continuity

Required Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)

• 5+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical role

• Strong experience administering Windows Server and Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, or CentOS) environments

• Proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including IaaS, PaaS, and hybrid configurations

• Hands-on endpoint administration and patching experience with Intune and NinjaOne

• Hands-on experience with scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash, Python, Terraform, or Ansible)

• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, firewalls)

• Experience with identity and access management platforms and principles

• Strong troubleshooting methodology and ability to resolve complex, multi-system issues under pressure

• Demonstrated willingness to adopt and integrate AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) into daily workflows for scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and process automation

Preferred Experience

• Relevant certifications: RHCE, MCSE, AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent

• Experience in regulated industries (nuclear, defense, energy, or federal) with familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53, CMMC, NRC cybersecurity requirements)

• Experience supporting environments subject to 10 CFR 73.54 (nuclear facility cyber security)

• Familiarity with zero-trust architecture principles

• Knowledge of ITIL or similar service management frameworks

• Experience leveraging AI-assisted automation for infrastructure monitoring, incident response, log analysis, or predictive maintenance

• Familiarity with AIOps platforms or machine learning-driven observability tools (e.g., Datadog AI, Splunk ITSI, or similar). Experience with Jamf for macOS endpoint administration is a plus

Benefits

• Competitive compensation packages

• 401k with company match

• Medical, dental, vision plans

• Generous vacation policy, plus holidays

Estimated Starting Salary Range
The estimated starting salary range for this role is $121,000 - $143,000 annually less applicable withholdings and deductions, paid on a bi-weekly basis. The actual salary offered may vary based on relevant factors as determined in the Company’s discretion, which may include experience, qualifications, tenure, skill set, availability of qualified candidates, geographic location, certifications held, and other criteria deemed pertinent to the particular role.

EEO Statement
The Nuclear Company is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an environment of inclusion in the workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We prohibit discrimination in all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, demotion, transfer, compensation, and termination.

Export Control
Certain positions at The Nuclear Company may involve access to information and technology subject to export controls under U.S. law. Compliance with these export controls may result in The Nuclear Company limiting its consideration of certain applicants.

Recruiting Fraud Alert
Your safety is our priority. We want to ensure your job search stays secure. Please note that the team at The Nuclear Company only communicates through official @thenuclearcompany.com email addresses. We will never ask for payments or sensitive financial information at any stage of our recruitment process. For your peace of mind, please verify all openings and submit your applications directly through our official careers page.

AI Usage
The Nuclear Company uses AI-enabled features in our applicant tracking system to help our recruiting team organize and review applications, for example by comparing application materials against criteria our recruiters set for the role. These tools support, but do not replace, human review. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Reporting to the VP Finance you'll own payroll and the processes, controls, and accounting surrounding it, plus support our international and multi-entity expansion by partnering with external experts and internal stakeholders to insure multi-jurisdiction compliance and administration.  Just as important, you'll design the financial processes, systems, and controls that take Finance from manual workarounds to a scalable, automated, audit-ready operation, partnering closely with People, Legal, RevOps, and Accounting. Own global payroll operations and partner on benefits administration

Build financial processes, controls, and payroll accounting

Manage entities, equity, and compliance

Partner with People on the employee lifecycle

 - Serve as a key escalation point for complex payroll and compensation payment questions, partnering with People on employee support




ABOUT YOU

 - Comfortable reading and working with employment agreements, contractor agreements, and offer letters, and partnering with Legal

Bonus points

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

jobs.title: Senior Director of Operations
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Join the dynamic team at Vacation®, the award-winning sunscreen company from Miami USA that’s on a mission to make sunscreen fun. Founded in summer 2021, Vacation® has swiftly gained acclaim among consumers, tastemakers, press, retailers, and dermatologists alike for the immersive brand world and "leisure-enhancing" products that transport you to paradise and back. Vacation’s steady growth is in large part thanks to the company’s focus on creativity and innovation, and the team’s shared mission to infuse a sense of fun into sunscreen aisles nationwide. You can discover Vacation's products at leading retailers including Ulta Beauty, Nordstrom, and Target, as well as www.vacation.inc.

Your role
The Senior Director of Operations is a strategic and hands-on operational leader responsible for building and leading the processes, systems, and teams that enable Vacation to scale efficiently, profitably, and predictably.

This role owns the end-to-end planning process, including demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), ensuring commercial demand is translated into actionable supply and inventory plans. A primary objective is to improve forecast accuracy, reduce forecast bias, optimize inventory investment, and ensure the organization makes informed, financially sound decisions.

The Senior Director also owns the company's third-party logistics (3PL) relationship, including strategic partnership management, contract negotiations, service-level agreements, cost management, and operational performance. This individual ensures that fulfillment operations consistently meet customer expectations, retailer requirements, and financial targets.

End-to-End Planning & S&OP Leadership

• Lead the end-to-end monthly S&OP process, including demand reviews, supply reviews, inventory reviews, and executive decision-making forums.

• Own the demand planning process, partnering with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to develop an accurate, unbiased, consensus demand forecast.

• Improve forecast accuracy through stronger forecasting methodologies, statistical analysis, historical trend analysis, and incorporation of commercial intelligence, promotional plans, seasonality, distribution changes, and new product launches.

• Establish forecast accountability by channel, customer, SKU, and time horizon, ensuring forecast assumptions are transparent, measurable, and regularly challenged.

• Analyze forecast accuracy and bias, identify root causes of forecast variances, and implement corrective actions to improve planning performance.

• Translate demand forecasts into executable supply plans, ensuring purchasing, production, and inventory commitments align with anticipated demand and business priorities.

• Lead supply planning activities, ensuring appropriate production capacity, supplier lead times, minimum order quantities, and replenishment requirements are incorporated into the plan.

• Establish and maintain inventory policies, including safety stock, reorder points, days on hand (DOS), and inventory targets by SKU and ABC classification.

• Proactively identify inventory risks, including potential stockouts, excess and obsolete inventory (SLOB), aging inventory, and inventory imbalances across channels.

• Lead inventory allocation and deployment decisions to optimize product availability across DTC, wholesale, retail, and other sales channels.

3PL & Fulfillment Operations Management

• Serve as the primary business owner of the 3PL relationship, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and performance standards.

• Lead 3PL contract negotiations, including pricing, service-level agreements (SLAs), contractual terms, performance requirements, and annual cost reviews.

• Evaluate 3PL performance against established KPIs, including on-time shipment, order accuracy, inventory accuracy, order processing time, receiving turnaround, and cost per order.

• Establish a structured operating cadence with 3PL partners, including weekly performance reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs).

• Develop and maintain comprehensive 3PL scorecards that provide visibility into service, cost, quality, productivity, and compliance.

• Hold 3PL partners accountable for performance against contractual commitments and proactively address service failures, recurring issues, and operational inefficiencies.

• Lead root cause analysis and corrective action plans to resolve fulfillment issues and prevent recurrence.

• Manage fulfillment capacity planning to ensure operational readiness for peak season, promotional events, new product launches, and changes in order volume.

• Oversee inbound and outbound logistics coordination, ensuring timely receipt of inventory and reliable shipment execution across all channels.

• Ensure compliance with retailer routing guides, shipping requirements, EDI transactions, labeling standards, and OTIF expectations.

• Partner with Finance to validate 3PL invoices, identify billing discrepancies, monitor fulfillment expenses, and ensure adherence to contracted rates.

Financial Management & Business Partnership

• Partner with Finance throughout the monthly financial close process, ensuring accurate and timely reporting of inventory, COGS, freight, fulfillment expenses, and operational accruals.

• Ensure inventory transactions, receipts, shipments, adjustments, and transfers are accurately reflected in the financial systems.

• Reconcile operational inventory reporting with financial records, investigate variances, and drive resolution of inventory discrepancies.

• Validate inventory valuation, inventory reserves, and excess and obsolete inventory exposure in partnership with Finance.

• Support monthly financial close by providing operational data, variance explanations, accrual estimates, and supporting documentation.

• Monitor actual operational expenses against budget, identifying variances, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

Leadership, Talent Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Lead, coach, and develop direct reports, establishing clear expectations, performance objectives, and development plans.

• Build functional capabilities across demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, fulfillment, and transportation.

• Develop a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, analytical rigor, and proactive problem-solving.

• Establish clear KPIs, individual goals, and team performance standards aligned with company objectives.

• Develop talent and succession plans to ensure organizational depth and continuity.

What excites us about you:

• 12–15+ years of progressive experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Planning, or related functions.

• 5+ years in a leadership role managing cross-functional teams.

• Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end demand planning, supply planning, and S&OP processes.

• Proven track record improving forecast accuracy, inventory productivity, and working capital.

• Experience negotiating and managing 3PL contracts and strategic logistics partnerships.

• Experience managing financial and operational performance, including inventory reconciliation, budgeting, and month-end close activities.

• Experience in high-growth consumer products, CPG, beauty, or retail environments preferred.

• Experience supporting both DTC and wholesale/retail distribution channels.

Compensation & Benefits:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision policies

• 15 Days PTO

• Employee Equity Options

• WFH stipend

• Annual Learning Stipend

• Complimentary Vacation® Products

What We Value

Vacation® employees have a deep hunger and eagerness to go above and beyond in everything they do. They love to leave their mark in contributing to the company’s growth and, maybe most importantly, they are humble when they do so. No job is too small, and they see every task they do as an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the company’s overall success. Attention to detail, organization, proactivity, accountability, humility and a sense of humor are cardinal virtues for a Vacation® employee.

Vacation® is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We recognize that diverse teams make the strongest teams. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by contacting us at people@vacation.inc so we can do our best to accommodate you in applying for the role.

jobs.description:

Kettle Studios is the creative production team behind one of the world’s most well known creative tech company’s digital marketing work, from cross-channel campaigns and website experiences to content for global retail partners.

We are looking for our first Head of Studio to run the team and lead us into a new way of working. You will introduce and implement AI and new tools into our creative process, and bring the team along on the journey with you. In partnership with our Acceleration teams, both at Kettle and across the Code and Theory network, you will shape how the Kettle Studio works in the AI-era.

This role requires PST working hours, and occasional in-person presence in SF and/or LA. Preference is for candidates presently residing on the West Coast.

What you’ll do:

• Run the Studio well today. Own quality, capacity and delivery for a large team that ships constantly. Know the work and the people well enough to make calls that feel smart, modern and appeal to cutting edge clients.

• Lead the team through change. Inspire production designers and copy editors to want to work in new ways, rather than being told to. Show them how new tools will make the work, and their roles, better, and coach your leads to do the same.

• Build new ways of working with the Acceleration team. Partner with Kettle's Acceleration team to define, test and roll out technology-enabled workflows across the client ecosystem, and get them out of pilot and into everyday practice.

• Grow our client business. Turn better, faster production into added scope, and help shape how we pitch and staff that work.

• Make what works spread. When one part of the team cracks something, the rest of the Studio should be using it within weeks. Keep an honest view of which tools are ready for client work and which aren't.

Candidates should have:

• Organizational leadership experience in a digital, creative agency and/or fast-paced creative tech organization

• Deep delivery operational expertise, including program management, workflow optimization, and creative operations at scale

• Deep practical fluency with generative AI and multimodal tools, including image, video, audio, and language models, and an ability to assess their creative quality, technical limitations, and production implications

• Managed complex, high-volume creative workflows as evidenced by the scale of budgets, team size, and variety of creative outputs in previous roles

• Management experience of a 50+ person team, with the ability to grow nurture ICs and managers to continue a healthy team culture and growth mindset

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to translate complex technical terms and concepts to marketable, accessible language for C-level clients

• Expertise in digital design asset production and post-production pipelines, including how assets, editorial, review, approvals, vendors, and delivery requirements interact across a production lifecycle

• A problem solver mentality, with the ability to break down complex problems into simple steps and actions, and create streamlined processes

• Experience operating at 10,000 feet, and the ability to sit down with creatives and producers to solve day-to-day challenges

The target range of base compensation for this role is $220,000-250,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

Trusted by the world’s top healthcare brands and their agencies, DeepIntent uniquely unites media, identity, and real-world clinical data to power privacy-safe, omnichannel marketing across every screen. What You’ll Do:

The Senior Director, Enterprise Sales will be responsible for cultivating high-value partnerships with pharmaceutical companies by integrating DeepIntent’s technology, data, and audience solutions into their commercial operations, marketing technology stacks, and customer engagement strategies. The Sr Director, Enterprise Sales has a deep understanding of how pharmaceutical companies leverage data, technology, and media to drive commercial success and a strong track record of developing JBPs that increase long-term revenue and integration depth.

This role will work cross-functionally within pharmaceutical organizations, engaging with key teams responsible for:

• Marketing and Commercial Strategy – Driving digital transformation, omnichannel marketing execution, and audience engagement to optimize HCP and patient outreach.

• Sales and Commercial Operations – Overseeing field force effectiveness, sales enablement, and data-driven decision-making to improve brand performance and customer engagement.

• Data & Information Management – Managing commercial and real-world data strategy, including customer insights, identity resolution, and integration of external data sources into pharma’s analytics ecosystem.

• Customer Experience and Digital Intelligence – Optimizing the use of technology to create personalized, data-driven experiences that enhance engagement with healthcare professionals and patients.

• Technology and Innovation – Leading the integration of emerging tools such as AI, data workbenches, and programmatic solutions into the pharma ecosystem to enhance targeting, measurement, and attribution.

• Media Investment & Audience Optimization – Strategizing paid media and programmatic investments to ensure optimal reach, efficiency, and impact across digital channels.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop & Strengthen Pharma Partnerships – Drive meaningful, long-term strategic relationships with pharmaceutical clients, embedding DeepIntent’s technology and solutions into their business workflows.

• Lead Joint Business Partnership Initiatives – Structure, negotiate, and execute JBPs that align DeepIntent’s media capabilities with pharma commercial priorities, driving deeper collaboration and investment.

• Integrate DeepIntent’s Solutions into Pharma Tech Stacks – Partner with clients to connect DeepIntent’s identity, audience, analytics, and activation solutions with their internal data ecosystems, CDPs, and measurement frameworks.

• Expand Audience Connectivity & Activation – Work with pharma teams to optimize audience strategies, helping them reach HCPs and patients through more data-driven, AI-powered approaches.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally – Serve as the bridge between Client Strategy, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to ensure that partnerships translate into impactful solutions and tangible business outcomes.

• Drive Revenue Growth & Market Differentiation – Identify and execute commercial opportunities that strengthen DeepIntent’s position as a preferred pharma partner, expanding our role beyond media execution.

• Proven experience structuring JBPs and long-term commercial agreements with pharma companies.

• Expertise in integrating media, data, and analytics solutions into pharma companies’ digital ecosystems.

• Strong knowledge of pharma or cross-industry commercial operations, audience strategy, and digital transformation trends.

• Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, engaging with marketing, sales, technology, and commercial data teams at top pharma companies.

• Executive presence and strategic thinking, with experience engaging senior-level pharma stakeholders.

• Be a strategic leader driving high-impact partnerships with the world’s leading pharmaceutical brands.

• Shape the future of pharma digital marketing, AI-powered audience activation, and advanced analytics.

• Work in a high-growth, innovation-driven healthcare AdTech company

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

ELECTRICAL ENGINEER, FACILITIES (STARLINK)

SpaceX is leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s largest satellite constellation and most advanced broadband internet system. We provide reliable and fast internet to millions of users worldwide, including populations with little or no connectivity, rural communities, aircraft, watercraft, and places where existing services are unreliable, too expensive, or disconnected by natural disasters. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system, thousands of satellites and consumer antennae that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing. The Starlink team is seeking out the best-in-class professionals to maximize Starlink’s potential for communities and businesses around the globe.

As an Electrical Engineer at our Starlink Production facility, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the safety, integrity, and efficiency of our electrical distribution systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, evaluating, and improving various electrical systems site-wide, including substation, switchgear, power distribution, lighting, UPS, Motor Control Centers, VFDs, and generators. Your expertise will drive continuous improvement initiatives, support sustainability goals, and ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations. Additionally, you will be tasked with designing upgrades and overseeing the installation of new assembly lines and processes, with the goal of creating a world-class facility that can support the mission of connecting people across the globe and enabling life beyond Earth. This position is based in Bastrop, Texas (Greater Austin, TX Area).

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Provide engineering support for the design, operation, improvement, and troubleshooting of all facility electrical components and systems, including load flow analysis, equipment evaluation, grounding systems, and power monitoring

• Coordinate downtime activities between maintenance, construction, and production teams to minimize disruptions

• Drive electrical distribution improvement projects using design change requests, power monitoring data, and advanced detection methods

• Troubleshoot electrical system problems, conduct breaker coordination, arc flash studies, and track electrical load and capacity

• Coordinate material procurement for equipment upkeep

• Write, negotiate, and manage construction contracts with subcontractors across multiple disciplines through contract close-out

• Collaborate within interdisciplinary teams to design, optimize, and maintain electrical systems

• Provide electrical engineering support to facility technicians to troubleshoot existing electrical equipment and controllers

• Oversee equipment installation, operation, and maintenance to meet specified parameters

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or other engineering discipline

• 3+ years of experience in industrial electrical engineering and medium or high voltage power systems

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 5+ years of professional experience with the design or build of commercial or industrial power systems

• Primary experience with electrical and power distribution systems (<600Vac)

• Working knowledge of delta/wye transformers, switchgear, motor control centers, building lighting, building construction specifications, and facility grounding

• Experience with critical power infrastructure including UPS systems, backup generators, and automatic transfer switches

• Experience creating and implementing process/design solutions with minimal impact to business operations

• Able to quickly assess an issue and assist technicians with troubleshooting and repair

• Ability to work in a high-concentration, high-stress environment, under possible extended work hours and tight deadlines

• Acute attention to detail, ability to see interactions with other systems to avoid problems

• AutoCAD/Revit – Beginner to intermediate skill level

• Familiarity with National Electric Code, National Fire Protection Association, and International Building Code

• Ability to multi-task, prioritize and work in an extremely fast-paced environment.

• Strong understanding of construction project management principles, including scheduling, budgeting, and contractor management

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Physical ability to perform hands-on work in various environments, including heat, cold, rain, and tight quarters

• Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed

• Must be onsite, remote work not considered

• Ability to travel as needed

• Valid driver's license

• Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted

This is a composite position that has two distinct responsibilities – As Oncology BTS Lead and as the Commercial BTS M&A Practice Lead.

BU BTS Franchise Lead

The Franchise Lead is the single accountable Business Technology Solutions (BTS) partner for a dedicated commercial franchise, a senior technology executive who sits at the intersection of commercial strategy and technology enablement, ensuring every technology and data investment directly accelerates brand performance, patient access, and commercial growth.

Serving as a trusted advisor to franchise VPs, Senior Directors, and IBT leads across Market Access & Patient Services (MAPS) and Sales & Marketing, this individual is the connective tissue between business ambition and technology execution, translating commercial priorities into a cohesive, forward-looking technology roadmap. This role owns the full BTS investment portfolio end-to-end: from strategic prioritization and business case development through delivery oversight and ROI validation, coordinating execution across shared services platforms and data teams’ enterprise wide.

As a strategic anchor for the META Business Unit, this leader navigates complex external environments to drive priorities that position the organization toward industry leadership. Most critically, this role eliminates technical friction across the patient journey, from Awareness to Adherence, ensuring that platforms spanning Consumer Marketing, MAPS, and HCP Sales & Marketing operate as one integrated ecosystem. In an era defined by omnichannel execution, connected data, and intelligent automation, this role is where brand strategy becomes technology reality.

Responsibilities:

• Business-BTS Strategic Alignment: Act as the primary BTS point of contact for Therapeutic Brand Leads and commercial support function leaders, building trusted, advisory-level relationships with VPs and Senior Directors across MAPS, and Sales & Marketing to ensure the franchise BTS strategy is fully aligned to and enabling commercial brand objectives.
• Strategic Commercial Pillar Support: Own and drive the franchise BTS roadmap across the three core commercial pillars, MAPS, and Sales & Marketing, with a clear mandate to eliminate technical friction across the E2E Patient journey.
• Portfolio Demand Management & Prioritization: Oversee the intake and prioritization of all incoming technology requests for the franchise, applying a structured, value-based prioritization framework that balances brand urgency, strategic impact, resource capacity, and enterprise standards to ensure the franchise technology portfolio is focused on the highest-value opportunities.
• Strategic Outcome & Value Management: Define Business Requirements (BRDs) and high-level success criteria for all franchise technology initiatives, establishing the strategic foundation for functional scoping, solution design, and delivery. Partner with brand and commercial leaders’ post-deployment to measure, validate, and communicate whether BTS investments delivered the expected commercial ROI.
• Omnichannel Coordination & Integration: Ensure technology initiatives across Sales & Marketing, MAPS are designed and delivered as an integrated ecosystem, preventing data silos between field sales, PSP, and access functions, and enabling a seamless, connected experience across the Patient-to-Rx journey.
• Market Access & Copay Technology Enablement: Lead the delivery of specialized Market Access and copay technology solutions for the franchise, working in close partnership with the shared services Market Access and Copay Center of Excellence organization to deploy tools that improve patient affordability, reimbursement outcomes, and access program effectiveness.
• BTS Budget Orchestration: Manage the full franchise BTS investment pool, owning budget planning, allocation, and governance to ensure funds are deployed against the highest-impact technology priorities, with clear financial visibility & accountability to BTS leadership.
• Solution Design & Feasibility Partnership: Partner with BU BTS architecture and shared services teams to evaluate solution options for franchise business needs, contributing strategic business context to feasibility assessments, trade-off evaluations, decisions to ensure solutions are pragmatic, scalable, and commercially grounded.
• Compliance, Security & Business Continuity: Ensure all franchise technology solutions and vendor relationships are secure, compliant, and operationally resilient, proactively managing information security, data privacy, and regulatory risks across the franchise application and platform landscape.
• Team Leadership & Organizational Development: Lead and develop a high-performing team of 10–12 AbbVie direct and matrixed reports, setting clear direction, building technical and strategic capability, and fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement in alignment with BTS talent priorities.
• Consulting Partnership: Actively engages strategic consulting partners to architect and deliver unique, innovative business capabilities, channeling external expertise, and bold thinking to address the franchise's most critical business priorities.

Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) Practice Lead

As the M&A Practice Lead, this leader is responsible for establishing tools, templates, and a knowledge base for Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A). This role will also act as subject matter expert, the primary point of contact for due diligence efforts, and the representative of Commercial BTS within the broader BTS community of M&A practitioners.

Responsibilities:

• Knowledge Management. Establish tools, templates, and a knowledge base for M&A.
• Mentorship. Act as an M&A subject matter expert and mentor for other team members.
• Due Diligence. Act as the primary point of contact for due diligence efforts, and the representative of Commercial BTS within the broader BTS community of M&A practitioners.

• Bachelor’s Degree with 10 years of relevant experience; Master’s Degree with 9 years of experience; PhD with 5 years of experience.
• Respective years of progressive experience in solution or enterprise architecture, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership or people management role.
• Proven track record of architecting and delivering complex, cross-platform technology solutions in a large, matrixed organization, preferably within pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences.
• Demonstrated experience with feasibility assessment, solution trade-off analysis, and architecture decision-making at scale.
• Prior experience managing a cross-platform solution portfolio and leading teams of 4 or more direct reports, including coordination with Technical Product Owners.

Skills & Experience

• Strategic Business Partnership & Executive Influence: Proven ability to build trusted advisory relationships with VPs and Senior Directors, translating complex technology concepts into clear business language and aligning diverse stakeholders around a shared technology vision with commercial rigor.
• Commercial Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of pharmaceutical commercial operations across Patient Services, Market Access, and Sales & Marketing, with the ability to connect technology strategy directly to brand performance and patient access outcomes.
• IT Strategy & Roadmap Development: Proven ability to develop and own a franchise-level technology roadmap, balancing short-term brand priorities with long-term scalability across a complex, multi-stakeholder portfolio.
• Portfolio & Demand Management: Experience managing a large, diverse technology portfolio, including structured intake, value-based prioritization, business case development, and governance across multiple concurrent initiatives.
• Value Realization & ROI Measurement: Ability to define upfront success criteria and partner with business leaders’ post-deployment to measure and communicate whether technology investments delivered expected commercial outcomes.
• Omnichannel & Data Integration Fluency: Working knowledge of omnichannel platforms and data integration principles, with the ability to identify and close data silos across Patient Services, Market Access, and Sales & Marketing.
• Solution Design & Feasibility Evaluation: Sufficient grounding in solution architecture and trade-off analysis to partner credibly with BU architecture teams and ensure franchise solutions are scalable, interoperable, and cost-efficient.
• Budget & Financial Management: Experience managing operational and capital IT budgets, with strong prioritization discipline and the ability to communicate investment trade-offs clearly to senior business and BTS leadership.
• People Leadership & Organizational Development Proven leader with experience building and developing high-performing teams of 10+ in matrixed environments, fostering a culture of accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

• A dynamic leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and contributes to a ‘team-first’ culture.

• Proven experience building and scaling a Partner Program at a cybersecurity or cloud hyper-growth startup AND/OR F1000 organization from the ground up (preferred).

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

jobs.title: Associate Scientist I, AD
jobs.description:
Forge Your Future with Us:

At Forge Biologics, we believe in turning bold ideas into life-changing realities. Our mission is simple yet powerful: to enable access to life-changing gene therapies and help bring them from ideas into reality. We partner with scientists, physicians, biotech and pharma innovators, and patient communities — all united by one goal: improving lives. If you’re driven by purpose and excited to make a tangible impact, this is where your journey begins.

Our team works out of The Hearth, a state-of-the-art, 200,000-square-foot cGMP facility in Columbus, Ohio. Here, you won’t just watch innovation happen — you’ll be part of it. Whether you’re scaling AAV manufacturing, collaborating on cutting-edge therapies, or supporting complex technical projects, you’ll play a key role in bringing hope to patients with genetic diseases.

What sets Forge apart is our culture of H.O.P.E. We are hardworking, showing up each day with determination and grit. We are open, creating a space where ideas flow freely and every voice is valued. We are purpose-driven, with every task directly tied to changing lives. And we are engaged, energized by the challenges we face and the milestones we achieve together.

At Forge, your growth matters. We’re committed to helping you expand your skills, take on new challenges, and develop your career through mentorship, hands-on learning, and opportunities for advancement. Our people are our greatest investment, and we’re proud to see team members grow with us.

If you’re ready to use your talent to help deliver hope to patients around the world, join us — and be part of something bigger than yourself.

About The Role:

The Associate Scientist I, Rapid Analytical Development (RAD) plays a pivotal role in executing swift and precise analytical tests for AAV gene therapy and plasmid products. Collaborating with a dynamic team of experts, you'll contribute to the advancement of groundbreaking therapies by leveraging cutting-edge analytical techniques and ensuring adherence to rigorous quality standards. This entry-level position offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the critical analytical aspects of gene therapy development

Responsibilities:

• Execute assays as directed by management to support gene therapy product development.

• Prepare reagents, assist in sample preparation, and maintain laboratory equipment for assay execution.

• Analyze and document experimental data, ensuring accuracy and completeness of records.

• Participate in assay optimization and troubleshooting activities under supervision.

• Contribute to the execution of analytical methods for product characterization.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely completion of projects.

• Assist in preparing reports and presentations summarizing assay results and findings.

• Adhere to laboratory safety protocols and maintain a clean and organized workspace.

• Learn and stay updated on relevant scientific literature and industry best practices.

• Actively participate in training programs and seek opportunities for skill development.

• Participates in analytical method transfer, qualification, and validation activities, as applicable to the role, in accordance with approved procedures, defined departmental responsibilities, and documented training and qualification requirements; Quality Control owns execution and technical responsibility, Analytical Development provides method-specific scientific support, and QA Technical performs independent quality review.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., biology, biochemistry, molecular biology).

• Experience and/or documented training commensurate with the assigned responsibilities for analytical method development, transfer, qualification, validation, or technical quality review, as applicable to the role. Personnel must complete required training and qualification before independently performing, reviewing, or approving assigned activities.

• Experience in analytical method development, characterization, and troubleshooting, with sufficient knowledge to support QC-led transfer, qualification, and validation activities.

Preferred Skills:

• Basic laboratory skills, including pipetting, cell culture, and sample preparation.

• Proficiency with the conduct of qPCR or ddPCR, cell-based assays, capillary gel electrophoresis or SDS-PAGE, immunoassays and knowledge of work with plasmids is preferred.

• Familiarity with basic data analysis tools and software (e.g., Excel).

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow standard operating procedures (SOPs).

• Demonstrated teamwork and communication skills within a laboratory setting.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change or new ones may be assigned.

Serving as a trusted advisor to franchise VPs, Senior Directors, and IBT leads across Market Access & Patient Services (MAPS) and Sales & Marketing, this individual is the connective tissue between business ambition and technology execution, translating commercial priorities into a cohesive, forward-looking technology roadmap. This role owns the full BTS investment portfolio end-to-end: from strategic prioritization and business case development through delivery oversight and ROI validation, coordinating execution across shared services platforms and data teams’ enterprise wide.

As a strategic anchor for the META Business Unit, this leader navigates complex external environments to drive priorities that position the organization toward industry leadership. Most critically, this role eliminates technical friction across the patient journey, from Awareness to Adherence, ensuring that platforms spanning Consumer Marketing, MAPS, and HCP Sales & Marketing operate as one integrated ecosystem. Partner with brand and commercial leaders’ post-deployment to measure, validate, and communicate whether BTS investments delivered the expected commercial ROI.

• Bachelor’s Degree with 10 years of relevant experience; Master’s Degree with 9 years of experience; PhD with 5 years of experience.

• Demonstrated experience with feasibility assessment, solution trade-off analysis, and architecture decision-making at scale.
• Prior experience managing a cross-platform solution portfolio and leading teams of 4 or more direct reports, including coordination with Technical Product Owners.

• Strategic Business Partnership & Executive Influence: Proven ability to build trusted advisory relationships with VPs and Senior Directors, translating complex technology concepts into clear business language and aligning diverse stakeholders around a shared technology vision with commercial rigor.
• Commercial Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of pharmaceutical commercial operations across Patient Services, Market Access, and Sales & Marketing, with the ability to connect technology strategy directly to brand performance and patient access outcomes.
• IT Strategy & Roadmap Development: Proven ability to develop and own a franchise-level technology roadmap, balancing short-term brand priorities with long-term scalability across a complex, multi-stakeholder portfolio.
• Portfolio & Demand Management: Experience managing a large, diverse technology portfolio, including structured intake, value-based prioritization, business case development, and governance across multiple concurrent initiatives.

The ideal candidate is an autonomous leader with deep supply chain expertise, has developed and implemented SOPs, implemented or improved ERP/WMS, and a proven track record of scaling high-performing teams.

 - Develop and implement robust SOPs to drive operational efficiency, consistency, and continuous process improvement.

 - Utilize and oversee the implementation, integration, or optimization of ERP and WMS software platforms to enhance material-related processes.

 - Identify and execute cost-reduction opportunities across the supply chain while maintaining a high level of quality and safety.

 - Manage and safeguard high-tech inventory to ensure maximum accuracy, mitigate stockouts, and maintain optimized stock levels.

 - Lead and develop a high-performing logistics and warehouse team through recruitment, mentorship, and a culture of excellence.




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, logistics, business administration, or equivalent work experience

 - 5+ years of experience in material management, inventory control, or supply chain management roles in a manufacturing environment

 - 2+ years of experience managing a lead of supervisors, associates or operators

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION

 - Strong understanding of production rate, critical path analysis, and key warehouse fundamentals

 - Strong understanding for receiving and deployment documentation for domestic and international shipments

 - Ability to identify safety issues with warehouse vehicles to ensure safe operations

 - Experience being hands-on and boots on the ground in the warehouse with proven skills in both process and equipment troubleshooting, and ability to adapt to constantly changing warehouse environments

 - Passion for employee development and enjoy the process of training and developing both new hires and veteran warehouse staff

 - Strong understanding for receiving and deployment documentation for domestic and international shipments

 - Experience supporting process development and implementing new processes

• Strong knowledge of compensation analytics, modeling, and benchmarking practices.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Dasher & Logistics Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Chicago, IL; Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Dasher & Logistics team ensures every delivery is completed with speed, accuracy, and a positive experience for consumers, merchants, and Dashers. We own the health of DoorDash’s delivery network, including supply and demand, cost and quality, Dasher pay and incentives, Dasher acquisition and retention, assignment and batching, and real-time operations.

Within Strategy & Operations, Dasher & Logistics is made up of teams that each own part of this system, such as Network Strategy, US Markets, Regulated Markets, Canada, Supply, Pay & Efficiency, and Live Ops. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to run and improve one of the largest last-mile logistics networks in the world.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations to own a meaningful part of the Dasher & Logistics network end-to-end. Depending on the team, that could be how we invest in Dasher supply, the health of every US market, our most complex regulated markets, or the delivery network for an entire country. You will be accountable for the cost-to-quality tradeoff in your area: faster, more reliable deliveries at the same cost, or the same quality at a lower cost.

You will find where the network underperforms, design and test the fix, and work with Product and Engineering to build it into how the network runs. You will make tradeoff decisions across Dasher earnings, consumer experience, merchant reliability, and unit economics, and bring clear recommendations to senior leadership. You will also build and develop a team that can take on more over time.

Success in this role means consistently delivering a faster, more reliable delivery experience while improving cost efficiency, and making changes that last because they are built into our products and operating rhythm.

You will report into a Director or Senior Director on our Dasher & Logistics team within Strategy & Operations. We expect this role to be hybrid, with some time in-office and some time remote.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Own business outcomes for your area, including delivery speed, quality, cost per delivery, and supply-demand balance, as the single DRI for those metrics in weekly business reviews and half-year planning

• Get to the lowest level of detail to diagnose where the network underperforms, by market, submarket, or zone, and explain why the metrics moved

• Manage key logistics levers, such as Dasher pay and incentives, supply programs, assignment and batching, delivery distance, and scheduling

• Design and run experiments that lead to clear decisions, then scale what works across markets

• Partner with Product, Engineering, and Analytics to turn manual wins into durable product and system changes

• Make thoughtful tradeoff decisions between cost, growth, and customer experience to protect long-term marketplace health

• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team, and grow the next set of leaders at DoorDash

• Help keep the network running smoothly during incidents, severe weather, and holidays alongside our Live Ops partners

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 8+ years of experience in strategy & operations, management consulting, finance, marketplace or logistics operations, or another analytically demanding field

• You have owned complex business areas with accountability for cost, quality, and financial results

• You are highly analytical and comfortable in the raw data, including writing SQL and building models in spreadsheets

• You use AI as a default part of how you work, building analyses, models, and prototype tools yourself to move faster

• You lead cross-functionally without formal authority and get teams that don’t report to you to adopt a shared plan

• You turn complex analysis into clear recommendations for executives, and you change course quickly when the results say you should

• You have managed and developed high-performing teams

• Bonus: experience with two- or three-sided marketplaces, gig or contractor-based labor models, last-mile delivery, or operating across markets with different regulatory dynamics

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$170,000—$250,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools: To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview.

How it works: Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support - rather than replace - human decision-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI-enabled tool  in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law.
