jobs.title: Office Administrator
jobs.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic, highly motivated individual to join our Twist Bioscience team in Wilsonville, OR. The Administrative Assistant and Office Manager will manage daily facility needs, meeting and event logistics, and visitor coordination, and will provide hands-on administrative support to operations leadership. The ideal candidate is highly organized, communicates well, and stays flexible when priorities shift quickly.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Support daily facility operations, including office supplies, housekeeping services, and meal programs.

• Provide administrative support to operations leadership.

• Coordinate catering and food services for meetings, trainings, special events, and daily onsite needs.

• Manage conference room scheduling, meeting space utilization, employee desk assignments, and general office space coordination.

• Coordinate site-wide events and employee engagement initiatives, including town halls, holiday celebrations, and company milestones, that promote a positive and connected workplace.

• Support onsite meetings, leadership and customer visits, audits, and other special events, partnering with Sales and Corporate Affairs administrators to manage guest visit logistics.

• Maintain and update the Wilsonville site pages on the company intranet.

• Provide flexible administrative and operational support for special projects and initiatives across multiple departments.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

• Bachelor’s degree or higher.

• 2+ years of experience as an administrative assistant and front desk receptionist.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to track tasks and timelines and proactively address potential risks and obstacles.

• A can-do attitude and high energy, with willingness to work flexible hours and take on last-minute, ad hoc assignments.

• Self-motivation and interest in growing your career over the long term.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

About Twist Bioscience

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care, agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel (f/m/x) - remote
jobs.description:
Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for four consecutive years.

Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions.

If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first).

We’re looking for a (Senior) Legal Counsel to join our team and be a trusted partner across the business. You’ll handle a broad and varied portfolio across our 23 European markets, from commercial contracts and consumer protection to data privacy and dispute management, and work closely with teams across the company to keep us moving fast while staying on the right side of the law.

This is a broad generalist role for someone who enjoys getting to grips with new legal topics, developing practical solutions, and recognising when specialist input is needed.

What you'll do

• Draft, review, and negotiate contracts with sellers, partners, and vendors

• Advise internal teams on legal risks and help them find practical, workable solutions

• Partner with teams across the business, including Marketing and our direct-to-consumer and B2B businesses, providing practical advice on commercial, consumer protection, and data privacy matters across our European markets.

• Support the business on new market entries, product launches, and strategic initiatives

• Own and improve our legal processes, templates, and documentation

• Work alongside external counsel when specialist expertise is needed

What you bring

• A completed law degree from an EU jurisdiction (preferably Austria or Germany), with a solid understanding of EU law. Bar admission or an equivalent professional qualification is welcome but not required.

• 3-5 years of legal experience, ideally in a fast-paced company or a mix of law firm and in-house

• You bring a solid generalist background with hands-on experience in commercial contracts and at exposure in various fields of law e.g. consumer law, data privacy law, insurance law, tax law, capital markets law. Experience in corporate law or litigation is a plus. You learn new areas quickly and know when to involve external experts.

• Fluency in English (our company language); German is a plus

• A practical, business-oriented mindset — you give clear advice, not just caveats

• The ability to work independently, prioritise well, and stay cool under pressure

Location & eligibility: This role is open to candidates based in Europe (including UK) only with a valid right to work.

WHY YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US:

Our Culture and Values:

• Decisions should be made based on facts and not by hierarchy levels? We sure think so!

• We embrace giving and receiving feedback, testing and welcoming new ideas, as well as sharing our knowledge across the company.

• You fail sometimes? Well, so do we! We’re all just human, let’s learn from our mistakes to improve in the future!

• No matter who you love, where you’re from, who you pray to, whether you pee sitting down or standing up – we are a bunch of talented people who enjoy spending our time making a difference!

Personal & Professional Development:

• You'll have access to a dedicated learning budget within your department to support your growth, whether it's courses, conferences, or other learning opportunities that matter to you.

• We partner with NiloHealth, offering you private sessions with experts for your personal growth and mental health.

• We frequently host internal workshops, allowing our teams to further develop their skills in different areas and enhancing collaboration across departments.

Flexibility:

• We care about a healthy work/life balance. We not only function and support a fully remote setting but also offer the possibility to work from our beautiful office in the vibrant heart of Vienna – we love dogs, so feel free to bring your furry little buddy too 😊

• We trust you to do the best job, so we don't care so much when you do it – you are able to self-organize.

• You will also be invited to take part in our office weeks, happening three times a year, where you will have the chance to work side by side with your colleagues and enjoy the team-building events and on-site workshops

…and much more! See https://careers.refurbed.com/ for further insights!

jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:

The New Product Verification Department is devoted to assuring safe, reliable, and effective products that exceed patient, surgeon, and hospital expectations. The department plays a vital role in product and process quality, in new product development and production, and in the quality of da Vinci and Ion robotic product lines, including diagnostic systems, endoscopic instrumentation, and supporting accessories. The engineering tech will work with a team of dedicated individuals within a product development team to assure the quality of new designs, to identify issues related to new designs and processes, and to work with other Test Engineers to develop harmonized test methods.

Roles & Responsibilities:

This position has responsibility and authority for:

Protocol Execution & Reporting

• Executes test protocols for clinically-based surgical simulation and automated testing utilizing da Vinci Surgical Systems and other test equipment
• Executes Design verification testing with guidance from the test owner
• Identifies and reports problems that arise during testing, and escalates new or persistent failure modes to appropriate engineering teams
• Provides documentation to the cognizant Test Engineer that clearly indicates the results of product testing
• Follows GDP (Good Documentation Process) when filling out test data sheets
• Performs instrument, endoscope and accessory cleaning and reprocessing
• Generates work instructions for test methods or procedures.

Other Responsibilities

• Ensures successful, on-time completion of department projects; communicates constraints to direct management when successful project completion is at risk
• Performs a broad variety of tasks in support of product verification and test process design as assigned by department management
• Complies with company Department and Standard Operating Procedures

Skills, Experience, Education, & Training:

Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to other employees, supervisors, or engineers.

• Computer skills: Ability to use MS office tools- Word, Excel as part of daily work. Ability to use on-line documentation. Ability to follow instructions to run software scripts.

Ability to multitask, and handle tasks with competing priorities effectively. Ability to work with biological samples, including blood, tissue and organs. Willingness to learn and contribute. Proactive and Self motivated.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will own ModernFi’s commercial relationships with the largest banks in the US end to end, from winning new partners to growing the revenue they generate over time. You will own the full sales cycle, from first conversation to signed deal, then lead as a revenue owner after close to drive consumption-based growth across your accounts. You’ll have impact and responsibility from day one, bringing new enterprise banks onboard and nurturing relationships that drive ModernFi’s growth.

Your work directly supports our mission to empower financial institutions with innovative deposit solutions, and it will shape the trajectory of the company and its client-focused culture. We value autonomy, ownership, and professional growth. You’ll be part of a team that combines deep expertise with a commitment to collaboration and shared learning. At ModernFi, your work matters: our products help financial institutions of all sizes better serve their customers and strengthen their communities.




THE ROLE


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Serve as the commercial owner of the largest bank accounts in the US, winning new enterprise partners and growing the consumption-based revenue they generate

 - Build trusted relationships with senior bank decision-makers and position ModernFi as a long-term partner in their deposit growth strategy

 - Lead as the revenue owner after close, driving consumption-based growth and expanding ModernFi’s footprint within each of your accounts

 - Work with Institution Success, Product, and Operations to onboard new banks smoothly and bring client feedback back to the team

 - Travels regularly to meet clients face to face, where in-person presence is key to building trust and ensuring successful outcomes

 - Keep your client databases, calendar, and CRM organized, and help establish best practices for enterprise bank engagement and revenue growth


ABOUT YOU

 - 2-4 years of sales experience, ideally as an account executive or in a similar new-business role

 - Banking or fintech experience is a plus, but not required

 - Hungry and coachable, with the drive to learn quickly and take ownership early

 - Able to build trust and relationships with bank decision-makers

 - High EQ, trustworthy, and calm under pressure

 - Based on the West Coast or NYC
   
   


ABOUT US

The caliber and character of the ModernFi team set us apart.

We value competence and drive over experience, and look for compassionate people with diverse backgrounds. We appreciate technical ability, dedication, and humble confidence. Above all, we value respect — for our colleagues, our clients, our partners, and ourselves.

Our team pushes each other to be better every day, supports each other when things go wrong, and grows together on this journey. Because we are a close-knit team, we are selective and considerate with every hire.

The people at ModernFi could be doing anything in the world, yet they choose to be here.




BENEFITS

 - Top-of-market comp, equity from day one

 - Health, dental, vision. 100% employee covered

 - 401(k) with a broad fund selection

jobs.description:

• Evaluates and deploys SI technologies for adaptive threat detection, automated triage, predictive vulnerability identification, and accelerated incident analysis to strengthen operational resilience.

• Leads continuous improvement initiatives across cybersecurity processes, developing metrics to track program health and maturity.

• Implements SI-driven performance insights, leveraging anomaly detection, process mining, and intelligent automation to identify inefficiencies, streamline workflows, and enhance operational maturity.

• Interfaces with government customers to understand, interpret, and translate cyber risk into actionable strategic and improvement plans.

• Provides guidance on integrating SI capabilities into cybersecurity modernization strategies, including risk quantification models, mission aligned automation opportunities, and secure architecture implications.

• May interface with external entities including law enforcement and intelligence/government agencies on security matters.

• Coordinates on emerging SI related threat vectors, adversarial AI considerations, and cooperative intelligence sharing regarding algorithmic vulnerabilities or model driven attack techniques.

• Communicates technical approaches and strategic findings clearly to both technical and non technical/executive audiences.

• Translates SI concepts, model outputs, and automation impacts into clear insights, enabling leaders to make informed decisions on technology adoption and cyber risk posture.

Here's what you need:

• 8–15 years of experience in systems security.

• Advanced knowledge of encryption, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, cyber forensics, intrusion detection, and incident response/remediation.

• Strong attention to detail; ability to balance multiple complex tasks simultaneously.

• Experience using or overseeing SI enabled cybersecurity tools (e.g., automated analysis platforms, ML based detection systems, security orchestration).

• Understanding of responsible AI practices, model governance, data protection requirements, and algorithmic risk considerations within federal or enterprise environments.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Financial Reporting
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

The Financial Reporting team delivers accurate, timely, and decision-useful financial information across CoreWeave’s global organization. The team oversees global consolidations, foreign currency matters, cash flow reporting, internal financial statements, and management reporting. It partners closely with Treasury, Tax, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to develop scalable reporting processes that support CoreWeave’s continued growth.

About the Role

As Senior Manager, Financial Reporting, you will own the consolidated statement of cash flows and the internal financial reporting package across CoreWeave’s global organization. This hands-on leadership role combines detailed review of supporting workpapers with resolution of complex reporting issues and coordination of inputs to deliver accurate, timely reporting through each close. Cash flow reporting will be a substantial focus, particularly during the first year and quarter-end. You will also oversee financial statement and disclosure reviews, reporting controls, and management analysis in partnership with consolidation, technical accounting, and other teams.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end consolidated statement of cash flows (SCF) and serve as the owner for ASC 230. Manage the reporting cycle; review workpapers, classifications, and noncash disclosures; reconcile to supporting schedules and financial statements; and resolve review comments with accounting teams and external auditors.

• Evaluate significant and nonstandard transactions with Technical Accounting and other subject-matter experts, documenting financial statement presentation, disclosure, and cash flow classification implications.

• Maintain the significant transaction tracker and coordinate recurring technical accounting and SCF discussions. Follow through on reporting impacts, supporting documentation, open issues, and required decisions with senior management.

• Own the financial reporting package from calendar and input coordination through consolidation of inputs, variance commentary, quality review, and timely delivery. Review the package with management, maintain consistent financial metrics, and track follow-up actions.

• Review master data and chart-of-accounts requests for financial reporting implications, and support ad hoc FP&A and systems-testing requests within agreed priorities and reporting deadlines.

• Review department and organizational changes for financial reporting implications, including financial statement line item (FSLI) classification, comparability of prior-period presentation, and disclosure impacts. Document conclusions with Finance and Technical Accounting and communicate them to senior management.

• Maintain effective financial reporting controls and review evidence and workpaper documentation. Oversee SOX evidence and key-report testing for assigned reporting processes, coordinate audit requests, and track remediation of identified issues.

• Identify and implement opportunities to enhance financial reporting through AI and automation, including cash flow workpaper preparation, variance analysis, financial statement consistency checks, and management reporting.

• Partner with Finance Systems, IT, and reporting stakeholders to evaluate, pilot, and implement AI-enabled reporting solutions. Validate outputs against source data, document review procedures, and measure improvements in reporting quality and efficiency.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• 8+ years of progressive experience in accounting, consolidation, or financial reporting.

• At least 2 years of experience managing or directly supervising accounting or financial reporting professionals.

• Experience managing monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes within a mid-sized or large organization.

• Hands-on experience performing consolidations across multiple legal entities.

• Strong U.S. GAAP knowledge, with particular depth in ASC 230, financial statement presentation and disclosures, and the effects of consolidation, foreign currency, and complex transactions on cash flow reporting.

• Working knowledge of SEC reporting requirements, including Form 10-Q and 10-K disclosures.

• Experience owning monthly financial reporting packages, including close-calendar coordination, financial statement review, variance narratives, quality checks, and communication of results to management.

• Hands-on experience owning the preparation and review of consolidated statements of cash flows in a complex organization, including supporting workpapers, noncash activity, classification judgments, and resolution of auditor comments.

• Experience analyzing financial results and preparing period-over-period variance explanations.

• Authorization to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Preferred Skills

• CPA or equivalent professional accounting certification.

• Experience working in a multinational, public-company, or similarly complex financial reporting environment.

• Experience applying AI-enabled tools, data analytics, or workflow automation to accounting and financial reporting.

• Experience implementing reporting improvements, including defining requirements, testing outputs, and supporting adoption by accounting and finance teams.

• Experience integrating newly acquired businesses or newly established legal entities into an organization’s financial reporting processes.

• Experience partnering with Finance Systems, IT, Treasury, Tax, and other cross-functional stakeholders.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

• Be Curious at Your Core

• Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $135,000 to $180,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• Voluntary supplemental life insurance

• Short and long-term disability insurance

• Flexible Spending Account

• Health Savings Account

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

• Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health

• Family-Forming support provided by Carrot

• Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside

• 401(k) with a generous employer match

• Flexible PTO

• Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations

• A casual work environment

• A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Applicants

California Consumer Privacy Act

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. jobs.title: Chief Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers’ capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.

ABOUT THE JOB

As an Integration Engineer, you will be the primary technical point of contact for multiple Rocket Motor programs. You will be responsible for guiding complex technical programs within Anduril Rocket Motor Systems. In this role you will support creation of technical plans for you assigned programs, you will also work closely with Program and Project Managers to drive execution on program deliverables. You will also serve as a technical advocate for your assigned programs within Anduril. An integration engineer will work with the product lines to leverage them against program requirements. If you are a hands-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for getting a project across the finish line, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead solid rocket motor programs from concept into production.

• Own the program—have full authority and responsibility for its execution.

• Generate technical program plans and execute to them.

• Be the “face of the program” with internal and external customers.

• Manage the day-to-day activities of an interdisciplinary technical team.

• Coordinate activities with other Anduril Rocket Motor Systems organizations outside of Engineering, such as Manufacturing Operations and Supply Chain.

• Work with Product Line leaders to ensure products are used appropriately across program efforts.

• Support growth efforts for potential new programs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A minimum of 5 years’ experience with the design, development, and manufacture of solid rocket motors.

• Strong technical background in mechanical design, internal ballistics, structural analysis, or thermal analysis.

• Strong project planning and management skills.

• Well-versed in the application of systems engineering, particularly risk management and requirements management.

• Ability to travel to other Anduril sites, customer sites, or supplier sites as business demands. Anticipated 25% travel.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Advanced degree (masters or doctorate) in engineering or engineering management.

• Experience with space propulsion, and/or orbital mechanics.

• Experience with solid works CAD software and/or Abaqus FEA software.

• Ability to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret Security Clearance.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Account Executive III (State & Federal Agency)
jobs.location: Bozeman, Montana, United States; Missoula, Montana, United States; Open to Remote
jobs.description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking an experienced Account Executive III to help grow onX for Business. In this role, you will own our larger and more complex opportunities, from first conversation through procurement, contract, and close. Your initial focus is expected to be state and federal agencies, with the flexibility to work with other segments as our strategy evolves.

This role requires a sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and is comfortable working with organizations where several stakeholders are involved in a purchase. You'll independently navigate complex sales cycles, develop account strategies, and coordinate with internal partners to address customer needs and move opportunities forward. You will collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to position onX's offline operational mapping solutions to meet customer needs. The ideal candidate has a track record of closing multi-stakeholder deals, building relationships across an organization, and hitting targets.

This position reports to the GM, onX for Business.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

• Independently manage the full sales cycle for complex opportunities, including discovery, product demonstrations, proposals, procurement, contract negotiation, and close.

• Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes, identifying decision-makers, understanding competing priorities, and building alignment throughout the sales cycle.

• Develop and execute account plans for priority organizations, identifying opportunities to expand onX adoption across teams, divisions, and regions.

• Manage renewals and expansion within assigned accounts, addressing complex customer needs and commercial considerations to support long-term account growth.

• Partner with sales leadership to align prospecting and expansion efforts with business priorities, independently adapting account approaches based on customer needs and market insights.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across customer organizations, understanding their operational challenges and positioning onX solutions to deliver value.

• Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other internal partners to navigate customer requirements, resolve obstacles, and support successful sales outcomes.

• Evaluate customer needs, deal risks, and commercial trade-offs to make informed decisions and keep opportunities moving forward, engaging leadership when appropriate.

• Identify and share customer and competitive insights, including objections, feature requests, and market trends, to inform sales approaches and potential improvements to team processes.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date pipeline and forecast information in the CRM, proactively identifying risks and adjusting plans to support sales goals.

• Support and mentor other Account Executives by sharing knowledge, providing guidance on complex sales situations, and contributing to team effectiveness.

• Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets and KPIs.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

• Five (5) or more years of B2B sales experience, with the majority of that time in a full-cycle, quota-carrying role and a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

• Proven ability to independently manage complex sales opportunities, including technical sales cycles, negotiations, and closing multi-stakeholder deals.

• Experience selling to government agencies or other organizations with formal procurement processes, including navigating bids, purchasing requirements, and contract negotiations.

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at multiple levels, navigate competing priorities, and build alignment around customer needs.

• Sound judgment and strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize opportunities, evaluate commercial trade-offs, and adapt your approach as customer needs or deal requirements evolve.

• An entrepreneurial, results-oriented mindset, with the initiative to identify opportunities, solve problems proactively, and thrive in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.

• Experience using AI tools to improve sales productivity, such as account research, prospecting, proposal preparation, or customer follow-up, with sound judgment in reviewing outputs and protecting customer information.

• Experience selling SaaS, mobile, or other technology solutions.

• A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.

• Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.

• Ability to travel quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

• Experience selling to state or federal agencies.

• Technical understanding of GIS software, data visualization, and collaborative mapping technology.

• Experience with field operations in Agriculture, Emergency Services, or Conservation Agencies.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make a base salary between $64,400 and $80,500 upon hire. The pay range will vary based on experience, skills, certifications, and education, among other factors outlined in the job description.

This role is eligible for the Sales Incentive Compensation Plan (SICP). Compensation is structured as 50% base salary and 50% target variable compensation, with total annual on-target earnings (OTE) of approximately $128,800 - $161,000. Target variable compensation is earned by achieving 100% of assigned quarterly quotas throughout the year. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and are not guaranteed.

In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with vesting schedule.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

• Competitive salaries, equity, and opportunities for growth

• Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan

• Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents

• 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%

• Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks

• Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle

• Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at PC@onxmaps.com.

Position open until filled.

#LI-Remote

At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger. By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us!

onX Maps will never ask for credit card or SSN details during the initial application process. For your digital safety, apply only through our legitimate website at onXmaps.com or directly via our LinkedIn page.

onX does not sell any Personal Information, but we may transfer employment related records to our service providers or third parties that provide business services to onX or as required by law. For more information, see our Privacy Policy.

As part of our interview process, your conversation may be recorded for documentation purposes to allow interviewers to focus fully on the discussion. Recordings are confidential and accessible only to authorized personnel. Please note, onX respects all applicable laws regarding recording consent, and you will have an opportunity to opt-out if preferred.

jobs.title: Medical Assistant-ENT Huntley Full Time Days
jobs.description:
**This is a Full Time position at 40 hours per week located at the Huntley clinic. Schedule is Monday through Friday.**

The Medical Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Medical Assistant is a member of the health care team primarily responsible for providing support to physicians, nurses, and other licensed medical staff by facilitating efficient patient flow, assisting with various patient care activities, and performing related administrative functions. The Medical Assistant is responsible for ensuring efficient patient flow through the clinic; maintaining neat, clean and safe patient care areas; promoting patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner; safeguarding patient confidentiality.

Responsibilities:

• Assures efficient patient flow through the site: Escorts patient to exam room, identifies patient with 2 identifiers and prepares patient for examination. Obtains accurate vital signs, per organization standards. Documents reason for visit and updates/confirms, allergies, smoking history and pharmacy information. Promptly informs the provider and registered nurse of any significant change in vital signs or acute symptoms. Anticipates/sets up equipment or supplies needed for visit. Cleans and prepares exam room for next patient. Responds to needs to expedite visits and maintain flow of patients and prioritize tasks accordingly.

• Assists practitioner with medical and surgical procedures in accordance with established protocols such as: Electrocardiogram (ECG), venipuncture, immunizations, setting up procedure trays, specimen collection and/or Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) waived testing as directed by Provider.

• Provides high quality care by: Prepares and stocks all exam rooms in treatment area by following established protocols for disinfecting and sterilizing equipment and instruments. Participates in environmental safety rounds. Maintains vaccine/medication inventory. Monitors and maintains equipment and instruments according to clinic guidelines. Assists in ordering supplies and correctly disposes of all expired items. Adheres to office opening and closing procedures.

• Functions as an integral part of the patient care team and promotes patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner: Accepts and performs delegated responsibilities in a positive manner. Offers assistance to others. Attends and participates in staff meetings. Communicates appropriately and effectively with patients and patient care team (in the office and on the phone)

• Performs delegated procedures common to the specialty area in a safe, effective, and efficient manner (see specialty practice addendum)

• Performs all other duties as assigned by the Supervisor or Manager

Required:

• High school diploma or GED.
• Current certification in one of the below or must have written proof of meeting candidate eligibility requirements for writing one of the five eligible certification exams (AAMA, AMT, NCCT, NHA, NRCMA)Accepted documentation:New MA Graduates within six (6) months from date of graduation from an MA Program must submit: a letter from the school or a letter from the certifying bodyNon-Certified MAs or new graduates past six (6) months from date of graduation from an MA program must submit: a letter from the certifying bodyWithin first six months of employment, will complete one of the following certifications after up to two test attempts:Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) through American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA)Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) through American Medical Technologists (AMT) orNational Certified Medical Assistant (NCMA) through the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT)Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) through the National Healthcareer Association (NHA)Nationally Registered Certified Medical Assistant (NRCMA) through the National Association for Health Professionals (NAHP)Signed acknowledgement during onboarding that certification must be attained within six (6) months, as a condition of employment
• American Heart Association accredited Basic Life Support (BLS/CPR) certification.
• Zero (0) to two (2) years’ experience in a relevant role.
• Strong computer skills.

Preferred:

• Completion of accredited Medical Assistant training program.
• One to two years of ambulatory care experience.
• Experience with electronic medical record.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

jobs.description:
About Akuna:

Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions, and automation. We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market-maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully, we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies and mathematical models.

Our Founding Partners first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Shanghai, London and Singapore.

What you’ll do as a Trading Sneak Peek Program Participant:

As a Trading Sneak Peek Program participant you will be enrolled in a crash course on the exciting world of options. You’ll learn from our dedicated trader trainers, as they introduce you to risk management, game theory, and optimal decision making. Outside the classroom, you’ll have the opportunity to apply your knowledge in real time.

Are you ready for a “sneak peek” into life as an options market maker? Does mastering the educational trading games and simulations used by our entry-level traders sound like fun? Would you like to shadow our trading desks to learn about Akuna's unique approach to acting as a global liquidity provider/market maker? If your answer is yes, our Sneak Peek Program is right for you!

jobs.title: Associate Claim Specialist
jobs.description:
Be part of something new: our Associate Claim Specialist training cohort starts January 4, 2027!

We’re excited to welcome five Associate Claim Specialists to MEMIC in a dedicated cohort, so you’ll learn alongside peers, build lasting relationships, and launch your claims career with structured support from day one. In this role, you will investigate, evaluate, and manage medical-only and low-complexity lost time claims, ensuring injured workers receive appropriate care and benefits while supporting policyholders and agents. With on-the-job training and opportunities for growth, this role is an ideal starting point for individuals seeking to develop expertise in workers’ compensation claims.

What You’ll Do

• Claims Management: Investigate, evaluate, and resolve medical-only claims and low-complexity lost time claims.

• Communication: Serve as a point of contact for insureds, injured workers, agents, brokers, attorneys, and other stakeholders to gather necessary information and provide timely updates.

• Benefit Delivery: Administer medical and indemnity benefits in compliance with state workers’ compensation statutes and MEMIC’s best practices.

• Quality Assurance: Maintain organized and high-quality claim files in accordance with company policies and procedures.

• Managed Care Coordination: Implement Managed Care strategies, coordinate rehabilitation plans, process medical bills, and monitor case progress.

• Legal & Regulatory Compliance: Interact with state and federal boards and commissions to ensure proper reserves and compliance with laws and regulations.

• Ongoing Learning: Stay updated on state laws and workers’ compensation trends through MEMIC-provided training and external certifications like WCP or Claims Law (AEI).

What You’ll Bring

• No prior experience required—MEMIC provides comprehensive on-the-job training.

• Strong attention to detail and excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word and Excel).

• Self-motivated, flexible, and capable of managing time and priorities effectively.

• Ability to collaborate and build relationships with cross-functional teams.

• Valid driver’s license required.

• Must obtain required adjuster licenses within six months of hire (or sooner as directed).

MEMIC is committed to a policy of nondiscrimination and equal opportunity for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetics, gender identity, veteran's status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Leave & Accommodation Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
The Leave & Accommodation Operations Specialist provides operational and administrative support for the U.S. Leave & Accommodation function, with primary responsibility for data reconciliation, recurring reporting, administrative processing, and coordination of information required by Payroll and Benefits for employees on leaves of absence.

This position works closely with the Senior Leave & Accommodation Specialist and cross-functional partners, including Payroll, Benefits, HRIS, onsite HR, and third-party administrators, to help ensure leave information is complete, accurate, timely, and appropriately communicated to the responsible functional teams.

An important component of the role is continuous process improvement. The Leave & Accommodation Operations Specialist will evaluate recurring administrative activities and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate manual processes, including reducing reliance on spreadsheets and duplicate data entry where practical.

The position does not make legal, compliance, benefit-plan, payroll, accommodation, or employment decisions. Matters requiring substantive interpretation or judgment are escalated to the appropriate functional owner.

Leave & Accommodation Operations Specialist Duties Include but are not Limited to the Following:

Leave & Accommodation Operations

• Maintain accurate administrative leave and accommodation information using approved systems, reports, trackers, and data sources.
• Review information received from applicable third-party administrators and internal systems and reconcile differences between source records.
• Maintain timely and accurate leave status information, including leave dates, status changes, return-to-work information, and other data necessary to support downstream processes.
• Monitor recurring administrative activities and identify incomplete, inconsistent, or missing information requiring follow-up.
• Support routine administrative workflow, reporting, ticket management, and other defined Leave & Accommodation operational processes.
• Provide backup coverage for established Leave & Accommodation administrative processes.

Payroll Reconciliation and Administrative Support

• Prepare and reconcile leave information required by Payroll to support accurate and timely pay administration for employees on leave.
• Review available leave, absence, timekeeping, disability, state-paid leave, and related information necessary for established payroll reporting processes.

Benefits Reconciliation and Administrative Support

• Support established reporting associated with benefit continuation or termination, insurance premium administration, deductions, 401(k) administration, and return-from-leave processes.
• Review information for completeness and accuracy prior to providing established reports or information to Benefits.
• Escalate benefit-plan interpretation, eligibility, coverage, or other substantive Benefits questions to the appropriate Benefits representative.

Data Quality, Controls and Reconciliation

• Perform routine quality-control reviews of leave data and administrative outputs.
• Reconcile information across approved source systems and reports and investigate differences before information is provided to downstream partners.
• Identify recurring data-quality issues, process gaps, or administrative errors and escalate issues to the appropriate functional owner.
• Maintain documentation supporting recurring administrative processes, including standard operating procedures, process instructions, checklists, and established controls.
• Support reliable administrative handoffs among Leave & Accommodation Services, Payroll, Benefits, HRIS, onsite HR, and third-party administrators.

Process Improvement and Automation

• Evaluate existing administrative processes to identify opportunities to reduce manual work, duplicate data entry, spreadsheet dependency, and unnecessary handoffs.
• Document current-state workflows, data sources, recurring activities, controls, exceptions, and pain points.
• Recommend opportunities to simplify and standardize recurring administrative processes.
• Partner with HRIS and appropriate functional stakeholders to define operational requirements for reporting, workflow, system, or automation improvements.

• Identify recurring exceptions or reconciliation problems and assist with determining their root causes.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Provide administrative backup and cross-coverage for defined Leave & Accommodation processes.
• Maintain appropriate confidentiality when handling employee and leave-related information.

Scope and Decision-Making

The Leave & Accommodation Operations Specialist performs defined administrative and operational activities in support of the Leave & Accommodation process. The role is expected to recognize when an issue falls outside established procedures and escalate the matter rather than independently making substantive employment, compliance, pay, or benefits decisions.

• Employment Compliance owns compliance interpretation, risk governance, accommodation-process support, and escalation.
• Benefits owns benefit plans and plan-specific administration and interpretation.
• Payroll owns pay administration and wage transactions.
• HRIS/Oracle owns system administration, reporting infrastructure, and employee data integrity.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (Incident Response, remote)
jobs.description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

Help turn Checkly's incident response, on-call and status pages from a young product that customers already pay for into a core part of our platform. In 2027 agents will be on call and we want to be ready for that. You'll shape what we build in 2027, build it with AI coding agents, and talk directly to the teams who use it in the middle of an incident.

The best engineering teams don't wait for users to tell them something's broken. They build resilient, reliable systems to catch it first: in the pull request, in staging, or production at 3am, before a single customer notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist.

Checkly gives developers, SRE teams and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: testing and synthetic monitoring defined as code, built on OpenTelemetry and Playwright. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

This role is about the post-mortem end of that line. We've built incident management, status pages and on-call into Checkly, and it's already bringing in revenue. Now we want to drive it strategically. Figure out together with us how to evolve incident management with clear signals and with agents being on call.

Thousands https://www.checklyhq.com/customers/ of teams, from AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai http://resolve.ai to large engineering organizations like LinkedIn, Citi and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B https://www.checklyhq.com/blog/announcing-20m-to-enable-engineers-to-detect-and-r/ funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Our stack is AI (Claude, Codex, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Go, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We don't filter on programming language. If you ship full-stack with AI, you'll pick ours up. We ship to prod all day, every day, practice Agile (not scrum), keep meetings low and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Shape a product from early stage to strategic. You'll be involved early in how we build incident response out as a platform, technically and on the product side. That means a lot of ownership, influence and visibility.

 - Build the foundation first. Incident management, status pages, on-call, and tight integration with the rest of Checkly. For at least the first six months this is solid product engineering. AI-assisted incident response comes once the foundation is in place.

 - Build and ship with AI. Coding agents are how you work: exploring solutions, scaffolding, refactoring, testing and debugging.

 - Talk to the people on call. You'll be directly involved in customer conversations. You'll learn how responders work under pressure and turn that into what we build next.

 - Find the right problems to solve. In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

 - Own your work end to end. From the first idea to rollout to how it behaves in production. You'll join the on-call and support rotations like everyone else.

 


WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

 - You've built incident management, on-call, alerting or status page products before. You know what responders need from a tool when something breaks at 3am.

 - You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

 - You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

 - You can drive a product area, not just pick up tickets. You make decisions without perfect information, and you ask for input when it counts. You have opinions about what we should build and why, and you change your mind when someone makes a better case.

 - You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

 - You share work early. Drafts, rough MVPs and half-finished docs go out for feedback before they’re polished. In an async team, that’s how good ideas get better fast.

 - FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without waiting for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, team meetups or conferences.

 


WHAT YOU WILL HATE ABOUT US

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

 - We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

 - We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

 - We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

 - We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

 - Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

 


HOW WE BUILD WITH AI

Don’t take our word for it. Here’s what that looks like in practice, written by the team:

 - Checkly and the agentic software layer https://checklyhq.com/blog/the-agentic-software-layer: Hannes on why the CLI is how agents use software, including running monitoring and incidents.

 - Your software factory stops at deploy https://checklyhq.com/blog/your-software-factory-stops-at-deploy: Stefan on what happens after deploy, when a failing check should kick off the fix.

 - We let AI agents rewrite a 92M-message-a-day service in Go https://checklyhq.com/blog/agentic-rewrite-nodejs-to-go: Eddie on porting a core service with an agent, and zero incidents.

 - Why I built my own AI agent orchestration tool https://checklyhq.com/blog/agentic-crafting-table-ai-agent-orchestration: Immanuel on running 10 to 20 coding agents at once.




BENEFITS

 - Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

 - Remote-first https://blog.checklyhq.com/we-scored-10-5-on-gitlabs-12-steps-to-better-remote-test/, flexible work hours https://app.notion.com/p/Remote-first-75c4fb08dc49400cabee6a3a9b827cc5?pvs=21, async-first https://app.notion.com/p/Async-by-default-Async-1-0-Checkly-b9dd37bec51d436bae6635ffce8c6730?pvs=21 (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture https://app.notion.com/p/Meetings-communication-transparency-b130664febf94ae9b320bd4a78370f2e?pvs=21

 - Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

 - Stock options

 - 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

 - Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

 - Co-working budget or home office setup

 - Annual company kickoffs

Find out more here https://app.notion.com/p/Benefits-Perks-ad474bec3a5d4d17bfbb43ebae3fec9c?pvs=21.

 


WHAT WE PAY

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator https://pay.checklyhq.com/ that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

 - €88k - €107k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

 - €79k - €97k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

 


APPLY

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our hiring playbook https://app.notion.com/p/Checkly-Hiring-Playbook-54bc05178d3b4118a15effe885f96d1a?pvs=21 and open-sourced our employee handbook https://app.notion.com/p/Checkly-s-Employee-Handbook-f262e36a64d641af8588a1c09bc0ff48?pvs=21. There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

jobs.description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a motivated Account Executive II to help grow onX for Business. In this role, you will manage the full sales cycle for inbound and new business opportunities, from initial outreach and discovery through proposal and close. Working within established sales processes, you'll build customer relationships, identify opportunities, and partner with sales leadership to navigate more complex deals. Your initial focus is expected to be law enforcement and public safety organizations, with the flexibility to work other segments as our strategy evolves.

This role requires a sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You will collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to connect customer needs with onX's offline operational mapping solutions. The ideal candidate has a track record of uncovering opportunities, building relationships quickly, and hitting targets.

This position reports to the GM, onX for Business.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

• Respond to and qualify inbound leads, and generate net new opportunities through outbound outreach.

• Manage the full sales cycle for assigned opportunities, including discovery, product demonstrations, proposals, quotes, and closing new business.

• Understand customer needs, communicate the value of onX solutions, and address common questions and objections throughout the sales process.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing customers, identifying opportunities to grow adoption and expand accounts.

• Manage renewals and expansion opportunities within assigned accounts, navigating routine commercial discussions and engaging sales leadership when additional support is needed.

• Execute prospecting and expansion plans in partnership with sales leadership, identifying opportunities and recommending adjustments based on customer feedback and sales results.

• Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to support customer needs, maintain continuity throughout the sales process, and contribute to a positive customer experience.

• Share customer and competitive insights, including common objections, feature requests, and emerging needs, with sales leadership, Marketing, and Product to help improve sales effectiveness.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date opportunity records, pipeline activity, and sales forecasts in the CRM.

• Proactively identify and communicate risks, obstacles, and changes in customer needs that could affect sales opportunities or account growth.

• Use AI tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness across sales activities, including prospect research, outreach preparation, and follow-up, while applying sound judgment to validate outputs and protect sensitive information.

• Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets and KPIs.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

• Two (2) or more years of B2B sales experience, with demonstrated ability to manage sales opportunities from prospecting and discovery through proposal and close. Experience in a full-cycle, quota-carrying role is preferred.

• Comfort with a high-activity sales motion, including daily outbound calls and email.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to build customer trust, understand customer needs, and clearly communicate product value.

• Experience using AI tools to improve sales productivity, such as account research, outreach preparation, or meeting follow-up, with sound judgment in reviewing outputs and protecting customer information.

• Proven success meeting and exceeding sales targets and KPIs.

• Ability to respond to objections, navigate routine negotiations, and recognize when more complex commercial discussions require additional support.

• Understanding of technical sales cycles and the ability to adapt your approach to customer needs.

• Results-oriented self-starter who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment.

• A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.

• Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.

• Ability to travel quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

• Experience selling to law enforcement, public safety, or other government customers.

• Technical understanding of GIS software, data visualization, and collaborative mapping technology.

• Experience with field operations in Emergency Services, Agriculture, or Conservation Agencies.

• Experience selling SaaS, mobile, or other technology solutions.

• A bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is a bonus.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make a base salary between $53,781 and $67,226 upon hire. The pay range will vary based on experience, skills, certifications, and education, among other factors outlined in the job description.

This role is eligible for the Sales Incentive Compensation Plan (SICP). Compensation is structured as 55% base salary and 45% target variable compensation, with total annual on-target earnings (OTE) of approximately $97,783 - $122,229. Target variable compensation is earned by achieving 100% of assigned quarterly quotas throughout the year. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and are not guaranteed.

In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with vesting schedule.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

• Competitive salaries, equity, and opportunities for growth

• Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan

• Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents

• 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%

• Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks

• Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle

• Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at PC@onxmaps.com.

Position open until filled.
