jobs.title: Superintendent (Data Center)
jobs.description:
Join the Team!

Is technology your passion? Do you want to work with smart, forward-thinking individuals? Do you want to grow in a career you love?

At Align, our professionals are the key to our success. We don’t just hire talent, we invest in exceptional people who are forward-thinking, results-driven, and passionate about what they do. We’re a group of tech-savvy professionals who are motivated by making an impact. Our culture is one of unbounded opportunity that celebrates the passions, skills and ideas of our team—work hard, play hard, be smart!

We believe great communities lead to great companies. That’s why we offer a dynamic workplace where you feel inspired, engaged and innovative. We offer professionals opportunities to train in the leading technologies, make an impact within the industry and acquire valuable new skills whether on client sites or in one of our regional offices.

Position Overview

Align is seeking an experienced Superintendent to lead day-to-day field execution for hyperscale data center white space fit-outs in colocation environments. You’ll be Align’s onsite point of contact for construction activities, coordinating subcontractors, sequencing trades, and overseeing installation quality and site safety.

The ideal candidate has construction management experience in data centers or commercial builds, with an understanding of white space infrastructure such as containment systems, overhead conveyance (including ladder racks and cable tray systems), structural support frameworks, and cooling components (HVAC). Familiarity with structured cabling systems (low voltage and fiber) is a plus.

• This is a full-time salaried position offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, paid training and performance-based bonuses.

• This position is based in the Atlanta metro area and will work onsite for local data center projects. At times approximately 50% travel outside of the Georgia area may be expected at times.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead on-site construction management for data center white space fit-out projects

• Oversee installation of: Hot aisle / cold aisle containment systems Overhead cable tray systems and ladder rack conveyance Structural support systems for cabinets, racks, cable trays, and electrical power distribution infrastructure Cooling infrastructure, including HVAC units Power distribution from PDU down to cabinet level

• Manage trade contractors and ensure proper sequencing of work (e.g., structural supports → overhead conveyance → electrical distribution → cabling → containment) to maintain schedule and avoid conflicts

• Coordinate with general contractors, subcontractors, and client stakeholders

• Enforce quality control (QC) processes to ensure installations meet design specifications, load requirements, and industry standards

• Monitor project schedule, budget, and progress; proactively identify and resolve risks/issues

• Ensure compliance with safety standards and site protocols

• Review construction drawings, submittals, RFIs, and shop drawings related to supports and overhead systems

• Verify proper installation tolerances, anchoring, and support systems for overhead infrastructure

• Support commissioning and handover processes

Required Qualifications

• 5-10+ years of construction management experience, preferably in mission-critical or data center environments

• Proven experience managing white space fit-out / tenant improvement projects in colocation or hyperscale data centers

• Strong understanding of construction sequencing, trade coordination, and site management

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple subcontractors and deliver projects on schedule

• Strong knowledge of QA/QC processes, including inspection of support systems and overhead installations

• Project Management skills including scheduling and budgeting

• Candidate must have strong problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Strong stakeholder and client communication

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with low voltage cabling (LVC) and/or fiber optic infrastructure within data centers

• Experience with Procore or a similar construction project management tool is a plus

• Working knowledge of structured cabling systems, pathways, and routing within overhead conveyance systems

• RCDD-level knowledge or experience with structured cabling design standards (e.g., setting or enforcing standards)

• Experience coordinating structural support systems with electrical and mechanical trades

• Experience in commissioning or turnover of data center white space environments

To support a fair, consistent, and high-quality hiring experience, some interviews may be recorded. These recordings help our team focus fully on the conversation at hand, rather than note-taking, and allow us to better evaluate and improve our recruitment process. Recordings are used solely for internal purposes such as training, quality assurance, and process improvement. Candidates will be informed in advance and asked to provide consent before any recording takes place.

Benefits and Perks:

At Align, we believe that supporting our employees both personally and professionally is key to our success. We offer a competitive benefits package designed to promote health, wellness, financial security, and work-life balance, including:

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

• Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options 401(k) plan with a dollar-for-dollar company match at 3% up to an annual maximum of $5k.

• Complimentary ClassPass membership to support your health and wellness goals

• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Company-paid holidays

• Cellphone Reimbursement Program

• Floating Holiday to celebrate a day that is meaningful to you

• Pre-tax commuter benefits, where applicable

• Employee wellness programs, events, and team-building activities

• Employee referral program

Align is a premier global provider of technology infrastructure solutions.

Align specializes in designing and deploying technology infrastructure solutions from the data center to the desktop as well as providing managed IT services for clients.

Our professional services team, which includes Data Center Solutions, provide strategic consulting, design, project management, engineering, implementation and support. Our best-in-class Managed Services team provides IT services and cybersecurity advisory for clients within the Alternative Investment industry. Align is a Microsoft Tier 1 Cloud Solutions Provider (CSP) and Gold Partner.

Our client centric approach and passion for driving IT innovation has enabled us to provide tailored solutions and business transformations for over three decades. Leading firms have relied on Align to provide forward-thinking technology strategies that support their current and future business needs.

Our teams have flawless track records of delivering technical solutions and have established long-standing relationships with an impressive client list of both Global 1000 and SMB clients. We work across a diverse list of industries including financial services, life sciences (pharmaceutical and health care), retail, technology, media and telecommunications.

For more information, visit: www.align.com

jobs.title: Leasing Manager

You are responsible for achieving and exceeding monthly sales quotas and contributes to meeting the property’s targeted resident retention goal by providing remarkable customer service. As a Leasing Manager, your primary responsibilities include:

• Motivate, train and lead sales and service team to reach leasing goals

• Administrative duties as assigned.

• 1-3 years of phone sales experience

• 1-3 years of customer service experience

• Industry experience highly desired

• A customer-focused mentality

• Sales aptitude

This position is eligible for additional bonus opportunities.

Salary Range

$60,000—$62,830 USD

• Paid leave. We provide 20 days of paid time off plus holidays.

• Retirement planning. We offer a 401k program with a company match.

• Tuition reimbursement. Plus, many other programs to support career development and growth.

jobs.title: Account Executive (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Purpose of Position

This is a fantastic opportunity for a confident and motivated individual to play an integral role in the fast paced and rewarding environment of account management. If you are enthusiastic about affiliate marketing, this is a great chance to further develop your program management skills and gain valuable experience while working with a wide range of brands on the platform in the US.

As an Account Executive, you will act as the main point of contact for assigned accounts, implementing affiliate strategies to continually grow and optimize your portfolio.

Key Tasks

• Assume ownership and serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, providing training, guidance, and ongoing support in line with each client’s agreed service level.

• Implement program management strategies designed to produce a successful affiliate program, meeting a client’s objectives and goals.

• Work independently to produce all necessary account management documentation and deliver regular reports on assigned programs.

• Proactively recruit new affiliates across the portfolio and project manage affiliate migrations in collaboration with clients and publisher team while building a working relationship with top 50 affiliates on network.

• Familiarize yourself with industry trends and Awin products to inform program management, while keeping clients informed of relevant information.

• Regularly leverage & utilize the Awin platform and third-party tools (i.e. Tableau, PowerBI, SimilarWeb, etc.) in support of account management deliverables for assigned clients and in support of wider network activities.

• Monitor affiliate program performance to ensure network compliance and program health

• Take a proactive approach in solving issues with assigned clients, escalating issues to the appropriate team level when necessary.

• Communicate effectively and professionally with clients, publishers, vendors and internal teams via email, phone and face-to-face.

• Provide support to all team members when necessary and be a reference point of knowledge and expertise for more junior members of the team

Skills & Experience

• Minimum 1+ years’ account management experience in an affiliate marketing or related role

• Knowledge of the affiliate marketing industry, including commission models, tracking solutions and various affiliate types.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong time management skills with the ability to be flexible and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

• Fast learner with strong team orientation and a positive, can-do attitude

• Accepts and seeks out ownership and accountability of work

• Proficiency with MS Office suite, specifically Excel and Powerpoint and willingness to learn new technology systems

Our Offer

• Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.

• Flexi-Office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid working model, designed to foster collaboration, trust, and autonomy.

• Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace at home.

• Medical & Life Insurance: Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage, along with life insurance protection for you and your family. We offer comprehensive premiums for health (CareFirst BlueCross BlueShield of Maryland), dental, and vision which are 100% covered for the employee and 50% for spouses with eligibility on the first of the month after hire date.

• 401(k): We contribute regularly to support your long-term retirement savings.

• Paid Vacation & Time Off: Competitive personal time off as well as sick days. We also offer a variety of different paid special leaves as well as various maternity/paternity for expecting parents

In addition, you’ll benefit from our global offering, including health and wellbeing initiatives, learning and development via Awin Academy, and peer-to-peer recognition programmes.

Compensation Range: $51,000 - $56,000/annually

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. Learn more at axelspringer.com/en/, and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why

Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.

jobs.title: Director, Distribution & Transportation
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

Getting the right product to the right place — on time, complete and undamaged — is how we keep our promises to customers. As Director, Distribution & Transportation for our Security business, you'll own the strategy behind that promise: the multi-site distribution network, the carrier partnerships, and the long-term direction of how we move product.

This is a seat with real scope. You'll lead the team that runs the network, sit at the table with commercial and operations leaders, and own the service performance our customers feel every day.

Position location – This will be a hybrid-based position within driving distance of the following location: Deerfield, IL. (Flexibility to work from home Mondays and Fridays.)

RESPONSIBLIITIES:

• Establish and execute the distribution, transportation, and network strategy for the Security business, aligning logistics capabilities with growth objectives, customer expectations, and operational requirements.
• Lead a multi-site distribution network, ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations across all facilities in North America.
• Own end-to-end transportation strategy, including carrier selection, contract negotiations, rate management, and ongoing performance oversight.
• Develop and optimize the transportation and distribution network to improve service levels, reduce costs, enhance scalability, and support evolving business needs.
• Deliver best-in-class customer service performance through reliable on-time, in-full, and damage-free delivery execution.
• Partner closely with Commercial, Operations, Manufacturing, Customer Service, Procurement, and Supply Chain leadership to drive cross-functional initiatives and business results.
• Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including service, cost, inventory flow, transportation efficiency, carrier performance, and warehouse productivity.
• Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives leveraging Lean, Six Sigma, and supply chain best practices to drive operational excellence.
• Lead annual logistics and transportation planning processes, including budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
• Manage third-party logistics providers (3PLs), warehouse partners, and transportation vendors to ensure performance expectations and contractual obligations are met.
• Evaluate emerging technologies, systems, and automation opportunities that enhance visibility, productivity, and customer experience across the distribution network.
• Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing team, creating organizational capability, succession plans, and career development opportunities.
• Ensure compliance with all applicable transportation, safety, regulatory, and environmental requirements.
• Provide executive-level reporting and recommendations regarding network performance, strategic opportunities, risks, and investment priorities.
• Set the distribution and logistics strategy for the Outdoors business and shape its long-term direction.

• 10+ years of leadership experience across transportation, logistics or supply chain.
• A bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Finance, Business Administration, Marketing or a related field — or equivalent experience. MBA preferred.
• Demonstrated success leading a multi-site distribution network.
• Experience managing carrier relationships, including negotiations and performance management.
• A track record of leading teams, influencing stakeholders and driving cross-functional initiatives.
• Accountability for service metrics — on-time, in-full and damage-free delivery.
• Willingness and ability to travel up to 30%.

Fortune Brands Innovations (NYSE: FBIN) is an industry-leading home, security and digital products company with a portfolio of trusted brands, including Moen, House of Rohl, Therma-Tru, Larson, Master Lock, Yale residential, and Sentry Safe.

We are building a company that is determined to win, and we are clear about how: strong brands, great people, and disciplined execution.

You'll join a team that puts customers first, keeps its commitments, and cuts through complexity to deliver meaningful results.

If you're looking for an opportunity to make an impact and help shape what's next for our iconic brands, we'd love to meet you. Apply now.

Explore life at Fortune Brands here.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Fortune Brands believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is Hiring Pay Range: $140,000 USD - $220,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based sales incentive plan.

At Fortune Brands, we support the overall health and wellness of our associates by offering comprehensive, competitive benefits that prioritize all aspects of wellbeing and provide flexibility for our teammates’ unique needs. This includes robust health plans, a market-leading 401(k) program with a company contribution, product discounts, flexible time off benefits, adoption benefits, and more. We offer numerous ERGs (Employee Resource Groups) to foster a sense of belonging for all associates.

Fortune Brands is built on industry-leading brands and innovation within the high-growth categories of water, outdoors and security. The Company makes innovative products for residential and commercial environments, with a growing focus on digital solutions and products that add luxury, contribute to safety and enhance sustainability. To learn more, visit our website at fbin.com.

jobs.title: Receptionist
jobs.description:
As our Rockstar Receptionist, you'll be the maestro of our front-office symphony, orchestrating a harmonious workplace that keeps our organization humming along. • Welcome committee extraordinaire: Greet, direct, and dazzle residents, staff, and visitors with your charm and helpfulness
